name: Waste - Permit for Collectors, Transporters, Dealers, and Brokers
description: This service provides permits for businesses that collect, transport, trade, or broker waste materials in Berlin.
eligibility: Professional competence: The responsible person must possess the required technical expertise and be able to provide proof. Business registration: Your business must be registered. Reliability: The owner and the person responsible for managing and overseeing the business must be suitable based on their personal characteristics, conduct, and abilities to properly fulfill their duties (§ 3 AbfAEV).
requiredDocuments: Application form for the permit (Formular für den Erlaubnisantrag)
Business registration (Gewerbeanmeldung)
Extract from the commercial register (Auszug aus dem Handelsregister)
Information from the commercial central register (Auskunft aus dem Gewerbezentralregister) — must not be older than 3 months; not required for sole proprietors

Proof of vehicle liability insurance including environmental liability insurance — must cover personal injuries of at least €7.5 million and property and water damage of at least €3 million; applies only to collectors and transporters
Proof of business liability insurance and environmental liability insurance — only required if interim storage or other activities not related to vehicle use are to be conducted

Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) — required for the business owner, legal representative, authorized partner, managing director, and person responsible for managing and overseeing the business; must not be older than 3 months and must be provided in original

Personal information from the commercial central register (Personenbezogene Auskunft aus dem Gewerbezentralregister) — required for the business owner, legal representative, authorized partner, managing director, and person responsible for managing and overseeing the business; must not be older than 3 months and must be provided in original
Proof of technical competence (Nachweis der Fachkunde) — demonstrated through a certificate of participation in an officially recognized training course; must be resubmitted every 3 years
fees: Decision on issuing a transport permit: €250.00–€5,000.00; Decision on substantial changes to permit-relevant circumstances: €50.00–€5,000.00; Decision on a content-limited or time-limited transport permit upon request: €50.00–€5,000.00
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: For permits for collectors, transporters, dealers, and brokers of hazardous waste with headquarters in Berlin, the Senate Department for the Environment, Transport and Climate Protection (SenUVK), Division IX B 3 is responsible.

name: Register Waste Collections for Non-Profit and Commercial Purposes
description: A service for registering commercial and non-profit waste collection activities in Berlin, subject to reliability checks and proper disposal verification.
eligibility: No public interests must oppose the collection; commercial collections may be prohibited if overriding public interests exist. Collectors must provide evidence that waste disposal is safe and compliant with regulations. The collector must be reliable—collections may be prohibited if facts raise concerns about the collector's reliability. Collections must be registered at least three months before they begin.
requiredDocuments: Notification form for commercial and non-profit waste collections in Berlin (available under "Forms"); the notification may also be submitted informally
Notification forms from other German federal states are also accepted
Company information: size and organization (company name, address, phone number, manager's name, non-profit status yes/no; legal form, number of employees, activities in other federal states)

Collection information: details on type, extent, duration, and location of collection—start date (attach business registration), type (house collection, container collection, other), frequency, collection area, planned duration
Information on waste to be recycled: type, quantity, and destination of waste—name of waste fractions, expected collection quantities, destination (sorting facility, export, direct distribution)

Information on recycling and recycling pathways: description of recycling pathways including assurance of recycling capacity; documentation must include names of recycling companies, permits/capacities of disposal facilities, contracts with recycling companies, certificates from recycling companies, or other documentation proving safe recycling
processingTime: Not stated on the page—check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page—check the official page for details.

name: Information on Towed Vehicles
description: This service provides information and details about vehicles that have been towed or impounded.
eligibility: No eligibility requirements.
requiredDocuments: Identity document: national ID card, passport, or passport replacement documents for foreign nationals
Receipt number/file number or notice from the traffic fine office
fees: No fee for information requests; maximum 225.00 Euro for relocation of vehicles up to 3.5 tonnes (e.g., cars), depending on type of relocation; maximum 565.00 Euro for relocation of vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, depending on type of relocation.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Information and Inquiry Office: telephone information available at (030) 4664-709800

name: Picking Up an Impounded Vehicle
description: This service allows vehicle owners to retrieve their vehicle that has been towed and impounded by Berlin authorities.
eligibility: Your vehicle has been towed and impounded. For information about relocated or impounded vehicles and the new location, contact the information and search office at (030) 4664-709800. A release certificate from the responsible police department or state prosecutor's office must be obtained in writing before your vehicle can be handed over; bring this to your appointment. If your vehicle is not roadworthy or has been classified as unsafe following technical inspection, you must arrange and pay for a suitable tow truck.
requiredDocuments: Identity document (passport, national ID card, or travel document for foreign nationals)
Release certificate from the responsible police department or state prosecutor's office
fees: No fee for the pickup itself. Fees may apply for vehicle impound storage, which are charged separately or registered to the case if they have been incurred.
processingTime: Approximately 40 minutes for vehicle pickup at the Biesdorf impound facility.

bookingInfo.office: The impound facility where the vehicle is being held is responsible for processing the pickup.

name: Deregistration of a Residence
description: This service allows you to deregister your residence with the Berlin registration authority.
eligibility: No eligibility restrictions.
requiredDocuments: Deregistration form (Abmeldung bei der Meldebehörde) — available under 'Forms' section, completed and submitted to a Berlin citizen office (Bürgeramt) by mail or in person
Copy of your ID card (Personalausweis) or passport
Additional registration forms if deregistering more than 3 persons
processingTime: If submitted in person at a citizen office (Bürgeramt), the deregistration will be processed on the same day.

bookingInfo.office: Available at all Berlin citizen offices (Bürgerämter). Special responsibility for refugees from Ukraine, asylum applicants, persons with toleration status or border crossing certificates from all of Berlin, and for collective registrations and deregistrations for accommodation facilities in Berlin.

name: Appointment of Guardian for Absent Person (Abwesenheitspfleger)
description: This service allows you to request the court-appointed guardianship of a legally adult person whose whereabouts are unknown to manage their property affairs when necessary.
eligibility: The service requires that an adult person involved in the property matter has an unknown whereabouts (not just unknown to the applicant), and that regulating the property affairs is necessary and in the interest of care.
requiredDocuments: Written application
Justification describing the property matter and the need for guardianship
Documentation of your own attempts to locate the adult person (e.g., inquiries with the State Residents Office or Registry Office)
fees: The court charges costs for conducting the guardianship, plus compensation for the guardian's activities.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court (guardianship court) having jurisdiction in the district where the property matter needs to be regulated is responsible.

name: Recognition of Child Adoption Under 18 Years from Abroad
description: This service enables recognition of a foreign adoption of a child under 18 years old through the Berlin family court.
eligibility: The child must have been under 18 years old at the time of adoption. You must submit a written, informal application to the competent family court containing the following information: name, address, date of birth, and nationality of the child and adoptive parents; and the date of adoption.
requiredDocuments: Foreign adoption decision
Child's birth certificate or foundling certificate with information about biological parents
Consent of biological parents to adoption (if no foundling certificate is provided)

Notarially certified copies of adoption decision, birth certificate, and parental consent, each with apostille (or legalization by German embassy or consulate) and certified translation by sworn translator
Documents showing child's origins and life history prior to adoption (unless adopting stepchild)
Social reports about adoptive child and adoptive parents (if prepared prior to adoption)
Suitability reports about adoptive parents (if prepared prior to adoption)
Information and evidence regarding involvement of adoption mediation agency, including address and website
Personal signed statement describing the foreign adoption procedure and, unless stepchild adoption, circumstances of child selection
Cost statement listing all costs and payments for the adoption procedure with payment recipients named
Proof of marital status (marriage certificate or registered partnership certificate in copy)
Proof of service authorization for parties without permanent residence in Germany
Certified translations into German of essential foreign language documents (adoption decision, birth certificate, parental consent); additional translations may be requested as needed
Copies of passports of adoptive parents and child
fees: €240.00 court fees; potentially additional costs, e.g., for service of documents
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Amtsgericht Schöneberg (Family Court) has jurisdiction locally and internationally if either the adoptive parents or the child reside in the jurisdiction of the Kammergericht, or otherwise only if no other German family court has jurisdiction because all parties reside abroad and at least one possesses German citizenship.

name: Adoption Mediation - Counseling and Support
description: This service provides counseling, mediation, and accompaniment for individuals or couples seeking to adopt children domestically or internationally, or pursuing stepchild or relative adoption, as well as origin search services for adoptees.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by adoption type. For domestic adoption: main residence in Berlin, minimum age 21 and 25 years, application for suitability assessment, proof of marriage or registered civil partnership. For international adoption: main residence in Berlin, minimum age 25 years, application to a free-standing provider or the Central Adoption Office Berlin-Brandenburg (ZABB), suitability assessment order from international placement agency or ZABB, proof of marriage or registered civil partnership. For stepchild adoption: proof of marriage, 4 years of partnership or shared parenting of a child, mandatory counseling before notarial declaration or family court application. For origin search: main residence in Berlin or adoption mediation through the Adoption Mediation Office of the Senate Department for Education, Youth and Family. For relative adoption: main residence in Berlin.
requiredDocuments: Identity document - copy of passport or ID card
Data protection declaration (GDPR-EU) per GDPR-EU §§ 13 and 14 regarding processing activities, adoption mediation and origin search
Application form for suitability assessment
Birth certificate
Marriage certificate or registered civil partnership entry
Life report
Extended police clearance certificate
Medical certificate
Credit report (Schufa)
Registration certificate
Proof of nationality
Placement authorization to Senate Department for Education, Youth and Family (for child release)
Child's birth certificate (for child release)
Informal application for file access / right to file access from age 16 onwards (for origin search)
fees: €1,300.00 for general suitability assessment for international adoption
processingTime: No fixed deadline is specified. For domestic adoption applicants: initial consultation is non-binding; after submitting a suitability assessment application, expect a waiting period of several months before further interviews. After multiple interviews and a home visit, the adoption mediation office decides on suitability, with no legally binding timeframe and no legal entitlement to child placement even after successful suitability assessment.

bookingInfo.office: Adoption Mediation Office of the Senate Department for Education, Youth and Family, which handles adoption mediation tasks for all youth offices in the twelve Berlin districts and is staffed exclusively by certified adoption specialists.

name: Address Change in Vehicle Registration Certificate Part I (ZBI)
description: This service allows vehicle owners registered in Berlin to update their address on their vehicle registration certificate Part I (registration document).
eligibility: Vehicle must already be registered in Berlin; the registered owner must not be exempt from mandatory insurance under § 2 Abs. 1 of the Insurance Act; the vehicle must not be exempt from registration under § 3 Abs. 3 of the Vehicle Registration Ordinance; the address change must have been completed in advance at the citizen's office; for legal entities, the address change must have been registered in the commercial register or with the business registration office; for online application, the registration certificate Part I must be provided with a security code to be released; for online application, online identification function is required (you need: your identity card or residence permit with activated online identification function (eID) and six-digit PIN, an external card reader or modern smartphone with Android or iOS, and the software such as AusweisApp); for online application, consent to electronic payment method is required (payment methods available: credit card (Visa, Mastercard) or PayPal).
requiredDocuments: Application for address change in registration certificate Part I (ZBI) — available online or in person
Registration certificate Part I / vehicle registration document with security code (for online application)
Identity card or passport and registration confirmation (or officially certified copy)
Power of attorney if applicable (informal or notarial), including identity documents of the authorizing person and authorized person
Registration certificate Part II / vehicle title document if new vehicle documents have not yet been issued and space on the vehicle registration document is insufficient for another address

For legal entities: commercial register, association register, or partnership register extract (original or copy); identity documents of management or authorized representatives (copy); business registration or re-registration (original or copy) or rental contract for the new address (original or copy); power of attorney on company letterhead with legally binding signature if applicable

For associations: business re-registration (original or copy) or current commercial register extract with identity documents of authorized representatives; or name and address of the association, extract from the association register (original or copy), and identity documents of authorized representatives
fees: €8.43 for online application; €11.40 for change at a citizen's office; €12.60 for change at the vehicle registration authority
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: State Office for Citizens' and Administrative Affairs (LABO): for reissuance of registration certificate Part I if space for another address is insufficient; Citizen's office (Bürgeramt): for address changes to vehicle registration document/registration certificate Part I. Additional appointments are released daily within available capacity; regular checking of the appointment booking system is recommended.

name: Request Access to Foreign Nationals File and Naturalization File - for Attorneys
description: Licensed attorneys can request access to the foreign nationals file or naturalization file of individuals with Berlin residency connections.
eligibility: You must be an authorized attorney (Rechtsanwalt/Rechtsanwältin); the State Office for Immigration (Landesamt für Einwanderung) must have jurisdiction; the foreign national must have their place of residence in Berlin or must have last resided in Berlin before leaving Germany; for online applications, you must consent to electronic payment (accepted methods: Visa, Mastercard, PayPal).
requiredDocuments: Application for access to foreign nationals file or naturalization file (online submission available)
Power of attorney (Vollmacht) for all persons for whom file access is requested, with the subject matter of the proceedings specified
Current residence document number if known (e.g., residence permit, visa, fictional certificate)
Foreign nationals central register number (AZR-Nummer) if known
Case reference number from the State Office for Immigration if known
Documents and evidence for online upload in PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG format (total file size not exceeding 30 MB; individual files not exceeding 5 MB each)
fees: €11.00 per file for which access is requested
processingTime: A few days

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Access to Severe Disability File
description: A service that allows individuals to request access to their records held in the severe disability file at the Berlin social welfare office.
eligibility: Advance appointment required. Please arrange your appointment in writing or by email.
requiredDocuments: Valid ID card, passport, or other official photo ID document for identity verification
Power of attorney or guardian certificate (required if another person is requesting access to the file on your behalf)
fees: No fee for access; €0.50 per page for photocopies
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the Berlin Versorgungsamt (Social Welfare Office for War Victims and the Disabled).

name: Age and Marriage Anniversaries
description: A service to report and receive recognition for age milestones and wedding anniversaries for Berlin residents.
eligibility: Age milestone or wedding anniversary; notification of wedding anniversary (if applicable, by relatives or third parties) to the competent Social Services office; residence in Berlin with official resident registration
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service can be accessed at the Social Services office (Amt für Soziales) of your residential district.

name: Disposal of Illegally Dumped Paper Waste
description: This service allows residents to report and arrange for the disposal of illegally dumped paper waste by notifying the responsible authority.
eligibility: Report of illegal waste by telephone, in writing, or electronically
requiredDocuments: Complaint containing the following information: location and time; volume; perpetrator (if known); personal data of the person reporting
fees: Free of charge (may be chargeable to the perpetrator if identified)
processingTime: Up to 7 days for public street areas

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Official Guardianship and Custodianship — Youth Office (Amtsvormundschaft - Amtspflegschaft - Jugendamt)
description: This service appoints the Youth Office as official guardian or custodian of a minor child following a family court decision or when the mother is under the age of majority.
eligibility: Your child is a minor; there is a family court decision ordering guardianship or custodianship, OR the mother is a minor (in which case legal guardianship is automatically established at the child's birth).
requiredDocuments: Birth notification of the child
Family court decision
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Youth Office of the district where the child has their usual residence. For legal guardianship where the mother is a minor, the Youth Office of the district where the mother has her usual residence.

name: Change/Transfer of Primary Residence
description: A service to change or transfer your primary residence registration if you are registered for multiple residences in Germany and your new primary or sole residence will be in Berlin.
eligibility: You are registered for multiple residences in Germany; your new primary residence or sole residence will be located in Berlin in the future.
requiredDocuments: Identity document: For all family members when submitting the declaration, you need identity documents as available: German ID card, passport, children's passport for German citizens, or national passport or passport replacement documents for foreign nationals.
Declaration of primary residence change: Required if you are not giving up any of your registered residences.
Deregistration from the registration office: Only required if you are giving up your previous primary residence.
fees: None (also applies to receiving confirmation of the registered change)
processingTime: Changes/transfers of primary residence can generally be processed and completed immediately.

bookingInfo.office: Available at all Berlin citizen offices (Bürgerämter); Responsible for Ukrainian refugees, asylum seekers, persons with toleration status, and persons with border crossing certificates from all of Berlin; Responsible for collective registrations and collective deregistrations for accommodation facilities in Berlin.

name: Application for Recognition as an Adult Education Institution
description: This service allows non-profit organizations in Berlin to apply for official recognition as adult education institutions under Berlin law.
eligibility: The applicant must be a non-profit legal entity (such as a non-profit GmbH, registered association, foundation, or public institution) with tax-exempt status, headquartered in Berlin with educational activities in Berlin. The organization must offer adult education outside of vocational training, have conducted adult education programs in the three years prior to application, employ qualified personnel for program development and implementation (or operate exclusively with volunteers), provide publicly accessible educational offerings, and maintain quality assurance mechanisms appropriate to its size.
requiredDocuments: Application for recognition as an adult education institution using the online process
Articles of association, partnership agreement, founding law, or equivalent documentation appropriate to the organization's legal form
Current register extract from the relevant registry (e.g., commercial register, association register, foundation register, or similar)
Proof of non-profit status, such as a copy of the current tax exemption certificate from the competent tax office
Annual reports, activity reports, and program offerings from the three years prior to the application year, demonstrating past adult education activities and future plans
Anonymized staffing plan showing personnel qualifications (not required if exclusively volunteer-staffed)

Quality assurance documentation: certified quality management system (e.g., AZAV, LQW, ISO 9000) if more than ten full-time employees, or quality management concept description if more than ten full-time employees without certification, or description of quality assurance instruments if up to ten full-time employees
processingTime: Approximately 3 months, provided all required documents are complete

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Recognition as a Farrier (Hufbeschlagschmied/in) — Examination Completed in Berlin
description: This service allows individuals who have successfully passed the state examination for farrier (horseshoeing specialist) in Berlin to apply for official government recognition of their qualification.
eligibility: Successfully completed state examination as a farrier (Hufbeschlagschmiedin / Hufbeschlagschmied)
requiredDocuments: Application for state recognition
Valid identity card (Personalausweis) or passport

Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) type '0' (for submission to a government authority), to be sent directly by the Federal Office of Justice (Bundesamt für Justiz) to the LAGeSo; the certificate must not be older than three months at the time of application
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Application for Recognition as Fire Protection Engineer
description: This service allows qualified professionals to obtain official recognition as a fire protection engineer in Berlin, enabling them to conduct independent fire safety assessments and certifications for building projects.
eligibility: Applicants must demonstrate personal suitability and the ability to hold public office; master the German language in speech and writing; have a clean criminal record; maintain a business location or workplace in Berlin and work as a freelancer, representative, manager of an engineering firm, or professor in a secondary capacity; hold a completed degree in architecture, building construction, civil engineering, or a fire protection-focused program from a German university, or equivalent qualification from a foreign institution, or completion of fire service technical training; and have at least five years of professional experience in fire protection planning and execution of buildings, particularly specialized structures with high fire protection technical complexity, or their inspection.
requiredDocuments: Completed application form for recognition as fire protection engineer
Curriculum vitae with complete documentation of professional development up to the time of application
Copies of degree certificates and employment references, as well as diploma, bachelor's or master's degree documents
Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) for submission to authorities (type O), not older than 3 months, or equivalent document
Information regarding any unsuccessful recognition procedures conducted in other states

Reference list of ten specialized building projects of different types with high fire protection technical complexity from independently prepared fire protection assessments completed in the last ten years

Copy of tax registration or commercial register extract or excerpt of articles of association; information on the number of employed engineers in the office and how many of them are to be deployed for inspection work upon recognition; information on any branch offices; information on any shareholdings in companies whose purpose is planning or execution of construction projects
Declaration that professional work is conducted independently and without outside influence
Declaration that required insurance coverage will be available in the event of recognition
Certificate from the examination committee (arranged by the recognition authority)
fees: €600.00 recognition fee; €1,200.00 to €2,900.00 for examination committee costs
processingTime: Approximately 1.5 to 2 years

bookingInfo.office: Recognition Authority for Fire Protection Engineers: Senate Department for Urban Development, Building and Housing, Supreme Building Supervision - Building Technology Division

name: Application for Recognition as a Structural Safety Engineer (Prüfingenieur/in für Standsicherheit)
description: This service allows qualified civil engineers with substantial professional experience in structural safety assessments to apply for official recognition as a structural safety engineer in Berlin.
eligibility: Applicants must be personally suitable and capable of holding public office; have proficiency in German (spoken and written); have a clean criminal record; have a business location/workplace in Berlin working as a freelancer, legal representative, managing director of an engineering firm, or professor in a secondary role; hold a completed degree in civil engineering from a German university or equivalent foreign degree; have at least ten years of full-time professional experience in preparing structural safety assessments, technical construction management, or comparable activities, including at least five years preparing structural safety assessments for above-average complex structures with a broad range of different load-bearing systems and at least one year in technical construction management.
requiredDocuments: Completed application form
Curriculum vitae with complete details of professional development up to the time of application
Copies of diploma/degree certificates and employment references, as well as copies of diploma, bachelor's, or master's degree documents
Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) for submission to a government authority (form type O), not older than 3 months, or equivalent document
Information on unsuccessful recognition procedures in other countries
Reference list of structural safety assessments independently prepared in the last ten years, demonstrating at least five years' experience with above-average complex structures
Detailed description of six selected structurally and constructively difficult reference projects
Evidence of at least one year of technical construction management experience
Copy of tax registration with finance office, or commercial register extract, or company partnership agreement extract
Details on the number of employed engineers in the office and how many would be deployed for inspections if recognition is granted
Details on any branch offices
Details on any shareholdings in companies whose purpose is planning or carrying out construction projects
Declaration that professional activities are conducted independently and with full responsibility
Declaration that required insurance coverage will be available in case of recognition
Certificate from the examination committee (to be arranged by the recognition authority)
fees: 600.00 euros recognition fee; 800.00 to 2,200.00 euros for examination committee expenses
processingTime: Approximately 1.5 to 2 years

bookingInfo.office: Recognition Authority for Structural Safety Engineers: Senate Department for Urban Development and Housing, Supreme Building Supervision - Technical Building Division

name: Apply for Recognition as Certified Expert (Erd- und Grundbau)
description: This service grants official recognition as a certified expert for soil and foundation engineering in Berlin, subject to meeting education, experience, and personal suitability requirements.
eligibility: Personal suitability: German language proficiency (spoken and written); criminal record clearance. Business location and status: business premises/workplace located in Berlin; work conducted on a freelance basis for own account or as an employed worker without directive authority. Education: completed degree in civil engineering, geotechnics, or engineering geology from a German university, or equivalent degree from a foreign university. Professional experience: minimum nine years working in construction, of which at least three years full-time; preparation and assessment of structural stability reports in soil and foundation engineering.
requiredDocuments: Application for recognition as certified expert (Erd- und Grundbau): submit completed application form with questionnaire in writing by post
Curriculum vitae: comprehensive list of professional development up to the time of application
Degree and employment certificates: copies of degree and employment certificates as well as diploma, bachelor, or master diploma
Certificate of conduct: proof of application for a certificate of conduct for submission to a government agency (form type O), not older than 3 months, or equivalent document

Evidence of independence and autonomy: copy of tax office registration or employer declaration that expert assessment work is conducted free from directives; information on any branch offices; information on any participation in a company whose purpose is planning or implementation of construction projects
Professional experience documentation: list of soil investigation reports prepared in the last two years, of which at least ten reports must demonstrate mastery of above-average tasks
Additional information and declarations: recognition procedures in other countries; declaration that required insurance coverage will be available in case of recognition
Technical qualification documentation: technical expert report from the Federal Chamber of Engineers (initiated by the recognition authority)
fees: 500.00 euros recognition fee; 1,500.00 euros for preparation of expert report
processingTime: 9 months

bookingInfo.office: The recognition authority for certified experts for testing technical systems is the Senate Department for Urban Development and Housing, Supreme Building Authority.

name: Application for Recognition as Certified Inspector for Technical Systems Testing
description: This service allows qualified engineers to apply for official recognition in Berlin as a certified inspector for technical systems testing.
eligibility: Personal suitability with proficiency in German language (spoken and written); criminal record clearance; place of business/work in Berlin; activity conducted on a freelance basis on own account or as an employee without instruction authority; completed engineering degree from a German university or equivalent degree from a foreign university; minimum five years of full-time professional activity in the requested field of expertise; minimum two years of participation in safety-critical system inspections.
requiredDocuments: Completed application form with accompanying questionnaire for recognition as a certified inspector for technical systems testing
Curriculum vitae with complete information about professional development up to the time of application
Copies of degree certificates and employment certificates, as well as diploma, bachelor's, or master's degree documents

Certificate of good conduct (Führungszeugnis) - evidence of application for certificate of good conduct for submission to an authority (document type O), not older than 3 months, or equivalent document
Copy of tax registration with tax office or employer declaration confirming that inspector activities are performed without instruction
Information about any branch offices
Information about any shareholdings in a company whose purpose is planning or executing construction projects
List of projects handled in the last five years
List of systems/facilities for which participation in inspections was provided
Information about any unsuccessful recognition procedures in other federal states
Declaration that required insurance coverage will be available if recognition is granted
Declaration that necessary equipment and tools for conducting inspections are available
Technical expert report (arranged by the recognition authority)
fees: Recognition fee: €500.00; Cost for technical expert report: €420.00 to €1,600.00
processingTime: Approximately 9 months

bookingInfo.office: Recognition Authority for Certified Inspectors for Technical Systems Testing: Senate Department for Urban Development, Building and Housing, Senior Building Supervision (Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen, Oberste Bauaufsicht)

name: Request Recognition as Dog Expert (Sachverständige Person)
description: Apply to be officially recognized as a qualified expert in dog matters (such as conducting competency tests, behavioral assessments, or breed evaluations) in Berlin, provided you meet the required professional reliability, knowledge, and experience standards.
eligibility: You must demonstrate personal reliability for the conscientious and impartial exercise of your duties. As an expert, you must possess in-depth knowledge of safe and animal-welfare-compliant dog care, social behavior, breed-specific characteristics, training and education of dogs, and the ability to safely handle behaviorally difficult or dangerous dogs, and you must be familiar with all applicable dog laws. Additional specific requirements apply depending on whether you are applying for competency test expertise, behavioral assessment expertise, or breed evaluation expertise.
requiredDocuments: Application for recognition as a dog expert (preferably submitted online); please indicate in the application whether you consent to publication of your personal data (name, address [optional], email and/or telephone) in the directory of recognized dog experts

Police clearance certificate (Führungszeugnis) for submission to a government authority (type O) to verify personal reliability; the certificate must not be older than three months; when requesting, specify the purpose as 'Recognition as a dog expert under the Berlin Dog Law'; submit to the responsible office listed under 'Responsible Office'
Summary overview of professional experience and knowledge in dog matters, including training courses, professional experience, continuing education completed, and current professional activities

Proof of expertise as a dog expert for competency tests (dog handler license), behavioral assessments, or breed evaluations, which can be demonstrated through valid permits under the Animal Welfare Act, veterinary license with relevant experience, specialist veterinary credentials in behavioral science, or other equivalent qualifications as specified
fees: 45.00 to 180.00 euros depending on effort required
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Recognition can only be granted if you provide your services as an expert in the state of Berlin. Recognition is valid only for the state of Berlin.

name: Application for Recognition as an Expert in Soil Protection Law Matters
description: This service allows you to apply for official recognition as an expert (Sachverständige/r) qualified to provide advice and produce reports on soil protection law matters in Berlin.
eligibility: You must appear in person for the expert interview. You must possess the required specialist knowledge (Sachkunde) in soil protection law. You must have the required technical equipment and facilities. You must be personally reliable. You must have the required professional liability insurance (Haftpflichtversicherung) for expert activity. It is strongly recommended to conduct a consultation discussion before submitting your application for recognition.
requiredDocuments: Application for Recognition as an Expert in Soil Protection Law Matters (note: application fees are due upon submission)
Application for Consultation Discussion (to use the offer of a personal consultation before submitting your application)
Curriculum Vitae (including complete details of professional and expert activity to date)
Biometric passport photograph (also accepted in digital format)
Proof of Professional Liability Insurance for experts and inspection bodies
Certificate of Good Conduct from the Federal Central Register (Führungszeugnis, document type O) — must not be older than three months, required to verify personal reliability
Tax Clearance Certificate (Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung) from your local tax office (Finanzamt)

Certificate from the Insolvency Register (for Berlin residents: up to two certificates may be required — one for consumer insolvency proceedings from your local court, and if you have been self-employed, a second for standard insolvency proceedings from Charlottenburg District Court, Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin; non-Berlin residents should consult the central registry of courts and jurisdictions)
Declaration of Technical Equipment and Facilities (Erklärung über gerätetechnische Ausstattung)

description: This service allows qualified foreign professionals to have their educational and professional credentials recognized in order to work as civil servants in the education sector in Berlin.
eligibility: You must be under 45 years old at the time of employment (with extensions possible for childcare and elder care). You must be a citizen of an EU member state, a state party to the European Economic Area agreement, or a third country with which Germany and the EU have a contractual agreement on recognition of professional qualifications. You must be personally suitable, demonstrating commitment to the free democratic constitutional order under the German constitution and having no prior professional misconduct, criminal record, or other disqualifying grounds for civil service.

For online applications, you must register/log in via BundID.

eligibility: You must be under 45 years old at the time of appointment or transfer (age limits may be extended for childcare up to one year per child under 18, and care of dependent relatives up to one year per relative, with a maximum extension of three years total). You must be a citizen of an EU member state, a contracting party to the European Economic Area Agreement, or a third country to which Germany and the EU have contractually granted recognition of professional qualifications. You must demonstrate suitability by committing to uphold the free democratic order under the German Constitution, and you must not be unsuitable for civil service due to professional misconduct, criminal offenses, or other serious grounds.
requiredDocuments: Application for Recognition (via online processing); for online submission, prepare all required documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG formats, with individual files not exceeding 3 MB
Curriculum vitae with tabular representation of professional career history
Proof of citizenship of an EU or contracting state
Qualification documents (e.g., training certificates, diplomas, degree certificates)

Character references (certificates or documents from home or qualification country confirming no criminal offenses, serious professional misconduct, or other circumstances affecting suitability; not older than three months)
Certificate of Professional Authorization (document from home or qualification country showing what professions your qualifications authorize)
Declaration of Previous Professional Recognition Procedures (statement whether recognition has been previously requested from any authority in Germany, with any resulting decision attached)
Residential address information (required for statistical purposes)

Evidence of professional activities performed (if applicable) — certificates documenting the nature and duration of work performed after acquiring qualifications in a member state in the relevant field
Evidence of competencies acquired through lifelong learning (if applicable) — certificates from relevant bodies documenting knowledge, skills, and competencies acquired through lifelong learning
processingTime: The responsible authority confirms receipt of documents within one month and notifies you of any missing documents. The one-month period begins when the application is received. A written decision on the application will be provided within four months of submitting complete documents.

name: Recognition of Foreign Professional Qualifications as Civil Servant — Healthcare and Social Services Career Path — Healthcare Sector
description: This service recognizes foreign professional qualifications for employment as a civil servant in the healthcare sector in Berlin.
eligibility: Age: You must not have completed your 45th year of life at the time of appointment or transfer. This age limit is extended by up to one year for each period of actual childcare for children under 18 years and by up to one year for each period of actual care for family members in need of care (parents, parents-in-law, spouses, registered life partners, siblings, or children) as determined by medical assessment, with a maximum total extension of three years. Citizenship: You must hold citizenship of an EU member state, a contracting state of the European Economic Area Agreement, or a third country to which the Federal Republic of Germany and the European Union have contractually granted recognition of professional qualifications. Suitability: You must provide assurance that you will at all times support the free democratic constitutional order as defined in the Basic Law of the Federal Republic of Germany. You must not be unsuitable for civil service due to professional misconduct, criminal offenses, or comparable serious grounds. For online application: Registration/login via BundID. Register with BundID if you do not yet have an account; basic registration with username and password is sufficient.
requiredDocuments: Application for recognition (via online processing). The application must specify which position in public service you are seeking. For online application: Please prepare all required documents and evidence for upload in PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG formats. Each individual file may not exceed 3 MB.
Curriculum vitae with tabular presentation of professional history
Proof of nationality — evidence of citizenship of an EU member state or contracting state
Qualification documents — training certificates, transcripts, diplomas, and qualification credentials

Character references — certificates or documents from your home or qualification state confirming that no criminal offenses, serious professional misconduct, or other circumstances affecting suitability are known. Such certificates or documents must not be older than three months at the time of submission.
Certificate of authorization to practice the profession — certificate from your home or qualification state showing what professional activities your qualification credentials authorize

Statement on previous professional recognition procedures — statement of whether and to which authority within the Federal Republic of Germany you have previously applied for recognition, with a copy of any decision issued
Residential address information — required for statistical purposes

Evidence of professional activities (if applicable) — certificates documenting the type and duration of professional activities in your field of qualification carried out in an EU member state after obtaining your qualification credentials
Evidence of competencies acquired through lifelong learning (if applicable) — certificates issued by a relevant body documenting knowledge, skills, and competencies acquired through lifelong learning

Additional documents — the competent authority may request that you submit additional information regarding the content and duration of your completed training and other professional qualifications in the form of study regulations, examination regulations, study records, or other suitable documentation, to the extent necessary to determine equivalence
processingTime: The competent authority will confirm receipt of documents within one month and will notify you of any missing documents. This one-month period begins when the application is received by the competent authority. A written decision on the application will be issued within four months after all complete documents have been submitted.

name: Recognition of Foreign Professional Qualifications as Disinfector
description: This service allows individuals with foreign disinfector training or qualifications to obtain official recognition and permission to use the professional title in Berlin.
eligibility: Foreign completed training equivalent to German training or equivalent knowledge (equivalence must be demonstrated through examination or adaptation course if necessary); health suitability; proof of reliability and integrity for practicing the health profession; sufficient German language skills at level B2; proof of jurisdiction for Berlin; for online application: registration/login with BundID account.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission to use the professional title (submitted online or by post using the form)
Proof of jurisdiction for Berlin (e.g., job offer letter, proof of ordinary residence in Berlin/registered address, applications for open positions in Berlin, invitations to interviews)
Tabular curriculum vitae with signature and date
Birth certificate and any name change certificates
Identity document (valid ID card or passport)
Certificate of good conduct from the Federal Central Register for presentation to an authority (form type O), not older than 3 months
Certificate of good standing/criminal clearance from police or judicial authorities of home country or country of study, not older than 3 months
Character reference certificate (Certificate of good standing) from competent authority of country where profession was practiced, not older than 3 months
Medical certificate from a doctor licensed in Germany, not older than 3 months
Training records and graduation diploma with German translation (see checklist for medical professional titles in EU member states or third countries)

German language proficiency certificate B2 from Goethe Institute, telc, TestDaf, or ECL certified language school, not older than 3 years (note: language certificates are verified for authenticity and accuracy; submission at time of application is not required)
Official certified copies of documents (if submitting copies, these must be officially certified; otherwise original documents must be submitted simultaneously)
processingTime: Approximately 3–4 months if all documents are complete

name: Apply for Recognition of Foreign Professional Qualifications as Educator
description: This service allows applicants with foreign childcare educator qualifications to have their credentials recognized as equivalent to German state certification in Berlin.
eligibility: You must have acquired a comparable professional qualification abroad as an educator; you must not have already submitted a recognition application in another German state; you must provide an extended police clearance certificate showing no serious misconduct that would make you unreliable for the profession; you must demonstrate German language skills at least at C1 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages; for online application, you must register or log in with a BundID account (basic registration with username and password is sufficient).
requiredDocuments: Application form for equivalence determination of foreign vocational childcare educator qualification with state recognition (can be submitted online or using the form)
Current curriculum vitae in tabular form and in German language (listing your education and professional experience)
Identity document: copy of passport or other official photo identification; if applicable, also copy of residence permit if you are not an EU citizen

Proof of intent to work in Berlin: copy of police registration with Berlin authorities if you already live in Berlin; if you do not yet have residence in Berlin, proof of intent to work in Berlin such as copy of employment contract or employer contact, or at minimum a written declaration of your intention to work in Berlin
Copy of original certificate of general education qualification and, if applicable, university entrance examination
Copy of professional qualification certificate in original language including detailed course and hour overview (Diploma Supplement/study record) for theory and practice

German translation of foreign qualification documents by publicly appointed or authorized translators (if documents are not in Latin script, transliteration of job title according to ISO standard required; documents originally in English do not require German translation)
Copy of marriage certificate (only if name change has occurred), with German translation if applicable

Certificates of relevant professional experience and other qualifications such as employer references, continuing education certificates, course certificates, and seminar certificates, with German translations if applicable

Certificate from country of origin: certificate confirming entitlement to practice the profession in the country where you trained (if the profession is regulated there), with German translation if applicable
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You may only submit your equivalence determination application in Berlin if you intend to work in this regulated profession in Berlin.

name: Recognition of Foreign Professional Qualifications as Driving Instructor
description: This service allows foreign-trained driving instructors to have their professional qualifications recognized in Berlin, subject to meeting health, language, and character requirements.
eligibility: You must hold a foreign professional qualification as a driving instructor; be at least 21 years old; be professionally and pedagogically suitable; be mentally and physically fit; demonstrate personal reliability and have not violated requirements for driving instructors; hold a valid driver's license for the vehicle class for which you seek instructor authorization; possess the necessary German language skills to teach driving students; provide all documents in German or with certified German translations by publicly appointed or authorized translators; and for online application, register or log in with a BundID account (basic registration with username and password is sufficient).
requiredDocuments: Application for equivalency assessment (online or informal written application; you may receive specific forms from the responsible authority)
Identity document (personal ID or other official photo ID; residence permit if you are not an EU citizen)
Current curriculum vitae in tabular form in German language (list of your training courses and professional experience)
Officially certified copy of your foreign professional qualification certificate as a driving instructor
Documentation of training and examination (detailed information on content, duration, and form of training as well as examinations taken)
Evidence of relevant professional experience and other qualifications if applicable (e.g., employer references, vocational training certificates, courses, and seminars)
Certificate from country of origin if driving instruction is not regulated in your home country (proof that you worked as a driving instructor for at least 2 years in the last 10 years)

Medical certificate of health fitness (proof of mental and physical health from the country where you obtained your qualification; must demonstrate fitness for the driving instructor profession; should be no more than 3 months old at application)

Character references (proof of personal reliability from an authority in your country of qualification, such as a criminal record extract or Certificate of Good Standing; should be no more than 3 months old at application)
Valid driver's license for the vehicle classes in which you wish to instruct
fees: 40.90 euros per issuance; additional costs may apply for translations and certifications
processingTime: Approximately 1-3 months

name: Request Recognition for Care-Specific Degree Programs, Training, and Further Education Courses
description: This service allows institutions to apply for official recognition of care-specific academic and vocational training programs offered in Berlin.
eligibility: The university location must be in Berlin. The care-specific degree program must already be demonstrably accredited. The care-specific degree program must convey all expert knowledge requirements. The conferral of an academic degree following successful completion of the care-specific degree program must be documented. Care-specific training and further education courses should convey substantially more comprehensive knowledge at a scientific level than an expert knowledge course. This means that both the contents of the modules designated for the expert knowledge course and their scope are binding. Care-specific training and further education courses must have a minimum scope of 270 hours. Due to complexity, a larger overall scope should be planned. For care-specific training and further education courses, tested knowledge must be conveyed and demonstrated by a corresponding certificate from the provider. For care-specific training and further education courses, teaching units can also be converted into ECTS units as is customary at universities.

name: Registration at the designated public primary school or community school

eligibility: Registration period: October 5 to October 16, 2026. Your child is school-eligible if born between October 1, 2020 and September 30, 2021, becoming compulsory school age on August 1, 2027. Children born between October 1, 2021 and March 31, 2022 may be enrolled early in school year 2027/2028 if they have no language support needs; proof of language level (such as QuaSta form or language assessment from BeoKiz procedure) is required for early enrollment applications, with the district school authority making the final decision. name: Registration at a Different Public Primary or Community School
description: This service allows parents to enroll their school-age child in a public primary or community school other than the one designated for their residence area during the official registration period.
eligibility: Your child must be school-age (born between October 1, 2020 and September 30, 2021, becoming school-age on August 1, 2027). Registration must occur during the official period (October 5-16, 2026). For early enrollment: If your child was born between October 1, 2021 and March 31, 2022, you may request early enrollment provided your child requires no language support (bring proof such as QuaSta form or language assessment from BeoKiz procedure). Children born after March 31, 2022 can only enroll in summer 2028. A school transfer is only possible if specific legal grounds exist, such as: better contact with siblings or close peers; access to a school with specific offerings (e.g., foreign languages or all-day care); or better childcare for working parents. The chosen school must have available places.

description: A subsidy for employees who contribute to asset-building savings products, such as building savings contracts or equity funds, subject to income limits.
eligibility: Income limits: As of 2024, the employee's taxable income (as per Section 2 of the Income Tax Act) must not exceed 40,000 euros. In the case of joint taxation of spouses, this amount doubles to 80,000 euros. Maximum eligible amounts: Savings allowances apply to asset-building contributions up to a maximum of 470 euros per year (e.g., for a building savings contract) or up to 400 euros per year (e.g., for an equity fund). The allowance is then granted at 9 percent of a maximum of 42.30 euros or 20 percent of a maximum of 80 euros respectively. If both spouses are employed as employees, both may claim the savings allowance. Application deadline: The application for the employee savings allowance must be submitted no later than the end of the fourth year following the savings year.
requiredDocuments: Income tax return
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Generally, the tax office of the place of residence is responsible.

name: Apply for Work/Research Scholarship in Early Music, New Music, and Sound Art
description: This service allows artists and curators working in early music, new music, and sound art to apply for Berlin state work or research scholarships to support their artistic projects.
eligibility: Applications are accepted from 24 November 2025 to 13 January 2026, with the deadline at 14:00 CET (no late submissions accepted). Your main residence must be in Berlin. You must be an artist or curator in new music/sound art or early music with completed artistic training and/or proof of several years of artistic activity in Berlin in these fields. You must demonstrate professional standing through work samples. Non-European nationals must have a Business Immigration Service (BIS) notation in their passport permitting self-employed activity. Berlin state scholarships (work, research, and cultural exchange) are combinable up to €24,000 per year; combinations with other domestic or foreign scholarships are permitted if their terms allow; combinations with project funding are allowed. You must not be enrolled in any university degree program (including doctoral studies) or employed as a professor at a higher education institution during the application and funding period.
requiredDocuments: Online application form with short description of your work project (must be in German; attachments accepted in PDF, JPG, PNG, and MP3 formats only)
Artistic CV (maximum 5 MB, PDF/JPG/PNG)
Documentation of artistic work from the last 12 months (optional; maximum 5 MB, PDF/JPG/PNG)
Two work samples as mandatory attachments (maximum 6 MB each; PDF/JPG/PNG/MP3 or links)
Detailed description of your work project (maximum 4 DIN-A4 pages; maximum 5 MB, PDF format)

Identity document, proof of Berlin residence address, and proof of residence permit (JPG/PNG/PDF, maximum 5 MB per file): German citizens must provide copy of valid ID card (front and back); EU citizens must provide copy of ID card or passport (front and back) plus registration confirmation or registration certificate; non-EU citizens must provide copy of valid ID or passport, registration confirmation or registration certificate, and copy of valid residence title or residence permit (front and back) or fictional certificate with work authorization notation
Partnership agreement for duo applications (GbR contract if existing, or declaration of artist group partnership with all members' signatures; maximum 5 MB; PDF/JPG/PNG)
processingTime: 5–6 months

name: Apply for Work/Research Stipendium in Performing Arts/Dance
description: This service allows individual artists and dancers living and working in Berlin to apply for a work or research stipendium to support their artistic projects in performing arts.
eligibility: Applications are accepted from January 20, 2026 to March 11, 2026, with a deadline of 15:00 on March 11, 2026. Only one application per person is permitted; previous applicants may reapply. Applicants must live and work in Berlin and must have completed artistic training and/or demonstrate several years of professional experience in performing arts or dance. The application and detailed project description must be submitted in German; the artistic CV and portfolio may be in English. Only individuals may apply, not groups or business partnerships. Applications regarding film or television projects are not permitted. Applicants may apply for this stipendium even if applying for other stipendiums, but must disclose if they receive other funding to determine compatibility. This stipendium can be combined with other Berlin state stipendiums up to a total of 24,000 euros per year and with project funding. At the time of application, applicants must not be enrolled at a university (including doctoral studies) or employed as a professor at a higher education institution. If studies ended recently, proof of completion must be provided.

Detailed description of the project (maximum 2 MB, PDF file, maximum 2 DIN A4 pages including cover page and images) explaining artistic planning, theme implementation, concept, objectives, participants, and scope of research
Artistic CV with portfolio (maximum 10 MB, PDF file, maximum 10 DIN A4 pages) covering artistic work and completed projects from the past 3 years, with online links to work permitted

Proof of Berlin residence and residence permit: For German citizens, copy of valid ID card (front and back); for EU citizens, copy of valid ID card or passport and registration certificate from the resident registration office; for non-EU citizens with residence title card, the card itself serves as ID and registration proof (upload relevant page with Berlin address and any employment supplement pages); for non-EU citizens without residence title card, copy of valid ID or passport, registration certificate, and valid residence title or residence right certificate (front and back). Note: If valid residence permit is not held during the application and stipendium period, no stipendium will be awarded.

name: Apply for Work Stipendium in Fine Arts
description: A work stipend for professional visual artists living and working in Berlin who have completed artistic training and regularly exhibit their work.
eligibility: Applications accepted from 06.07.2026 to 02.09.2026, with deadline 02.09.2026 at 11:00 (online submissions must be received by this time). You must live and work in Berlin. You must have completed artistic training and/or demonstrate several years of professional activity in fine arts. You must professionally present your work at fine arts venues (museums, exhibition spaces, project spaces, etc.) in exhibition contexts. If working across multiple disciplines, your primary focus must be in fine arts. Application must be submitted in German (attachments may be in English). You may apply as an individual or as a group (GbR); groups must have worked together for at least 2 years and more than 50% of members must have primary residence registered in Berlin. You cannot be enrolled at a university or employed as a (guest) professor at the time of application or during the funding period. You may apply for other stipends simultaneously, but must disclose if you receive another award to check compatibility. This stipendium can be combined with other Berlin state stipends up to €24,000 per year (except the Fine Arts Research Stipendium) and with project funding, but is excluded if you received a Kunstfonds Bonn Foundation stipend for the same funding year.

name: Apply for Work Stipendium for German-Language Literature
description: This service provides financial support for professional authors living and working in Berlin to develop German-language literary works.
eligibility: Applications are accepted from 18 March 2026 to 6 May 2026, with the deadline at 11:00 on 6 May 2026. Only one application per person is permitted. You must live and work in Berlin and be a professional author. The application must be submitted in German. Only individuals may apply; group applications are not permitted. The stipendium cannot be combined with a German Literature Fund (Deutscher Literaturfonds) stipendium with the same funding period. You may apply even if you have applied for other stipendiums, but must disclose if you receive an offer for another stipendium so compatibility can be assessed. The stipendium is combinable with other Berlin state stipendiums up to €24,000 per year and is freely combinable with other named and unnamed domestic and foreign funding sources (verify compatibility with those programmes' terms). Combinations with project funding are permitted. You must not be enrolled in a regular programme of a literature-focused degree programme (e.g. Leipzig, Hildesheim, Biel, Vienna or others) or employed as a professor at a university at the time of application, during the selection process, or during the funding period. If your studies ended recently, provide proof of completion with your CV.

Curriculum Vitae (CV) (maximum 2 MB, PDF file) including a list of publications from the last three years with titles, publication locations, and media

Exposé (maximum 5 MB, PDF file, maximum 2 DIN A4 pages) describing the submitted work sample. Note: Exposés exceeding 2 DIN A4 pages (including cover pages, bibliographies, illustrations, other documents) will not be accepted and the application will be formally excluded.

Reading sample of an incomplete literary work (maximum 10 MB, PDF file, maximum 20 DIN A4 pages). Note: Reading samples exceeding 20 DIN A4 pages (including cover pages, bibliographies, illustrations, other documents) will not be accepted and the application will be formally excluded.

Proof of eligibility for Berlin (e.g., registration certificate for residence, rental contract for business establishment, or employer confirmation of employment location in Berlin)

Documentation of the content and duration of your training (e.g., Diploma Supplement, Transcript of Records; you may also submit continuing education certificates and professional experience documentation)

name: Request Exemption from or Deviation of Animal Identification Requirements (Species Protection)
description: This service allows you to request an exemption from or deviation of the mandatory identification requirements for protected mammals, reptiles, or birds under German species protection law.
eligibility: You must have a living mammal, reptile, or bird of the species listed in Annex 6, Column 1 of the Federal Species Protection Ordinance (BArtSchV), with legal origin and lawful acquisition. For a deviation request: the primary identification method cannot be applied due to physical or behavioral characteristics or if specimens fall below minimum weight thresholds. For an exemption request: the identification requirement is already fulfilled or not necessary—this includes cases where an injured, helpless, or sick vertebrate is taken in for care and then released back into the wild; where the vertebrate is already marked under EU species protection regulations or regulations of other member states; where vertebrates are held or released as part of population protection or reintroduction measures; or where the keeper could not meet the identification requirement in time due to circumstances such as illness.
requiredDocuments: Application for deviation from primary identification method or exemption from identification requirement (submit as informal written request by mail or email)

Proof of legal origin (evidence may include: details of prior acquisition with free proof such as old receipts, photos, expert assessments, documentation of trade route and accounting records; lawful import with EC import permit; captive breeding with breeding confirmation from nature protection authority, registration confirmation, accounting records or breeder certification including parental animal details; legal collection from nature with exemption permit or release from competent authority)

name: Species Protection - Apply for Exception Permit to Relocate or Destroy Nests of Protected Insect Species
description: Request an exemption to relocate or destroy nests of protected insects such as hornets, bumblebees, or wild bees when human safety cannot be guaranteed and no alternative measures are available.
eligibility: Human safety risk cannot be excluded — relocation or destruction of a nest of hornets, bumblebees, or wild bees is only permitted if human endangerment cannot be ruled out. The danger cannot be averted by other measures — before relocation or destruction, it must be clarified whether the existing danger can be prevented by other suitable measures; an expert must be commissioned to examine the possibilities. If the nest must be destroyed — relocation is not possible — before destruction, an expert must clarify whether the danger can be averted through relocation or whether this is not possible (for example, because the nest is in an inaccessible location and cannot be removed intact).
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from species protection regulations — submit the application informally in writing, describing how the danger exists and why it cannot be averted by other means, and if applicable, why relocation is not possible
Expert assessment results from a qualified expert who has examined the situation on site (recommended)
fees: €72.00 minimum fee for exemption from species protection regulations; €50.00 maximum for nest relocation
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

Animal information including number, species, age, sex, origin, location, purpose of use, and identifying marks

name: Asbestos - Notification of Activities with Asbestos-Containing Materials
description: This service requires businesses to notify the authorities before beginning work activities involving asbestos-containing materials, with specific requirements depending on the risk level of the activities.
eligibility: Activities with asbestos-containing materials must be assessed before commencement according to § 11a subsection 1. The applicant must provide information including: the date of construction start or building year; whether the planned activities are permitted under § 11 or § 17 subsection 1; whether activities could result in release of asbestos fibers; and whether activities fall within low, medium, or high-risk categories considering planned protective measures. As a specialist business, you must employ qualified and certified personnel. Certified personnel require successful completion of an officially recognized certification course, valid for six years. Hazard identification and risk assessment, protective measure determination, and employee instruction must be conducted by a person with certification per Annex I Number 3.7. If you as employer lack this certification, you must appoint a certified responsible person in your business. Asbestos activities must be supervised by an authorized person with certification per Annex I Number 3.7 who must be present on-site during all activities. Only employees with expertise per Annex I Number 3.6 may perform asbestos activities; this expertise becomes mandatory as of 05.12.2027. Technical equipment must comply with TRGS 519 standards. High-risk activities additionally require approval under § 11a subsection 3 in conjunction with Annex I Number 3.4.
requiredDocuments: Asbestos notification form (company-based) for low and medium risk areas
Specification of risk category including type of exposure assessment
Number of qualified employees
Measures to limit asbestos exposure of employees
Information on responsible and supervising person
Proof of qualification of responsible and supervising persons
Names of employees expected to be deployed
Proof of technical knowledge and skills per Annex I Number 3.6
Preventive health examination proof for all persons performing asbestos activities
Documentation of hazard assessment and work plan
Asbestos notification form (site-based) for high-risk areas
Copy of approval (for high-risk activities)
Supplementary asbestos notification regarding location and time (for activities at changing work sites in medium-risk category)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

The supervisory person's duties can also be performed by a qualified responsible person. You also need a sufficient number of employees with specialist expertise per Annex I Number 3.6. As a specialist business, you need proof of technical equipment according to TRGS 519, Attachment 8. There must be no concerns about the employer's reliability.
requiredDocuments: Application for authorization or extension for high-risk activities (submit as informal written request by post or email; LAGetSi will send you the information sheet with required application documents)
Designation of responsible and supervisory persons with proof of qualification (specialist expertise)

Berlin typically requires your own set of equipment; the remainder can be obtained through rental agreements. Therefore, proof of maintenance and rental agreements is also required.

Proof of fiber emissions from room air filter systems and high-performance vacuum extraction devices according to TRGS 519 Section 8.2, Para. 2, and test results for air technical systems according to TRGS 519 Section 8.2, Para. 7
fees: €1,075.00 to €2,675.00 for specialist business authorization; €267.00 to €535.00 for modification or extension of specialist business authorization
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Recognition of Assistance Dogs

Application for issuance of a certificate and identification badge for guide dogs (available in the forms section)

Proof of concrete individual suitability of the assistance dog, such as: severe disability ID card (Schwerbehindertenausweis); decision confirming a degree of disability; certificate from a social benefits provider or medical specialist certificate

Previous residence documents under EU freedom of movement (if issued: residence card, permanent residence card, or certificate of permanent residence right for EU citizens)

Self-employed/freelance documentation: business register extract or trade registration, and latest tax assessment
Current enrollment certificate (for students)
Income evidence (e.g., pension notice) and current health insurance certificate (for non-employed persons)
Current benefit notice (for SGB II or SGB XII recipients)
Proof of main residence in Berlin: registration certificate or rental contract with landlord confirmation
Evidence of continuous residence in Germany (if applicable: previous residence documentation such as tax assessment or old rental contract)
