fees: €56.00 for residence permit as label; €100.00 for residence permit as electronic residence title; €27.60 for Turkish nationals under 24 years; €46.00 for Turkish nationals 24 years and over; €6.00 additional for digital passport photo at self-service terminal on-site
processingTime: Residence permit as label can be issued directly at appointment on-site. Residence permit as electronic title (eAT) takes 4-6 weeks for collection.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Residence Permit - Switzerland
description: This service issues a residence permit for Swiss nationals and their family members who meet the eligibility requirements and reside in Berlin.
eligibility: You must be a Swiss citizen (or a family member of a Swiss citizen, where at least one family member holds Swiss nationality); have your main place of residence in Berlin; and attend a personal appointment. To schedule an appointment, contact the competent departments F 1 and F 2 via the contact form (see further information).
requiredDocuments: Completed application form for the issuance of a residence title (Formular Antrag auf Erteilung eines Aufenthaltstitels)
Valid passport or ID card for Swiss citizens
Valid passport for family members of Swiss citizens
Current biometric passport photo (note: from 01.05.2025, biometric photos must be created digitally only by authorities or photo studios and transmitted via secure electronic means)

Proof of right to freedom of movement for Swiss citizens: For employees—employment contract or job offer; for self-employed—trade registration from trade office, possibly contracts, invoices or similar; for freelancers—tax number from tax office, possibly contracts, invoices or similar; for students—university admission or enrollment certificate, proof of sufficient means of subsistence and health insurance; for non-working persons—proof of sufficient means of subsistence and health insurance
Proof of family relationship for family members (e.g., birth certificate, marriage certificate, registered same-sex civil partnership, custody documents for minor children)
Proof of main residence in Berlin: either registration confirmation (Meldebestätigung) or lease agreement and landlord's move-in confirmation
fees: €46.00 for those aged 24 and over; €27.60 for those under 24; €100.00 for adults; €50.00 for minors
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks after your appointment, the residence permit will be issued as an electronic residence title and will be ready for collection.

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the State Office for Immigration (LEA) at the Friedrich-Krause-Ufer location.

name: Transfer Swiss Residence Permit to New Passport or ID Card
description: This service allows Swiss nationals with an existing residence permit in Berlin to transfer their permit to a new Swiss passport or identity card.
eligibility: You must have a valid Swiss residence permit, possess a new Swiss passport or Swiss identity card, have your main residence in Berlin, and be able to attend an in-person appointment. To schedule an appointment, contact the responsible departments F 1 and F 2 via the contact form (see further information).
requiredDocuments: New Swiss passport or new Swiss identity card
Swiss residence permit

One current biometric passport photo (as of 01.05.2025, biometric passport photos may only be created digitally directly at government offices or photography studios and transmitted via a secure electronic channel — please check the State Office for Immigration website before your appointment for current requirements)
fees: €46.00 for ages 24 and above; €27.60 for ages up to 24; €67.00 for adults; €33.50 for minors
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks after your appointment until the Swiss residence permit is issued as an electronic residence title and is ready for collection

bookingInfo.office: State Office for Immigration (LEA) at the Friedrich-Krause-Ufer location only

name: Residence Grant (FG 1) for Temporary Protection for Refugees from Ukraine - Biometric Processing
description: This service registers biometric data (fingerprints) for refugees from Ukraine who have been granted temporary protection status under German law.
eligibility: You submitted an online application for temporary protection to the LEA before 31 May 2022; you have received a residence title under § 24 of the Residence Act or a certificate of deemed residence (Fiktionsbescheinigung); your fingerprint data has not yet been stored in the Central Aliens Register (AZR); you are at least 14 years old. To cancel or change your appointment, contact ed-termine@laf.berlin.de instead of using the cancellation link in your appointment confirmation, and the LAF will book you a new appointment.
requiredDocuments: Appointment confirmation (printed or by email)
processingTime: 5-10 minutes

bookingInfo.office: You will receive an appointment from the LAF (Landesamt für Flüchtlingsangelegenheiten). You cannot book an appointment yourself.

name: Residence Permit (FG 2) for Temporary Protection for Ukrainian Refugees - Fingerprinting at LAF Following LEA Referral
description: This service provides fingerprinting and registration processing for Ukrainian refugees who have applied for temporary protection and have a scheduled appointment at LEA starting from June 1, 2022.
eligibility: You submitted an online application for temporary protection to LEA by May 31, 2022; your LEA appointment for issuing the residence permit is scheduled for June 1, 2022 or later; your fingerprint data has not yet been stored in the Central Register of Foreigners (AZR) — this will be checked at your LEA appointment, after which you will receive an appointment for fingerprinting at LAF; you are at least 14 years old.
requiredDocuments: Appointment confirmation (printed copy or email)
processingTime: 5-10 minutes

bookingInfo.office: You receive an appointment from LEA. You cannot book an appointment yourself.

name: Residence Permission for Temporary Protection for Refugees from Ukraine - Assignment Decision
description: This service grants temporary residence permission and assigns accommodation in Berlin to refugees fleeing Ukraine who meet specific eligibility criteria.
eligibility: You belong to one of the following groups and had your usual residence in Ukraine before 24 February 2022: Ukrainian nationals; or stateless persons and nationals of countries other than EU/EEA states or Ukraine who enjoyed international protection or equivalent national protection in Ukraine; or family members of Ukrainians or persons who received protection in Ukraine; or stateless persons and nationals of countries other than EU/EEA states or Ukraine who can prove they lawfully and long-term resided in Ukraine on the basis of a residence title issued under Ukrainian law and who are unable to safely and permanently return to their country or region of origin.
requiredDocuments: Valid document proving identity (valid passport, passport replacement, or Ukrainian ID card)
If you do not have a passport, passport replacement, or Ukrainian ID card: certificate of identity verification issued by the Ukrainian Embassy
Your Ukrainian residence permit (if you do not have Ukrainian citizenship)

Proof of accommodation in Berlin (if available): registration confirmation from the Citizens' Office of your residential district, or rental contract for residential space in Berlin, or confirmation of permanent accommodation provision for Ukrainian refugees
Your luggage (if available) for potential onward travel to other German federal states after the assignment decision
processingTime: Approximately 20-60 minutes

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Temporary Protection Residency Grant for Ukrainian Refugees — Assignment Decision Upon Referral by LEA
description: This service issues a temporary protection residency grant to eligible refugees from Ukraine and certain stateless persons and third-country nationals who were in Ukraine before February 24, 2022.
eligibility: You belong to one of the following groups and had your ordinary residence in Ukraine before February 24, 2022: Ukrainian nationals; or stateless persons and third-country nationals (not from EU/EEA states or Ukraine) who enjoyed international protection or equivalent national protection in Ukraine; or family members of Ukrainians or persons who received protection in Ukraine; or stateless persons and third-country nationals (not from EU/EEA states or Ukraine) who can prove they lawfully and long-term resided in Ukraine under a residence title issued under Ukrainian law and are unable to safely and permanently return to their country or region of origin. You must have received an appointment invitation from LAF by email. A negative COVID-19 rapid test (not older than 24 hours) is required if available; you can also take the test on-site.
requiredDocuments: Valid identity document (valid passport, passport replacement, Ukrainian national ID card, or certification of identity clarification issued by the Ukrainian embassy if you have none of the above)
Valid Ukrainian residence title (if you do not hold Ukrainian nationality)

Proof of accommodation in Berlin, if available (registration confirmation from your district citizen office, or a rental contract for residential space in Berlin, or confirmation of permanent accommodation provision for Ukrainian refugees)
Your luggage, if available (for potential onward travel to other federal states after the assignment decision)
processingTime: Approximately 20-50 minutes

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Residence card for family members of EU and EEA citizens
description: This service issues a residence card to non-EU/EEA family members of EU or EEA citizens who have freedom of movement rights and wish to reside in Berlin.
eligibility: You are a family member (spouse, registered same-sex partner, minor unmarried child, or parent) of an EU or EEA citizen who has freedom of movement rights (such as worker, self-employed, or non-employed status); you are not yourself an EU or EEA citizen; you have a family relationship with the EU/EEA citizen; you maintain a family household together in Berlin; you have your main residence in Berlin. Note: Family members of German citizens generally cannot obtain this card under freedom of movement law but may be eligible for a residence permit under separate immigration law.
requiredDocuments: Form 'Angaben zur Ausstellung einer Aufenthaltskarte' (completed)
Valid passport

1 current biometric passport photo (as of 01.05.2025, biometric photos must be created digitally at authorities or photo studios and submitted via secure electronic means; check the State Office for Immigration website for current requirements)
Proof of relationship with the EU/EEA citizen (e.g., birth certificate, marriage certificate, or registered same-sex partnership certificate)

Certified translation of all foreign documents; depending on country of origin, an apostille or legalisation may also be required (consult the Federal Foreign Office for details on international document certification)
Registration confirmation (Meldebestätigung) of the EU/EEA citizen

Proof of the EU/EEA citizen's freedom of movement rights: for employees: employer confirmation of employment; for self-employed: business registration, tax number, current tax assessment; for non-employed: proof of health insurance and means of subsistence; for family members of German citizens: residence card or permanent residence card from another EU country for the family member
Proof of main residence in Berlin: registration confirmation (Meldebestätigung) or rental contract and landlord's confirmation of move-in
fees: €46.00 for applicants age 24 and over; €27.60 for applicants under age 24; €6.00 additional fee for biometric photo creation at the self-service terminal on-site
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks after your appointment to collect the residence card as an electronic residence document.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Transfer Residence Card or Permanent Residence Card to a New Passport
description: This service allows family members of EU or EWR citizens to transfer their residence card or permanent residence card to a new passport.
eligibility: You must possess a residence card or permanent residence card issued to you as a family member of a citizen of the European Union (EU) or European Economic Area (EWR) — Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway — and you do not yourself hold the nationality of an EU or EWR member state. You must have obtained a new passport. You must have your main residence in Berlin. You must appear in person with an appointment by contacting departments F 1 and F 2 via the contact form (see Further Information).
requiredDocuments: New passport
Residence card or permanent residence card

1 current biometric passport photo. Note: From 1 May 2025, biometric passport photos must generally be created digitally only directly at the authorities or in photo studios and submitted via a secure electronic method. Please inform yourself in time before your appointment on the website of the State Office for Immigration (see Further Information) about the current status.
Digital passport photo creation available at a self-service terminal on site
fees: €46.00 for those aged 24 and older; €27.60 for those under 24; €6.00 for creation of a digital passport photo at the self-service terminal on site
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks after your appointment until the residence card is issued as an electronic residence title and is ready for collection.

bookingInfo.office: This service is available only at the State Office for Immigration (LEA) at the Friedrich-Krause-Ufer location.

name: Residence Title for Former Germans
description: This service provides residence permits for individuals who acquired a foreign nationality after January 1, 2000 and held or hold German identity documents, allowing them to reside legally in Berlin.
eligibility: Acquisition of a foreign nationality (from January 1, 2000 onwards) and simultaneous possession of a German identity card and/or passport; main residence in Berlin; personal appointment required.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a residence title (completed) — required only on first application
Valid foreign passport
German identity card or German passport — if lost, a loss report (Verlustanzeige) from any Berlin Bürgeramt is required
1 current biometric photograph 35mm x 45mm, frontal view with neutral expression and closed mouth, looking straight at camera, light background

Certificate of registration times in Berlin from January 1, 1995 onwards — extended registration certificate (fee-based) available from any Berlin Bürgeramt or the Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten; required only on first application; if you had interim residence(s) in another German state, additional documents proving residence there are required (e.g., employment contracts, rental agreements, or certificates)

Evidence of acquisition of foreign nationality — original and copy required (e.g., acquisition certificate, extract from civil registry, or certification from consulate or embassy; for Turkish nationals also 'Nüfus Kayit Örnegi' with translation) — required only on first application
Evidence of acquisition of German nationality — naturalization certificate (original and copy)
Certificate of good conduct (not older than three months) — available from any Berlin Bürgeramt (fee-based); certificate for private purposes is sufficient; required only on first application

Evidence of secured livelihood — all documents in original and copy: For employees: employment contract, current employer certification, salary statements for last 6 months; For self-employed: examination report completed by tax advisor, auditor, or tax representative with accompanying documents (e.g., commercial registry extract), latest tax assessment; For freelancers: tax assessments, account statements, invoices and similar documents showing regular income; For retirees: pension statements
Rental contract or purchase contract with residential area specified — original and copy
Proof of monthly rent or property costs — original and copy
Health insurance — proof of adequate health insurance coverage as part of secured livelihood; statutory health insurance is sufficient; private health insurance must be checked for adequacy
Proof of main residence in Berlin — registration certificate (Meldebestätigung) or rental contract and landlord's confirmation of move-in
fees: €100.00 for residence permit (adults); €113.00 for settlement permit (adults); €50.00 for residence permit (minors); €56.50 for settlement permit (minors); €93.00 (adults); €46.50 (minors); €27.60 (up to age 24); €46.00 (from age 24 onwards)
processingTime: Approximately 5–6 weeks. It is recommended to apply 4–6 weeks before the current residence title expires.

bookingInfo.office: This service is only available at the Landesamt für Einwanderung (LEA) at the Friedrich-Krause-Ufer location.

name: Residence Permit for Employment - Change of Employer
description: This service allows foreign workers with a valid employment residence permit to change employers while maintaining their legal work authorization in Berlin.
eligibility: You must hold a valid employment residence permit (either a Blue Card EU or a residence permit issued under §16a(1), §18a, §18b, §18d, §18f, §19c, or §38a of the German Residence Act). Your residence permit must be valid for at least 8 more weeks. Your work permission must be restricted to a specific employer and you wish to change to a different employer. You must have your primary residence in Berlin. You must provide a current email address for contact by the Immigration Office.
requiredDocuments: Application for modification of your residence permit to change employers (online only; you will receive a PDF confirmation)
Declaration of Employment Relationship form (completed and signed by your new employer; not required for au pairs changing host families)
Employment contract with the new employer (a draft is acceptable)
Passport or other identity document (for the online application, your passport or passport substitute number and validity period are required)
fees: No fee for modification of the residence permit or Blue Card EU or issuance of a certificate.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Permission to Install Containers, Exchange Containers, and Portable Rental Toilets
description: This service allows businesses to apply for authorization to place exchange collection containers, portable rental toilets, or shipping containers at designated locations in Berlin for a limited period.
eligibility: Exchange collection containers are installed exclusively using the exchange procedure. Maximum installation duration is 30 days; a new application is required thereafter for the same location. Maximum space dimensions per location: width 2.50 m × length 8.00 m × height 3.00 m. Maximum three exchange collection containers per location. At an approved location, either portable rental toilets or exchange containers/containers may be placed, but not a mix of both. For online application: registration via Mein Unternehmenskonto (MUK); you need a valid ELSTER certificate for your business.
requiredDocuments: Application for installation of containers, exchange containers, and portable rental toilets (must be submitted online with your business ELSTER certificate)
fees: €11.00 per site exemption permit; no fee for framework exemption permit; variable costs calculated according to Anlage 2 SNGebV (see legal basis)
processingTime: 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Street Traffic Authority (Straßenverkehrsbehörde) of the district where the installation will take place

name: Training Support for Education Abroad (Foreign BAföG)
description: Financial support for German and eligible foreign nationals pursuing vocational training or higher education outside Germany.
eligibility: German citizenship as defined by the German Constitution, or foreign nationals meeting the requirements of § 8 of the Federal Training Assistance Act (BAföG). Applicant must not have completed their 30th year of life at the beginning of the training period (exceptions listed in § 10 BAföG). The training institution and program must be eligible for support. Regular attendance at the training institution/university is required. Applicant must demonstrate insufficient income and/or assets or insufficient financial capacity of parents, spouse, or registered life partner.
requiredDocuments: Application for Training Support (can be submitted online or by mail using official forms)
Additional application forms and supporting documents for determining eligibility (proof of personal and financial circumstances)
Special form: Training Abroad (supplementary sheet)
Identity proof (valid personal documents, residence confirmation if applicable, proof of residence status for non-Germans)
Income statements or declaration by applicant (declaration and where applicable evidence of expected income during the funding period)
Assets statements for applicant (e.g., capital insurance, savings accounts, real estate, valuables, vehicles)
Income declaration form (from parents/spouse/registered partner)
Proof of income from the second preceding calendar year (e.g., tax assessment notice, electronic wage tax certificate, benefit notices, pension statements)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Berlin is exclusively responsible for supporting training in Italy, San Marino, and Vatican City. All applications from Berlin districts are processed by the Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf District Office.

name: Training Support for Vocational Advancement (Master BAföG)
description: Financial support for eligible German citizens and certain foreign nationals pursuing accredited vocational advancement training programs lasting at least 400 hours.
eligibility: German citizenship under the Basic Law or foreign nationals meeting § 8 AFBG requirements; personal suitability and regular attendance at training facility required; training measure must be eligible (excluding certification-only courses); provider must hold valid certificate; course must comprise at least 400 instructional hours; full-time programs must be completed within 36 calendar months; part-time programs within 48 calendar months; application should be submitted promptly, with benefits granted from the month of application, earliest from training start date; for online application: registration via BundID using online ID passport (recommended) or username/password; optional eID activation requires electronic ID card, EU citizen card, or electronic residence permit with activated eID function, PIN, external card reader or modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS, and AusweisApp software.
requiredDocuments: Application for vocational advancement training support (Master BAföG) — submit online or by mail using provided forms
Additional forms and sheets to determine eligibility (documentation of personal and financial circumstances)
Valid identity documents and registration confirmation (Meldebestätigung) for identity verification
Proof of residence status for non-German nationals

Form: Income and assets declaration of applicant (Attachment 1 Form A) — full-time programs only, including income declarations for the funding period and asset documentation (life insurance, building savings contracts, pension contracts, savings accounts, real estate, valuables, vehicles, etc.)
Form: Declaration by spouse or registered life partner (Attachment 2 Form A) — full-time programs only
Proof of previous year's income (tax return, wage tax certificate, benefits statement, pension statement, etc.)
Birth certificates of own children — full-time programs only
Additional documents may be required depending on individual circumstances; refer to form instruction sheets
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Responsibility is determined by the applicant's place of residence.

name: Training Support for Students (Student BAföG)
description: Financial support for students pursuing vocational training who meet German citizenship or foreign resident requirements and have insufficient income or parental financial capacity.
eligibility: German citizenship as defined by the Basic Law, or foreign nationals meeting requirements of § 8 Federal Training Assistance Act (BAföG). Age limit: applicant must not have completed their 45th year of life at the start of the training period for which support is requested (exceptions listed in § 10 BAföG). Training institution must be eligible for support (check with institution). Insufficient income and/or assets of applicant, or insufficient financial capacity of parents, spouse, or registered life partner. Regular school attendance required. Application must be submitted in timely manner; benefits are granted from the month of application, at earliest from the start of training.
requiredDocuments: Application for training support (submitted online or in writing via post)
Additional forms and documents for determining eligibility (documentation of personal and financial circumstances)
Valid identity documents
Registration confirmation if applicable
Proof of residence status for non-German nationals
Income statements or declaration from applicant regarding expected income during the grant period
Asset statements of applicant (e.g., capital-building insurance, savings accounts, property, valuables, vehicles)
Form: Income declaration (from parents/spouse/registered life partner)
Evidence of income from the second-to-last calendar year (e.g., tax assessment notice, wage tax certificate, benefit notice, pension notice)
Birth certificates of applicant's own children
Additional documents may be required depending on individual case — please consult guidance notes accompanying the forms
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Contact the responsible training support office (Amt für Ausbildungsförderung) based on jurisdiction; special cases apply if applicant is or was married, parents are deceased, custody conditions apply, parents reside in different jurisdictions, no parent resides in Germany, or support is for distance learning courses.

name: Apply for Export License Plate for Imported New Vehicles from Abroad with Registration Certificate Part II
description: This service allows you to apply for an export license plate for factory-new vehicles imported from abroad that have a valid registration certificate and COC certification for Germany.
eligibility: COC Certificate with Germany entry required — ensure field 47 of the COC certificate contains a Germany entry (emission class/emission key). Vehicle inspection required per § 14 paragraph 8 FZV. All documents must be provided in original form.
requiredDocuments: Application for allocation of export license plate (completed) (see Forms)
Valid personal identification document
Informal power of attorney if applicable, including personal identification documents of both the authorizing party and authorized representative, unless it is a notarized power of attorney
Vehicle registration certificate/Zulassungsbescheinigung Part II together with COC certificate - Certificate of Conformity or manufacturer's data confirmation
Extract from Commercial Register and business registration in original or certified copy, plus personal identification documents of authorized representative(s) (for companies)
Extract from Association Register in original or certified copy, plus personal identification documents of authorized representative(s) (for associations)
Insurance confirmation for export license plate
Notification for VAT purposes regarding intra-EU acquisition of new motor vehicle (see Forms) (for EU imports)
Customs clearance certificate for imports from non-participating EU member states per § 6 paragraph 6 FZV

SEPA direct debit mandate or proof of payment of motor vehicle tax — SEPA direct debit mandate for motor vehicle tax collection available since 01.03.2014; cash payments only accepted at Customs Office Marzahn
Expert report per § 21 StVZO or § 13 EC-FGV if the vehicle is not type-approved
fees: Fee according to the current fee schedule for traffic measures; minimum 36.70 EUR. Production of license plates is not a service of the Berlin vehicle registration authority — no information available regarding additional costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Processing handled exclusively by the vehicle registration authority in Berlin-Lichtenberg. Appointment can be scheduled with the vehicle registration authority.

name: Request export license plate for new imported vehicles without vehicle registration certificate
description: This service allows you to obtain an export license plate for new vehicles imported from abroad that lack a German vehicle registration certificate (Part II).
eligibility: COC certificate must have an entry for Germany (pollution class/emissions code) in field 47; vehicle must be presented in accordance with § 14 Para. 8 FZV; all documents must be provided in original form.
requiredDocuments: Application for allocation of export license plate (completed)
Valid personal identification document
Informal power of attorney if applicable, including personal identification documents of the person granting and the person holding the power of attorney (unless it is a notarized power of attorney)
COC certificate or manufacturer data confirmation for vehicles without EC type approval; alternatively, a full expert report according to § 21 StVZO from a technical inspection authority
Extract from the commercial register and business registration in original or certified copy, plus personal identification documents of the authorized representative (for companies)
Extract from the association register in original or certified copy, plus personal identification documents of the authorized representative (for associations)
Insurance confirmation for export license plate
Purchase contract or import certificate
Notification for VAT purposes regarding intra-Community acquisition of a new motor vehicle (for EU imports)
Customs clearance certificate for imports from non-participating EU member states according to § 6 Para. 6 FZV
SEPA direct debit mandate or proof of vehicle tax payment (SEPA direct debit mandate for vehicle tax collection available as of 01.03.2014; cash payments only accepted at Customs Office Marzahn)
Expert report according to § 13 EG-FGV if the vehicle is not type-approved
fees: According to the current fee schedule for road traffic measures; minimum fee is €36.70. License plate production is not provided by the Berlin motor vehicle registration authority — separate costs may apply.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Processing exclusively at the Motor Vehicle Registration Authority in Berlin-Lichtenberg; appointments can be scheduled at the Motor Vehicle Registration Authority.

name: Apply for Export License Plate for Used Vehicles Imported from Abroad
description: This service allows residents to obtain an export license plate for used vehicles that have been imported from outside Germany.
eligibility: COC Certificate must have a Germany entry in section 47 (emissions class/emissions key). Vehicle must be presented according to § 14 Abs. 8 FZV. All documents must be provided in original form.
requiredDocuments: Application for allocation of an export license plate (completed) (see Forms)
Valid personal identification document
Informal power of attorney if applicable, including personal identification documents of both the authorizing person and the authorized representative (unless it is a notarized power of attorney)
COC Certificate with Germany entry in section 47 (emissions class/emissions key)

Foreign vehicle registration documents (if vehicle cannot be clearly identified due to missing technical data, a full inspection report according to § 21 StVZO with technical data sheet from an inspection body is required)
Proof of valid main inspection according to § 29 StVZO (HU inspection report)
Insurance confirmation for export license plate
Commercial register extract and business registration in original or certified copy, plus personal identification documents of authorized representatives (for businesses)
Association register extract in original or certified copy, plus personal identification documents of authorized representatives (for associations)

Notification for VAT purposes regarding intra-community acquisition of a new motor vehicle (see Forms) (for EU imports) - required for vehicles not older than six months or with less than 6,000 km total mileage
Customs clearance certificate for imports from non-participating EU member states according to § 6 Abs. 6 FZV

SEPA direct debit mandate or proof of motor vehicle tax payment (as of 01.03.2014, SEPA direct debit mandate can be issued for motor vehicle tax collection; cash payments only accepted at Customs Office Marzahn)
Foreign license plates if vehicle is registered (if applicable)
fees: Minimum fee of €36.70 according to the current fee schedule for traffic regulation measures. License plate production is not a service of the Berlin motor vehicle registration authority, and no information can be provided regarding additional costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Processing is handled exclusively by the Motor Vehicle Registration Authority in Berlin-Lichtenberg. Appointments can be scheduled with the Motor Vehicle Registration Authority.

name: Request Export License Plate (Ausfuhrkennzeichen) for New and Used Vehicles from Germany
description: This service allows residents to apply for a temporary export license plate to drive a vehicle out of Germany for sale or transfer abroad.
eligibility: Vehicle inspection required according to § 14 Abs. 8 FZV (Road Traffic Licensing Regulations). All documents must be presented in original form.
requiredDocuments: Completed application form for export license plate allocation (available under 'Formulare')
Valid personal identity document
Power of attorney (informal or notarized) including identity documents of the authorizing person and authorized representative (if applicable)
Vehicle registration certificate Part I (Fahrzeugschein/Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I) for registered vehicles
Proof of valid main inspection (HU test report) according to § 29 StVZO for registered vehicles
Vehicle registration certificate Part II (Fahrzeugbrief/Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil II) for registered vehicles
Operating permit (Betriebserlaubnis) for vehicles not requiring registration
Official license plates for registered vehicles
Insurance confirmation for export license plate
Commercial register extract and business registration in original or certified copy, plus identity documents of authorized representative (for companies)
Association register extract in original or certified copy, plus identity documents of authorized representative (for associations)
SEPA direct debit mandate or proof of motor vehicle tax payment (available from 01.03.2014 onwards; cash payments only at Zollamt Marzahn)
Certificate of Conformity (CoC) or manufacturer data confirmation for new vehicles
Expert assessment according to § 21 StVZO or § 13 EG-FGV for non-type-approved new vehicles
fees: Fee is determined according to the current Road Traffic Fees Regulation and starts at €33.20 in the most favorable case. License plate production is not provided by the Berlin Motor Vehicle Registration Authority; separate costs may apply (consult the office for details).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Processing is exclusively handled by the Motor Vehicle Registration Authority (Kraftfahrzeugzulassungsbehörde) in Berlin-Lichtenberg. Appointments must be scheduled with the KFZ-Zulassungsbehörde.

name: Information from the Joint Tariff Register of Berlin and Brandenburg
description: This service provides information from the Joint Tariff Register shared by Berlin and Brandenburg.
eligibility: Before submitting your tariff inquiry, please check whether your question can be answered by the existing summaries available via the link provided. For online inquiries: Please answer all questions completely, as we cannot otherwise provide information. If you cannot provide certain information or have further questions, please call us at (030) 9028-1457 during office hours. Office hours: Monday, Tuesday and Friday 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM; Thursday 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request for Information from Historical Registry Office Records for Vital Events Registered in Berlin
description: This service allows you to request certified extracts or information from archived vital records (births, marriages, deaths) held by Berlin's registry offices after the statutory retention period has expired.
eligibility: The statutory retention period for the registry office's records has expired. Records are transferred to the archive after legally defined time periods: 110 years after birth, 80 years after marriage, or 30 years after death. You must know which specific Berlin registry office originally registered the vital event — specifying only "Berlin" is insufficient. It is recommended to use online search options before submitting your request. If you wish to use the reading room at the Berlin State Archive in person, you must arrange an appointment in advance.
requiredDocuments: Inquiry form for information/extract from archived vital records registers of Berlin registry offices (can be submitted online or in person at the Berlin State Archive, but only after prior registration)
Precise information about the person being searched: full name and birth name if applicable
All given/first names
Type of event (birth, marriage, or death)
Date of the event
Register number
Name of the registry office that originally registered the vital event
fees: Maximum costs depend on the intended use, number of requested register copies, certifications needed, and investigative effort required.
processingTime: 1 to 16 weeks. Please refrain from inquiries about processing status, as these delay the processing time.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Recognize Foreign Professional Qualifications - Professional Recognition
description: This service allows residents who earned professional qualifications abroad to have them officially recognized in Germany.
eligibility: You must have acquired professional qualifications abroad and provide original documents or certified copies. All documents must be in German (if in another language, you may need a certified translation from a publicly appointed translator). For online application submission, you need to register/log in with a BundID account; basic registration with username and password is sufficient.
requiredDocuments: Table showing your completed training courses and professional activities
Statement of your current place of residence
Proof of identity
Your professional qualifications acquired abroad
Evidence of relevant professional experience or other proof of qualifications if required to determine equivalence
Declaration whether and where you have previously submitted an application for equivalence determination
Approval notice for equivalence determination (if applicable)
Additional documents as required by your specific profession — contact the responsible office for details
fees: No fee for the online portal and services of the Unified Point of Contact Berlin; variable fees depending on workload and statutory regulations for your profession; additional costs may apply for translations, certifications, and compensatory measures
processingTime: If all required documents are complete and received by the responsible office, a decision will be issued within 3 months.

bookingInfo.office: Contact the office responsible for recognizing your professional qualifications (see further information); the Berlin consulting hotline is available for international skilled workers who work or wish to work in Berlin (see further information); the Unified Point of Contact Berlin primarily serves skilled workers with professional qualifications from EU countries and can process many applications online; it also provides general information to national and international skilled workers and assists in locating the appropriate recognition authority.

name: Request Exception Permits for Motor Vehicles and Trailers
description: This service allows you to apply for exception permits for motor vehicles and trailers that deviate from standard construction and operating regulations.
eligibility: An officially recognized motor vehicle expert (a.a.S.) must have certified in a report that the vehicle deviates from the construction and operating regulations of the Road Traffic Licensing Regulation (StVZO) or the Vehicle Licensing Regulation (FZV). If there is no space on multi-axle motor vehicles according to the registration certificate Part I or the expert report to affix a standard rear license plate, the vehicle must be presented for inspection before an exception permit can be issued.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of an exception permit
Expert report on deviations from construction and operating regulations (must be prepared by an officially recognized motor vehicle expert (a.a.S.))
fees: The fee is determined according to the fee schedule for road traffic measures in its respective current version and amounts to a minimum of €10.20. Please note that this fee may be higher depending on the individual case and the specific application submitted.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You can submit inquiries to the vehicle registration authority using the contact form with the subject 'Query: Exception permit for a vehicle'.

name: Certificate of Good Standing (Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung)
description: This service issues an official certificate confirming that a professional's most recent work activity was conducted in Berlin and they are in good standing.
eligibility: Your most recent professional activity must have been performed in Berlin.
requiredDocuments: Proof of professional activity in Berlin (certificate from the relevant professional chamber regarding registered data)
Name change document (if applicable)
Doctoral degree (if available)
Specialist qualification (e.g., medical specialist), if this should be included in the certificate

Training completion certificate (e.g., medical examination certificate) (only if training was not completed in Berlin and/or the professional qualification approval or license was not issued in Berlin)
Professional qualification approval or license document (only if training was not completed in Berlin and/or the professional qualification approval or license was not issued in Berlin)
Note: If copies are submitted, they must be officially certified. For copies without official certification, original documents must be presented at the same time.
fees: €105.00 for EU member states; €128.00 for third countries; €30.00 for aid organizations
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Certificate of Good Standing is issued only by the State Office for Health and Social Affairs Berlin - State Examination Office for Health Professions.

name: Permission to Practice as a Naturopath (Heilkunde)
description: A permission granted by the Berlin health authority to individuals who meet educational, health, and reliability requirements to practice naturopathy.
eligibility: Must be at least 25 years old; demonstrate completion of at least a primary or secondary school education; demonstrate reliability with no serious criminal or moral violations; be in good health suitable for practicing naturopathy; demonstrate knowledge and skills through an examination by the health authority to ensure that practicing naturopathy poses no danger to public health or to patients.
requiredDocuments: Application form (available online or submit an informal written application)
Brief curriculum vitae
Certified copy of school completion certificate
Current extract from the resident registration office
Current medical certificate confirming health suitability to practice naturopathy
Extended certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) for presentation to an authority
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Tempelhof-Schöneberg; Lichtenberg

name: Removal of Illegally Dumped Vehicle Wrecks
description: A service for reporting and arranging removal of illegally dumped vehicle wrecks in Berlin.
eligibility: Report the illegal dumping by telephone, in writing, or electronically.
requiredDocuments: Complaint containing: location and time; volume; perpetrator (if known); personal details of the reporting party
fees: Free of charge; fees may apply to the perpetrator if identified later.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Building Records Archive - Access to Building Files
description: A service that allows property owners, authorized representatives, and building management to request access to archived building records for a property by demonstrating legitimate interest.
eligibility: You must demonstrate a legitimate interest to access the archived building files. You have such interest if you are: property owner(s), authorized representative(s), or building management company/administrator.
requiredDocuments: Land registry extract (not older than six weeks)
Personal ID or property management authorization (current)

Power of attorney from the property owner for access and permission to photocopy or copy (if applicable, a sub-authorization) — only necessary if you are not the direct property owner or if you are acting as a building management company
Declaration of cost assumption — only necessary if you are not the direct property owner or if you are acting as a building management company
fees: Minimum fee: €36.00; approximately €25.00 per file (this is a framework fee)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Type Approval for Vehicle Parts (Individual Approval)
description: This service grants approval for vehicle parts that have been inspected and evaluated by an officially recognized technical expert according to German road traffic regulations.
eligibility: Assessment by an officially recognized expert in motor vehicle traffic for the inspection of a vehicle part according to Section 22a of the German Road Traffic Licensing Regulation (StVZO).
requiredDocuments: Expert report from an officially recognized expert in motor vehicle traffic on the inspection of a vehicle part according to Section 22a StVZO
Identity card or passport with registration confirmation
fees: The fee is determined according to the fee schedule for measures in road traffic in the applicable version and amounts to 10.50 EUR per approval.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service is available at the vehicle registration authority (Zulassungsbehörde) at the locations Berlin-Lichtenberg and Berlin Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg.

name: Building Permit - Request a Preliminary Building Notice (Bauvorbescheid)
description: This service allows you to request a preliminary building notice for a construction project that meets the requirements of Berlin's Building Code.
eligibility: The project must be a construction project according to § 75 Paragraph 1 of the Berlin Building Code (BauO Bln); complete information about the project and all involved parties must be provided.
requiredDocuments: Application for Preliminary Building Notice (may be submitted online via assistant or as a written form by post)
Signed application form with all required signatures, to be sent to the building authority
All required documents and evidence in PDF format (total file size not exceeding 300 MB; individual files not exceeding 20 MB each)
Complete and reviewable construction documents and materials as required by § 5 BauVorlV
Construction documents necessary to assess the questions to be decided by the preliminary notice regarding the building project
Special construction documents according to Attachment 1 BauVorlV
fees: Fees according to the Berlin Building Fee Regulation (BauGebO)
processingTime: See § 69 of the Berlin Building Code (BauO Bln)

bookingInfo.office: The building authority of the district where the property is located is responsible for processing the preliminary notice. Submit the application to that district building authority. For preliminary notices for construction projects under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Building Authority (including embassies and construction projects of the federal government and states), submit the application to the Senate Department for Urban Development, Building and Housing (Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen).

name: Building Permit - Case Status Information (Baugenehmigung - Vorgangsauskunft)
description: This service allows applicants to check the status of their building permit application online using access credentials provided upon application submission.
eligibility: Your building permit application must have already been submitted and you must have received a confirmation of receipt (Eingangsbestätigung) containing the access credentials for the electronic case status inquiry.
requiredDocuments: Bezirk (responsible district)
Aktenzeichen (file reference number)
PIN (personal identification number)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The building authority (Bauaufsichtsbehörde) of the district in which the property is located is responsible for processing building permit applications.

name: Building Permit - Submit under Exemption from Approval
description: A streamlined building permit submission process for projects that meet specific planning requirements and can proceed without formal approval.
eligibility: The planning requirements under § 62 Abs. 2 of the Berlin Building Code (BauO Bln) must be met. The construction project must either: fall within the scope of a development plan (§ 30 Abs. 1 or 2 BauGB) and not contradict its provisions, or have the necessary exemptions and exceptions (§ 31 BauGB) already granted, or be finally established as planning-compliant in a planning decision (§ 75 Abs. 2 BauO Bln), or involve changes and conversion of loft stories for residential purposes including roof dormers under § 34 Absatz 1 Satz 1 BauGB. Additionally, infrastructure provision must be secured under BauGB, and complete information about the project and parties involved must be provided. The construction plans must be prepared by a qualified plan author (such as an architect or structural engineer) with authorization to submit building plans.
requiredDocuments: Documents submitted for exemption from approval (may be submitted online via assistant or by post using the provided form)
All required documents and evidence in PDF format (total file size not exceeding 300 MB; individual files not exceeding 20 MB each)
Complete and verifiable construction plans and other documents (according to § 3 BauVorlV)

Excerpt from the cadastral map, site plan, and qualified open space plan (showing the construction plot and neighboring properties within at least 50 m radius; construction plot must be marked; site plan must be based on the cadastral map)
Construction drawings
Building description and operational description (explaining the construction project and its use)
Structural safety certificate (if subject to building authority review) or declaration from structural engineer according to the criteria catalog in Annex 2 BauVorlV
Fire protection certificate (if subject to building authority review)
Noise and vibration protection documentation (calculations demonstrating compliance with applicable standards)

Confirmation of compliance with ancillary building law requirements according to the Building Ancillary Law Guidelines of the Supreme Building Authority at the Senate Administration responsible for construction
Special construction plans according to Annex 1 BauVorlV

Documentation confirming secured infrastructure regarding water and energy supply, wastewater disposal, and traffic access (if the project cannot connect to public infrastructure or lacks sufficient road frontage, in accordance with BauVorlV § 3 Absatz 1)

Verifiable calculation for projects within development plan scope (if the development plan contains provisions on building density and the calculation is not already part of the site plan, according to § 7 Absatz 6 BauVorlV)
Survey form for building statistics (Hochbaustatistikgesetz) for buildings
Approval from the supreme state road authority or Federal Highway Authority (for projects requiring approval under § 9 Absatz 2 Satz 2 of the Federal Highway Act)
Statement from the lower nature conservation and landscape management authority (according to § 17 Absatz 1 of the Federal Nature Conservation Act)
fees: Building fees are generally calculated based on construction costs.
processingTime: See § 62 Abs. 3 BauO Bln

bookingInfo.office: Submit to the Building Authority (Bauaufsichtsbehörde) of the district where the property is located. For projects under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Building Authority (including approvals for embassies and construction projects of the federal government or states), submit to the Senate Administration for Urban Development, Building and Housing (Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen).

name: Building Permit for Special Structures
description: A building permit application for special structures such as day care facilities, high-rise buildings, assembly halls, hospitals, residential homes, schools, universities, and amusement parks that meet the criteria defined in Berlin Building Code § 2 Abs. 4.
eligibility: The project must be classified as a special structure (Sonderbau) according to § 2 Abs. 4 of Berlin Building Code (BauO Bln), such as certain day care facilities, high-rise buildings, assembly halls, hospitals, residential homes, schools, universities, or leisure and amusement parks. You must provide complete information about the project and all parties involved. The building plans must be prepared by a qualified designer (architect or structural engineer) who is authorized to submit building documents.
requiredDocuments: Application for a building permit for special structures (completed via online assistant or paper form with PDF documents)
Extract from the land register (Flurkarte), site plan, and qualified open space plan showing the building site and neighboring properties within at least 50 meters
Building drawings
Building description and operational description explaining the construction project and its use
Structural stability report (if required by building authority) or declaration from structural engineer per Attachment 2 criteria
Fire protection report (if required by building authority)
Sound and vibration protection documentation showing compliance with building code requirements
Confirmation of compliance with building ancillary law (Baunebenrecht) per guidelines from the Supreme Building Authority
Special building documents per Attachment 1 of Building Documents Regulation (BauVorlV)
Documentation of secured infrastructure for water and energy supply, wastewater disposal, and traffic access (if not connected to public utilities)
Verifiable calculation per § 7 Abs. 6 BauVorlV for projects within a development plan area with building use regulations (if not already part of site plan)
Building activity statistics survey form per Building Statistics Act (Hochbaustatistikgesetz) for building structures
fees: Building fees are generally calculated based on construction costs.
processingTime: According to § 69 of Berlin Building Code (BauO Bln).

bookingInfo.office: The building authority (Bauaufsichtsbehörde) of the district where the property is located is responsible for processing building permit applications. Submit the application to the respective district building authority. For projects under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Building Authority (including embassies and federal/state construction projects), submit the application to the Senate Department for Urban Development, Building and Housing (Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen).

name: Building Permit for Advertising Installations Under Simplified Building Permit Procedure
description: A simplified building permit application process for advertising installations that meet specific criteria under Berlin building regulations.
eligibility: The project is subject to § 63a BauO Bln (Berlin Building Code); the advertising installation(s) is/are not procedure-exempt; complete information about the project and all parties involved must be provided.
requiredDocuments: Application for building permit under simplified building permit procedure for advertising installations (submitted either via online assistant or paper form with supporting documents)
PDF format upload capability with total file size not exceeding 300 MB and individual files not exceeding 20 MB each
Complete, examination-ready building plans and other documents according to § 4 BauVorlV

Extract from the cadastral map (Flurkarte), site plan, and qualified open space plan according to § 3 BauVorlV (cadastral extract must show the property and neighboring properties within at least 50 meters; property must be marked; site plan must be prepared based on the cadastral map)
Drawing and description or other appropriate representation of the advertising installation, such as a colored photograph or colored photomontage
Proof of structural stability (if subject to building inspection); otherwise, a statement from the structural engineer according to the criteria catalogue in Appendix 2
fees: Fees according to BauGebO (Berlin Building Fees Regulation)
processingTime: According to § 69 Building Code Berlin (BauO Bln)

bookingInfo.office: District Building Supervisory Authority (Bauaufsichtsbehörde) of the district where the property is located; for projects under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Building Authority (including embassies and federal/state construction projects), submit to the Senate Department for Urban Development, Building and Housing (Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen)

name: Request Building Permit in Simplified Building Permit Procedure
description: This service allows you to apply for a building permit through a simplified procedure for projects that meet specific criteria under Berlin building law.
eligibility: The project must be a project according to § 63 BauO Bln. The project must not be classified as a special building or advertising structure. The project must not be procedure-free. Your project must not be located within the scope of a development plan in the sense of § 30 Abs. 1 or 2 BauGB and you must not have a valid planning law decision according to § 75 Abs. 2 BauO Bln. Complete information about the project and the parties involved must be provided. The building plans must be prepared by a person authorized to prepare building plans (including an architect or structural engineer) who is authorized to do so.
requiredDocuments: Application for building permit in simplified building permit procedure (via online assistant or written form by mail)
All required documents and evidence in PDF format for upload (total file size not exceeding 300 MB; individual files not exceeding 20 MB each)
Complete examination-ready building plans and other documents according to § 3 BauVorlV

Excerpt from the cadastral map (Flurkarte), site plan (Lageplan), and qualified open space plan according to § 3 BauVorlV (cadastral excerpt must show the building plot and neighboring plots within at least 50 m radius with the building plot clearly marked)
Building drawings
Building description and operational description explaining the construction project and its use
Proof of structural stability (if examined by building authority) or otherwise declaration from structural planner according to Appendix 2 criteria catalog
Proof of fire protection (if examined by building authority)
Calculations demonstrating compliance with sound and vibration protection requirements under building law

Confirmation of compliance with auxiliary building law (Baunebenrecht) according to the building auxiliary law guideline of the Supreme Building Authority at the competent Senate Administration for Building
Special building plans according to Appendix 1 BauVorlV

Information on secured infrastructure for water and energy supply, wastewater disposal, and traffic access (if the project cannot be connected to public water/energy supply or public wastewater disposal, or does not have adequate access to public traffic areas)

Examination-ready calculation for building projects within the scope of a development plan (if the development plan contains regulations on the extent of building use and this is not already part of the site plan)
Statistical survey form for building activity statistics (Erhebungsbogen für die Bautätigkeitsstatistik) according to the Building Statistics Act for buildings
fees: Building fees are generally calculated depending on construction costs.
processingTime: See § 69 Building Ordinance Berlin (BauO Bln).

bookingInfo.office: City Development Office (Stadtentwicklungsamt). The building authority (Bauaufsichtsbehörde) of the district where the building plot is located is responsible for processing building applications. Send your application to that building authority. For building projects under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Building Authority (such as approval of embassies and building projects of the federal and state governments), please send your application to the Senate Administration for Urban Development, Building and Housing (Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen).

name: Building Chamber - Application for Registration as an Authorized Building Design Engineer (Bauvorlageberechtigter Ingenieur)
description: This service allows qualified civil engineers and architects with a relevant university degree and minimum practical experience to apply for official registration as an authorized person who can submit building design documentation to authorities.
eligibility: Professional qualifying university degree in civil engineering or building construction; minimum two years of practical work in building design after completing studies
requiredDocuments: Application for registration as an authorized building design engineer (Bauvorlageberechtigter)
Reference/project list attachment to application (completed and signed)
University degree diploma and transcript (copy) - professional qualifying degree in civil engineering

Building permits and design documentation (original or copy) - for at least two buildings with independently prepared design documentation, approval notes, and corresponding building permits from a period of at least 2 years (excluding specialist planning)

Certification of independently performed planning services by authorized design professionals - certifications from the authorized design author or authorized employer confirming planning work in performance phases 1-5 according to § 33 of the Fee Schedule for Architects and Engineers (HOAI), with confirmation that the applicant performed these services under their supervision
processingTime: A decision on the application must be made within three months of submission of complete documents; the Berlin Building Chamber may extend this deadline once by up to two additional months.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Building Chamber – Application for Registration as a Consulting Engineer
description: This service allows qualified engineers in Berlin to register on the official list of consulting engineers (beratende Ingenieure/innen) maintained by the Building Chamber.
eligibility: Primary residence, professional establishment, or place of employment in Berlin; willingness to perform professional duties; authorization to use the title "Engineer" (Ingenieur/Ingenieurin) or completion of appropriate professional training; relevant practical experience of at least two years or qualification for higher technical administrative service; professional practice as a self-employed engineer or as legal representative of an engineering firm.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration on the list of consulting engineers
Birth certificate including proof of current and former names (if applicable due to name changes or marriage)
Proof of residence, professional establishment, or place of employment in Berlin
Declaration that no grounds for refusal of registration are known
Declaration regarding entries in comparable professional registries of professional chambers in other German states, EU member states, or states equivalent under EU law
Proof of professional liability insurance (for self-employed practice)
Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) from the Federal Central Register, type 0 (official certificate)
University degree certificate (e.g., Diplom/Bachelor/Master)
Engineer's certificate (Ingenieurzeugnis) including transcript of graded subjects
Evidence of two years of professional practice (e.g., employment references or reference lists)
processingTime: 1–3 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Building Chamber - Application for Registration in the List of Qualified Structural Planners
description: This service allows qualified professionals to apply for registration as a structural planner with the Berlin Building Chamber.
eligibility: Professional qualification from a university degree in architecture, civil engineering, or structural engineering; minimum three years of practical experience in the field of structural planning
requiredDocuments: Application for registration in the list of structural planners of the Berlin Building Chamber (completed)
Appendix: reference and project list to application
Diploma certificate
Certificate including grades and subject overview
processingTime: 4-8 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request deletion of membership in the Chamber of Architects as a consulting engineer
description: This service allows consulting engineers to request removal of their membership from the Berlin Chamber of Architects when they no longer provide services or maintain a business location in Berlin.
eligibility: You no longer provide services as a consulting engineer in Berlin; you no longer maintain a business location in Berlin as a consulting engineer.
requiredDocuments: Declaration for deletion of membership in the Berlin Chamber of Architects
processingTime: 1-3 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Building Chamber - Request Deletion of Membership as an Engineer
description: This service allows engineers to request removal of their membership from the Berlin Building Chamber when they no longer provide services or maintain a business location in Berlin.
eligibility: You no longer provide services as an engineer in the state of Berlin; You no longer have a business location as an engineer in the state of Berlin
requiredDocuments: Declaration for deletion of membership in the Berlin Building Chamber
processingTime: 1-3 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Building Chamber - Request Engineer Membership
description: This service allows you to apply for professional membership in the Berlin Building Chamber as a qualified engineer.
eligibility: You must have the right to use the professional title 'Ingenieur' / 'Ingenieurin'. This requires one of the following: a degree in a technical or natural science field from a German scientific university, university of applied sciences, or business academy; a degree from a German public or legally equivalent private engineering school; successful completion of an operational management course from a state-recognized German mining school; or authorization from the competent authority to use the title 'Ingenieurin' or 'Ingenieur'.
requiredDocuments: Application for admission to the Berlin Building Chamber (mandatory or voluntary membership)
Engineer degree certificate and final transcript (certified copy) with exact specification of field of study
Current proof of employment/activity
Professional liability insurance (copy) - for mandatory membership application, including a copy of your insurance policy and, if applicable, current proof of validity for older policies
Police certificate of good conduct - Document type 0 (for voluntary membership application)
fees: Free: Voluntary membership; €30.00: Mandatory membership; €150.00: Mandatory membership for consulting engineers
processingTime: 1-3 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Building Charges Register - Information Request
description: A service that provides property owners and prospective buyers with information from the building charges register for a specific property, subject to demonstrated legitimate interest.
eligibility: You must demonstrate legitimate interest to access the building charges register. Those with legitimate interest include: property owners; prospective buyers; property owners; prospective buyers.
requiredDocuments: Application for information from the building charges register (signed) — submit an informal written application by post, fax, or scanned by email, with your own signature
Property details — street, house number, if applicable plot register sheet number, plot, parcel number
Proof of legitimate interest — you must sufficiently demonstrate your legitimate interest in the information
fees: €17.00 — negative certificate per property; €29.00 — copies of existing building charges (including photocopies) per property
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service can only be accessed at the district office (Bezirksamt) responsible for the location where the property is situated.

name: Tree Protection - Request Exception Permit
description: Request an exception permit to carry out measures on protected trees on private or public property in Berlin.
eligibility: You must be the property owner or authorized representative. The measure affects trees on private and public properties and does not apply to federal projects. Tree work must typically occur outside the period from March 1 to September 30 (felling prohibition period). The property owner's traffic safety obligation may be grounds for tree measures, and owners must prevent damage to persons or property caused by trees. Protection of animals living in trees and hedges must be observed. If you are not the property owner, powers of attorney from the owners are required.
requiredDocuments: Application for exception permit (available online or by written request via email or post)
Details of planned measure (e.g., tree felling, tree trimming, crown reduction, or root work such as excavation, fill, or root severing)
Tree species, trunk circumference (measured at 1.30 meters height), and crown diameter
Statement of reasons for the request
Site plan or location sketch of the protected tree stand
Contractor quote or expert assessment (if available)
Table for legal entities (for measures affecting 15 or more trees)
Power of attorney (if applicable)
Proof of fee exemption (if applicable)
fees: €45.00 to €760.00 administrative fee; rejection of the measure is also subject to a fee
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Contact the Environment and Nature Conservation Office (Umwelt- und Naturschutzamt) in the district where the tree is located.

name: Building Law - Participate in the Creation of a Development Plan
description: This service allows you to submit comments and feedback during the public participation period for the creation of a development plan in Berlin.
eligibility: No prerequisites required. For online participation: registration/login via BundID (optional) or Mein Unternehmenskonto (MUK). Private individuals may use BundID voluntarily. Legal entities require a business account (MUK). For online participation with BundID using the "Online-Ausweis" variant, you need: your electronic identity card, EU citizen card (eID card), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated online authentication function (eID) and your PIN; an external card reader or a modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS operating system; the "AusweisApp" software. Legal entities need an Elster certificate for registration via Mein Unternehmenskonto (MUK).
processingTime: The duration of the procedure is variable and depends on the scope of comments and statements received.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Illegal Construction Waste (Bauschutt) - Disposal
description: A service for reporting and arranging the removal of illegally dumped construction waste in Berlin.
eligibility: Report the illegal waste by telephone, in writing, or electronically.
requiredDocuments: Complaint containing the following information: location and time; volume; person responsible (if known); personal data of the person reporting
fees: Free of charge (potentially chargeable to the person responsible if identified later).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Construction Site - Securing Work Area and Regulating Traffic
description: This service provides special use permits and traffic regulation orders required to establish and operate construction sites on public roads in Berlin.
eligibility: A special use permit from the responsible Street and Green Space Office is required for any construction site established on public road land. The building contractor must obtain this permit before beginning work.
requiredDocuments: Online application for traffic regulation order, including information on work area location and timeframe

Traffic sign plan capable of being ordered, or if using RSA standard plans: a dimensioned site plan with requested traffic and safety measures (note: submitted plans and images will be published online for public information; ensure all materials are properly licensed or legally unencumbered with no third-party rights)
Signal installation site plan (traffic light plan) for work areas in the vicinity of traffic signal systems, obtainable from GB infraSignal GmbH

Additional documents as needed, such as sample letters for planned resident notifications, detour plans, utility plans, permits agreements, power of attorney for third-party applications, or documentation of completed consultations
processingTime: 2 to 6 weeks before work begins; processing follows receipt order and prioritization. Depending on work complexity, required coordination, and application volume, processing may take several months.

bookingInfo.office: For traffic regulation orders on roads in the higher-level road network (road levels 0-III), the Department VI - Traffic Management is responsible. For other work areas, the traffic authorities responsible (part of the Street and Green Space Offices) are competent.

name: Request Information on Urban Planning and Zoning Aspects of a Construction Project
description: A service for obtaining information about urban planning and zoning law aspects related to a proposed construction project.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Construction Project — Advice on Urban Planning and Planning Law Aspects
description: This service provides consultation on urban planning and planning law aspects for construction projects.
eligibility: No prerequisites required
requiredDocuments: Information about the property and planned construction project
Site plan (if applicable)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Urban Planning Opinion on Construction Project
description: A service for obtaining an official urban planning assessment regarding the planning law and urban design aspects of a proposed construction project.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
requiredDocuments: Informal application (formloser Antrag)
fees: 75.00 Euro in unplanned areas; 30.00 Euro in planned areas
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Building Plan and Building Lines - Information Service
description: A service providing information and inquiries about building plans (Bebauungspläne) and building lines (Fluchtlinien) in Berlin, with no eligibility requirements.
eligibility: There are no eligibility requirements.
fees: No fee for online inquiries; €32.00 per half hour commenced for written inquiries from building lines plans
processingTime: 2 weeks for written inquiries from building lines plans

bookingInfo.office: Building plans may be viewed at the responsible surveying office (Vermessungsamt). Inquiries about approved and pending building plans as well as information about building feasibility of properties can be obtained from the responsible city planning office (Stadtplanungsamt).

name: Certification of Fingerprints for Submission to Foreign Authorities
description: This service provides official certification of your fingerprints for submission to foreign government agencies, available to Berlin residents with primary residence registration.
eligibility: You must be registered in Berlin with your primary residence. Fingerprints can only be taken at the State Office for Citizenship and Public Order if you have your primary residence in Berlin.
