Record card excerpt if you own a paper driver's license that was not issued in Berlin (you only need the record card excerpt if your lost driver's license was not obtained in Berlin but in another state; request it yourself from the driver's licensing authority of the state where your driver's license was issued and send it to: State Office for Citizen and Regulatory Affairs (LABO), Department IV - Driver Licensing, Unit IV C 21, Puttkamerstr. 16-18, 10969 Berlin)
fees: €42.50 for replacement driver's license; €10.00 for temporary driver's license when applied for simultaneously with replacement driver's license; €13.30 for temporary driver's license only; €6.32 additional for direct mail delivery of the driver's license (delivery by registered mail or deposited in mailbox, requires name on mailbox); €9.52 additional for express production of the driver's license
processingTime: 48 hours (two business days) for express production of the driver's license by the Federal Print Office

bookingInfo.office: Driver's licensing authority (Fahrerlaubnisbehörde); appointments can be scheduled via contact form

name: Request Initial Driver's License (Fahrerlaubnis - Ersterteilung beantragen)
description: A service for applying for an initial driver's license in Berlin, available to residents with a primary residence in Berlin who meet the minimum age requirement and can provide the necessary documents and certifications.
eligibility: Primary residence in Berlin required; if Berlin is only a secondary residence, the application can only be submitted in justified exceptional cases with consent from the authority of the primary residence. Minimum age requirement applies; applications may be submitted up to 6 months before reaching the minimum age. Personal appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card (Personalausweis) or passport
One current biometric passport photo on paper (bring your own; photos are not printed on-site)
Declaration of driving school and test center (name and address of the driving school; name and address of the test center; no change of test center is possible after receiving test approval)

Certificate of first aid training (with exceptions for certain medical and healthcare professionals as defined in § 19 Abs. 3 FeV; certificate of participation is required in all cases; instructions on emergency measures at accident sites do not qualify)
Vision test certificate (not older than 2 years; required only for classes AM, A1, A2, A, B, BE, L, or T)
Certificate of medical eye examination (not older than 2 years; required only for classes C, C1, CE, C1E, D, D1, DE, D1E)
Certificate of physical and mental fitness (not older than 1 year; required only for classes C, C1, CE, C1E, D, D1, DE, D1E)
Functional and performance test (not older than 1 year; required only for classes D, D1, DE, D1E)

Certificate of good conduct/criminal record (Führungszeugnis, type 'O' for submission to authorities; required only for classes D, D1, DE, D1E; must be requested at a citizen's office, not at the driver licensing authority; €13.00 fee)
Certificate of basic qualification for professional drivers (if you are applying for driver classes C or D and wish to apply for a driver qualification record)
fees: €45.90 (standard fee); €45.10 (if applying only for classes AM or L); €6.32 (direct delivery of license via registered mail or postbox delivery, name required on mailbox); €35.00 (issuance of driver qualification record including direct delivery within Germany); €13.00 (certificate of good conduct, if required)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Applications can be submitted at any of the designated authorities. Visit the official page for each location to check whether appointment booking and other application methods are available.

name: Driver License Extension for Classes D1, D1E, D, and DE
description: Service to extend an existing driver license to include bus and coach driving categories (D-class licenses).
eligibility: Applicant must have primary residence in Berlin (secondary residence applicants need approval from their primary residence authority). Minimum age requirement applies; applications may be submitted 6 months before reaching the minimum age. Personal appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
One current biometric passport photo on paper (bring your own; photos are not printed on-site)
Existing driver license or copy if not issued in Berlin; for extensions of former DDR licenses, provide the VK-30 form (application card) if available
Driving school details (name of operator and address); may be submitted later if not yet selected at time of application

First aid training certificate (previous certifications already submitted to the licensing authority do not need to be resubmitted; training in emergency measures at accident scenes is no longer recognized as of 22.10.2017)
Eye examination (not older than 2 years)
Medical examination (not older than 1 year)
Functional and performance test (not older than 1 year)
Certificate of good conduct (Führungszeugnis, form type 'O') — must be requested simultaneously at a citizen service office (Bürgeramt), not at the driving license authority; subject to fee
Professional qualification certificate for professional drivers (Grundqualifikation) if applying for D-class extension with driver qualification record (FQN)
fees: €45.10 for driver license extension application; €6.32 for direct dispatch of license by registered mail (requires applicant name on mailbox); €35.00 for FQN extension including direct dispatch within Germany
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Apply at a Berlin citizen service office (Bürgeramt), as the required certificate of good conduct can only be requested there. Contact individual office locations to learn about appointment booking and other application options.

name: Driver's License - Request Extension
description: Service to extend an existing driver's license to additional vehicle classes in Berlin.
eligibility: Main residence in Berlin (if Berlin is secondary residence, application only possible in exceptional cases with consent from main residence authority); Minimum age requirement (application possible earliest 6 months before reaching minimum age); Personal appearance required
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
1 current biometric passport photo on paper (bring your own; no photos printed on-site)
Original driver's license presented; plus copy of driver's license if not issued in Berlin; for extension of former GDR driver's license, present VK-30 form (application card) if in possession
Driving school and test center details (name of school and address, plus name and address of test center; change of test center not possible after examination approval)
Vision test certificate (not older than 2 years; required only for classes AM, A1, A2, A, B, BE, L, or T)
Eye doctor examination (not older than 2 years; only for classes C, C1, CE, C1E)
Medical examination (not older than 1 year; only for classes C, C1, CE, C1E)
First aid training certificate (note: training only in immediate accident measures not recognized since 22.10.2017; if previously submitted to driving authority, re-submission not required)
Professional qualification for professional drivers (if applicable; only if extending to vehicle class C and requesting driver qualification certificate)
fees: 45.10 Euro for extension application; 6.32 Euro for direct mail dispatch (registered letter/mailbox insertion, requires name on mailbox); 35.00 Euro for FQN extension including direct dispatch within Germany
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Application can be submitted at any of the listed authorities; check individual office pages for additional submission options beyond appointment booking.

name: Driver Qualification Certificate (FQN) Application Due to Changes, Loss, Damage, or Theft
description: Service for professional drivers in Berlin to apply for a replacement or renewed driver qualification certificate (FQN) due to changes, loss, damage, or theft.
eligibility: You are a professional driver; you are a holder of a driver qualification certificate (FQN); you have your main residence in Berlin; personal appearance is required; you must provide a loss declaration if your FQN is lost; you must provide a police report if your FQN was stolen.
requiredDocuments: Your old or to-be-renewed driver qualification certificate (FQN) — bring it with you if applying due to changes or damage
Written declaration of loss if you lost your FQN
Police report if your FQN was stolen
1 current biometric passport photo on paper — please bring a photo with you as no paper photos are printed on site
Valid card driving license
Identity card or registration certificate (copy)
Employment authorization (EU) or residence permit with authorization to work, if applicable
fees: 35.00 EUR for standard mail delivery of the FQN within Germany; 41.40 EUR for express issuance of the FQN
processingTime: Standard: The newly issued FQN will be sent to you by post. Express procedure: The FQN will be ready for pickup at the driving license authority 3 business days after application submission.

bookingInfo.office: If the driving license or driver card is also missing in addition to the FQN, please indicate this when scheduling your appointment.

name: Driver License - Driver Qualification Certificate (FQN) - Apply, Extend, or Renew
description: This service allows professional truck and bus drivers in Berlin to apply for, extend, or renew their Driver Qualification Certificate (FQN), which is required for commercial driving of vehicles in classes C and D.
eligibility: Main residence in Berlin; personal appointment required; you are a professional driver or in training as a professional driver; you need to provide proof of basic qualification or further training; eligible for first issuance of class C or D license, extension to class C or D, or renewal of your license, or reissuance after withdrawal or voluntary surrender of your license.
requiredDocuments: Official proof of place and date of birth (e.g., ID card or passport)
Valid ID card or passport
Registration certificate if applicable
1 current biometric passport photo on paper (bring your own; photos are not printed on-site)
Valid card-format driver's license
Work permit (EU) or residence permit with notation of permitted employment if applicable
Proof of basic qualification or further training if available (basic qualification for first issuance or extension of FQN; further training for renewal of FQN)
fees: €35.00 for issuance, extension, or renewal of FQN with direct mail within Germany; €41.40 for FQN issuance via express procedure; €7.00 for review of application for recognition of other completed specialized training measures (additional training for hazardous goods and animal transport)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service can be used at all citizen offices (Bürgerämter) in Berlin. Note: When applying for issuance, extension, or renewal of the FQN, please book an appointment for the services of first issuance, extension, renewal, or reissuance of a driver license for class C or D.

name: International Driving License Application
description: Apply for an international driving license if you hold a German card-format driving license or a recognized foreign license and have your residence in Berlin.
eligibility: German residents must hold a German card-format driving license (holders of old paper-format licenses must first convert to a card-format license). Holders of foreign driving licenses may inquire at the driving license authority about possibilities for issuing an international driving license. Residence must be registered in Berlin; if Berlin is a secondary residence, the application can be submitted with the consent of the primary residence authority. Personal appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
One current biometric passport photo on paper (please bring one; paper photos are not printed on-site)
Presentation of the driving license
processingTime: Immediate

bookingInfo.office: Citizen Office (Bürgeramt): Holders of German driving licenses with primary or secondary residence in Berlin can apply for an international driving license at any Berlin Citizen Office. Driving License Authority (Fahrerlaubnisbehörde): Holders of foreign driving licenses must submit the application at the Driving License Authority, Puttkamerstr. 16-18. For information about additional application options beyond appointment booking at individual offices, check the official office locations.

name: Request a Record of Driving License File (Karteikartenabschrift)
description: This service allows you to request an official record of your driving license file if your paper driving license was issued in Berlin and you have moved to another German state or EU/EWR country.
eligibility: Your paper driving license was issued in Berlin; you have relocated your residence from Berlin to another German state or to another EU or EWR member state
requiredDocuments: Application for record of driving license file (may be submitted primarily online; alternatively, submit a written request by post or email with required documents)
Personal information: family name, first name, date of birth, place of birth, current and previous address
Driving license number and issue date
Proof of identity: copy of your driving license or passport
Address of the responsible licensing authority: the driving license authority at your current place of residence
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Card Driving License Exchange
description: Exchange your card driving license (Kartenführerschein) for a renewed version if you hold one and have your main residence in Berlin.
eligibility: You must be a holder of a card driving license and have your main residence in Berlin. If Berlin is only your secondary residence, you may only submit an application in justified exceptional cases with the consent of the authority of your main residence. Personal appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
One current biometric passport photo on paper (please bring a photo with you; paper photos are not printed on site)
Card driving license

Training certificates according to the Professional Drivers Qualification Act, if applicable (if a driver qualification certificate is to be applied for after completion of professional driver training; please submit original certificates but only provide copies for the application)

Valid eye test for removal of glasses requirement (for removal of glasses requirement during license exchange; for holders of driving license classes C and D, an eye examination according to Regulation 6 No. 2 must be provided)
fees: €26.50 for card driving license exchange; €6.32 for direct mail delivery of the card driving license to your home; €9.52 for express production of the driving license (only possible at the driving license authority); €35.00 for driver qualification certificate including direct delivery within Germany; €42.10 for driver qualification certificate in express procedure
processingTime: With direct mail delivery, the driving license is sent directly from the Federal Print Office via German Post by registered letter/insertion into your mailbox. This requires that the name of the driving license holder is displayed on the mailbox.

bookingInfo.office: Card driving license exchange without express; Card driving license exchange with express; provisional driving license

name: Driving License - Request New Issuance
description: Request a new driving license if yours was previously revoked or suspended, with an in-person appointment required and Berlin residency as your main place of residence.
eligibility: In-person appointment is required; main residence in Berlin. If Berlin is only a secondary residence, the application can only be submitted in justified exceptional cases and with consent from the authority of your main residence.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
1 current biometric passport photo on paper (bring your own; paper photos are not printed on-site)
Documents regarding driving license revocation if available (e.g., court judgment)

Certificate of good conduct (Führungszeugnis, type 'O', for submission to an authority) — this is requested simultaneously with the application and is subject to a fee; can only be requested at a citizen's office (Bürgeramt), not at the driving license authority
Vision test certificate (not older than 2 years; only for license classes AM, A1, A2, A, B, BE, L, or T)
Medical eye examination (not older than 2 years; only for license classes C, C1, CE, C1E, D, D1, DE, D1E)
Medical examination (not older than 1 year; only for license classes C, C1, CE, C1E, D, D1, DE, D1E)
Proof of first aid training (if not previously submitted to the driving license authority; training in 'immediate measures at accident site' has not been recognized since 22.10.2017)

Proof of basic qualification for professional drivers if applicable (required if you are applying for driving license classes C/D and want to request the driver qualification certificate (FQN) simultaneously)
fees: 222.60 euros; 35.00 euros for issuance of FQN including direct shipment within Germany
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Apply at a Berlin citizen's office (Bürgeramt), as the simultaneous application for the required certificate of good conduct is only possible there. Check individual office locations for additional application options beyond appointment booking.

name: Driver License - Converting a Foreign Driver License from an EU/EEA Country
description: This service allows residents to convert a valid driver license from an EU or EEA country into a German driver license with a Berlin residence registration.
eligibility: Main residence must be registered in Berlin. If Berlin is only a secondary residence, the application can only be submitted in justified exceptional cases and with the consent of the authority where your main residence is registered. Personal appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
One current biometric passport photo on paper (please bring a photo with you; printed photos are not available on-site)

Presentation of the EU driver license (this applies even if the EU driver license has already expired; if the EU driver license has been lost or stolen, provide detailed information about the driver license such as license classes, place of issue, and date of issue; if you still have a copy of the driver license or confirmation of the data from the issuing country, please submit these as copies with your application)
For conversion of truck or bus driver licenses (C and D classes): Certificate of physical and mental fitness
Certificate of medical examination of vision
For D classes (bus) additionally: Functional and performance test
Application for a certificate of conduct (document type '0' for official purposes)
If applicable: Evidence of professional driver qualification (code number 95)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The application can be submitted at any of the authorities listed on the official page. You can learn whether there are additional options for submitting your application beyond booking an appointment by visiting the individual locations (click on the location).

name: Driver's License - Recognition of a Foreign Driver's License from a Third Country
description: This service allows residents with a primary residence in Berlin to convert a valid foreign driver's license from a non-EU/EWR country into a German driver's license.
eligibility: Primary residence in Berlin required. If Berlin is only a secondary residence, the application can only be submitted in justified exceptional cases with approval from the authority of your primary residence. In-person appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
Residence permit, if you are not an EU/EWR citizen
One current biometric passport photo on paper (bring your own; no photos are printed on-site)

Specification of driving school and testing center (required for third countries and potentially Schedule 11 with examination) — name of the driving school owner and address, as well as name and address of the testing center

Valid foreign driver's license (must be valid and presented in original at time of application for German license; international licenses cannot be converted, a valid national license is always required)
Translation of foreign driver's license (required if the license is not issued in German or English; otherwise may be requested during application processing)
First aid training certificate (required only for conversion of licenses from third countries)
Vision test (for car and motorcycle licenses, classes A and B — always required for third country conversions; generally not required for Schedule 11 countries unless specified in country notes)

Medical examination certificates for truck and bus drivers (if applicable) — general medical examination, eye examination, and functional and performance test for bus driving (required for third countries or Schedule 11 countries if license to be issued for next 5 years)
fees: €37.50 for conversion of foreign driver's license without examination; €45.10 for conversion of foreign driver's license with examination
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Application can be submitted at any of the offices listed on the Berlin.de page. Contact individual locations to confirm application options available.

name: Driver's License - Conversion of an Official Service Driver's License
description: This service allows you to convert an official service driver's license into a regular civilian driver's license in Berlin.
eligibility: Personal appearance is required. You must have your main residence in Berlin. If Berlin is only your secondary residence, you may only submit an application in justified exceptional cases and with consent from the authority of your main residence.
requiredDocuments: Identity card (Personalausweis) or passport
One current biometric passport photo on paper (please bring your own photo; no paper photos are printed on site)
Service driver's license (Dienstführerschein)
Civilian driver's license if the conversion extends your general driving privileges
Certificate regarding the status of your service driver's license if you have since left the service
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The application can be submitted at any of the responsible authorities listed. You can find out whether additional options besides booking an appointment are available by visiting the individual office locations.

name: Driver's License - Exchange of Old Paper License for EU Card License
description: This service allows you to exchange your old paper driver's license (issued by December 31, 1998) for a modern EU card license if you have your primary residence in Berlin.
eligibility: You wish to continue driving a motor vehicle in public road traffic; your paper driver's license was issued on or before December 31, 1998; you have your primary residence in Berlin (if Berlin is only your secondary residence, the application can only be submitted in justified exceptional cases with the consent of the authority of your primary residence); personal appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity document (German ID card or passport)
One current biometric passport photo on paper (you must bring this with you; paper photos are not printed on-site)
Original old driver's license
Valid eye test or eye examination for removal of vision correction restriction (required for classes C and D licenses per FeV §12 Abs. 6 with examination per Annex 6 No. 2)

Card file extract if you own a paper driver's license not issued in Berlin (only required if your license was issued in another federal state; request from the issuing state's driving license authority and send to LABO, Abt. IV, Puttkamerstr. 16-18, 10969 Berlin)
fees: €26.50 for exchange to EU card license; €6.32 additional for direct mail delivery (not combinable with express); €9.52 for express production (application only at driving license office)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details. Note: Direct mail delivery is available where the license is mailed directly by the federal printing office via registered mail/mail slot delivery, provided the license holder's name is on the mailbox.

bookingInfo.office: Available at all citizen offices (Bürgerin Berlin. For appointment availability and other application options, visit individual office locations or contact the Berlin Authorities Telephone (030) 115.

name: Driver's License - Pick Up Extended Driving License
description: This service allows you to pick up your extended driving license by making a personal visit to the designated office.
eligibility: Personal appearance is required
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
Presentation of the current driving license
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Pick-up of the driving license is only possible at the Puttkamerstraße location.

name: Pick up driver's license
description: A service to collect your new or replacement driver's license at the citizen's office where you submitted your application.
eligibility: You must have applied for one of the following at the citizen's office: exchange of an old driver's license for an EU card license, replacement license due to loss or theft, or exchange of a card license; you selected the option "Pick up at citizen's office" when submitting your application; personal appearance is required. The pickup is only possible at the citizen's office where you submitted the application for issuance of your (new) driver's license. You may have an authorized person pick up the driver's license on your behalf.
requiredDocuments: Application confirmation
National ID card or passport
Old driver's license (if applicable)
Power of attorney from applicant (if using a representative)
Copy of national ID card (if using a representative)
Old driver's license (if using a representative and applicable)
processingTime: 14 days to 3 months. Please note that processing time at the driver's license authority varies between 14 days and 3 months, and the current processing status does not allow precise conclusions about your document pickup date. We recommend checking the processing status regularly. Please note that there is no separate notification when your driver's license is ready for pickup.

bookingInfo.office: Pickup is only possible at the citizen's office where you submitted the application for issuance of your (new) driver's license. Pickup is available at all Berlin citizen's offices without prior appointment booking. Some locations optionally offer appointment booking as well.

name: Extend Driver's License
description: This service allows you to extend your driver's license when it is about to expire or has already expired.
eligibility: You must apply for renewal approximately 8-10 weeks before your driver's license expires. You can also apply after the license has expired, though if it expired more than 7 years ago, you may need to retake the driving test. Renewal cannot be requested more than 6 months before expiration. Personal attendance is required. You must have your primary residence in Berlin; if Berlin is only a secondary residence, you can only apply in exceptional cases with permission from your primary residence authority. If you want to add the 95 code (professional driver training) before the renewal deadline, you must apply for a license exchange instead.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
Current driver's license
1 current biometric passport photo on paper (bring your own; no photos are printed on-site)
Medical examination certificate for vision (not older than 2 years)
Certificate of physical and mental fitness (not older than 1 year)
Functional and performance test (not older than 1 year; only for classes D, D1, DE, D1E from age 50 onwards)

Certificate of good conduct (only for classes D, D1, DE, D1E; document type 'O'; will be requested during application at a cost; can be applied for online or at a citizen office, not at the driver's license authority)
Proof of professional driver training (if you are renewing a class C or D license and requesting the driver qualification record at the same time)
fees: €45.10 for driver's license renewal; €35.00 for renewal of a driver qualification record (FQN) including direct mail within Germany
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: It is recommended to apply for renewal of a class D driver's license at a Berlin citizen office (Bürgeramt), as the required certificate of good conduct can only be requested there.

name: Replacement Passenger Transport Driver's License (P-Schein)
description: Request a replacement for a passenger transport driver's license (P-Schein) if you have lost or damaged your original.
eligibility: Primary residence in Berlin. If Berlin is only your secondary residence, the application can only be processed with the consent of the authority of your primary residence. Personal appearance is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
Driver's license

If applicable: record card extract (Karteikartenabschrift) if you hold a passenger transport driver's license that was not issued in Berlin — request this independently from the driver licensing authority (Fahrerlaubnisbehörde) of the federal state where your passenger transport driver's license was issued, then send it to: Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten (LABO) Abt. IV - Fahrerlaubniswesen Sachgebiet IV C 41, Puttkamerstr. 16-18, 10969 Berlin
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Appointments can be requested via the contact form.

name: Passenger Transport License (P-Schein) - Issuance
description: A passenger transport driving license for taxi, rental car, or ambulance operations, requiring minimum age, prior driving experience, good conduct, and medical fitness certification.
eligibility: Minimum age 21 years (19 years for ambulance services); possession of Class B driving license for at least 2 years or 2 years within the last 5 years (1 year for ambulance services); driving license must be German, EU/EEA, or from an approved state; main residence in Berlin (secondary residence requires exception approval); personal appearance required; proof of specialist knowledge required for taxi, rental car, and shared demand transport licenses as of August 2, 2021.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
German card-format driving license (conversion required if holding older German, DDR, or foreign EU/Annex 11 driving license)
Certificate of good conduct (document type 'O') — must be requested at a citizen office, not at the driving license authority
Medical certificate of physical and mental fitness — not older than 1 year
Medical certificate of vision examination — not older than 2 years
Functional and performance test — not older than 1 year (required for issuance or reissuance)
First aid training certification — required only for ambulance services
fees: €45.10 for issuance and extension of passenger transport license; €222.60 for reissuance of passenger transport license
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Apply at a Berlin citizen office (Bürgeramt) because the required certificate of good conduct can only be requested there. Pickup of the passenger transport license is only possible at the driving license authority (Fahrerlaubnisbehörde). Check individual office websites for appointment booking and other submission options.

name: Driver's License for Passenger Transport (P-Schein) - Request Renewal
description: This service allows you to renew your driver's license for passenger transport (P-Schein) in Berlin.
eligibility: You must apply for renewal approximately 12 weeks before the expiration date. All documentation (including medical examination certificates and proof of adequate vision) must be provided at the time of application or submitted as soon as possible. The notification to collect the P-Schein will only be sent once all required evidence is complete and in order. Personal appearance is required. You must have your primary residence in Berlin. If Berlin is only your secondary residence, the application can only be submitted in justified exceptional cases and with the consent of the authority at your primary residence.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
Presentation of the current P-Schein
Presentation of the driver's license
Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis, type 'O' for submission to an authority — must be requested at a citizen office at the time of application and incurs a fee)
Certificate of physical and mental fitness (not older than 1 year)
Medical certificate of vision examination (not older than 2 years)
Functional and performance test (only required for renewal from age 60 onwards or if you have already reached age 60)
fees: €38.00 for renewal of the driver's license for passenger transport; €13.00 for the certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Apply for renewal at a Berlin citizen office (Bürgeramt), as the required certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) can only be requested there. Collection of the driver's license for passenger transport (P-Schein) is only possible at the driving license authority (Fahrerlaubnisbehörde). Contact individual office locations to learn about available appointment options.

name: Collect Passenger Transport Driving Permit (P-Permit)
description: This service allows residents to pick up their approved passenger transport driving permit (P-permit) after their application has been processed.
eligibility: Your application must be completed and you must have been notified in writing about your application processing and asked to schedule a pickup appointment; an in-person visit is required.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport
Presentation of driving license
Passenger transport permit (in case of renewal)
processingTime: 15 minutes

bookingInfo.office: Passenger transport driving permit collection is only possible at the Driver License Authority - 4th floor.

name: Apply for Recognition of Driving Instructor Training Facility
description: This service enables operators to apply for official recognition of a driving instructor training facility in Berlin, subject to meeting reliability, staffing, facility, and curriculum requirements.
eligibility: No facts may exist that would make the facility owner or responsible management appear unreliable for operating a driving instructor training facility. The responsible management must be capable of supervising instruction competently and ensure compliance with § 40 FahrLG. The facility must have sufficient qualified instructors able to teach the competencies required by § 7 FahrLG in their respective areas. Required classroom space, teaching materials, and training vehicles must be present. A proper training curriculum plan must be in place.
requiredDocuments: Application form for a driving instructor training facility (submit by mail or email to fahrlehrer@labo.berlin.de)
Identity document, such as passport or ID card with registration certificate
Driving instructor license/driver's license

Extended criminal record certificate (not older than 3 months at time of application; use form 'Anschreiben Führungszeugnis' and specify authority as: Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten Referat Fahrerlaubnisse, Personen- und Güterbeförderung, reference: IV D 11 HSB Fahrschulerlaubnis)

Certificate from commercial register (not older than 3 months at time of application; use form 'Anschreiben Führungszeugnis' and specify authority as: Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten Referat Fahrerlaubnisse, Personen- und Güterbeförderung, reference: IV D 11 HSB Fahrschulerlaubnis)

Medical assessment of mental and physical fitness by occupational physician (previous certification for driving instructor license is not sufficient; assessment must be renewed for facility management)
Current tax clearance certificate from the relevant tax office

Evidence of qualification under § 8 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 DV-FahrlG (three years as driving school owner/operator or three years as full-time instructor or degree in mechanical engineering or educational science or judicial qualification)
Commercial register extract (for legal entities only)
To-scale sketch/plan of classroom spaces with specifications of equipment, occupancy limits (1.5 square meters per student), and required teaching materials per regulations plus models
Rental contract or lease agreement for premises with owner confirmation of commercial use

name: Acquire Family Pass
description: A discount pass for Berlin families with children under 18 years old that provides access to cultural and recreational benefits.
eligibility: Open to Berlin families with children under 18 years old. A family consists of any parent-child or grandparent-grandchild relationship, including with foster children. Single parents can also acquire the pass. You must confirm with your signature that the information about your family members on the pass card matches the details in your family members' identity documents. Your family must be registered as residents of Berlin.
processingTime: Immediate at sales points; approximately 1 week for online orders

name: Family Matters - Establish Child Support
description: A service for establishing child support payments through either out-of-court agreement or court proceedings when the other parent does not voluntarily provide support information or commit to paying.
eligibility: Out-of-court request: Before filing an application, you should request in writing via registered mail with return receipt that the other parent provide their current income and assets information along with supporting documents, particularly salary statements from their employer. If the other parent complies, the competent youth office can calculate support based on income documentation. If the other parent commits to future support payments in an enforceable document, no court application for support is required. The support-obligated parent can have such a document (enforceable title) created before the youth office until the child turns 21 or before any notary. Court application: If the other parent does not provide information about their income and assets or does not voluntarily commit to support payments in an enforceable document, an application for support with the family court is necessary. You can only file a claim for child support in court through a lawyer. Your lawyer will inform you about the specific requirements of the support claim.
requiredDocuments: Evidence of the other parent's income (copy to provide to lawyer)
Demand letter and registered mail receipt with return receipt (to provide to lawyer)
Possible response letters from the other parent or their representative (to provide to lawyer)
fees: Court and attorney fees apply, which depend on the value of the proceedings. Additionally, there are costs incurred by the court for service of documents, interpreters, expert witnesses, etc.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: If divorce proceedings are pending in court, the family court handling the divorce proceedings is responsible. Otherwise, the family court with jurisdiction in the district where the child or the parent authorized to act on behalf of the minor child ordinarily resides is responsible. Note: In certain cases, another court may be responsible. Your lawyer can provide information about this.

name: Family Matters - Establish Child Support via Simplified Procedure
description: A simplified court procedure for parents to establish child support payments from the other parent of a minor child living in separate households.
eligibility: Parent-child relationship: The person from whom support is requested must be a parent. For example, step-parents cannot be required to pay support. Minority: The child requiring support must be a minor at the time the application is filed with the court. Separate households: The child requiring support must not live together with the parent from whom support is being requested. No existing support order: There must be no court decision or enforceable document regarding the requested support in existence, and no proceeding for the requested support must be pending at any court. Prior out-of-court request: Support for the past can only be claimed if you have requested the obligated parent to provide information about their assets and income for the purpose of claiming support.
requiredDocuments: Application for Establishment of Support (available under 'Forms') — the official form must be used, completed in full, and signed
fees: Fees are incurred based on the value of the case. Fees are due upon conclusion of the proceeding when the court decides on the support application.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court (Family Court) with jurisdiction is the court in whose district the child's habitual residence is located. You can determine which court is responsible for you using the Local and Court Directory (see 'Further Information').

eligibility: The transfer of custody or partial custody to only one parent is granted only when this best serves the welfare of the child or all parties involved agree to it.

Birth certificate of the child

Joint custody declaration (if available)

Previous court custody decisions (if available)
Description of the facts (who currently has parental custody, what problems have occurred in the past or are expected in the future)
fees: Court fees and potentially attorney fees apply, calculated according to the value of the proceedings. Additional costs may be charged for court services such as service of documents, interpreters, procedural assistants, and expert witnesses.

Otherwise, the District Court (Family Court) in the district where the child habitually resides is competent. Note: In certain cases, another court may be competent. Consult with a lawyer for advice.

name: Family Matters - Regulating Parental Access Rights
description: This service allows parents and close relatives to establish or modify court-regulated access (visitation) arrangements with a child, with the child's best interests as the guiding principle.
eligibility: Both parents generally have the right and duty to have contact with the child. Other close relatives have an access right if it serves the child's best interests. If contact with certain persons would harm the child, the family court can restrict, limit, or exclude access rights temporarily or permanently. A milder alternative is supervised access (begleiteter Umgang), where contact occurs in the presence of a third party, such as a youth welfare representative.
requiredDocuments: Application for regulation of parental access (can be filed informally or with assistance from the court's legal filing office, except when connected to pending divorce proceedings, which requires a lawyer)
Description of circumstances: when the last access took place, what problems have occurred
Detailed description of desired access schedule including frequency, duration, and timing
Specification of desired arrangements for statutory holidays, childcare closure periods, school holidays, and family-significant dates (e.g., birthdays, religious holidays)
Description of who will hand over the child to whom, at what time and place, at the beginning and end of access
Full addresses of parents and child
Birth dates of parents and child
Nationalities of parents and child
Child's birth certificate
Paternity recognition certificate (if available)
Joint custody declaration (if available)
Marriage certificate (if available)
Divorce decree (if available)
Identity card or passport (required for in-person filing at the court's legal filing office)
fees: Court fees apply based on the value of the case in dispute. Additional costs may be incurred for service of documents, interpreters, procedural representatives, expert witnesses, access supervisors (Umgangspfleger), and legal representation. You may request legal aid (Verfahrenskostenhilfe) if you cannot afford the proceeding costs.

name: Apply for Emission Badge (Feinstaubplakette)
description: A service for registering an emission badge for vehicles that meet specific pollution control standards in Berlin.
eligibility: Your vehicle must meet the criteria of emission group 2 (red), 3 (yellow), or 4 (green). Vehicles in emission group 1 cannot receive a badge. Application deadline: 3 weeks. It is particularly recommended for tourists and other Berlin visitors from abroad to apply for the badge approximately 3 weeks before their Berlin visit to ensure timely delivery to their home address. For online application (optional): You need an activated online identification function (eID). This requires your electronic identity card, EU citizen card (eID card), or electronic residence title (eAT), each with activated online identification function (eID) and your PIN; an external card reader or a modern, NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS operating system; and the AusweisApp software. For online application: consent to electronic payment. Available payment methods include credit card (Visa, Mastercard) and PayPal. You will receive an invoice after successful payment.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of an emission badge (can be submitted online, by mail, electronically by email or fax; submit documents as upload, attachment, or copy)

Registration certificate Part I / Vehicle registration document / manufacturer's certificate (in copy) showing: date of first registration of the vehicle, fuel type (petrol, diesel, etc.), vehicle type (car, motorhome, or commercial vehicle), and permissible gross weight (up to 2.8 t, greater than 2.8 t up to 3.5 t, or greater than 3.5 t)
processingTime: 7 to 14 days to receive the badge, depending on varying postal delivery times (especially to foreign countries)

name: Temporary Holiday Rental Permission for Berlin Primary or Secondary Residence
description: Permission to temporarily rent out your self-occupied Berlin primary residence or secondary residence as holiday accommodation when protected private interests outweigh public housing preservation interests.
eligibility: Permission can be granted upon request if protected private interests outweigh public interest in preserving housing. For primary residence: protected private interests typically exist when owners or authorized users rent their self-occupied primary residence (where their actual center of life is established) during absence periods for non-residential purposes, provided the character as primary residence is maintained. For secondary residence: protected private interests are generally recognized only when self-occupied secondary residence is rented by day or week as holiday accommodation or guest lodging for a maximum of 90 days per year. Alternatively, notification of permission-free alternative use up to 49% of floor area of primary residence may apply.
requiredDocuments: Application form for permission for temporary holiday rental and assignment of registration number, submitted in writing to the responsible district office (online submission not possible)
Detailed information in application form about applicant and affected residential unit
Certificate of registration (Meldebescheinigung)
Application justification with supporting evidence
For authorized users: rental agreement (valid lease or sub-lease contract)
For authorized users: landlord's written consent
For property owners: proof of ownership (current land registry extract)
Notification form for permission-free alternative use (up to 49% of floor area for primary residence only), submitted in writing to district office (online submission not possible)
fees: €100.00 per residential unit for primary residence holiday rental permission; €150.00 per residential unit for secondary residence holiday rental permission; €77.00 to €231.00 for negative certificates when no profitability calculation required; €231.00 to €693.00 for negative certificates when profitability calculation required; half the applicable fee for amendments to existing permissions; no separate fee for registration number assignment; one-tenth to five-tenths of full fee if application withdrawn after processing begins or if application rejected.
processingTime: Case-by-case and application-dependent

bookingInfo.office: The Housing Office (Wohnungsamt) or Citizens' Office (Bürgeramt) of the district office (Bezirksamt) in whose district the residential space is located. Permission is granted there upon request at the discretion of the responsible authority.

name: Determination (Conferral) of Professional Trainer Qualification under the German Vocational Training Act (BBiG)
description: This service allows individuals to apply for official recognition as a qualified trainer in their profession when they meet specific experience and eligibility requirements, even if they cannot take the formal examination.
eligibility: You may apply for this conditional qualification if you intend to train apprentices in your own business or as an employed professional, provided no qualified trainer is available for that occupation; you can demonstrate professional experience in the training occupation of at least 1.5 times the regular training duration (for example, 4.5 years for a three-year apprenticeship); you cannot take the examination due to objective reasons or it would be unreasonable for you to take it due to special life circumstances or extraordinary professional or social hardships; and you have not been prohibited from employing children and young people or from hiring and training apprentices.
requiredDocuments: Tabular curriculum vitae with names of parents including mother's maiden name (required for checks against the Federal Central Register and Trade Register) and your own nationality
Copies of certificates for training, continuing education, and further education
Copies of certificates or evidence of professional employment
For self-employed persons: copy of business registration or commercial register extract; for employed persons: statement from the employer
processingTime: 6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Industrie- und Handelskammer zu Berlin, Fasanenstraße 85, 10623 Berlin. The decision on conferral of trainer qualification is made by the Senate Administration for Integration, Labor, and Social Affairs in coordination with the Berlin Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IHK Berlin).

name: Notification of Fireworks Display - Burning of Pyrotechnic Objects
description: This service allows you to notify the responsible authority of your intention to burn fireworks or other pyrotechnic objects, provided you hold the required legal permits or certificates.
eligibility: You must hold a valid commercial permit under § 7 of the Explosives Act (Sprengstoffgesetz), with the responsible person possessing a valid explosives law permit; OR you must hold a valid non-commercial permit under § 27 of the Explosives Act, with the responsible person possessing a valid explosives law permit; OR you must hold a valid certificate of competence under § 20 of the Explosives Act, with the responsible person possessing a valid explosives law certificate of competence.
requiredDocuments: Notification form for fireworks display (online available and recommended, or written by mail)
Identity document (personal ID or other official photo identification document)
Valid permit under § 7 (commercial) or § 27 (non-commercial) of the Explosives Act, or a valid certificate of competence under § 20 of the Explosives Act
Site plan of the burning location (to-scale sketch at 1:100 scale showing distances to any obstacles in the vicinity of the fireworks, such as trees, buildings, etc.)
Current commercial register extract (for registered businesses) or articles of association/bylaws (for legal entities in formation such as GmbH or AG)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Notifications for burning pyrotechnic objects at locations within Berlin must be submitted to the competent district administrative office (Ordnungsamt) of the responsible district authority (Bezirksamt).

name: Fireworks - Request exception to ban on setting off F2 category pyrotechnic items
description: This service allows eligible adults to request an exemption permit to set off small category F2 fireworks outside the normal permitted period, subject to special occasion requirements and local conditions.
eligibility: You must be at least 18 years old and the responsible person for setting off category F2 small fireworks. You wish to set off the category F2 small fireworks between 2 January and 30 December. A special occasion is mandatory. An exemption permit can only be granted if, given the local circumstances and careful consideration of the legitimate interests of third parties, it is appropriate in the individual case.
requiredDocuments: Application for fireworks exemption permit (available online and recommended, or by post)
Identification document (passport or other official photo ID)
Site plan of the fireworks location (scale-accurate sketch at 1:100 scale showing distances to any obstacles in the fireworks area, such as trees, houses, etc.)
Any additional evidence that grounds for an exception exist, if applicable
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the local authority (Ordnungsamt) responsible for the location where the fireworks will be set off.

name: Fireworks - Register Sale of Small and Mini Fireworks
description: A registration service for businesses that sell small and mini-category fireworks (F1 and F2 pyrotechnic items) in Berlin.
eligibility: Sale of pyrotechnic items in categories F1 and F2 (individual and small fireworks). Each sales facility must appoint a sufficient number of responsible supervisory persons responsible for sales and/or storage through internal organizational arrangements. Category F2 fireworks may only be sold within fixed sales premises; sales through traveling or market operations are prohibited.
requiredDocuments: Distribution announcement form for fireworks (available under 'Forms') — must include information about the management of the sales facility/branch and responsible persons; must be completed in full text form and submitted to the responsible public order office at least 14 days before commencing operations
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The announcement must be submitted to the public order office (Ordnungsamt) in the district where the sales facility is located.

name: Certificate of Fiction (Fiktionsbescheinigung)
description: A certificate issued to non-German residents with legal residency status that allows them to remain in Germany while awaiting a decision on a residence permit application.
eligibility: You must have legal residency with or without a residence permit at the time of application. This means you must either hold a valid residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) or national long-term visa (Category D), or be entitled to reside legally in Germany without a visa based on your nationality. Holders of Schengen short-stay visas (Category C) cannot receive this certificate. You must also have filed an application for a residence permit (the certificate is only issued when a decision on the permit application cannot yet be made at the time of your appointment), and you must have your main residence registered in Berlin. Personal appearance at the office is required.
requiredDocuments: Valid passport or passport substitute
Previous residence permit (if applicable, such as electronic residence permit (eAT))
Proof of main residence in Berlin: either registration certificate for accommodation (Meldebestätigung) or rental contract and landlord's confirmation of move-in
fees: Adults: €13.00; Minors: €6.50. The following are exempt: Turkish nationals; persons recognized as refugees or subsidiary protection beneficiaries; resettlement refugees; foreigners receiving a public stipend for their residence; persons receiving benefits under SGB II, SGB XII, or the Asylum Seeker Benefits Act (with current proof required).
processingTime: The certificate is issued at the time of your appointment.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Financial Investment Agent - Permit Application
description: Apply for permission to work as a financial investment agent (Finanzanlagenvermittler) in Berlin by demonstrating personal reliability, financial stability, professional competence, and adequate insurance coverage.
eligibility: Applicants must demonstrate: (1) Personal reliability verified through a federal criminal record certificate (Führungszeugnis) and commercial register extract, both not older than three months; (2) Orderly financial circumstances with no debts or known insolvency proceedings; (3) Adequate professional liability insurance for the business operation; (4) Professional competence demonstrated by passing a Chamber of Commerce (IHK) examination or comparable recognized professional qualification; (5) For online applications: registration with a BundID account.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission under § 34f of the Trade Regulation Act (Gewerbeordnung) - may be submitted online or using the official form
Personal identification document - passport or other official photo ID (not required for electronic submission); residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen
Certificate from the Federal Criminal Register (Führungszeugnis) for submission to authorities (record type O) - not older than three months
Extract from the Commercial Register (Gewerbezentralregister) for submission to authorities (record type 9) - not older than three months
Information from the Debtor Register (Zentrales Vollstreckungsportal) - must be requested online

Proof of no insolvency proceedings: For natural persons resident in Berlin, two certificates are required - one for consumer insolvency proceedings (from local court) and one for standard insolvency proceedings (from Charlottenburg District Court, Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin); for legal entities and partnerships based in Berlin, obtain certification from Charlottenburg District Court; applicants based outside Berlin should check jurisdiction via the central court directory
Professional competence certificate - IHK examination certificate or comparable recognized professional qualification
Confirmation of professional liability insurance from an insurance company covering financial investment mediation - not older than three months
Current trade register extract - registered businesses must submit current extract; businesses in formation must submit articles of association or bylaws
processingTime: Approximately 1 month

bookingInfo.office: Submit the application to the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for your business location. If your business location is not yet known, you may apply to the regulatory office responsible for your place of residence.

name: Financial Investment Broker — Register for Competency Examination
description: This service allows you to register for the competency examination required to work as a financial investment broker.
eligibility: You must appear in person for the examination. The registration deadline is usually 28 days before the respective examination date.
requiredDocuments: Online registration via the IHK Berlin registration portal
Photo identification for verification during the examination
fees: €205.00 to €395.00 depending on the examination format or scope
processingTime: You will normally receive the certificate within a few days after passing the examination.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Fishing - Apply for an Exception Permit under the Fishing Regulations
description: A service for applying in advance for an exception permit to fish under Berlin's fishing regulations.
eligibility: You must apply for the exception permit in advance.
requiredDocuments: Application for exception permit/exemption - submit the application in writing by mail
Justification for the necessity of an exception permit/exemption
processingTime: No information available.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Fishing - Register Fishing Lease Agreement
description: A service for registering or notifying the authorities of a fishing lease or sublease agreement for Berlin waters.
eligibility: The minimum lease period is twelve years. The lower fishing authority may permit exceptions to avoid undue hardship in justified cases.
requiredDocuments: Fishing lease agreement or sublease agreement in written form
processingTime: 1 month. Within one month of conclusion or modification of a lease agreement, a statutory approval fiction of one month applies: the agreement is considered unchallenged if the authority has not issued an objection notice to the contracting parties within one month.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Fishing - Request Permission for Electrofishing
description: This service allows you to apply for an exemption permit to conduct electrofishing under specified technical and legal conditions.
eligibility: You may only fish using direct current or suitable pulsed direct current. You must operate the electrofishing equipment according to recognized technical standards.
requiredDocuments: Written application for an exemption permit, specifying the purpose of fishing using electric current
Certificate of completion for electrofishing course (operator permit)
Type approval certificate for the electrofishing equipment to be used
List of waters and time period for the activity
processingTime: 2-6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Fishing - Annual Report on Eel Stocking Submission
description: This service allows you to submit your annual report on eel stocking activities to the fisheries authority by the required deadline.
eligibility: Deadline: April 30 of the following year. You must submit your records of eel stocking for the relevant calendar year to the lower fisheries authority by April 30 of the following year.
requiredDocuments: Records of eel stocking for the relevant calendar year (including the timing of stocking measures, origin of the fish, their species and age class, and their mass or quantity)
processingTime: 1-4 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Fishery - Annual Report on Commercial Eel Catch Submission
description: This service allows commercial eel fishers to submit their annual catch records to the fishery authority by the April 30 deadline.
eligibility: Deadline: April 30 of the following year. You must send records of eel catch for the relevant calendar year to the lower fishery authority by April 30 of the following year.
requiredDocuments: Records of eel catch for the relevant calendar year
processingTime: 1-4 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Aquaculture - Request Permission for Non-Native and Non-Indigenous Species
description: A permit service for aquaculture operators to request approval to introduce or relocate non-native or non-indigenous fish species in aquaculture facilities.
eligibility: You must be an aquaculture operator. The fish species and non-target species you wish to introduce or relocate must not cause negative ecological impacts. The species you wish to introduce or relocate are subject to mandatory approval. The application must be submitted before introducing or relocating non-native or non-indigenous species.
requiredDocuments: Written application for import/relocation submitted by post

Information and documentation in accordance with the guideline in 'Annex 1' of EU Regulation No. 708/2007, including: description of the project; potential impacts on native species; measures to minimize these impacts; name of the organism to be introduced/relocated with specification of genus, species, subspecies, etc.; characteristics of the organism; objectives and reasons for introduction; geographic area affected by the introduction; documentation for approval of a crisis management plan for non-routine introductions and pilot phases ('Annex I – G. Management Plan'); if applicable, information on risk mitigation measures
processingTime: Typically 6 months once all documentation is complete

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for or Renew a Fishing License
description: A service for Berlin residents to apply for or renew fishing licenses (Fischereischein) in categories A, B, or J, depending on age and qualifications.
eligibility: Primary residence in Berlin required. Fischereischein A for anglers: Available from age 14 after passing the angler exam. If relocating to Berlin from another state, the angler exam from that state must be presented to obtain a Berlin Fischereischein A for nationwide fishing rights. If primary residence in Berlin is temporary, a one-year Fischereischein A may be issued. Fischereischein J for youth: Ages 12–17 can apply without an exam; valid for one year and renewable twice. In Berlin, holders must have fishing club membership and proof of instruction from a Fischereischein A or B holder to purchase a coarse-fish angling permit. Fischereischein B: Reserved for persons who completed professional fisher training, fishery science training, or engaged in commercial fishing for at least ten years.
requiredDocuments: Application form for issuance or renewal of a fishing license (can be submitted in person during office hours or by a third party with power of attorney and a copy of the applicant's ID card, front and back)
Proof of passed sport fishing exam or predatory fish or salmonid qualification in original form, issued before the Berlin fishing license law came into effect
Proof of legacy angler status: Original fishing license or fishing association membership card issued before April 30, 1995
Valid ID card or passport with proof of Berlin primary residence (registration certificate not older than one year)
Student ID (for youth without ID documents): With consent statement and copy of front and back of guardian's ID card plus guardian's signature on application form
Current passport photograph for the fishing license
Proof of passed angler exam per Berlin fishing license law or equivalent exam from another state in original form
fees: Fischereischein A: €18.00 (1 year), €27.00 (5 years); Renewal: €9.00 (1 year), €13.50 (5 years); Annual fishing fee: €21.00. Fischereischein B: €27.00 (5 years); Renewal: €13.50 (5 years); Annual fishing fee: €135.00. Fischereischein J: €10.00 (1 year); Renewal: €5.00 (1 year); Annual fishing fee: €4.00.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Fischereiamt (Fisheries Office) — this service can only be used at this office.

name: Apply for Vocational Training Support in Berlin (FBB)
description: This service provides financial support to Berlin businesses offering apprenticeships that meet specific eligibility criteria, including support for combined training, disadvantaged apprentices, and special circumstances.
eligibility: The apprenticeship must be registered with a competent Berlin chamber or authority; the probationary period must be successfully completed; it must be a first vocational training (with exceptions for combined training); combined training may be supported if the company cannot provide all required training content in-house; support available for rare trades (Splitterberufe) requiring attendance at vocational schools outside Berlin; support for disadvantaged individuals lacking school qualifications or with special educational needs; support for atypical gender-minority trades (less than 20% representation); support for caregivers with children under 12 or recognized care providers; support for apprentices whose training was interrupted due to business insolvency or closure; support for refugees and displaced persons with valid residence status who entered Germany within the last 5 years (effective from apprenticeships beginning 01.09.2021).
requiredDocuments: Application for Vocational Training Support in Berlin (FBB) — complete application with all required data processing declarations, preferably submitted online
Registered apprenticeship contract (copy) from the competent chamber or authority
Registration confirmation (copy) from the competent chamber or authority
Confirmation of necessity for combined training from the competent chamber or authority
Cooperation agreement between lead company and training partner including all annexes (e.g., training plan, matrix, detailed exam preparation content, duration, costs, participants)
Invoices and payment receipts for combined training costs per contract with partner or for exclusive exam preparation
Attendance records from the training partner
Tabular curriculum vitae of apprentice with own signature covering period from end of general education to start of apprenticeship
Corresponding evidence for curriculum vitae (e.g., school completion or exit certificate, certificates of further qualifications, employment agency registration notice if applicable)
Exemption from Berlin vocational school instruction where applicable (if attending vocational school outside Berlin/Brandenburg)
Attendance confirmations from vocational school or inter-company training facility outside Berlin
Last three wage/salary statements (copy)
Tax office confirmation of tax class and allowance for caregivers/care providers
Child's birth certificate (copy) where applicable
Social benefits notice regarding living assistance or similar (copy) where applicable
Health insurance or care insurance confirmation of recognition as care provider for another person
Registered apprenticeship contract and registration confirmation from the competent chamber or authority with previous employer (copy)
Termination letter from previous employer or insolvency administrator (copy)
Valid identification documents proving current residence status (copy)
Record of asylum application in Germany with date of submission or other confirmation from the competent foreign office (copy)
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks, provided all required documents are complete

bookingInfo.office: The Handwerkskammer Berlin (Berlin Chamber of Crafts) has been commissioned by the State of Berlin to implement the FBB program. Implementation by the Chamber does not mean only trades are eligible; rather, all apprenticeships in companies of the free economy and free professions are eligible if one of the funding criteria is met.

name: Apply for Funding for a Turn Assist System
description: This service provides financial support for the installation of approved turn assist systems (Abbiegeassistenzsysteme) on commercial vehicles operated in Berlin.
eligibility: Vehicles must be operated primarily in Berlin; retrofit work must not begin before the funding approval is granted; a 24-month binding period applies from the date of system installation; only systems approved by the Federal Motor Transport Authority (Kraftfahrtbundesamt) are eligible; vehicles must have a permissible gross mass of at least 3.5 tonnes; systems must have general operating approval (ABE) under §22 StVZO; systems must include a camera-monitor or sensor system coupled with acoustic or optical warning signals; for leasing or rental contracts, the total contract term must be at least 24 months, as must the remaining term of any vehicle lease at the time of installation; registration and login in the electronic application and administration system are required.
requiredDocuments: Application for turn assist system funding (online only)
Vehicle registration certificate for the vehicles to be retrofitted or the leasing/rental contract
Proof of a business location in Berlin

Commercial register extract, business registration, or proof of non-profit or freelance activity (such as extract from association register or confirmation of freelance activity registration with tax authority)
Quote for turn assist system (proof of intent to purchase, lease, or rent a turn assist system from the provider/manufacturer)
General operating approval (ABE) from the Federal Motor Transport Authority for the turn assist system under §22 StVZO
Owner's consent for installation of the turn assist system in the case of leasing or rental contracts
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Funding for Projects Implementing Internationalization Strategies
description: This service provides funding for small and medium-sized enterprises in Berlin's manufacturing and cluster sectors to support the market introduction of innovative products developed through their own research and development.
eligibility: You must be a representative of a small or medium-sized enterprise from the manufacturing sector or Berlin clusters with a registered seat or business location in Berlin. The internationalization measure must be directly related to the market introduction of innovative products. The product must have been developed to market maturity through your own research and development activities.
requiredDocuments: Application for SME project funding through IBB (online only)
Completed and legally binding specimen signature form
Copy of personal identification document
Copy of business registration (if applicable)
Business registration notice
PEP Information Sheet / Declaration of Politically Exposed Person (PEP)
Declaration of de minimis aid already received or applied for
SME self-declaration
processingTime: 4-6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Business-Related Electromobility Funding (WELMO)
description: This service provides financial support to small and medium-sized enterprises and self-employed individuals in Berlin for the acquisition of electric vehicles and charging infrastructure.
eligibility: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and self-employed individuals with a seat or business location in Berlin are eligible. There is no restriction of business sectors or industries. A motorized vehicle must be necessary for the exercise of the commercial, non-profit, or freelance activity. Additionally, applicants who can demonstrate through the SolarPLUS funding program that the supported charging infrastructure and/or electric vehicle is served by a supported battery storage system or solar installation are eligible. Applicants must be located in Berlin. The project must not have commenced before confirmation of application receipt by IBT GmbH. The minimum registration period for the subsidized vehicle is 12 months, as is the minimum usage period for charging infrastructure from commissioning. Legal entities must be registered in the Berlin State Administration's transparency database. Funding is granted as de minimis aid and must not exceed €200,000 within a rolling three-tax-year period. If other state subsidies are claimed for the same eligible costs, funding is only permitted if the maximum subsidy intensity or amount does not exceed the threshold for the other subsidy. Registration and login in the IBB electronic application and administration system is required.
requiredDocuments: Application for Business-Related Electromobility Funding (WELMO) — online only

Business registration certificate or commercial register extract (not older than 12 months) for registered companies, OR confirmation from the tax office of tax registration, OR extract from the association register or cooperative register
Identity proof (copy) — passport or travel document
Attachment 2 of the funding application (Declaration of Performance Provision Regulation) if employing more than 10 employees and expected subsidy exceeding €25,000
Confirmation from the tax office or tax advisor regarding application of the small business exemption or elimination of sales tax due to non-profit activity (if applicable)
SME self-declaration (for partner companies and affiliated companies)
Offer from a registered consulting company in the consultant pool (if applying for consulting subsidy)

Proof of intent to purchase or lease an eligible vehicle (lease term minimum 12 months) in the form of an offer copy from the vehicle dealer, manufacturer, or internet printout (if applying for vehicle subsidy)
Copy of registration certificate for a Euro 4 or lower vehicle (if claiming scrappage premium)
Proof of compliance with DIN 75078 for new purchase of e-accessibility taxi (if applying for e-accessibility taxi subsidy)
Proof of conversion to e-accessibility taxi or installations in an e-accessibility taxi and proof of compliance with DIN 750 (if applying for e-accessibility taxi subsidy)

Proof of intent to purchase or lease and establish stationary charging infrastructure in the form of an offer copy from the charging infrastructure provider (if applying for charging infrastructure subsidy)
Proof of intent to commission grid connection in the form of an offer copy, if necessary (if applying for charging infrastructure subsidy)
Proof of intent to commission adaptation to low-voltage or medium-voltage grid in the form of an offer copy, if applicable (if applying for charging infrastructure subsidy)

Declaration that no additional federal charging infrastructure funding will be claimed, if applicable and applicable for publicly accessible charging infrastructure (if applying for charging infrastructure subsidy)
Consent declaration from property owners for installation of charging infrastructure, if applicable (if applying for charging infrastructure subsidy)
processingTime: Approximately 3 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Funding of Performance and Production Venues for Performing Arts/Dance
