description: This service provides annual funding support for professional performance and production venues specializing in performing arts and dance that have been operating for at least two years.
eligibility: Applications are accepted from 18.05.2026 to 30.06.2026, with the deadline at 23:59 on 30.06.2026. Online applications must be submitted by this time; submissions after 23:59 will not be accepted and in-progress submissions will be automatically cancelled. The project must begin and end in the coming calendar year. Funding is allocated in the current year for the following calendar year. Applicants must operate an existing, professionally run performance venue and/or production venue that has been under the applicant's management for at least 2 years.
requiredDocuments: Application form for one-year funding of performing arts/dance performance and production venues (to be submitted online as PDF)
Description of the programmatic profile of the performance venue and/or production venue (max. 4 MB, PDF file)
Profile description of the venue
Information about spatial conditions such as number and size of rehearsal and performance spaces, seating capacity in performance/production rooms
Number of planned usage days (rehearsal days/performance days)
Type and duration of contract or rental agreement for the performance and/or presentation venue
Usage conditions for groups and individual artists working/performing at the venue
Overview of permanent staff working at the venue (e.g. artistic director, technicians, etc.)
Brief description of project plans including expected participants (if program funds are requested)
Program information for the performance venue and/or production venue during the funding period (max. 2 MB, PDF file)
Brief description of artistic projects/guest performances during the funding period to be realized without program funds, including project responsibility
Justification for why investments are necessary to secure the performance venue and/or presentation venue/work structures

Detailed financing plan for the funding period (max. 5 MB, XLSX file) including projected revenue from events and rentals; mandatory fees such as GEMA fees, KSK contributions, royalties, foreign artist taxes, and potential barrier removal costs; details of third-party funding (other public funding sources, private sponsors, donations—no in-kind contributions) for which applications will be submitted later or for which commitments already exist for the funding period; detailed cost breakdown for non-construction investment subsidies in the financing plan; use of the provided sample financing plan in XLSX format without altering the template structure; yellow-highlighted rows must not be changed; rows not needed should be left at 0.00 euros; ensure online application form totals match the financing plan totals

Documentation and informational materials about previous work (max. 4 MB, PDF file) including press articles, program booklets, cast lists, video links covering the past 2 years and audience attendance (capacity utilization); provision of website link for materials that cannot be electronically uploaded; option to submit paper documentation with full name by the deadline if electronic upload is not possible
For legal entities (associations, GmbH, foundations, etc.): bylaws or articles of association plus extract from association register or commercial register
processingTime: 6 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Funding to Digitize Objects of Cultural Heritage
description: This service provides funding to Berlin-based cultural heritage institutions for digitizing outstanding or highly requested cultural objects and making them accessible to the public.
eligibility: Application deadline: 12 May 2026 – 15 July 2026, with submissions closing at 13:00 on 15 July 2026. Eligible applicants are cultural heritage institutions based in Berlin (such as archives, libraries, museums, memorials, etc.), and any cultural institution outside Berlin's public administration that makes cultural assets accessible to the public. Institutions under direct or indirect Berlin state administration are prioritized. Priority items for digitization must be outstanding or highly requested cultural assets that are representative of Berlin and/or your institution and of interest to the public and relevant to science, education, or culture. A comprehensive project concept must be in place, including clear goals for the digitization process which must be sustainably designed. Digitization must not have already begun before application. All applicants must register their institution with the German Digital Library (DDB) and commit to making digitized objects available to the DDB where legally possible. The cultural heritage institution must be registered in Berlin's Transparency Database.
requiredDocuments: Application for digitization of cultural heritage objects (online only; upload documents in XLSX, PDF, JPG, JPEG or PNG format; total file size not to exceed 30 MB, individual files max 5 MB)

Project description including: value of the collection, legal situation of objects to be digitized, conservation condition, technical digitization approach, planned cataloguing and description of objects, presentation of digitized items and metadata, accessibility and reusability, long-term data archiving
Financing plan
Timeline/schedule
Number in Berlin's Transparency Database
Service provider quotes
Letter of Intent (for cooperation projects)
Cost estimates (if available)
Photos or scans of objects (if available) – at least one representative example of the selected objects
processingTime: 8 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Child Tax Allowances for Children 18 Years and Older
description: A service to apply for tax allowances for adult children who meet specific eligibility criteria related to employment, education, training, or disability status.
eligibility: Eligible applicants must include: (1) Children under 21 years old who are unemployed and registered as job-seeking with the employment agency; (2) Children under 25 years old without vocational training who are pursuing vocational training, higher education, or volunteer service (such as FSJ) or in transition between such activities for up to 4 months; (3) Children under 25 years old with completed vocational or higher education who are not gainfully employed, only working within their training, in a minijob, or maximum 20 hours per week; (4) Children with disabilities who cannot support themselves and became disabled before age 25 (or before 2007 if before age 27). All general conditions for child tax allowances must also be met; age limits may increase in cases of military or civil service.
requiredDocuments: Application for wage tax reduction
Attachment for children to the application for wage tax reduction
General documents for child tax allowances, such as school, training, or study certificates
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the tax authority (Finanzamt) of your place of residence.

name: Request a Certificate of Good Conduct (Führungszeugnis)
description: A service to request an official certificate of good conduct from Berlin authorities, available to residents aged 14 and older who are registered in Berlin.
eligibility: You must be registered as a resident in Berlin or have your usual place of residence there; minimum age 14 years; citizenship of another EU member state may be required for a European certificate of good conduct; for online applications, you need an activated online identification function on your electronic ID card, eID card, or electronic residence permit, plus the six-digit PIN, an external card reader or modern smartphone with Android or iOS, and the AusweisApp software.
requiredDocuments: Application for Certificate of Good Conduct (available online, in person, or in writing)
Online processing: your ID card or electronic residence permit with activated online identification function for authentication
In-person application at your chosen citizen office (with or without appointment)
Written application: unsigned written request by post, which will be verified according to legal requirements including signature authentication
For minors: application may be submitted by legal representatives (usually parents)

Transfer of fee if submitting by post: transfer the fee to the district's account in advance and enclose proof of payment; include 'Certificate of Good Conduct for [Name, First Name]' in the reference line
Copy of ID card or passport for written application
For official certificate of good conduct: name and address of the authority for which the certificate is intended, file reference number, and intended use
For extended certificate of good conduct: written request from an authorized entity that has explicitly requested the extended version
fees: 13.00 Euro; fees may be waived in certain cases (see information sheet for details)
processingTime: Approximately 2 weeks for delivery; approximately 4 weeks for a European certificate of good conduct

bookingInfo.office: Applications can be submitted at all Berlin citizen offices (Bürgeramt) without prior appointment. Some locations optionally also offer appointment booking.

name: Lost and Found - Reclaim Lost Items
description: A service to retrieve lost property that has been turned in to Berlin's police, citizen offices, or lost and found bureau.
eligibility: You must be the owner or have lost the item; the item must have been turned in to the police, a citizen office, or the lost and found bureau (destroyed items and intentionally discarded items such as furniture are not accepted); and the item must not have been auctioned (items are typically auctioned after 6 months).
requiredDocuments: Proof of ownership, such as a purchase receipt; for electronic devices: serial number or IMEI number; for keys: a duplicate key
Your ID document (if not lost), such as your national ID card or passport; not required if claiming a lost ID document
For representation: written power of attorney and ID document of the authorized representative, ID document of the person collecting the item, and a copy of your ID document (if not lost)
fees: No fee for national ID cards or passports; no fee if the item is worth €10 or less; €3.00 for driver's licenses, certificates, bank cards, savings books, and other documents; €5.00 to €50.00 if the item is worth €50 to €500 (tiered); 10% of the value if the item is worth over €500.
processingTime: Approximately 30 minutes; it may take several days for a turned-in item to arrive at the lost and found bureau.

bookingInfo.office: Central Lost and Found Bureau Berlin (see Tempelhof-Schöneberg District Office); if the Central Lost and Found Bureau is difficult for you to reach due to age or disability, the item can be held for collection at one of the citizen offices — please contact us, for example by phone.

name: Report Found Items
description: A service that allows residents to report items they have found to the appropriate authorities.
eligibility: You have found an item.
requiredDocuments: Report of the find
Details about the location of the find (Fundort)
Details about the time of the find (Fundzeit)
Detailed description of the item
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Central Lost and Found Office Berlin (see 'Bezirksamt Tempelhof-Schöneberg'); Citizens Offices (Bürgerämter); Berlin Police (Polizei Berlin)

name: Apply for War Victim Benefits (Kriegsopferfürsorge) under Social Compensation Law
description: A service for war victims to apply for social compensation benefits, requiring recognition under Social Compensation Law.
eligibility: Presentation of a recognition notice (Anerkennungsbescheid) under one of the Social Compensation Law (SER) statutes
requiredDocuments: Initial application for war victim benefits (KOF)
Recognition notice (Anerkennungsbescheid)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the Berlin Versorgungsamt (Veterans and Social Compensation Office).

name: Illegal Garden Waste - Disposal
description: A service for reporting and arranging the removal of illegally dumped garden waste from public spaces.
eligibility: Report of illegal waste (by telephone, in writing, or electronically)
requiredDocuments: Complaint containing the following information: location and time; volume; perpetrator (if known); personal data of the reporting person
fees: Free of charge (may be subject to fees for the perpetrator)
processingTime: Up to 7 days for public street land

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Gaststätte (Food and Beverage Service) - Request Permit
description: This service allows you to apply for a permit to operate a food and beverage establishment (gaststätte) in Berlin, subject to meeting requirements for personal reliability, professional knowledge, and suitable premises.
eligibility: You must demonstrate: (1) Personal reliability - verified through a certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) from the Federal Central Register and a statement from the Commercial Register, both not older than three months; (2) Professional competence - proof of instruction on food safety knowledge required by law; (3) Suitable premises and location - the rooms must be appropriate for the intended use and meet health and safety requirements under building regulations, cause no harmful environmental impact, and meet accessibility standards.
requiredDocuments: Application for a gaststätte permit (online or written by post)
Personal identification document - passport or other official photo ID (not required for electronic application); residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen
Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) from the Federal Central Register for submission to a government authority (document type O), not older than three months
Commercial Register extract (Gewerbezentralregisterauszug) for submission to a government authority (document type 9), not older than three months
Gaststätte instruction certificate (Gaststättenunterrichtung) according to § 4 GastG - proof of attendance at an IHK-approved food service course or equivalent qualification
Purchase, rental, or lease contract proving you have actual control over the business premises
Floor plan of the premises intended for the gaststätte operation and employee areas (preferably at scale 1:100)
Current commercial register extract for registered companies; articles of association or bylaws for companies in formation (GmbH, AG)
fees: Unlimited permit: 100.00 to 1,500.00 euros depending on effort; Limited permit: 50.00 to 500.00 euros depending on effort
processingTime: Approximately 3 to 5 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the district office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for the location where your business premises are situated.

name: Food and Beverage Service - Request Permission for Special Occasion
description: Permission to operate food and beverage service at a special event of short duration, such as street festivals, Christmas markets, or sporting events.
eligibility: A special occasion of short duration must exist, such as street festivals (e.g. folk festivals or carnivals), Christmas markets, sporting events, or company anniversaries. The applicant must demonstrate personal reliability, which is verified through various documents including a certificate of conduct from the Federal Central Register and information from the Commercial Register. Knowledge of food regulations is required only if gastronomic activities are carried out regularly and sustainably at specific occasions.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission (submit online or by post)
Identity document (passport or other official photo ID, plus residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen)
Certificate of conduct from the Federal Central Register for submission to authorities (form type O) — must not be older than three months
Commercial Register extract for submission to authorities (form type 9) — must not be older than three months
Food service training certificate per § 4 GastG (if reapplying) — certificate of participation in food service training from a Chamber of Commerce or equivalent qualification
Current Commercial Register extract (for registered businesses) or articles of association/bylaws (for entities being established, such as GmbH or AG)
processingTime: Approximately 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The application must be submitted in good time (at least 2 weeks in advance) to the local government office responsible for the event location.

name: Catering Business - Request Authorization for Representative
description: This service allows a catering business owner to authorize a representative to act on their behalf in running a gastronomy establishment.
eligibility: The catering business owner must have a valid catering license or have applied for one at the same time. The representative must demonstrate personal reliability, which is verified through a criminal record certificate (Führungszeugnis) from the federal register and a commercial register certificate. The representative must also provide proof of training in food safety and hygiene regulations.
requiredDocuments: Application for authorization of a representative (can be submitted online or in writing to the competent regulatory office)
Valid catering license of the owner (must be in place or applied for at the same time)
Identification document of the owner and the representative (ID card or other official photo ID; not required for electronic application) and residence permit if the applicant is not an EU citizen
Criminal record certificate (Führungszeugnis) of the representative for submission to a government authority (document type O) - must not be older than three months
Commercial register certificate (Gewerbezentralregisterauszug) of the representative for submission to a government authority (document type 9) - must not be older than three months
Proof of competency of the representative: certification from the Chamber of Commerce (IHK) confirming participation in the catering establishment training or comparable qualification
fees: 17.00 to 187.50 euros depending on expenses for an unlimited authorization; 17.00 to 62.50 euros depending on expenses for a limited-term authorization
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) in the district where your catering establishment is located.

name: Gastronomy Business - Request Provisional Permission
description: This service allows you to request a provisional operating permit when taking over an existing restaurant or gastropub establishment.
eligibility: You are taking over an existing gastronomy business located in the same premises as the previous operator, and the establishment has not been closed for longer than one year.
requiredDocuments: Application for provisional permission (can be submitted online or by mail)
Personal identification document (ID card or other official photo ID; not required if submitting application electronically)
Residence permit, if the applicant is not a citizen of an EU country
Floor plan drawing showing the rooms designated for the gastronomy business and for employee use (preferably at a scale of 1:100)
Purchase, rental, or lease agreement providing proof of actual authorization to use the premises
Business registration (Gewerbeanmeldung) for the successor
Current extract from the Commercial Register (for registered companies); or articles of association/corporate bylaws (for companies in formation such as GmbH, AG)
fees: €17.00 to €187.50 depending on effort for unlimited permission; €17.00 to €62.50 depending on effort for limited-term permission
processingTime: Approximately 1 to 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Submit the application to the local order office (Ordnungsamt) in the district where your establishment is located. Only one application is needed for both provisional and final permission. The establishment may already operate during the examination of the provisional permit requirements, but only within the scope of the previous permission if you intend to change the type of operation or rooms.

name: Food Service Business - Apply for Provisional Deputy Authorization
description: Authorize a deputy to temporarily manage an existing food service business on behalf of the provisional license holder.
eligibility: You are taking over an existing food service business from the previous operator at the same location. The food service business owner must have a valid provisional food service license or must apply for one in a timely manner.
requiredDocuments: Application for provisional deputy authorization (available online or submit written application to the responsible regulatory office)

Personal identification document of the provisional license holder and the provisional deputy: passport or other official photo ID document (not required for online applications); residence permit if the applicant is not an EU citizen
Valid provisional food service license from the owner or proof that one has been applied for in a timely manner
fees: €17.00 to €93.75 per case for an unlimited license; €17.00 to €31.25 per case for a time-limited license
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) in the district where your business location is situated.

name: Notification of Continuation of Gastronomy Business Following Death of License Holder
description: This service allows the designated heirs or successors of a deceased gastronomy business license holder to notify the authorities of their intention to continue operating the establishment.
eligibility: The gastronomy business must continue unchanged (no changes to business type or premises). The original license holder must be deceased and the license must still be valid. Continuation is only permitted for natural persons, not legal entities (GmbH, AG, or associations). You must prove membership in the entitled circle of persons (e.g., through inheritance certificate, marriage certificate, registered civil partnership, or similar documentation). You must provide proof of instruction regarding necessary food law knowledge; the certificate must be submitted no later than 6 months after notifying of continuation.
requiredDocuments: Notification of continuation of the existing gastronomy establishment (informal notification in text form)
Official identification document (identity card or other official photo ID; residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen)
Death certificate of the license holder

Proof of entitlement to continue as heir, spouse, civil partner, minor heir, estate administrator, estate guardian, or executor (inheritance certificate; court order as estate administrator; letter of appointment as estate guardian; executor's certificate)
Gastronomy instruction certificate (IHK certification of participation in the gastronomy instruction course or comparable qualification; must be submitted no later than 6 months after notification)
Trade registration for the person authorized to continue the gastronomy business
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit the application for continuation to the local authority (Ordnungsamt) in the district where your gastronomy establishment is located.

name: Gaststättengewerbe - Register for Instruction Certification
description: Registration and certification for the hospitality/restaurant business instruction requirement.
eligibility: Personal attendance required. You must attend the instruction in person.
requiredDocuments: Online registration through the IHK Berlin registration portal (registration for hospitality instruction available online only)
Photo identification document for identification during the instruction
fees: €100.00 for hospitality instruction; €330.00 for hospitality instruction with interpreter
processingTime: Not stated on the page

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Disturbance from Pub/Restaurant Noise
description: This service allows residents to file a complaint or report about excessive noise from a pub or restaurant establishment.
eligibility: No requirements
requiredDocuments: Complaint or report with the following information: name and address of the pub/restaurant
exact time(s) of the incident (date and time)
type and nature of noise disturbance (music, loud conversations of guests, slamming doors, etc.)
names and addresses of potential independent witnesses (not family members, relatives or acquaintances) who perceived or could have perceived the reported noise at the stated time
processingTime: 4 weeks

bookingInfo.office: This service can be accessed at the Environment and Nature Protection Office (Umwelt- und Naturschutzamt) at the locally responsible district office (Bezirksamt).

name: Commission a Building Survey
description: A service for property owners or building rights holders to commission a certified surveyor to measure and register a new building or structural modifications once the structure is completed to raw building stage.
eligibility: You must be the property owner or building rights holder; the building or structural modification must be completed to raw building stage in its essential structures; you must commission a publicly appointed surveying engineer (ÖbVI) — in Berlin, only ÖbVI conduct building surveys.
fees: Costs are determined according to the fee schedule for publicly appointed surveying engineers (ÖbVIVergO). The amount depends on the specific case conditions and is calculated based on the floor area of the building.
processingTime: Please inquire with the publicly appointed surveying engineer (ÖbVI) for details.

bookingInfo.office: Publicly appointed surveying engineers (ÖbVI) are responsible for conducting the building survey. The surveying office responsible for registering the building survey in the property cadastre is the office in whose district the building to be surveyed is located.

name: Birth Registration on German Seagoing Vessels - Initial Registration
description: This service registers births that occur on German-flagged seagoing vessels and issues the corresponding birth certificates.
eligibility: Birth must occur on a seagoing vessel flying the German flag. The birth must be reported without delay by a responsible person to the ship's captain. Any parent with custody rights is obligated to report the birth, or if both parents are unable to do so, any other person present at the birth or with direct knowledge of it may report.
requiredDocuments: Captain's report documenting the announcement of the birth
Additional documents may be required depending on the individual case
fees: Birth certificate: €12.00; Each additional certificate issued simultaneously: €6.00; International birth certificate: €12.00; Each additional certificate issued simultaneously: €6.00; Certified register extract (birth register): €12.00; Each additional certified register extract issued simultaneously: €6.00
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Registration of a Child's Birth
description: This service allows parents to register the birth of a child with the local registry office (Standesamt) in Berlin, either through submission by the hospital/birthing center or through parental notification for home births.
eligibility: The child is born in a Berlin hospital or birthing center (in which case the facility reports the birth to the registry office), or the child is born at home (in which case midwives, birth assistants, or doctors issue a birth certificate that parents must submit to the registry office within one week). All required documents must be in German or officially translated by a certified translator in Germany, and certain documents may require apostille or legalization depending on the country of origin. Documents in Arabic, Greek, Hebrew, or Cyrillic must have personal names transliterated according to ISO standards (ISO 9-1995, ISO 843, DIN 31634, ELOT 734, etc.). All documents must be submitted in original form and may not be altered, perforated, or laminated.
requiredDocuments: Birth notice (either submitted by the hospital/birthing center or birth certificate submitted by parents within one week for home births)

Declaration by both parents regarding the child's given and family names (signed) — may be informal but must be signed by both parents; form available at hospital, birthing center, or registry office; often already included in the birth notice submitted by the facility
Valid identity card or passport of both parents
Birth certificate of the mother
Birth certificate of the father (if applicable)
Marriage certificate (if applicable)
Paternity recognition (if applicable and both parents are not married)
Custody declaration (if applicable and both parents are not married)
Evidence of dissolution of marriage (divorce decree, death certificate, or dissolution notation on the marriage certificate if the mother is divorced or widowed)
Power of attorney (if applicable; relatives in direct line such as grandparents, parents, or children may receive documents without power of attorney)
Additional documents as may be required by the registry office (consultation with the responsible registry office is recommended if either or both parents hold a non-German nationality)
fees: Free for birth notification. Birth certificate for personal records: €12.00. Certified extract from the birth register: €12.00. International birth certificate: €12.00. Each additional certificate of the same type issued simultaneously: €6.00.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The birth must be registered at the registry office (Standesamt) of the district where the child was born, regardless of the parents' place of residence.

name: Birth Abroad - Initial Registration in Birth Register for German Nationals without Domestic Residence (ever) - Application
description: This service allows German nationals and certain other persons born abroad who have never resided in Germany to register their birth in the German birth register.
eligibility: The child was born abroad and is a German national, stateless person, stateless foreigner, or recognized foreign refugee at the time of application. The adult child or applicant, or the minor child and both parents, have never resided in Germany or do not currently reside there. The applicant must be the child themselves, their parents, spouse, life partner, or children. Original documents or certified copies must be submitted; simple copies or electronically transmitted documents are not sufficient.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration of a foreign birth in the birth register (to be submitted in writing by mail)
Birth certificate
Birth certificates of both parents
Marriage certificate of the child's parents (if parents were married at the time of birth or married before application, or if the mother was married at the time of birth)
Identity cards or passports of the child's parents
Foreign language documents (require translation and certification as applicable)
Additional documents as required on a case-by-case basis
fees: €80.00 for application for registration; €160.00 for application for registration if foreign law applies; €12.00 for birth certificate; €6.00 for each additional certificate issued simultaneously; €12.00 for international birth certificate; €6.00 for each additional certificate issued simultaneously; €12.00 for certified birth register extract; €6.00 for each additional certified extract issued simultaneously
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Register Birth Abroad (Nachbeurkundung)
description: This service allows German residents to register a child born abroad in the German birth register.
eligibility: The child must have been born abroad and be a German citizen at the time of application, or be stateless, homeless foreign national, or recognized foreign refugee with ordinary residence in Germany. The applicant must be the child, parent, spouse, life partner, or child of the person born abroad. Either the child or applicant must have had or currently have a residence in Germany (or the last German residence if none currently exist). If neither the child nor applicant has ever had a German residence, the Registry Office I (Standesamt I) in Berlin is responsible instead.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration of birth abroad (Antrag auf Nachbeurkundung der Geburt)
Child's birth certificate
Birth certificates of both parents

Marriage certificate of child's parents (if applicable — required when mother was married at time of birth or parents married before application; must include dissolution notice if marriage was dissolved)
Proof of paternity recognition or determination and custody declaration (if applicable — required when parents unmarried and paternity established by recognition or court decision)
Identity cards or passports of child's parents and applicant (if applicable)
Certified translation into German or authentication (Apostille or Legalization) for foreign-language documents
Additional documents as determined by individual case
fees: €80 for entry in German birth register; €160 if foreign law must be observed; €8–€80 for withdrawal or rejection of application; €12 for birth certificate issuance; €6 for each additional birth certificate issued simultaneously; €12 for international birth certificate; €6 for each additional international birth certificate issued simultaneously; €12 for certified register extract; €6 for each additional certified register extract issued simultaneously
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Registry Office (Standesamt) of your residential district. If you currently have no residence in Germany, the Registry Office of your last German residence is responsible.

name: Request Birth Certificate
description: This service allows you to request an official birth certificate or certified extract from the birth register for a person born in Berlin.
eligibility: The birth must already be registered with the registry office (Standesamt) in the district where the person was born. You may request the certificate if you are: the person named on the certificate; a direct relative (parents, children, grandparents, grandchildren); a spouse or registered life partner; a sibling with legitimate interest; a person with legal interest; or a person with power of attorney. You must know which registry office is responsible. If you only know the former name of a Berlin registry office, you can search online for free. If the registry office is completely unknown, you can request a paid search. For online applications: consent to electronic payment (credit card: Visa, Mastercard) or bank transfer is required.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a birth certificate or certified extract from the birth register (can be submitted online or in person; online submission is only possible if you can specify the responsible registry office)
Identity document (Personalausweis or passport) — required for in-person applications
Proof of relationship (e.g., birth certificate, marriage certificate, or registered life partnership certificate) — required for in-person applications if you are a direct relative
Proof of legal interest (e.g., inheritance certificate or property register extract) — required for in-person applications if you are not a direct relative
Power of attorney — required if you are requesting the certificate for another person
fees: Free for birth certificate for social insurance purposes; €12.00 for German birth certificate; €12.00 for multilingual/international birth certificate; €12.00 for certified extract from the birth register; €6.00 for each additional certificate of the same type issued simultaneously; €20.00 to €80.00 depending on search effort for determining the responsible registry office in Berlin.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Registry Office (Standesamt): The registry office responsible is the one in the district where the person was actually born, regardless of current residence. If you only know the birthplace as 'Berlin', you can request a paid search to determine the correct office. For births over 110 years ago, contact the Berlin State Archive (Landesarchiv Berlin).

name: Sidewalk Crossings - Construction and Modification
description: A service for property owners to request construction or modification of sidewalk crossings (driveway access points) through the Roads and Green Spaces Department.
eligibility: Applicant must be the property owner (proof required: land registry extract or notarized contract)
requiredDocuments: Application from the property owner with plan sketch
Application if the responsible authority should construct the sidewalk crossing
fees: 100.00 to 800.00 euros administrative fee depending on effort, plus construction costs depending on size and conditions. After timely receipt of the administrative fee and a cost advance, the responsible authority constructs the crossing and settles accounts with the property owner. The same applies analogously to modifications or extensions of sidewalk crossings.
processingTime: 3 months for construction of the sidewalk crossing by the road construction authority (the Roads or Civil Engineering Department in the respective Roads and Green Spaces Department). Note: Applications must be submitted at least 10 weeks before the planned construction start.

bookingInfo.office: The service can be obtained from the Roads and Green Spaces Department - Roads or Civil Engineering Department - in the respective district.

name: Sidewalk Passages - Construction and Modification by Property Owner
description: A service for property owners to construct or modify sidewalk passages (vehicle crossings) with approval from the local district office.
eligibility: Applicant must be the property owner (proof required: property register extract or notarized contract); the contracted company must be listed in the Entrepreneur and Supplier Directory (ULV).
requiredDocuments: Application from the property owner with sketch plan and execution plan
Statements from all utility administrations; utility inquiries via Infrastruktur eStrasse GmbH
fees: 100.00 to 800.00 euros administrative fee depending on effort.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service can be requested in the competent district at the Street and Green Space Office (Roads or Civil Engineering Department).

name: Request Temporary Sidewalk Crossing
description: This service allows property owners and construction managers to apply for a temporary, barrier-free sidewalk crossing on their property.
eligibility: Temporary sidewalk crossings must be constructed at level grade for accessibility reasons. You must inquire about existing underground utility lines before construction begins. Applicants must be adjacent property owners, construction contractors, or their authorized representatives.
requiredDocuments: Application for temporary sidewalk crossing (submit online)
Dimensioned site plan with specification of the temporary usage period
Power of attorney (if being represented)
processingTime: Approximately 3 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The service can be requested from the Roads and Green Spaces Department in the responsible district.

name: Money Laundering - Report Anonymous Tip Suspecting Wage Tax Assistance Association Violation
description: A service for reporting anonymous suspicions that a wage tax assistance association is violating money laundering laws.
eligibility: Suspicion that a wage tax assistance association is violating the Money Laundering Act. Report your tip if you suspect that a wage tax assistance association is violating the Money Laundering Act.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Money Laundering Prevention - Providing Information as an Obligated Party
description: A service for obligated parties in financial services, insurance, real estate, and related sectors to submit information and documents as requested by supervisory authorities for anti-money laundering compliance.
eligibility: You have received a request from the competent supervisory authority to submit documents. You are obligated to provide information if you are a natural person, legal entity, or partnership operating as a financial enterprise, insurance intermediary, company service provider, trustee, real estate agent, bookmaker, or goods dealer/art dealer/art warehouse operator (where storage is in customs-free zones). The person submitting documents must be a member of senior management or an internal/external money laundering officer of the enterprise, or may be represented by the obligated party's legal counsel and/or tax advisor with original power of attorney and specification of purpose. For online applications, you must register/log in via BundID (basic registration with username and password is sufficient).
requiredDocuments: Information and documents as individually requested by the supervisory authority
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Money Laundering Prevention — Notification of Outsourcing Internal Security Measures
description: This service allows obligated entities under German money laundering law to notify the relevant supervisory authority when outsourcing internal security measures to a qualified third party.
eligibility: You are eligible if you are a natural or legal person obligated under the Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz) and operating as: 1) a financial institution, 2) an insurance intermediary with foreign registered office maintaining domestic branches, 3) a service provider for companies and trust assets or trustee providing services specified in GwG § 2(1) No. 13 for third parties, 4) a real estate agent, 5) a bookmaker, 6) a gambling establishment, 7) an operator of a betting intermediary location, or 8) a goods dealer, art broker, or art warehouse operator where storage occurs in customs-free zones. The notifying person must be a member of the management level or an internal/external (group) money laundering compliance officer of the company, or the company's legal representative with original power of attorney. The third party must be sufficiently qualified and reliable, ensure proper implementation of security measures, and outsourcing must not impair the obligated entity's control mechanisms or supervisory authority oversight.
requiredDocuments: Notification of outsourcing of internal security measures (submit via online procedure where possible; notification must credibly demonstrate the third party's suitability and name the measures being outsourced)

Proof of authorization to notify (one of: appointment notice as money laundering compliance officer, contract for outsourcing internal security measures, evidence that the applicant is a member of management level such as commercial register extract or partnership agreement, or case-specific original power of attorney of the legal representative)

Proof of third party's qualifications (curriculum vitae showing professional career history and, if applicable, certificates of participation in continuing education or comparable qualification measures)

Certificate of conduct for presentation to a government authority (extract from Federal Central Register not older than three months; use purpose: 'Notification of outsourcing internal security measures under GwG'; recipient authority is the competent supervisory authority listed under 'responsible authorities')

Trade register extract for presentation to a government authority (extract from Trade Register not older than three months; use purpose: 'Notification of outsourcing internal security measures under GwG'; recipient authority is the competent supervisory authority listed under 'responsible authorities')
Contract with the third party (copy of contractual agreement with the third party to whom security measures will be outsourced)

Current commercial register extract or incorporation documents (registered firms must provide current extract from commercial register; legal entities in formation must provide articles of association or bylaws)
fees: No fee; or 138.00 to 1,380.00 euros depending on effort if the supervisory authority prohibits the outsourcing
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Money Laundering Prevention - Request Exemption from Risk Analysis Documentation
description: This service allows regulated financial institutions and businesses to request exemption from documenting a money laundering and terrorism financing risk analysis if their risks are clearly identifiable and manageable.
eligibility: Applicants must be natural or legal persons operating as: (1) Financial enterprises; (2) Insurance intermediaries with foreign headquarters operating domestic branches; (3) Service providers for companies and trust assets or trustees providing services specified in GwG § 2 paragraph 1 number 13 for third parties; (4) Real estate brokers; (5) Bookmakers; (6) Gambling establishments; (7) Betting agency operators; (8) Goods dealers, art intermediaries, and art warehouse operators where storage occurs in customs-free zones. The applicant must be a member of management level or an internal/external money laundering officer of the company, or a legal representative with original authorization. Risks must be clearly identifiable (no complex business activities, manageable transaction volume, homogeneous customer structure, no other risk-increasing circumstances) and there must be sufficient understanding of risks through documented security measures (e.g., staff training and security checks). Online applicants must register with a BundID account.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from risk analysis documentation (in text form, preferably via online procedure) with traceable and reasoned demonstration that money laundering and terrorism financing risks in your business area are manageable and clearly identifiable

Proof of eligibility: (a) Proof of appointment as (group) money laundering officer, or (b) Contract for outsourcing internal security measures, or (c) Evidence that applicant is a member of company management (e.g., commercial register extract or partnership agreement), or (d) if applicable, original authorization of the legal representative specific to the individual case

Current risk analysis: a traceable presentation of implemented internal security measures based on identified and assessed concrete money laundering and terrorism financing risks in your business area

If applicable, current commercial register extract: registered companies must submit a current commercial register extract; legal entities in formation (GmbH, AG) must submit articles of incorporation or bylaws
processingTime: Approximately up to 6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Money Laundering Prevention - Request Exemption from Duty to Appoint a Money Laundering Officer
description: This service allows eligible regulated businesses to apply for an exemption from the requirement to appoint a dedicated money laundering officer.
eligibility: Applicants must be natural or legal persons subject to the Money Laundering Act and engaged in one of the following activities: financial enterprises; insurance intermediaries based abroad with domestic establishments; service providers for companies and trust assets or trustees providing specified services to third parties; real estate agents; bookmakers; casinos; betting intermediaries; goods traders, art intermediaries and art warehouse operators where storage occurs in customs-free zones. Additionally, applicants must demonstrate clear internal communication on money laundering prevention within the company, appropriate personnel training, and implementation of risk-based protective measures to prevent business relationships and transactions related to money laundering or terrorist financing.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from the duty to appoint a money laundering officer (can be submitted online or by post in text form)
Documents in PDF, JPG, JPEG or PNG format for online submission

Proof of eligibility (depending on applicant type): trade register extract or articles of association for management members; appointment evidence for current money laundering officers; outsourcing contract for externally contracted third parties; or original power of attorney for legal representatives

name: Money Laundering Prevention - Notification of Appointment of a Money Laundering Officer (or Group Money Laundering Officer)
description: This service allows entities subject to German money laundering regulations to formally notify the authorities of their appointment of a money laundering officer or group money laundering officer.
eligibility: Entities legally required to appoint a money laundering officer under the Money Laundering Act include: natural or legal persons operating as financial enterprises, bookmakers, gaming banks, or betting intermediary operators. Legal entities operating as parent companies of a group are required to appoint a group money laundering officer if they operate as financial enterprises, foreign insurance brokers with domestic branches, service providers for companies and trust assets or trustees providing specific services, real estate brokers, bookmakers, gaming banks, betting intermediary operators, goods dealers, art brokers, or art warehouse operators (insofar as warehousing occurs in customs-free zones). The person submitting the notification must be a member of management or an internal/external money laundering officer of the company. A legal representative may also submit the notification with original power of attorney. The money laundering officer and their deputy must operate in Germany and must demonstrate required personal reliability and professional qualifications. For online submission, registration with BundID is required.
requiredDocuments: Notification of appointment of a money laundering officer (or group money laundering officer) and their deputy, submitted preferably through the online procedure

Proof of authorization to submit: certification of appointment as money laundering officer, or contract for outsourcing internal security measures, or evidence that the submitting person is a member of management (e.g., commercial register extract or partnership agreement), or original power of attorney for legal representative if applicable
Curriculum vitae documenting professional career development for each future money laundering officer and deputy
Certificates or training attendance documentation or comparable qualifications for continuing education if applicable

Certificate of Good Conduct from the Federal Central Criminal Register (Führungszeugnis) for authority submission (Document type O), not older than 3 months, with stated purpose 'Appointment as Money Laundering Officer under GwG'
Commercial Register extract (Gewerbezentralregisterauszug) for authority submission (Document type 9), not older than 3 months, with stated purpose 'Appointment of Money Laundering Officer under GwG'
Current commercial register extract for registered companies, or articles of association/bylaws for legal entities in formation
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

eligibility: For private individuals applying online: valid German ID card or residence permit with activated online authentication function (eID) and six-digit PIN, external card reader or modern smartphone with Android or iOS, and required software (e.g., AusweisApp2). For automated access to property owner data: applicant must be a surveying office, notary, public utility company (energy/water/waste/sewage), telecommunications infrastructure operator, government agency, or other public body with a legitimate use case; a software certificate is required for access outside the Berlin state network and will be sent after approval to the responsible person who manages it within their organization. If applying on behalf of an organization, a power of attorney from the client is required.
requiredDocuments: Application for access to Geobasisdaten Online (online submission only)
Attachment: Designation of group certificate responsible person for companies and public institutions (signed by executive or person with power of attorney; upload with online application)
Proof of existence of company or public institution not older than one year (examples: commercial register extract, business license, tax office registration, or chamber registration confirmation)

Power of attorney from client for access to property owner data (must include: client, contractor, limited time period, subject of data processing, description of type and purpose of data use, reference to data processing agreement under GDPR Article 28(3), BlnDSG § 48(5), or BDSG § 62(5))

name: Report Geological Drilling and Investigations
description: A service to officially report planned geological investigations, building ground surveys, or geothermal drilling to the Berlin authorities at least 14 days before work begins.
eligibility: Notice must be submitted 14 days before the geological investigation or drilling begins. This applies to planned building ground investigations, geothermal drilling, or geological surveys. Restrictions apply to drilling in nature reserves, water protection areas, or near underground structures (subway shafts, etc.) and buried utilities. For online submission: registration via BundID or Mein Unternehmenskonto (MUK) is required. For online submission: activated online ID function (eID) or Elster certificate is required. For BundID registration with online ID option: electronic ID card, EU citizen card (eID card), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated eID function and your PIN; external card reader or modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS; AusweisApp software. Legal entities require an Elster certificate for MUK registration. Results must be submitted no later than 3 months (technical data) or 6 months (assessment data) after work completion, or per Geological Data Act if different deadlines apply.
requiredDocuments: Online notification form for geological investigations and drilling (submitted exclusively online)
Core samples or bore sample information and borehole layer log

For area-wide geological investigations using measurements: measurement data and documentation of processing steps applied (data must be processed into comparable and assessable data using commercially available technical means)
processingTime: The notification is processed immediately.

name: Court Interpreter - General Oath Application
description: This service allows qualified interpreters to apply for official accreditation and take an oath to work as court interpreters in Berlin.

You must demonstrate the required personal reliability. When invited to the oath ceremony, you must take an oath or make a solemn affirmation that you will accurately and conscientiously transfer the spoken texts into the target language.

See 'responsible authorities' for current contact details.

name: Court Hearings — School Class Visits
description: A service allowing school classes to attend court proceedings in person as educational visitors to the District Court Tiergarten.
eligibility: Planning of the visit and registration are required. An appointment is absolutely mandatory. For organizational reasons, Tuesdays and Thursdays are not available as visit days. Please call the District Court Tiergarten at least 2 weeks before your intended date. To facilitate appointment scheduling, you should have ready two or three alternative dates. The meeting point on the visit day will be provided during registration. The courtroom will be communicated on site. Each class (maximum 20 students) must be accompanied by an adult supervisor. If a class has more than 20 students, an additional adult supervisor is required, as the class must be split across different hearings due to space constraints. The class must arrive at the meeting point at least 30 minutes before the hearing begins, as security checks may cause longer waiting times. Every person entering the building will be checked. These checks serve to establish identity. For this reason, every person must present a valid official photo identification upon entry. Items that could be misused for physical attacks or to disrupt court proceedings are prohibited in the building, in particular tools, scissors, knives, firearms, glass and gas bottles, pepper spray, alarm clocks, CD and MP3 players, cans, air pumps, whistles, and radios. Mobile phones of any kind may be brought in, but their use in the courtroom is prohibited. If there is suspicion of a violation of weapons law, a criminal complaint will be filed.
requiredDocuments: Identity card (Personalausweis)
Passport (Reisepass)
Student ID (Schülerausweis)
Driver's license (Führerschein)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Change of Gender Entry and First Name (according to SBGG)
description: A service for eligible residents to officially change their gender entry and corresponding first name with the registry office.
eligibility: You must register the change with the registry office at least three months before submitting your declaration. You must be 18 years old or older, or if aged 14-17 have parental consent, or if under 14 have a legal guardian submit on your behalf with your consent (if you are 5 or older). You must have German citizenship, be a citizen of another EU member state, or possess a settlement permit or renewable residence permit and lawfully reside in Germany, or hold a Blue Card EU. New first names corresponding to the new gender entry must be specified; existing names that match the new gender entry may be retained. If you have changed your gender entry before, you must wait at least 12 months since the last change before submitting a new declaration. Any foreign documents must have an official certified translation, and if necessary, an apostille or legalization.
requiredDocuments: Registration of the change of gender entry (can be submitted informally in writing with your signature or in person at the registry office, or using the provided registration form)
Declaration of change of gender entry (must be submitted in person at the registry office three months after registration; the registry office will provide you with an appointment)
Passport or national ID card (to be presented by the declaring person and any legal guardians)

Proof of residence permit if applicable (if the declaring person does not have German citizenship: proof of unlimited residence right [settlement permit] or renewable residence permit and lawful residence in Germany or Blue Card EU)
Birth certificate if born in Germany
Official certified translation of birth certificate if born abroad
Marriage or civil partnership certificate if currently married or in a civil partnership
Interpreter (if the declaring person does not have sufficient command of the German language, an interpreter must be arranged and paid for by the applicant)
fees: No fee for declaration of change of gender entry; 15.00 EUR for declaration according to § 2 SBGG; 12.00 EUR for certificate of name usage
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Commercial Trade - Setting Fairs, Exhibitions, and Markets
description: A service for commercial vendors to obtain official designation for holding fairs, exhibitions, and markets as regulated commercial events.
eligibility: You must be a commercial vendor seeking to have your event officially designated (private markets such as flea markets do not require designation). Identity document - passport or other official photo ID (not required if applying electronically), plus residence permit if you are not an EU citizen

Purchase, rental, or lease agreement proving you have actual control over the event spaces/areas
Floor plan/layout plans of the spaces/areas intended for the event (preferably at a scale of 1:100)
Event concept describing measures to protect participants from dangers to life or health, and measures to prevent significant disturbances to public safety or order
Copy of valid liability insurance (Haftpflichtversicherung) of the event organizer
For registered businesses and legal entities in formation: current extract from the Commercial Register or articles of association (notarized)
Terms of participation or market regulations governing admission and participation of vendors for the specific event

Residence permit, if the applicant is not a citizen of an EU country

Tax clearance certificate (Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung) from the competent local tax office

name: Trade – Request Reinstatement of Trade License After Revocation
description: This service allows business owners whose trade license was revoked due to unreliability to apply for reinstatement once certain conditions are met.
eligibility: The reasons for the trade license revocation due to unreliability must no longer apply. The responsible authority must also be able to assess that you will operate your trade properly in the future. Application is earliest possible 1 year after revocation, though exceptions may allow earlier application. Upon reinstatement, you must simultaneously file a trade registration notice with the responsible authority. If a required permit was previously revoked due to unreliability, you must reapply for that permit before resuming the permitted business activity.
requiredDocuments: Application for trade license reinstatement – may be submitted informally in writing or electronically (e.g., by email) and must contain details about the applicant, any changes of residence, intended business activities, and place of operation
Personal identity document (national ID card or other official photo ID)
Residence permit if the applicant is not a citizen of an EU country
Evidence of how you have supported yourself since the trade license revocation and whether you were employed
Certificate of conduct for submission to an authority (Belegart O) – not older than three months, issued from the Federal Central Register (Bundeszentralregister)
Trade register extract for submission to an authority (Belegart 9) – not older than three months, issued from the Trade Central Register (Gewerbezentralregister)
Information from the debtor register (Central Enforcement Portal – Zentrales Vollstreckungsportal)

Insolvency register certificate – for natural persons resident in Berlin: two certificates required (one for consumer insolvency from your local court; one for standard insolvency from District Court Charlottenburg, Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin); for legal entities and partnerships based in Berlin: District Court Charlottenburg is responsible; applicants based outside Berlin should check the central registry of courts (Orts- und Gerichtsverzeichnis)
Current tax certificate (tax clearance certificate) from the responsible local tax office (if applicable)
Clearance certificate from the responsible social security provider (Sozialversicherungsträger) (if applicable)

Current certificates from trade tax office, tax office, and social security providers (if you had payment arrears at the time of the previous trade revocation); certificates must detail: amount of any remaining arrears separated by main and secondary claims; the period from which any main claim originates; payment arrangements made after the revocation, including dates and compliance; enforcement measures taken, their nature, and results

Certificates from the debtor file of the insolvency court, tax office, and trade tax office (if you moved residence after the revocation); required from both current responsible authorities and those responsible at the time of the original revocation

name: Business Deregistration (Gewerbe abmelden)
description: A service to formally deregister a business that you are closing, relocating outside Berlin, or changing in legal structure.
eligibility: You want to completely close your already-registered business, relocate it outside of Berlin, or change its legal structure. Business operators are natural or legal persons (stock corporation, limited liability company, registered cooperative or registered association, limited partnership with shares). The deregistration must be submitted by the following persons or their authorized representatives: for sole proprietorships: the sole proprietor; for partnerships (e.g., general partnership, civil partnership): the managing partners; for limited partnerships: each personally liable partner, and limited partners of a limited partnership only if they have management authority; for capital companies (e.g., limited liability company, stock corporation): the statutory representatives (managing directors, board members). The business deregistration must be submitted simultaneously with the cessation of business operations, relocation to another municipality (outside Berlin), or when changing the legal structure of your business.
requiredDocuments: Business deregistration form (available online or in paper form)
Identity document: national ID card or other official photo identification document (not required for electronic application)
Residence permit if the applicant is not a citizen of an EU country
Current extract from the commercial register for registered businesses (proof of authority to represent)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) of the district where your company's business premises are located.

Consent declarations of shareholders (only for business registrations of legal entities under formation)
Supplementary sheet for authorized representatives (for business registrations of legal entities with multiple authorized representatives)

name: Business Re-registration (Gewerbe ummelden)

eligibility: You want to relocate your already registered business within Berlin, change your business activity, or your name has changed. The re-registration must be submitted by the following persons or their authorized representatives: for sole proprietorships: the sole proprietor; for partnerships (e.g. general partnership, civil law partnership): the partners with management authority; for limited partnerships: each personally liable partner, and limited partners only if they have management authority; for capital companies (e.g. limited liability company, corporation): the legal representatives (managing directors, board members). The re-registration must be submitted simultaneously with the relocation to another district (within Berlin), when the business activity changes, or when the name of the business operator changes.

If individual businesses have not filed the appropriate business notice, their data cannot be included in the information provided. No information can be provided for businesses that have been deregistered for longer than one year. name: Gambling - Apply for Bookmaker License
description: This service allows individuals and businesses to apply for permission to operate as a bookmaker in Berlin, subject to meeting specified eligibility requirements and providing required documentation.
eligibility: Applicants must be natural persons or legal entities under private law (e.g. GmbH, associations, registered cooperatives, foundations). The bookmaking activity must not contradict the objectives of the Gambling State Treaty. Applicants must demonstrate personal reliability through clearance certificates and registry documents. Applicants must possess the required technical expertise and commercial knowledge to independently conduct bookmaking activities; for legal entities, the legal representative must provide this proof. A security deposit must be lodged to cover state tax claims with interest, fines, penalties, costs of criminal and administrative proceedings, and bettors' claims arising from the betting business. The amount of the security deposit is set in the permit decision based on the presumed scope of the bookmaking business and the amount of expected liabilities, and may be increased or reduced by the authority at any time.
requiredDocuments: Application form for bookmaking business (available under 'Forms') — submit in text form by post or electronically
Personal identification document — legible copy of ID card or passport and residence permit if applicant is not a citizen of an EU country

Certificate of conduct for submission to a government office (issued within 3 months; for legal entities, required from all legal representatives; indicate purpose as 'Buchmachererlaubnis nach § 2 Abs. 1 RennwLottG')

Central business registry certificate for submission to a government office (issued within 3 months; for legal entities, required from all legal representatives plus one for the entity itself; indicate purpose as 'Buchmachererlaubnis nach § 2 Abs. 1 RennwLottG')

Bankruptcy register information (for natural persons in Berlin: two certificates required — one from district court of residence for consumer insolvency proceedings, one from Regional Court Charlottenburg for standard insolvency proceedings; for legal entities and partnerships in Berlin: from Regional Court Charlottenburg, Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin; applicants outside Berlin should check jurisdiction via central registry directory; certificates not older than 3 months; for legal entities, also required from all legal representatives)
Self-disclosure from debtor register (issued within 3 months; for legal entities, also required from all legal representatives)

Tax clearance certificate (issued within 3 months; contact operating tax office if already operating a business, or tax office of residence if not; for legal entities, also required from all legal representatives)
Proof of own capital or operating capital of at least €25,000 — demonstrated by current bank statement or bank confirmation; must verify that funds are not borrowed or from third-party partnerships

Security deposit — may be provided as bank guarantee, savings book with blocking notation, fixed-term deposit account with pledge agreement in favor of the Senate administration responsible for business, or zero-interest escrow account designated by the Senate administration responsible for business; amount determined by permit decision and adjusted as circumstances change

Proof of commercial competence for bookmaking business — demonstrated by passing an examination before an examination board (e.g. Deutscher Buchmacherverband Essen e.V.) or proof of at least two years of continuous employment as a bookmaker assistant

Register excerpt from commercial or association register (for registered legal entities such as GmbH: current excerpt from commercial register; for registered associations: current excerpt from association register; for legal entities being established: articles of incorporation or association bylaws)

name: Land Register - Extract
