name: Land Register - Owner Correction After Inheritance
description: A service to correct property ownership records in the land register when a registered owner passes away, for heirs to formally register their inheritance.
eligibility: Application is required for land register correction. When registered property owners pass away, the land register is not automatically corrected. You must be an heir or beneficiary of a property.
requiredDocuments: Written application form for correction (Berichtigungsantrag)

Proof of inheritance in one of the following forms: certified copy of an inheritance certificate (Erbschein), original or certified copy of notarized will or inheritance contract with opening protocol from the probate court, or European Certificate of Succession (for estates with international elements)
fees: Free of charge within the first two years after the inheritance. After two years, a fee is charged based on the property value.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Land Register Office (Grundbuchamt) responsible for maintaining the specific land register where the property is recorded. You can identify the responsible office using the link provided at https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Land Register - Ownership Transfer or Suspension Entry
description: This is a property registration procedure in the land register for recording the transfer of ownership or creating a suspension entry (Auflassungsvormerkung) for real estate.
eligibility: The land register procedure is a request-based procedure. For a pre-entry (Voreintragung): The person transferring the property must be registered as the owner in the land register. Exception: The transferring person is the heir or heiress.
requiredDocuments: Application — Usually filed by an authorized notary
Consent declaration (Bewilligungserklärung) — The entry must be expressly approved by the owner and must be certified by a notary
Representation documents (e.g., owner's power of attorney, commercial register extract)
Evidence of legal succession (e.g., certificate of inheritance, notarized will)
fees: A fee of half the standard rate applies based on the property value (e.g., purchase price) according to § 34 GNotKG (Annex 1 KV 14150 GNotKG). The amount is determined by § 34 GNotKG (Annex 2 Table B).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent office is exclusively the land register office (Grundbuchamt) where the land register is maintained. You can determine the responsible land register office via the following link: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Land Register - File Access (Grundbuch - Einsichtnahme)
description: This service allows you to request access to view property information in the Berlin land register, provided you can demonstrate a legitimate legal interest.
eligibility: You must submit a request for access, which is only available in person at the land register office. You must declare and prove a legitimate interest, such as: having a claim against the property owner that you want to enforce through the land register; granting credit to the property owner; being a tenant seeking to identify the actual landlord; or other similar legal grounds.
requiredDocuments: Application (oral or written) containing: property designation (land register district and sheet number, or at minimum street and house number); property owner information if known
Personal ID card or passport with registration certificate (for oral applications)
Written application (for advance preparation): informal format, submitted by post or fax with sender details
Power of attorney in original form (if applicable)
Evidence of legitimate interest such as: rental contract; credit contract draft; purchase contract or draft; enforcement title; lawsuit against the property owner
fees: File access is free of charge. If certified copies are requested, separate costs apply.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Access is available at any Berlin land register office. Use the official link to determine your responsible office: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Grundbuch - Entry of Building Right (Erbbaurecht)
description: This service allows you to register a building right (Erbbaurecht) in the land register, which must be applied for by a notary and must be recorded as the first-ranking entry.
eligibility: The registration of a building right is an application procedure submitted by a notary. Only property owners registered in the land register can grant a building right. The building right must mandatorily be entered in the land register at the first-ranking position.
requiredDocuments: Written application containing the property designation (land register or site designation) and the entries to be made in the land register

Notarial contract: The agreement on the building right must be declared in a notarial contract with the simultaneous presence of all parties involved; representation is permitted when making declarations
Tax clearance certificate from the Spandau Tax Office (Berlin only) for each building right agreement
Approval under the Price Clause Act (Preisklauselgesetz) for agreements with a term of up to 30 years
fees: A full fee applies according to Attachment 1 Section 14121 GNotKG. The value of the right is determined either by the property value with development or by the annual value of the ground rent. The amount is determined according to § 34 GNotKG (Attachment 2 Table B).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You can request the entry at any Berlin district court (Amtsgericht) with a land register office (Grundbuchamt). You can determine the responsible land register office via the following link: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Land Register Maintenance
description: Service for maintaining entries in the land register (Grundbuch) through an application process with notarized documents.
eligibility: Application procedure: The Land Register Office will generally only act upon application. Notarized documents: The application must generally be accompanied by notarized documents. Government permits and certificates: Depending on the requested entry, permit requirements may apply.
requiredDocuments: Notarized documents (as per the eligibility requirements above)
Any required government permits and certificates (depending on the type of entry requested)
fees: The fee is based either on the value of the matter or a fixed fee applies.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Land Register - Registration of Mortgage Rights
description: This service allows property owners to register mortgage rights (Grundschuld or Hypothek) in the land register by submitting an application through a notary.
eligibility: This is an application-based procedure. To register a mortgage right or Grundschuld, you must be registered as the property owner in the land register.
requiredDocuments: Application (typically submitted by the authorized notary)
Declaration of consent (Bewilligungserklärung) — the registration must be explicitly authorized by you and notarized by a notary
fees: Full fee according to the value of the mortgage right; see Annex 1 KV 14122, § 34 GNotKG (Annex 2 Table B).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Land Register Office (Grundbuchamt) responsible for maintaining the land register is solely competent. You can determine the competent office via the following link: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Land Register - Deletion of Land Charges
description: A service for requesting the deletion of land charges (mortgages or land debts) from the land register when a loan has been repaid.
eligibility: This is an application-based procedure. Deletion does not occur automatically upon repayment of the loan debt. The application must be submitted in writing by the property owner(s) with notarially certified signatures. If the creditor submits the application, they must include the property owner's consent.
requiredDocuments: Deletion application (Löschungsantrag) and owner consent (Eigentümerzustimmung) with notarially certified signatures
Deletion authorization (Löschungsbewilligung) from the creditor (e.g., bank or credit institution) with notarially certified signatures, and an official seal if the bank is authorized to use one
Original land charge certificate (Briefurkunde) or mortgage certificate if one is registered in the land register
fees: Half fee based on the value of the land charge according to Appendix 1 KV 14140, Section 34 GNotKG (Appendix 2 Table B).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Only the land register office (Grundbuchamt) responsible for managing the specific property's land register is competent. You can determine the responsible office via: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Land Register - Changes to Land Charges (Grundpfandrechte)
description: A service for registering changes to land charges in the land register, available to both the person benefiting from the change and the person disadvantaged by it.
eligibility: The procedure is application-based. The right to be modified must already be entered in the land register.
requiredDocuments: Application submitted by the person benefiting from the change (beneficiary) or the person legally disadvantaged by the entry (affected party)

Declaration of consent from affected parties or proof of incorrectness — a notarized declaration specifying the changes to be registered, with the affected party's signature notarially certified; or proof by document of incorrectness if the change occurred outside the land register (e.g., company name change or attachment of the right)
Owner consent — for changes to the rank of registered land charges, owners must consent in notarial form
Land charge certificate (Grundschuld- or Hypothekenbrief) — if the land charge was registered as a certificate right
fees: In most cases, half the fee is charged based on the value of the change (KV 14130 GNotKG). The amount is determined by § 34 GNotKG (Annex 2 Table B).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent office is exclusively the Land Register Office (Grundbuchamt) where the land register is maintained. You can identify the responsible Land Register Office using this link: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Property Register - Deletion of Liens and Restrictions
description: This service allows property owners to request the deletion of encumbrances or restrictions recorded in the property register.
eligibility: This is an application-based procedure. The property register office does not automatically delete entries upon the death of the entitled person or their waiver of the right.
requiredDocuments: Application for deletion (written submission) — the property owner is authorized to submit; alternatively, the person whose right is to be deleted may also submit the application; in most cases involving purchase or gift contracts, the notary submits the deletion request

Deletion consent or death certificate — the entitled person (e.g., holder of a usufruct right) must declare that the right can be deleted from the property register; the consent must be explicitly given either before a notary or with a certified signature; if the entitled person is deceased, submit a death certificate with the application
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The property register office (Grundbuchamt) responsible for maintaining the property register is exclusively competent. You can determine the responsible office via: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Land Register - Forced Mortgage Registration (Zwangshypothek)
description: This service registers a forced mortgage (security lien) on a property's land register to secure enforcement of a creditor's claim against the debtor.
eligibility: Application required. Minimum claim amount: €750.01. Debtor must be registered as owner or co-owner in the land register. A valid enforcement title is required (court decision or notarized document with enforcement clause). The enforcement title must be served on the debtor before enforcement begins; for certain documents, a two-week waiting period applies after service. No other enforcement obstacles may exist (e.g., no insolvency proceedings entry). Multiple enforcement titles may be combined.
requiredDocuments: Written application containing: property designation (land register or location designation), your personal details (name, address/company and seat, date of birth), information on joint creditors if applicable (e.g., shares or joint creditor status per § 428 BGB), debtor's details (name, address/company and seat)
Enforcement title in original (fully enforceable certified copy or enforcement order); simple or certified copies are not sufficient
List of all claims to be asserted, including any payments already made by the debtor, interest rates and start dates (not calculated), and receipts for any enforcement costs claimed
fees: Full fee based on the enforcement title amount (total claim being registered), calculated according to § 34 GNotKG (Table B) and Annex 2.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The land register office (Grundbuchamt) responsible for the property where the land register is maintained. You can determine the responsible office via: https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/_assets/was-moechten-sie-erledigen/zustaendigkeit-in-grundbuchsachen.pdf

name: Apply for Gründerinnen Bonus
description: A financial support program for female entrepreneurs to help with business startup costs.
eligibility: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Land Transfer Tax - Assessment (Grunderwerbsteuer - Festsetzung)
description: This service assesses and determines land transfer tax liability when ownership of a property in Berlin changes hands.
eligibility: Change of legal owner for real estate. Applies to acquisition transactions involving properties located in the State of Berlin.
requiredDocuments: Property purchase contract (Grundstückskaufvertrag)
Contracts for other legal transactions that trigger a change of legal owner for properties
Construction contracts where there is an obligation to develop the property
fees: No fees; however, costs may incur for example in case of late payment or non-payment (late payment surcharges or default surcharges).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Finance Office Spandau (Finanzamt Spandau) is generally responsible for all acquisition transactions relating to properties located in the State of Berlin.

name: Apply for Basic Income Support in Old Age and for the Permanently Work-Impaired (Social Assistance)
description: This service allows you to apply for basic income support if you have reached retirement age or have permanent work disability and have insufficient income and assets to support yourself.
eligibility: You must meet the following conditions: (1) Have reached retirement age (between 65 and 67 years depending on birth year) OR have permanent full work disability (certified by the pension insurance provider) AND be at least 18 years old; (2) Have income and assets insufficient to cover your living expenses; (3) Have residence in Berlin through official registration or, if homeless, have usual place of residence in Berlin.
requiredDocuments: Application form for Basic Income Support in Old Age and for the Permanently Work-Impaired according to SGB XII (submit completed and signed form with required documents as copies by mail to the responsible Social Services office of your district or submit in person)
Valid identity documents and residence confirmation if applicable
Evidence of permanent full work disability
Income documentation
Asset documentation (for example: life insurance, building savings insurance, Riester pension contracts, funeral insurance, burial provision, savings accounts, real estate, valuables, vehicles)
Bank statements
Rental contract and rent change notices if applicable
Evidence of health and long-term care insurance
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Contact the Social Services office (Amt für Soziales) of your residential district in Berlin.

name: Land Tax (Grundsteuer)
description: A tax levied on the ownership of real estate properties and their structures.
eligibility: Property ownership. The Land Tax (GrSt) is a tax on the ownership of real estate properties and their structures.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the tax authority (Finanzamt) in whose administrative district the property is located.

name: Property - Request Beneficial Right Certificate
description: This service allows property owners, acquirers, and other authorized persons to request a certificate confirming that a beneficial right registered in the land register remains valid on the dominant part after property division.
eligibility: A beneficial right registered in the land register remains on the dominant part after property division. Eligible applicants include: property owner(s), property acquirer(s), or other authorized persons (e.g., notary). The applicant must be the owner, acquirer, or otherwise authorized person as defined by law.
requiredDocuments: Application for beneficial right certificate (online or written by post)
Property details: location and land register information
Current land register extract (Grundbuchauszug)
Authorization deed establishing the easement (copy)
File upload requirements for online application: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or DOCX format; total file size not exceeding 30 MB; individual file size not exceeding 5 MB
processingTime: 4 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Surveyor's Office (Vermessungsamt): Submit your application to the local surveyor's office responsible for maintaining the land cadastre; or through a notary (Notar/in)

name: Property - Request Certificate of Local and Economic Unity
description: This service allows property owners, buyers, and authorized representatives to request an official certificate confirming the local and economic unity of one or more properties.
eligibility: Property owners, buyers, or otherwise authorized persons (such as notaries) may apply.
requiredDocuments: Application form for certificate of local and economic unity (online or written by mail)
Current land register extract (if available)
Copy of the application for consolidation or assignment of property components, and if applicable, division
Map excerpt or sketch with identification of the affected properties
processingTime: 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Property Distance Certificate Application
description: Request an official certificate documenting the distance between two property addresses for legal or administrative purposes.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
requiredDocuments: Application form for distance certificate (available online or submitted in writing by post)
Street and house number of the start and destination addresses
Official request for proof (if applicable), for example written notice from Deutsche Rentenversicherung (German Pension Insurance)
Form from the requesting authority or organization (if applicable)
fees: No fee for certificates requested by authorities under the Social Code; 126.00 euros per certificate for all other cases.
processingTime: 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The surveying office (Vermessungsamt) in the district where the start address is located.

name: Request Property Parcel Merger (Flurstücksverschmelzung)
description: This service allows property owners to request the merger of multiple property parcels into a single parcel unit.
eligibility: Applicant must be the property owner or authorized representative. The parcels to be merged must form a geographic and economic unit. The parcels must be registered in the land register (Grundbuch) under a single running number as one property entry; if not yet registered this way, merger can be requested together with registration. The parcels must not be encumbered in Section III of the land register, or must be uniformly encumbered; if not, a component assignment (§ 890 Abs. 2 BGB) must be requested.
requiredDocuments: Application for property parcel merger (online or written form by mail)
File size requirements for online submission: total files max 30 MB, individual files max 5 MB, formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, PDF
Identification of the parcels to be merged
Certified power of attorney (if represented)
Authorization proof (for condominium associations)
Business documentation for legal entities: trade register excerpt, business license, tax office registration, association register excerpt, or chamber registration proof
processingTime: Approximately 2 weeks; in individual cases, land register office approval may be required, which could extend processing time.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request a Certification of Grounds for Cancellation (Gegenstandslosigkeitsbescheinigung) for a Property
description: This service allows property owners, buyers, or authorized representatives to request a certification that a registered easement (Grunddienstbarkeit) in the land register no longer has a legal basis.
eligibility: The registered easement in the land register no longer has a legal basis. Applicants must be the property owner, buyer, or otherwise authorized person (e.g., notary).
requiredDocuments: Application for a Certification of Grounds for Cancellation (can be submitted online or by post in writing)
Property details including location and land register information
Current land register extract
Grant document (Bewilligungsurkunde) by which the easement was established (in copy)
For online applications: all documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or DOCX format; total file size must not exceed 30 MB; individual files must not exceed 5 MB
processingTime: 4 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Surveying Office (Vermessungsamt) — the office responsible for maintaining the land cadastre in your area, particularly for space-related property rights such as easements; or alternatively, a notary (Notar/in)

name: Property Boundary Certificate for Land Parcels (Grundstück - Grenzbescheinigung für Flurstücke)
description: A service to request an official boundary certificate for a land parcel, available to owners, purchasers, and other authorized parties such as notaries.
eligibility: Buildings must be recorded in the current state in the land register (Liegenschaftskataster). If buildings are not yet recorded or have undergone changes to their floor plan since the last survey, the property owner must first commission a cadastral building survey from a publicly appointed surveyor (ÖbVI). A prior boundary determination procedure may be required for the issuance of a boundary certificate. Eligible applicants: property owners, purchasers, or other authorized persons (e.g., notaries). Financial institutions and third parties must demonstrate legitimate interest; owners, building rights holders (Erbbauberechtigte), and notaries are exempt from this requirement.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a boundary certificate (can be submitted online or by post in writing)
For online application: all required documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or DOCX format (total file size not exceeding 30 MB; individual files not exceeding 5 MB each)
For written application: designation of the property and, if applicable, a specific building; indication if the boundary certificate should be issued together with an extract from the cadastral map
Demonstration of legitimate interest (required for financial institutions and third parties only)
fees: 110.00 euros per certificate; potentially additional fees for cadastral map extract; fees increase if boundary establishment or building survey is required
processingTime: 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Property - Commission Boundary Survey
description: A service for property owners and authorized persons to commission an official boundary survey of their property in Berlin.
eligibility: You must be the property owner, holder of a building right (Erbbauberechtigte/r), holder of a usage right (Nutzungsberechtigte/r), or an authorized representative. You commission a publicly appointed surveying engineer (Öffentlich bestellte/r Vermessungsingenieur/in - ÖbVI) to conduct the survey, as these are the only professionals authorized to perform boundary surveys in Berlin.
fees: Costs are charged according to the fee schedule for publicly appointed surveyors (ÖbVIVergO) for conducting the boundary survey. Additionally, fees apply according to the Survey Fees Ordinance (VermGebO) for recording the survey results in the property cadastre. The amount depends on the specific circumstances of your case.
processingTime: Please inquire with the publicly appointed surveying engineer — not stated on the page.

bookingInfo.office: Publicly appointed surveying engineers (ÖbVI) are responsible for conducting the boundary survey. The Surveying Office (Vermessungsamt) responsible for the district where the property is located is responsible for recording the survey results in the property cadastre.

name: Property - Request Property Number/House Number
description: A service for property owners and holders of equivalent rights to request the assignment or correction of property numbers and house numbers in Berlin.
eligibility: Eligible applicants are property owners, holders of building rights (Erbbauberechtigte), other persons with equivalent property rights, and their authorized representatives. If applying on behalf of someone else, a power of attorney is required.
requiredDocuments: Application for assignment of property numbers/house numbers (online submission available; file size limit: 30 MB total, 5 MB per file; accepted formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, PDF)
Site plan or sketch with markings of building entrances and access routes/entry points from the street (recommended)
Power of attorney (required if applying as a representative)
fees: €85.00 per assigned property number; no fee for assignment of already-assigned property numbers, renumbering due to street name changes, renumbering to correct numbering sequence, or removal of surplus property numbers
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the surveying authority (Vermessungsamt) in the district where the property is located.

name: Property - Request Property Number Certificate
description: A service to request an official certificate confirming the property number of a specific plot of land in Berlin.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
requiredDocuments: Application for a property number certificate (online or informal written application by post)
For online application: all required documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG format (total file size max 30 MB; individual files max 5 MB each)
Map excerpt or sketch with marking of the affected properties
processingTime: 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the Berlin Land Survey Office (Berliner Vermessungsamt) where the property is located.

name: Property - Request Identity Certificate for Land Parcels
description: This service provides an official identity certificate for land parcels (Flurstücke) registered in the property records.
eligibility: No prerequisites are required.
requiredDocuments: Application form (available online or submit informally in writing by post)
Property/land parcel information
Current land registry extract (Grundbuchauszug)
Document establishing the legal circumstances (in copy, if available)
For online submission: all required documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG format (total file size not exceeding 30 MB; individual file size not exceeding 5 MB)
processingTime: 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Property Site Plan (Building Submission) Preparation and Certification
description: A service for property owners or authorized representatives to have a certified site plan prepared by a publicly appointed surveyor for submission to building authorities.
eligibility: You must be the property owner, holder of building rights, or authorized representative. The building authority has requested a site plan from you. You must commission a publicly appointed surveyor (ÖbVI), as only publicly appointed surveyors in Berlin can prepare site plans. For submission of building plans to the building authority, you must use a person authorized to submit building documents who is registered with the Chamber of Construction.
fees: Costs are determined according to the fee regulation for publicly appointed surveyors (ÖbVIVergO). The amount depends on the specific conditions of each case (for example, the perimeter length of the building plot, land value, and any existing or planned floor area).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check with the publicly appointed surveyor for details.

bookingInfo.office: Publicly appointed surveyors and surveyors (ÖbVI) are responsible for preparing site plans.

name: Property - Certificate of Non-Affectation Request
description: A service to request a certificate confirming that a registered property easement does not affect all parts of a property.
eligibility: Property owner, property buyer, or other authorized person (e.g., notary) whose property is registered in the land registry with an easement that does not affect all parts of the property.
requiredDocuments: Application for a Certificate of Non-Affectation (submit online or as a written request by post)
For online applications: All required documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or DOCX format (total file size not exceeding 30 MB; individual files not exceeding 5 MB)
Property details including location and land registry information
Current land registry extract
Copy of the deed granting the easement
processingTime: 4 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Surveying Office (Vermessungsamt) responsible for the land registry in your area, or through a notary

name: Property - Non-Extension Certificate (Nichterstreckungsbescheinigung)
description: A service to request a certificate confirming that a registered property burden does not extend to all parts of the property.
eligibility: The registered burden in the land register does not extend to all parts of the property. The burden (excluding easements) can be: a registration of a transfer agreement, usufruct, a limited personal easement, a right of first refusal, or a land charge. Applicants must be: the owner, the buyer, or another authorized person (e.g., notary).
requiredDocuments: Application for a Non-Extension Certificate (can be submitted online or in writing by mail)

Online application file requirements: all required documents and supporting evidence must be provided in PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG or DOCX format; total file size must not exceed 30 MB; individual files must not exceed 5 MB each
Property details (location, land register information)
Current land register extract
Grant deed (Bewilligungsurkunde) in which the burden was agreed upon (in copy)
processingTime: 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Surveying Office (Vermessungsamt) responsible for maintaining the property cadastre for your location, or a notary

name: Property - Request Tracing of Parcel Development
description: A service to request a historical trace of how a property parcel (Flurstück) has developed and changed over time.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
requiredDocuments: Request for tracing of parcel development — online submission or informal written application by post
For online submission: total file size must not exceed 30 MB; individual files maximum 5 MB each; permitted file formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, and PDF
Current parcel designation — when providing a current parcel, a development trace up to a specified historical date will be created
Historical parcel designation — when providing a historical parcel, a development trace up to the current situation will be created
Supporting documents for identifying the historical property situation, such as old plans, or clarification of the reason for the trace (for example, an entry of a charge in the land register)
fees: €32.00 per started half-hour; cost depends on processing scope.
processingTime: Approximately 2–8 weeks, depending on complexity.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Property - Request Harmlessness Certificate
description: A service to request a harmlessness certificate for real estate, required before completing transactions involving property sales or changes to apartment and partial ownership rights.
eligibility: A harmlessness certificate must be requested before completion of the transaction (sale of land or changes to apartment and partial ownership rights). Any natural or legal person with a legitimate legal interest in determining harmlessness may apply. Applicants must demonstrate that obtaining approvals, declarations, or consents from entitled parties is only possible under disproportionate difficulties or not at all. Applicants must provide the required documentation.
requiredDocuments: Notarized contracts for sale, exchange, or assignment
Current property register extract
Deliverable addresses of all owners and creditors
For affected partial areas: site plan or extract from the cadastral map showing the area
For apartment and partial ownership: division declaration and occupancy certificate
fees: 361.00 euros; 9.00 euros per additional copy requested simultaneously
processingTime: Processing time is approximately 2 months, because the parties involved (owners and holders of rights registered in the property register) must be consulted beforehand. Processing time begins when all documentation is received.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the respective surveying office (Vermessungsamt) in whose district the property is located (also applies to apartment and partial ownership).

name: Property - Certify signature on unification application with simultaneous parcel consolidation
description: This service certifies the signature of property owners on an application to unify multiple parcels of land into a single property unit in the land register.
eligibility: The application must be submitted by the property owner or an authorized representative (certified power of attorney required). The application includes the request for parcel consolidation. Future owners may also submit a unification application, but the unification can only be registered in the land register after they are entered as owners. The properties to be unified must form a local and economic unit. The properties must not be encumbered or must be equally encumbered in Section III of the land register. Signature certification can only be done by the competent surveying office or a notary public. A signature certification appointment is scheduled by telephone or email after the application is submitted, and personal attendance is required.
requiredDocuments: Application for signature certification on a unification application (online or by mail)
Official photo identification for all applicants
Information about the property/parcels
Current business register excerpt for companies
Current association register excerpt for associations
Certified power of attorney if applicable for representation

name: Commercial Register - Registration as Limited Liability Company (GmbH)
description: Register a limited liability company (GmbH) in the commercial register by submitting a notarized articles of association and meeting minimum capital and shareholder requirements.
eligibility: A company contract (articles of association) between all shareholders is required. The articles must include: company name with legal form designation (e.g., GmbH or Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung); domestic seat of the company as specified in the articles; business purpose for which the company is founded; amount of share capital (minimum €25,000, or minimum €1 for an Unternehmergesellschaft with the designation 'Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt)' or 'UG (haftungsbeschränkt)'); nominal amounts of business shares (each share minimum €1, divisible only in whole euros, with total matching share capital). The articles must be notarized. Before registration, all shareholders must pay at least one quarter of their cash contributions to business shares; any non-cash contributions must be fully delivered; total cash and non-cash contributions must be at least €12,500 (or the full amount for an Unternehmergesellschaft). All managers (Geschäftsführer) must sign the registration with certified signatures.
requiredDocuments: Registration form containing: company name, seat, domestic business address, names/first names/dates of birth/residence of all managers, representation rules of managers, and manager declarations that no legal appointment obstacles exist, they have been informed of their unlimited disclosure obligation, contributions to business shares have been made as required and are at their free disposal
Articles of association
Proof of appointment of managers (in articles or by separate shareholder resolution)

Shareholder list signed by all managers containing: surnames, first names, dates of birth and residence of shareholders, or company name, seat, competent register court and registration number if shareholder is a legal entity; numbered business shares with nominal amounts to be paid and respective percentage stake in share capital; total percentage of share capital if a shareholder holds multiple shares
fees: €150.00 for registration of a GmbH; €240.00 if non-cash contributions are included; plus a provision fee equal to 1/3 of the registration costs.

If you only conduct pure asset management or operate a small business, you may register voluntarily. All partner signatures on the registration must be notarially certified, and the registration document must be submitted electronically by the notary to the court.

Business purpose (Unternehmensgegenstand)

Application deadlines vary by reason: for failed examinations, apply immediately upon receipt of the notice; for special reasons, apply in time before the training contract expires; for parental leave, apply by the time training resumes at the latest.

name: Exception Permit for Registration in the Craft Register as an EU/EEA Citizen or Swiss National
description: An exception permit that allows EU, EEA, or Swiss citizens with relevant professional experience to register in the craft register without the standard training qualification.
eligibility: You must be a citizen of an EU member state, EEA state, or Switzerland. You must demonstrate professional experience as a self-employed person or business manager through one of the following: (1) at least six years continuous activity, ending no more than ten years before application; (2) at least three years continuous activity after completing at least three years of training in the trade; (3) at least four years continuous activity after completing at least two years of training, ending no more than ten years before application; (4) at least three years continuous self-employment plus at least five years as an employee; (5) at least five years in a management position with at least three years in technical responsibilities leading a department, after completing at least three years of training (does not apply to hairdressing). The activity must fall within a regulated craft trade listed in Schedule A of the Craft Regulation, but permits cannot be issued for opticians, hearing aid acousticians, orthopaedic technicians, orthopaedic shoemakers, dental technicians, or chimney sweeps.
requiredDocuments: Application form for exception permit
Personal identification document (identity card, passport, residence confirmation, residence permit, or equivalent)
EU certificate from the competent authority of your home country documenting the nature and duration of your professional activity

name: Craft Business - Authorization to Practice as Experienced Journeyman (Old Journeyman Rule)
description: This service grants authorization to operate a regulated craft trade based on professional experience and qualifications rather than master certification.
eligibility: You must have: (1) Passed a journeyman examination or equivalent final examination in the regulated craft trade listed in Appendix A or a related craft according to the Crafts Code; (2) Proof of a total of 6 years of work experience (after passing the journeyman examination) in the regulated craft trade listed in Appendix A or a related craft according to the Crafts Code; (3) Proof of managerial/leadership activity for at least 4 years, where leadership activity means having independent and permanent decision-making authority in an enterprise or essential parts of an enterprise; (4) Proof of business management, commercial, and legal knowledge; (5) Technical expertise in the regulated craft. Authorization under § 7b HwO can be demonstrated through work certificates, job descriptions, or other means. Documentation must clearly show the leadership activity and specific scope of duties and responsibilities. If business management, commercial, and legal knowledge cannot be demonstrated through professional experience, the required knowledge and skills must be evidenced through participation in appropriate courses or other means.
requiredDocuments: Application for authorization to practice pursuant to § 7b HwO
Identity verification — identity card or other official identity document with photograph
Proof of technical expertise in the craft for which authorization is requested, for example through training certificates, continuing education documents, work references, or similar documentation

You must demonstrate master-equivalent knowledge and skills in the new trade through submitted training certificates, work references, and other qualifications. If these documents are insufficient, you may take a competency examination (Sachkundeprüfung) administered by the competent Chamber of Skilled Trades; you bear the costs of this examination.

description: This service registers a vocational training contract for an apprenticeship in the trades sector with the Berlin Chamber of Crafts, subject to the employer's eligibility and compliance with legal requirements.

The training facility must be suitable in nature and equipment for vocational training, and the number of apprentices must be in appropriate proportion to the number of qualified professionals employed. The training facility must be located in the Berlin Chamber of Crafts district and be 100% assigned to the trades sector and/or train a trades profession. The vocational training contract must comply with legal regulations and the training ordinance. Apprentices under 18 years of age require an initial medical examination.

Trainer form (Ausbilderbogen) - if a new trainer is appointed, the trainer form and proof of training authorization must be attached

name: Registration in the Craftsperson's Roll

eligibility: You can be registered in the Craftsperson's Roll if you or your business manager has successfully passed the master examination in a regulated trade that matches the trade you wish to practice or in a related regulated trade. name: Craft Trade — Exemption permit for registration in the Craftsmen's Register as a German with master-equivalent qualifications
description: This service allows qualified individuals to register as a craft business operator in Berlin without a master's examination by obtaining an exemption permit based on demonstrated master-equivalent knowledge and skills.
eligibility: An exemption permit may be granted if you can demonstrate that taking the master's examination would be unreasonable for your circumstances. Examples include: particularly long-term work experience, possession of other qualifications, lengthy waiting times for master examinations, or pursuit of a specialized trade. Time or money constraints and work overload are not typically valid reasons. For a limited-term exemption permit, examples include unforeseen necessity of business takeover. You must demonstrate master-equivalent knowledge and skills in the relevant craft trade as well as sufficient commercial and legal knowledge. If these cannot be sufficiently proven through training certificates, work references, and other documents, you may take a specialist knowledge examination (Sachkundeprüfung) at your own expense.

eligibility: You must hold a state-recognized foreign professional qualification in a craft trade; you intend to work in that craft trade in Berlin; all documents must be presented in German with translations by officially appointed or authorized translators; for online applications, you must register and log in using your BundID account (basic registration with username and password is sufficient).

Identity document (e.g., passport, European ID card, or convention passport; if not issued in German, include German translation; must show name, first name, place of birth, and date of birth in Latin characters; should include photo and signature)
Curriculum vitae or resume in German, listing training programs (vocational, academic, or school-based), further education, and previous employment

Professional qualification certificates (e.g., examination and final certificates, professional certificate, diploma, bachelor and/or master certificates, or comparable documents; if available, include documents on training content and duration such as Diploma Supplement, Transcript of Records, Relevé de Notes, study book, examination regulations, or comparable documents; German translations required if originals are not in German)

Proof of professional experience (certification of type and duration of relevant professional practice, such as employment references, work books, professional further education, or comparable documents; German translations required if originals are not in German)

Certificate from training country (if applicable: if the profession is regulated in your training country, a certificate from the competent authority that you are authorized to practice the profession there; German translation required if not issued in German)

Proof of name change (if applicable: if your first or last name differs from the name on your professional qualification certificate, provide official documentation of the name change, such as birth certificate, marriage certificate, naturalization notice, or other appropriate evidence; German translation required if not issued in German)

Declaration or documentation regarding previous equivalence applications (if applicable: declaration that you have not previously submitted an equivalence application, or if applicable, documents from previous applications to other competent authorities)
fees: Typically up to approximately 600.00 euros; the specific costs depend on the processing effort and will be communicated in the fee notice, payable immediately upon notification. Additional costs may apply for translations or certification of documents, which vary individually.
processingTime: Approximately 3 months, provided all documents are complete.

bookingInfo.office: The Berlin Chamber of Crafts (Handwerkskammer Berlin) is responsible for determining equivalence in non-regulated craft trades or craft-like trades for intended work in Berlin. The Chamber provides consultation before application submission, identifies the appropriate craft profession for you, and informs you which documents must be submitted as originals or as certified or simple copies with German translations.

name: Craft Trade - Determine Equivalence of Foreign Professional Qualifications in Non-Licensed Craft Trades or Craft-Like Businesses
description: This service evaluates whether your foreign craft training qualifications are equivalent to German craft trade standards for working in a non-licensed craft trade in Berlin.
eligibility: You must have a state-recognized professional craft qualification from abroad; you intend to work in Berlin in the corresponding craft trade; all documents must be submitted in German language with translations by publicly appointed or authorized translators; for online applications, you must register or log in with a BundID account (basic registration with username and password is sufficient).
requiredDocuments: Application for determination of equivalence between foreign professional qualification and German reference craft trade (can be submitted online or by post)

Identity document such as passport, European ID card, or convention passport with German translation if not originally issued in German; document must show name, first name, place of birth, date of birth in Latin characters and include your photograph and signature
Curriculum vitae (CV) in German providing a tabular overview of your training courses (vocational, academic, or school-based), further training, and previous employment
fees: Usually up to approximately 600.00 euros; the Handwerkskammer (Chamber of Crafts) will inform you of the actual costs, which depend on processing effort and are due immediately upon notification of the fee notice; additional costs may apply for translations or certifications of your documents, which vary individually.
processingTime: Approximately 3 months, provided all documents are complete.

bookingInfo.office: Handwerkskammer Berlin (Berlin Chamber of Crafts) is the responsible office for equivalence determination in non-licensed craft trades or craft-like businesses for work intended in Berlin. The Chamber provides consultation before application submission and helps identify the appropriate craft profession. The Chamber will inform you which documents must be submitted as originals or as certified or simple copies with German translation.

name: Craft Trade – Establishing Equivalence of Foreign Professional Qualifications in Licensed Trades (Journeyman Examination)
description: This service assesses whether your foreign craft trade qualification is equivalent to the German reference profession for licensed trades in Berlin.
eligibility: You must have completed formal craft trade training abroad; you intend to work in the corresponding craft trade in Berlin; all documents must be submitted in German language with translations by publicly appointed or authorized translators; for online application, you must register or log in with a BundID account (basic registration with username and password is sufficient).
requiredDocuments: Application for establishing equivalence between foreign professional qualification and German reference profession (online or by post)

Identity document (e.g., passport, European ID card, or convention passport; if not in German, include certified German translation; must show name, first name, birthplace, date of birth in Latin characters; should include photo and signature)
Curriculum Vitae (CV) or Résumé in German, providing tabular overview of training courses, further education, and previous employment

Professional qualification certificates (e.g., examination and completion certificates, professional credential, diploma, bachelor and/or master certificates, master craftsman credential, or comparable documents; also include documentation of content and duration of training if available, such as Diploma Supplement, transcripts, Transcript of Records, diploma attachments, Relevé de Notes, study book, examination regulations, annual certificates, subject and grade summaries, or comparable documents; include German translation if not originally in German)

Proof of professional experience (certification of type and duration of relevant professional practice, such as employment certificates, employment books, professional further education, or comparable documents; include German translation if not originally in German)

Optional: Certificate from training country (if the profession is regulated in your training country, a certificate from the competent authority confirming you are authorized to practice the profession; include German translation if not originally in German)

Optional: Proof of name change (if your first or last name differs from the name on your professional qualification certificate due to marriage, naturalization, gender change, or similar reasons, provide an official document evidencing the name change, such as birth certificate, marriage certificate, naturalization notice, or other suitable proof; include German translation if not originally in German)

Optional: Declaration or documentation regarding previous equivalence applications (a declaration that you have not previously submitted an equivalence application, or if applicable, documents from any previous equivalence applications submitted to other competent authorities)
fees: Usually up to approximately 600 euros; the exact costs depend on processing effort and are due immediately upon receipt of the fee notice from the Chamber of Crafts; additional costs may apply for translations or certification of documents, which vary individually.
processingTime: Approximately 3 months, provided all documents are submitted completely.

bookingInfo.office: For establishing equivalence in licensed crafts with intended work activity in Berlin, the Chamber of Crafts Berlin (Handwerkskammer Berlin) is responsible. The Chamber provides consultation before application submission and identifies the appropriate craft profession for you. The Chamber will inform you which documents must be submitted as originals, certified copies, or simple copies.

name: Determining Equivalence of Foreign Professional Qualifications in Licensed Skilled Trades (Master Craftsman Examination)
description: This service assesses whether your foreign skilled trade qualification is equivalent to the German standard for practicing a regulated trade in Berlin.
eligibility: You must have formal vocational training in a skilled trade from abroad; you must intend to work in the corresponding trade in Berlin; all documents must be submitted in German language with translations by publicly appointed or authorized translators; for online application, you must register or log in with your BundID account (basic registration with username and password is sufficient).
requiredDocuments: Application for determining equivalence between foreign professional qualification and German reference occupation (online or by postal mail)

Identity document (e.g., passport, European ID card, or convention passport) with readable information in Latin characters including name, surname, place of birth, and date of birth, plus German translation if not originally issued in German
Curriculum vitae (CV) in German covering training courses, further education, and previous employment

Professional qualification certificates and documentation (e.g., exam certificates, diplomas, bachelor's/master's degrees, master craftsman certificates, or comparable documents, plus supporting materials such as Diploma Supplement, transcripts, course descriptions, or comparable documents) with German translation if not originally issued in German

Evidence of professional experience (e.g., employment certificates, employment records, professional continuing education, or comparable documents) with German translation if not originally issued in German

Certification from the training country (if the profession is regulated in your country of training) confirming you are authorized to practice the profession there, with German translation if not originally issued in German

Proof of name change (if applicable), such as birth certificate, marriage certificate, naturalization notice, or comparable document showing the name change, with German translation if not originally issued in German
Statement or evidence regarding any previous applications for equivalence determination
fees: Typically up to approximately €600.00; the Handwerkskammer (Chamber of Crafts) will inform you of the exact costs, which depend on processing effort and are due upon receipt of the fee notice; additional costs may apply for translations and certifications of your documents, which vary individually.
processingTime: Approximately 3 months, provided all documents are complete.

bookingInfo.office: For equivalence determination in licensed skilled trades with intended employment in Berlin, the Handwerkskammer Berlin (Berlin Chamber of Crafts) is responsible; they provide consultation before application submission and help identify the appropriate skilled trade profession for you.

name: Request Deletion from the Craftsmen Register, Register of Non-Licensed Trades, or Register of Trade-Like Businesses
description: This service allows registered craftspeople to request removal of their business from the Chamber of Crafts registers when they cease operations.
eligibility: You are registered in the Craftsmen Register (Handwerksrolle), the Register of Non-Licensed Crafts, or the Register of Trade-Like Businesses with the Chamber of Crafts.
requiredDocuments: Application for deletion (note: deletion can take effect no earlier than the date the business cessation becomes known to the Chamber via postal receipt; retroactive deletion is not possible for legal reasons)

Trade deregistration confirmation from the responsible trade/regulatory office (if applicable — please include a copy of the confirmed business deregistration, if you are ceasing your business entirely)
Return of original Craftsmen or Trade Card in original form (personal appearance is not required)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: For businesses located in the Berlin Chamber of Crafts district, submit the request to: Handwerkskammer Berlin. Note: Deregistering your business with the trade office alone does not automatically result in deletion from the Chamber of Crafts registers.

name: Trades — Register New Business Management with the Craft Chamber
description: Register a new business manager at the craft chamber for a skilled trade business, requiring appropriate professional qualifications and full-time employment.
eligibility: Master craftsman certificate (Meisterbrief) for the relevant trade, or equivalent foreign or domestic professional qualification (such as engineer or industrial technician degrees), or alternatively an exemption permit or authorization to practice; full-time employment in the craft business. The business management must be available to the company to the same extent as a master craftsman owner to fulfill their functions, which typically means continuous full-time employment.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration/change/extension in the register of regulated or unregulated trades and trade-like businesses
Proof of qualification, for example master craftsman certificate, authorization to practice, exemption permit, or technician certificate
Old craft card (Alte Handwerkskarte)

Employment contract if applicable, demonstrating that business management is available to the company during normal working hours with working hours and salary according to collective bargaining agreement or industry practice; or alternatively business manager declaration (Betriebsleitererklärung) if the manager is also the technical operations manager and holds at least 30% stake as a shareholder
Current registration certificate (Meldebescheinigung), not older than three months
Form: Attachment A — Business Manager Declaration (Anlage A: Betriebsleitererklärung)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Trades – Individual Information from the Trades Register
description: This service provides individual information from the trades register, the list of trades not requiring authorization, and the list of trades-like businesses for those with a legitimate economic interest.
eligibility: Applicants must have a legitimate economic interest in obtaining the information, such as suppliers wanting to know a business owner or private individuals seeking details about a business before awarding a contract. Information will be provided unless there are overriding privacy concerns. The information recipient may only use the data for the stated purpose of their application.
requiredDocuments: Application for individual information under § 6 para. 2 HwO (must be submitted in text form to the competent Chamber of Crafts; must include details of the applicant, the business information (address, name) for which information is requested, and credible evidence of the applicant's legitimate interest; verbal applications are not permitted)
Identity document (presentation of ID card, passport with registration confirmation, residence permit, or comparable identity documents)
fees: 10.00 EUR per information request; fees apply even if the requested trades business cannot be found (negative information)
processingTime: Approximately 1 week

bookingInfo.office: For trades businesses with a place of business in Berlin, the application must be submitted to the competent Chamber of Crafts Berlin.

name: Residential and Neighborhood Noise Complaints
description: A service that allows residents to file complaints about noise disturbances from neighbors or residential activities without any prerequisites.
eligibility: No prerequisites required
processingTime: 4 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The service can be accessed at the locally responsible public order office (Ordnungamt) in your district.

name: Monitoring of House Wells and Small Water Works
description: This service oversees the monitoring and testing of private house wells and small water supply systems to ensure water safety and quality.
eligibility: Sample collection must be performed by an authorized testing facility (laboratory).
fees: No fee; reporting of test results to the health authority
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the health authority (Gesundheitsamt) in the district where the water supply system is located.

name: Illegal Waste Disposal (Hausmüll)
description: This service handles the reporting and removal of illegally dumped waste in public spaces.
eligibility: Report of illegal waste (by phone, in writing, or electronically)
requiredDocuments: Complaint containing the following information: location and time
volume
cause/responsible party (if known)
personal details of the reporting party
fees: Free of charge (may be chargeable to the responsible party if identified)
processingTime: Up to 7 days for public street land

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Assistance with Homelessness or Risk of Homelessness
description: This service provides support for people who are homeless or at risk of losing their housing.
eligibility: You are homeless or at risk of losing your housing soon if you do not receive assistance.
requiredDocuments: Application for social assistance (Sozialhilfe) with attachments
Identification document, such as a national ID card, passport, or residence permit
Proof of last residence, such as a national ID card or registration certificate
Proof of current income, such as wage statements
Official notices from employment office, job center, social office, refugee affairs office, health insurance, or pension provider
Wage statements or salary slips
Proof of assets, such as bank statements, valuable items (car, jewelry, etc.), savings contracts (Bausparverträge), life insurance, or private pension insurance
Proof of existing debts, such as bank statements, payment reminders, or installment payment agreements

Rental contract and documents related to housing, such as notices of rent changes, rental account statements, payment reminders, eviction notices, notices of eviction lawsuits, notices of forced eviction, utility company payment reminders, or notices that electricity will be disconnected
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The locally competent office is typically the Social Welfare Office (Amt für Soziales) in the district where the person seeking assistance resides. For people without a fixed residence or registration address in Berlin, special regulations apply (see the regulations on local jurisdiction for social assistance benefits). People without a residence permit or in ongoing asylum proceedings should contact the State Office for Refugee Affairs (Landesamt für Flüchtlingsangelegenheiten).

name: Request Help with Subsistence Living Costs
description: A social assistance benefit for individuals whose income and assets are insufficient to cover living expenses and who do not qualify for other primary social benefits.
eligibility: You have no entitlement to priority benefits, including basic security benefits for elderly and permanently disabled persons (Chapter 4, Book XII of the German Social Code), basic security benefits (social money) under Book II of the German Social Code, or benefits under the Asylum Seekers' Benefits Act. Additionally, you must not be receiving an early pension or have reached retirement age (which begins between 65 and 67 years depending on birth year) and must not have temporary full work disability certified by a pension provider. Your income and assets must be insufficient to cover living expenses.
requiredDocuments: Application for social assistance with attachments
Valid identity documents, where applicable confirmation of registration
Documentation of temporary work disability
Income records

Asset documentation, for example for savings plans (life insurance, savings and loan insurance, Riester pension contracts, burial insurance, funeral provision, and similar), savings accounts, real estate, property, valuables, vehicles
Bank statements
Rental contract, where applicable notice of rent changes
Documentation of health and long-term care insurance
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service is available at the district office (Bezirksamt) of your residential district.

name: Subsistence assistance for minors in relative care
description: Financial assistance for minors under 15 years old who are living outside their parents' household with relatives and whose income and assets are insufficient to cover their living expenses.
eligibility: Minor up to completion of 15th year of life; accommodation outside parental household; no child-rearing assistance from youth office; low income and low assets of the child — income and assets insufficient to cover living expenses.
requiredDocuments: Application for social assistance with attachments
Valid identity documents
Birth certificate
Residence confirmation
Power of attorney from parents or guardians for personal care
Statement from youth office confirming whether child-rearing assistance under German Social Code Book Eight (SGB VIII) is required
Income documentation for the child (child allowance, orphan's pension, half-orphan's pension, maintenance, maintenance advance, or other income)

Asset documentation for the child (for example: capital-building insurance such as life insurance, building savings insurance, Riester pension contracts and similar; savings accounts; real estate; properties; valuables)
Bank statements of the child
Documentation of health insurance and long-term care insurance for the child
Rental contract and any rental modification notices
Permission for full-time foster care from youth office (not required for: grandparents, great-grandparents, siblings, aunts, uncles, nieces, nephews)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service can be requested in the residential district (Wohnbezirk) of the minor child.

name: Childcare Education - Group Care Education Assistance
description: This service provides educational support for families through group care programs, administered by the youth welfare office following an application and assistance plan.
eligibility: The youth welfare office grants educational assistance to the family following a prior application and creation of an assistance plan. The family must be willing to participate in achieving the goals jointly developed in the assistance plan.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Assistance with Child-Rearing — Educational Support Worker/Supervision Assistant
description: Support service provided by the youth welfare office to families with children who need educational guidance and behavioral support through an assigned support worker.
eligibility: The youth welfare office provides assistance with child-rearing to families following a formal application and creation of a support plan. The family must be willing to cooperate and work toward the goals established in the support plan.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.
