Application and creation of an appropriate help plan
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Social pedagogical family help can be requested at the Youth Office (Jugendamt) of your residential district and will be provided during consultation.

name: Help with Parenting - Sociopedagogical Family Support
description: The Youth Office provides educational support to families through sociopedagogical family assistance following an application and the creation of a support plan.
eligibility: The Youth Office provides assistance with parenting (Hilfe zur Erziehung) for the family following a prior application and creation of a support plan. The family must be willing to cooperate in achieving the goals jointly developed in the support plan.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Long-term Care Assistance
description: This service provides financial assistance for long-term care costs for eligible individuals with care needs starting at care level 2, provided they lack sufficient financial resources after exhausting other support options.
eligibility: You have a care need (Pflegegrad) of level 2 or higher. For care level 1, eligibility for relief benefits, care aids, and living environment improvements is assessed individually. You do not have sufficient financial means to cover necessary care costs after exhausting all other available support options, such as benefits from long-term care insurance (Pflegeversicherung).
requiredDocuments: Application for Long-term Care Assistance (Social Welfare) — submit in writing by post or online for outpatient care only; online submissions must be between 100–150 dpi, in JPG, JPEG, PNG, or PDF format, with individual file size max 3 MB and total max 85 MB
Valid identity document (e.g., identity card, EU citizen card, electronic residence permit, or passport with registration confirmation)
Proof of residence status for non-German citizens
Power of attorney or guardianship certificate (if applicable)
Care level determination notice from your long-term care insurance fund
Medical assessment report from the Medical Service of Long-term Care Insurance
Medical records (if available)
Disability determination notice and severe disability certificate (if applicable)
Proof of health and long-term care insurance
Income statements
Asset documentation (e.g., life insurance, building savings contracts, Riester pension contracts, funeral insurance, savings accounts, real estate, valuables, vehicles, etc.)
Bank statements
Information about family members obligated to provide support
Rental agreement and any rental modification notices
Care facility agreement or nursing care contract (if applicable)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: For outpatient care in your own home or shared housing: the Social Welfare Office (Amt für Soziales) responsible for your current residence. For care in a residential facility: the Social Welfare Office of the district where you lived before admission to the facility. If your previous residence was outside Berlin, the Social Welfare Office at your previous address remains responsible.

name: Help Overcoming Special Social Difficulties
description: Financial and social assistance for adults facing particular life circumstances with social difficulties that they cannot manage on their own.
eligibility: Must be 18 years or older. Service is for persons whose particular life circumstances are connected with social difficulties and who cannot overcome these difficulties through their own resources. Special life circumstances include: lack of or insufficient housing, unsecured economic foundation for living, violence-affected living conditions, release from a closed institution, or comparable disadvantageous circumstances.
requiredDocuments: Application for social assistance
Valid personal identification documents and, if applicable, proof of residence registration
Documentation regarding the special life circumstances, which may include income and asset verification depending on the individual case
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The locally responsible office is generally the Department for Social Affairs (Amt für Soziales) in the district where the person seeking help resides. Special regulations apply for persons without a fixed place of residence or registration address in Berlin (see implementation directive in the 'Legal Basis' section).

name: Request for Assistance with Household Maintenance
description: This service provides financial assistance to help maintain your own household when no one living there is able to manage it.
eligibility: There is no entitlement from other primary benefit providers (such as health and nursing insurance funds); You have your own household that you wish to continue; No one in the household is able to manage it; In the case of care needs, these must not exceed care level 1.
requiredDocuments: Application for social assistance with attachments
Valid personal identification documents and registration confirmation if applicable
Care insurance decision if available, or assessment by the Medical Service of Health Insurance Funds if available
Medical records if available
Decision from the Welfare Office regarding determination of disability level and severely disabled ID card if applicable
Evidence of health and nursing insurance coverage
Denial notice from health or nursing insurance including reasoning
Income documentation

Asset documentation, such as capital-building insurance (life insurance, building savings contracts, Riester pension contracts, burial insurance, funeral provisions and similar), savings accounts, real estate, property, valuables, vehicles
Bank statements
Rental agreement or notice of rent change if applicable
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Assistance for Adults with Mental Illness, Addiction Disorder, or Intellectual Disability
description: This service provides support and assistance for adults living with mental illness, addiction disorders, or intellectual disabilities in Berlin.
eligibility: None
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service can be accessed at the district office (Bezirksamt) of the district where the person resides.

name: Assistance for Adults with Primarily Physical Disabilities or Chronic Illnesses
description: This service provides support and assistance for adults who have primarily physical disabilities or chronic illnesses.
eligibility: No eligibility requirements.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Health Assistance (Hilfen zur Gesundheit)
description: Financial assistance to help cover health insurance costs for residents without adequate statutory or private health insurance coverage and unable to afford the necessary health services from their own income and assets.
eligibility: Lack of adequate health insurance: No statutory or sufficient private health insurance exists; Financial hardship: Obtaining funds for the required health assistance cannot reasonably be expected from income and assets.
requiredDocuments: Application for Social Assistance (Sozialhilfe) with attachments
Proof of previous health insurance provider
Valid personal identification documents; residence confirmation if applicable
Income documentation
Rental contract; rental change notice if applicable
Asset documentation (e.g., life insurance, savings plans, Riester pension contracts, burial insurance and similar), savings accounts, property, real estate, valuables, vehicles
Bank statements
The scope of required documents, particularly income and asset documentation, depends on the individual circumstances of each case
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service can be accessed at the Social Services Office (Amt für Soziales) of your residential district.

name: Request a Historic License Plate
description: This service allows you to register a historic license plate for a vehicle that was first registered at least 30 years ago.
eligibility: The vehicle's first registration must have taken place at least 30 years ago.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration (not required if the vehicle is already registered)
Passport or identity card with residence confirmation (or officially certified copy)
Power of attorney if applicable, including identity documents of the grantor and agent, unless it is a notarized power of attorney (in which case the grantor's identity document is not needed)
Extract from the Commercial Register and business registration in original or certified copy, plus identity documents of the authorized representative (for businesses)
Extract from the Association Register in original or certified copy, plus identity documents of the authorized representative (for associations)
Written consent and identity card of both parents/guardians (for minor vehicle holders)
SEPA direct debit mandate (not required if the vehicle is already registered)
Previous license plate(s)
Electronic insurance confirmation
Vehicle registration certificate Part II (Fahrzeugbrief)
Vehicle registration certificate Part I (Fahrzeugschein)
Expert report according to § 23 StVZO
fees: Starting at €31.80 according to the current fee schedule for road traffic measures, though the fee may be higher depending on the specific application. The manufacture of license plates is not a service provided by the Berlin motor vehicle registration authority, and no information can be provided about additional costs for plates.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details. Additional appointments are released daily as capacity allows; regular checking of the appointment platform is recommended.

bookingInfo.office: Berlin Motor Vehicle Registration Authority (Kfz-Zulassungsbehörde Berlin)

name: Height Control Points - Request Information
description: A service to request information about height control points (geodetic reference points) from Berlin's surveying office.
eligibility: Email address required. For free information via the 'Geobasisdaten online' portal, you need a personal account.
requiredDocuments: Application for information from the height control point field (can be submitted online)
fees: Free for online information via 'Geobasisdaten Online' portal; 10.40 euros for written information for the first point; 3.30 euros for written information for each additional point; 16.00 euros for written information for the control point overview per page of the first copy
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the Surveying Office (Vermessungsamt) in the district where the measurement is to be conducted.

name: Honorary Financial Investment Advisor - Request Permission
description: This service allows you to apply for permission to work as a honorary financial investment advisor (Honorar-Finanzanlagenberater) under German trade regulations.
eligibility: You must demonstrate: (1) personal reliability, verified through a certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) from the Federal Criminal Register and a certificate from the Commercial Register (not required if you already hold a Financial Investment Intermediary license); (2) orderly financial circumstances, checked for debts and insolvency proceedings (not required if you already hold a Financial Investment Intermediary license); (3) sufficient professional liability insurance; (4) proof of passing the expertise examination (Sachkundeprüfung) before a Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) or equivalent recognized professional qualification; (5) a BundID account for online application.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission under § 34h of the Trade Regulation Act (Gewerbeordnung) for Honorary Financial Investment Advisor — online submission available or use the form
Personal ID document: national ID card or other official photo identification (not required for electronic submission); residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen

Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) for submission to authorities — issued by Federal Criminal Register, not older than three months, request from your local resident registration office or online via Federal Ministry of Justice

Commercial Register excerpt (Gewerbezentralregisterauszug) for submission to authorities — issued by Commercial Register, not older than three months, request from your local resident registration office or online via Federal Ministry of Justice
Information from the debtor register (Schuldnerverzeichnis) — request online via the Central Enforcement Portal (Zentrales Vollstreckungsportal)

Information from the insolvency register — for natural persons in Berlin: two certificates required (one from local court for consumer insolvency, one from Berlin Regional Court Charlottenburg for regular insolvency); for legal entities and partnerships in Berlin: from Berlin Regional Court Charlottenburg; applicants outside Berlin should check the central directory of courts
Proof of expertise: IHK expertise examination certificate (Sachkundeprüfungsnachweis) or equivalent recognized professional qualification
Professional liability insurance confirmation — from an insurance company confirming professional liability insurance for honorary financial investment advisory, not older than three months
Current commercial register excerpt — required for registered businesses; for legal entities in formation (GmbH, AG), submit articles of association or bylaws
processingTime: Approximately 1 month

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for your business location. If your business location is not yet known, you may submit the application to the regulatory office responsible for your place of residence.

name: Fee-Based Financial Investment Adviser — Register for Expert Knowledge Examination
description: This service allows you to register for the expert knowledge examination required to become a certified fee-based financial investment adviser.
eligibility: You must appear in person for the examinations. The registration deadline is generally 28 days before the respective examination date.
requiredDocuments: Online registration through the IHK Berlin registration portal
Photo identification document for identification during the examination
fees: 205.00 Euro to 395.00 Euro depending on examination format or scope
processingTime: You will normally receive the certificate within a few days after passing the examination.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Hearing Diagnostics for Children and Adolescents with Suspected Hearing Disorders and Family Counseling
description: This service provides hearing diagnostics for children and adolescents suspected of having hearing disorders, along with counseling and support for families with hearing-impaired children.
eligibility: Appointment scheduling only after telephone consultation; children and adolescents between 0 and 18 years old
requiredDocuments: Yellow U-Heft preventive health booklet of the child
Medical findings and important information about the child's medical history
Therapeutic or school reports
Severely disabled person ID card if already available
Hearing aids if already available
fees: No fees; services provided without a referral letter and without a health insurance card
processingTime: Dependent on the specific question, approximately 1 to 3 hours

bookingInfo.office: We operate across district boundaries!

name: Dog Ownership — Request Dog Tax Exemption or Report Non-Taxable Dog Ownership
description: Apply for an exemption from dog tax in Berlin or report that your dog is not subject to dog tax, based on specific eligibility criteria such as guide dogs, shelter dogs, or social benefit recipient status.
eligibility: You must have registered your dog in the dog registry or directly with your tax office. For tax exemption: tax exemption grounds must apply to you or your dog, including: guide dog for the blind; dog for supporting certain persons (exclusively and necessarily serving protection and assistance to blind, deaf, or other disabled persons); dog in training as a service, rescue, or guide dog; dog that has passed service or rescue dog certification and is available for public protection; dog from a shelter or similar animal welfare facility (exempt for five calendar years); or receipt of certain social benefits (citizen's allowance, education and participation benefits, living assistance, basic security in old age or reduced earning capacity, asylum seeker benefits, or pensions for age, reduced earning capacity, or death under the German Social Code). For reporting non-taxable ownership: dog held by a legal entity (such as an association) or held for income purposes with dog-keeping expenses deducted as business expenses or advertising costs. For online application: registration/login on the ELSTER portal is required.
requiredDocuments: Application for Dog Tax Exemption or Report of Non-Taxable Dog Ownership (available online or as a paper form; paper form must be signed if submitted by mail or in person)
Supporting documents relevant to your exemption claim (such as pension notice, employment agency notice, dog training certificate, disability certificate, shelter adoption contract, etc.)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Dog Ownership - Exemption from Leash Requirement
description: This service allows dog owners to obtain an exemption from the mandatory leash requirement in Berlin if they meet specific eligibility criteria including pet liability insurance, microchip identification, and proof of competence.
eligibility: Pet liability insurance: You must provide proof of sufficient pet liability insurance via insurance policy. This requirement applies even to dogs held outside Berlin but led in Berlin. Microchip identification: Dogs that have completed their third month of life must be equipped with a tamper-proof identification. Dog owners bear the cost. The chip/identification number always consists of a 15-digit numeric code. Competence in dog handling: You must have theoretical knowledge and practical skills in keeping and handling a dog. Residence: While dog handlers living outside Berlin may also apply for an exemption, the application must be submitted to the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) in the district where the dog is most frequently led.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from leash requirement (available upon request from your responsible authority)
Information about the dog: breed/mix, microchip number, date of birth, withers height in cm (measured laterally on a standing dog, from ground to the highest point of the shoulder blade)

Proof of competence in dog handling (one of the following): Dog owners who have continuously and without objection held a dog for 3 years in the past 5 years must provide: dog tax certificate and written declaration of objection-free dog keeping, plus presentation of the dog to the authority after application to verify the microchip number; OR persons who have successfully passed the competence test per § 7 HundeG Berlin (or equivalent test) must provide: competence certificate (theoretical and practical) issued by an authorized expert (can be submitted later); OR persons whose competence has been recognized by another authority must provide: competence recognition notice and any certificate of test results; OR veterinarians, service dog handlers, hunting dog handlers, holders of permits to train dogs for protection purposes or to train dogs or guide their holders, holders of permits for commercial breeding or keeping of dogs must provide: appropriate documentation such as professional credentials, proof of passed tests, dog identification card

Current photograph of the dog owner or keeper: clear, recent photo without border (frontal, without hat or eye covering) to be affixed to the competence certificate for identification purposes; the certificate is personal and non-transferable

Behavioral assessment (for listed dog breeds): proof of a behavioral assessment issued by an authorized expert, confirming that off-leash behavior was tested (indicated by a mark under 'Recommendation for further keeping and handling of the dog' on the assessment certificate); can be submitted later
fees: 61.50 EUR minimum: issuance of competence certificate (for competence verified over years or competence recognized by another federal state); 41.00 EUR minimum: issuance of competence certificate (after competence test, for certain professions or with permit); 15.00 EUR: replacement certificate; 20.50 EUR per quarter-hour of processing time, maximum 246.00 EUR: issuance of competence certificate for listed dog breeds
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Dog handlers not residing in Berlin must submit the application to the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) in the district where the dog is most frequently led.

name: Dog Ownership - Exemption from Muzzle Requirement for Medical Reasons
description: This service allows dog owners to request an exemption from the mandatory muzzle requirement if their dog has a medical condition that causes particular suffering under the muzzle, provided the dog poses no danger to the public.
eligibility: The dog must have a documented medical condition that causes particular suffering under the muzzle requirement. The dog must pose no danger to the surrounding area or public; the risk posed by the dog must not be greater than the medical suffering caused by the muzzle requirement.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from muzzle requirement for medical reasons (available upon request from your responsible local authority)
Dog information: breed/crossbreed and chip number
Information about the veterinarian

Veterinary certificate: a statement from a practicing veterinarian confirming that the dog suffers particularly under the muzzle requirement due to a named medical condition and should therefore be exempted; the certificate should be no more than one month old at the time of application

Additional official veterinary assessment if needed: in unclear or critical cases (for example, if incidents are documented), an additional assessment by an official veterinarian may be required, which involves presenting your dog to the responsible authority at a scheduled appointment
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Dog Ownership - Reporting a Dangerous Dog
description: A service for registering a dangerous dog with the responsible local authority in the district where the dog is kept.
eligibility: The dog owner or permanent keeper must register the dangerous dog with the authority responsible for the location where the dog is kept. The dog must have been brought to Germany legally and must not pose a danger to the surrounding area or display aggressive behavior toward people and animals. The dog must be presented to the authority at the time of registration.
requiredDocuments: Registration form for a dangerous dog (form provided by the authority)
Identity document (national ID card)
Certificate of competency examination (Sachkundeprüfung) — can be submitted later

Certificate of temperament test (Wesentest) — negative certificate confirming the dog does not display excessive fighting drive, aggression, sharpness, or comparable qualities toward people or animals — can be submitted later
Certificate of good conduct (Führungszeugnis) from the Bürgeramt — can be submitted later
Proof of liability insurance (Tierhalterhaftpflichtversicherung) for adequate pet owner liability coverage
fees: 30.00 Euro; additional fees may apply for necessary veterinary measures in individual cases.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The district public order office (Ordnungsamt) in the district where the dog is to be kept.

name: Dog Registration - Register Dog in Dog Registry
description: This service allows dog owners in Berlin to register, deregister, or update their dog information in the central dog registry.
eligibility: You are the owner of a dog; Berlin is the permanent location where the dog is kept; registration must occur immediately when you acquire a dog; deregistration is required when the dog dies, is lost, or ownership ends; updates must be submitted if you move with your dog.
requiredDocuments: Registration, deregistration, or change notification form for the dog registry (available online, in writing, or by phone)
Online processing requires creating an owner account (Microsoft Internet Explorer browser not supported)
Written registration, deregistration, or change notification by mail or email
Telephone registration, deregistration, or change notification
Information about the dog owner (name and address details)
Information about the dog: breed, sex, date of birth
Plakette number for listed dog breeds (if applicable)
Transponder number of the dog (the 15-digit microchip number inserted by a veterinarian, found in EU pet passport)
fees: Free for deregistration and change notifications; €17.50 per dog for online registration; €26.50 per dog for written or telephone registration
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday: 09:00-16:00; Friday: 09:00-13:00

name: Dog Ownership - Tax Deregistration
description: This service allows you to deregister a dog for tax purposes in Berlin when you no longer own or keep a dog in the city.
eligibility: You have ended dog ownership in Berlin. This applies if: the dog has died; you are moving out of Berlin; you have given the dog to someone else; you have surrendered the dog to an animal shelter; the dog has run away and you assume it will not return.
requiredDocuments: Online deregistration via Berlin Dog Registry (Hunderegister Berlin) platform, which simultaneously serves as tax deregistration — no additional deregistration with the tax office is required

Tax deregistration via the tax online platform 'Mein ELSTER' submitted to your tax office (requires one-time registration at Mein ELSTER, or alternatively online identification (eID) via your ID card without registration)
Written deregistration form (available under 'Forms') sent by mail to your tax office with your signature
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks until you receive a new tax assessment notice

bookingInfo.office: Normally: Tax office (Finanzamt) of your place of residence; if the dog was not held by you personally but by an association or business: Tax office in whose area the dog was kept (operating location tax office)

name: Dog Ownership - Register Dog for Taxation
description: A tax registration service for dog owners in Berlin who must register their dog with the appropriate tax office within one month of purchase or relocation.
eligibility: You must be the dog owner or keeper (the dog lives in your household) and hold the dog in your Berlin household. Registration is required even for commercial dog keeping, such as for breeding or as a guard dog. You must register your dog for tax purposes within one month of purchase or moving to Berlin, or within the first four months of life if your dog is younger than three months old.
requiredDocuments: Online registration via Hunderegister Berlin platform (available under 'Further Information')
Alternatively: online registration via 'Mein ELSTER' tax platform (requires one-time registration or use of eID function from your ID card)
Alternatively: written or telephone registration with Hunderegister Berlin
Alternatively: written form 'Registration of a Dog' sent by post to your tax office (must be signed; if registering a dog for the first time, you do not need to enter a tax number)
SEPA direct debit authorization (optional, for automatic tax payment from your account)
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks to receive your tax assessment notice

bookingInfo.office: Normally: tax office (Finanzamt) of your place of residence; if the dog is not kept by you personally but by an association or company: the tax office in whose area the dog is kept (operating location tax office)

name: Hygiene Oversight in Communal and Medical Facilities
description: This service provides hygiene monitoring and supervision for communal and medical facilities in Berlin.
eligibility: None
requiredDocuments: Hygiene plan (if applicable)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the Health Department (Gesundheitsamt) in the district where the facility is located.

name: Noise and Nuisance Complaint – File a Complaint about a Construction Site
description: A service for filing complaints about significant noise, dust, vibration, or other nuisance emissions from construction site activities.
eligibility: Current significant emission (noise, dust, vibration, or other nuisance) originating from construction work at a building site.
requiredDocuments: Your name and address (anonymous complaints are also possible)
Power of attorney with name and address of the person on whose behalf you are filing (if filing for another person)
Name and address of witnesses (if you can name witnesses to support your complaint)
Name and address of the building owner/client (if known)
Name and address of the construction company performing the work, and if possible contact details for the on-site supervisor (if known)
Address of the construction site
Description of the nuisance: what exactly is the disturbance?
Date and time period of the nuisance emission
Description of the work performed and machinery used
Photos of the construction site activity (if available)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Contact by phone Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 11:00. Telephone: (030) 9025-2253. Online complaint submission is also possible.

name: Real Estate Loan Broker - Request Permission
description: This service allows you to apply for official permission to work as a real estate loan broker in Berlin, subject to verification of your reliability, financial situation, insurance coverage, and professional qualifications.
eligibility: You must demonstrate personal reliability (verified through a police clearance certificate and commercial register extract, each not older than three months); orderly financial circumstances (no outstanding debts or known insolvency proceedings); sufficient professional liability insurance; professional qualifications (proof of passed chamber of commerce examination or comparable recognized professional qualification); and for online applications, registration with a BundID account.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission as a real estate loan broker (online or paper form)
Valid personal identification document with photograph (not required for electronic application), or residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen
Police clearance certificate (Führungszeugnis) for presentation to authorities (document type O), not older than three months
Commercial register extract (document type 9) for presentation to authorities, not older than three months
Information from the debtor register (Central Enforcement Portal)

Insolvency register certificate(s): for natural persons resident in Berlin, two certificates are required (one from your local court for consumer insolvency and one from Berlin Regional Court Charlottenburg for standard insolvency); for legal entities and partnerships based in Berlin, obtain from Berlin Regional Court Charlottenburg, Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin
Professional qualification certificate from chamber of commerce or comparable recognized professional qualification
Professional liability insurance confirmation from an insurance company (not older than three months, complying with EU requirements for credit intermediaries)
Current commercial register extract (for registered businesses) or articles of association/bylaws (for businesses in formation)
fees: 90.00 to 1,740.00 euros depending on administrative costs
processingTime: 1 month

bookingInfo.office: The application must be submitted to the Local Authority Office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for your business location. If your business location is not yet known, you may apply to the Local Authority Office responsible for your place of residence.

name: Real Estate Loan Broker - Register for Professional Knowledge Exam
description: This service allows you to register for and take the professional knowledge examination required to work as a real estate loan broker in Berlin.
eligibility: You must appear in person for the exam. You must observe the registration deadline; the exam is offered at a maximum of eight standardized dates nationwide. You may be exempted from the practical exam if you hold a permit as a financial investment broker, fee-based financial investment adviser, insurance broker, or insurance adviser, or if you possess an equivalent professional qualification or degree.
requiredDocuments: Online registration only through the IHK Berlin registration portal
Photo ID for identification during the exam
Proof of exemption from the practical exam, if applicable (see registration form for required documents)
Proof of passing the written exam section, if only retaking the practical exam section
fees: €240.00 for written exam section; €220.00 for practical exam section; €360.00 for both written and practical exam sections
processingTime: You will receive the certificate within 1-2 weeks after the exam.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Permission to operate as real estate agent, developer, construction supervisor, loan broker, or residential property manager
description: This service permits individuals and companies to legally operate as real estate agents, developers, construction supervisors, loan brokers, or residential property managers in Berlin.
eligibility: Personal reliability verified through federal criminal record certificate (Führungszeugnis) and business register certificate; orderly financial circumstances checked for debts and insolvency proceedings; mandatory professional continuing education of 20 hours per three-year period for real estate agents and residential property managers; adequate professional liability insurance; registration with BundID account for online applications.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission (online available or paper form)
Personal ID or official photo identification document (not required for electronic applications); residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen
Federal criminal record certificate for submission to authorities (document type O), not older than three months
Business register extract for submission to authorities (document type 9), not older than three months
Information from debtor registry (Central Enforcement Portal) requested online

Insolvency register information: for natural persons residing in Berlin, two certificates required (one from district court for consumer insolvency, one from District Court Charlottenburg for standard insolvency); for legal entities and partnerships based in Berlin, obtain from District Court Charlottenburg, Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin; for applicants outside Berlin, consult central court registry
Professional liability insurance confirmation for residential property managers, not older than three months
Current commercial register extract (for registered companies) or articles of association/bylaws (for companies in formation)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Apply at the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for your business location; if no business location is yet known, apply at the regulatory office responsible for your residential address.

name: Vaccination Injury — Consultation and Support
description: This service provides consultation and support for individuals who have suffered health damage from a publicly recommended or legally mandated vaccination that has persisted for at least six months.
eligibility: The vaccination was publicly recommended or legally mandated; the health damage has persisted for at least six months. An appointment must be scheduled by email.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the Versorgungsamt (Social Welfare Office) — Customer Service Center. Please schedule an appointment by email: kundencenter-beratung@lageso.berlin.de

name: Vaccine Injury Compensation - Apply for Compensation for Victims of Vaccine Damage
description: This service allows residents to apply for compensation if they have suffered health damage from a publicly recommended or legally mandated vaccination.
eligibility: The vaccination must have been publicly recommended (e.g., by the Federal Ministry of Health or a state health authority, in Berlin: Senate Department for Health, Care and Equality) such as flu vaccination or Corona vaccination, or legally mandated such as measles vaccination for teachers and medical personnel. The health damage or its consequences must have persisted for at least 6 months following the vaccination.
requiredDocuments: Application for benefits (see Forms section)
Vaccination certificate
processingTime: 270 days

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Yellow Fever Vaccination Centre Permit
description: This service grants permission to medical practitioners to operate a yellow fever vaccination centre, subject to tropical medicine training and compliance with specified standards.
eligibility: Applicants must hold medical licensure (Approbation) as an approved physician and have completed further training in tropical medicine. You must also commit to meeting certain standards, including information and training obligations, requirements for handling vaccine, and documentation duties. Additionally, you must have suitable practice premises and a qualified representative with equivalent credentials (also a permit holder).
requiredDocuments: Written application (informal submission)
Proof of further training in tropical medicine
Medical licensure (Approbation)
processingTime: Approximately 1–2 weeks after submission of complete documents and receipt of the fee. Vaccination activities may only commence after the permit is issued and after the applicant has sent a vaccination stamp impression to the authority. The applicant must obtain this seal themselves, and it must meet the requirements specified in the approval notice.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Report Vaccination Side Effects
description: A service for healthcare professionals and facility leaders in Berlin to report adverse effects from vaccinations to the health authority.
eligibility: The reporting person must be required to report (reporting-required persons are physicians and directors of pathological-anatomical diagnostic facilities). The affected person must have their primary residence in Berlin.
requiredDocuments: Form from the Paul Ehrlich Institute for reporting to the health authority by a person required to report according to the Infection Protection Act
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible health authority is the district health office (Gesundheitsamt) of the district in which the affected person has their primary residence.

name: Vaccinations and Infectious Diseases - Consultation
description: This service provides consultation on vaccinations and infectious diseases for residents with no prerequisites required.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
requiredDocuments: Vaccination card (if consultation regarding own vaccination protection is desired)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the Health Department (Gesundheitsamt) of your residential district (principal residence required).

name: Report Infectious Diseases — for Doctors and Laboratories
description: A service for eligible healthcare providers and laboratories to report notifiable infectious diseases and events to the appropriate health authority.
eligibility: The reporting person must be obligated to report. A complete list of all persons obligated to report can be found in the Infection Protection Act § 8. The reported event must be notifiable. A notifiable infectious disease or notifiable event must have occurred. Notifiable diseases and events are specified in the Infection Protection Act in § 6 and § 7.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the Health Department (Gesundheitsamt) in the district where the affected person or the person in whom the pathogen was detected has their main residence. Notifiable events in hospitals can also be reported to the Health Department in which the hospital is located. The occurrence of tuberculosis requiring treatment must be reported to the Center for Tuberculosis Patients and At-Risk Persons.

name: Reporting Infectious Diseases – For Community Facilities
description: A mandatory reporting service for staff, attendees, and managers of child care facilities in Berlin who must report notifiable infectious diseases or events under Section 34 of the Infection Protection Act.
eligibility: Reporting persons: employees, attendees, and managers of Berlin facilities that primarily care for children. Reportable event: a notifiable infectious disease or notifiable event under § 34 of the Infection Protection Act (Infektionsschutzgesetz) must have occurred.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible health authority (Gesundheitsamt) is located in the district where the community facility is situated.

name: Infection Control Environmental Consultation - Indoor Air Quality, Mold
description: This service provides environmental health consultation regarding indoor air contamination and mold prevention under infection control regulations.
eligibility: No requirements
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Infection Protection Instruction with Certificate
description: This service provides mandatory infection protection instruction and certification for individuals working with food or in related roles in Berlin.
eligibility: Personal attendance is required. Persons without sufficient knowledge of German must bring an interpreter (friend, etc.).
requiredDocuments: Identity document: Passport or national ID card with current address registration certificate and, if applicable, landlord confirmation; or eID card for EU/EEA citizens (EU citizen card) with current address registration certificate and, if applicable, landlord confirmation
For third-country nationals: work permit and residence permit
For persons under 18 years of age: written consent of the legal guardian(s)
For school interns (grades 7-10): proof of internship

For volunteer members of registered non-profit associations and volunteer helpers in school cafeterias: letter from the organization confirming no compensation is paid and that certification is only for Berlin-based organizations

name: Guild Association - Request Approval of Bylaws
description: Request approval of bylaws for a guild association (Innungsverband) that represents multiple craft guilds in a state.
eligibility: Applicant must be a union of craft guilds (Handwerksinnungen) of the same craft or related crafts within a state's district; no other state guild association may already exist in the state; the bylaws must have been adopted by a member assembly that was quorate.
requiredDocuments: Informal written application for approval of bylaws or bylaws amendment
New bylaws; if applicable, the old bylaws if an amendment is to be approved
Resolution of the member assembly including protocol and invitation
processingTime: 3-4 weeks for straightforward cases; longer processing time should be expected for procedures involving multiple states.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Guild Association - Request Approval of Bylaws for a State Guild Association Across Multiple Federal States
description: This service allows voluntary associations of craft guilds to request approval of bylaws for establishing a state guild association that spans multiple German federal states.
eligibility: Voluntary association of craft guilds of the same craft or crafts that are professionally or economically related; formation of a joint state guild association for multiple federal states; no other state guild association for the same craft or professionally/economically related crafts must exist in the association's territory, or an exception case must be justified; the bylaws must contain specific provisions including: name, headquarters, and territory of the state guild association; its tasks; membership entry, withdrawal, and exclusion; member rights and obligations and the basis for calculating membership fees; procedures for calling member assemblies, voting rights, and decision-making; board formation; documentation of assembly and board resolutions; budget planning and annual financial statement preparation and review; conditions for bylaw amendments; dissolution of the association; and use of remaining assets upon dissolution.
requiredDocuments: Informal written application for approval of bylaws of a joint state guild association for multiple federal states, which must contain information about which craft guilds intend to join the state guild association, specify the territory and federal states covered, and explain whether a state guild association for the same or related craft already exists in that territory (and if so, provide detailed justification for why an exception is warranted)
Bylaws of the state guild association (to be attached to the application), with documented evidence of proper adoption through appropriate supporting materials
processingTime: Processing time depends on the scope of review required

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Inobhutnahme von Kindern und Jugendlichen (Taking Children and Adolescents into Care)
description: Emergency protective care service for children and adolescents in crisis situations, provided without prerequisites or required documentation.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Youth Welfare Office (Jugendamt) at the child's place of residence is responsible.

name: Insolvency - Discharge of Remaining Debt
description: This service allows natural persons to apply for insolvency proceedings and obtain a discharge of their remaining debts.
eligibility: The applicant must be a natural person, such as consumers, employees, self-employed individuals, civil servants, the unemployed, trainees, or prisoners. The application for discharge of remaining debt must be submitted together with the application to open insolvency proceedings. Declarations must be submitted to verify whether you have already been granted or denied discharge of remaining debt and when this occurred. The insolvency proceeding generally lasts 3 years as determined by law since October 1, 2020. If you have already obtained discharge of remaining debt within 3 years under the regulations effective from October 1, 2020, the duration of the insolvency proceeding is 5 years.
requiredDocuments: Application for opening of insolvency proceedings and discharge of remaining debt (complete the application for either standard insolvency proceedings or consumer insolvency proceedings; all required declarations are included in the official forms provided)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: For consumer insolvency proceedings, the application must be submitted to the District Court (Amtsgericht) at the applicant's place of residence. Exception: If an application to open insolvency proceedings was initially filed by a creditor (third-party application), the application for discharge of remaining debt must be submitted to the District Court Charlottenburg, as this is where the creditor application is also processed.

name: Estate Insolvency Proceedings (Nachlassinsolvenzverfahren)
description: A legal procedure to declare and manage the insolvency of a deceased person's estate when the estate is unable to pay its debts or is over-indebted.
eligibility: The heir(s), estate creditors, estate administrators, estate custodians, or executors may apply. There is generally no time limit for filing after the death occurs, except that estate creditors must file within 2 years of accepting the inheritance. However, heirs must immediately request the opening of estate insolvency proceedings upon learning of the estate's insolvency or over-indebtedness. The application must include information about the deceased (name, birth and death dates, last residence, and any probate court file number if known); information about the heirs and whether the inheritance has been accepted; the grounds for insolvency (payment inability and/or over-indebtedness); and a list of estate assets and all creditors with their claims. Statements must be substantiated if the applicant is an estate creditor or a co-heir filing on behalf of all heirs.
requiredDocuments: Application for opening the estate insolvency proceedings (no mandatory form; a template is available under 'Forms')
Proof of heir status (e.g., inheritance certificate or will)
Proof of creditor status (e.g., judgment, contracts) — required only from creditors
Estate inventory
List of creditors
fees: Fees are charged for processing the application and conducting the estate insolvency proceedings; the amount depends on the estate assets recovered.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court Charlottenburg (Amtsgericht Charlottenburg) is the sole authority responsible for handling estate insolvencies in Berlin. If a debtor dies during consumer insolvency proceedings at another court, the resulting estate insolvency proceedings are automatically transferred to the District Court Charlottenburg.

name: Request for Negative Certificate Regarding Pending Insolvency Proceedings
description: A service to obtain an official certificate confirming whether insolvency proceedings are pending for yourself or another party.
eligibility: For inquiries about a third party: you must demonstrate legal interest and provide documentation explaining why you need the information. Certificates are only issued upon written request. For personal inquiries, no special requirements apply.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a negative certificate (must be submitted in writing by post or in person)
Identity document (personal ID card or passport — must be presented in person for oral applications, or a copy must be attached for written applications)
For third-party inquiries: proof of legal interest (documentation demonstrating your legal interest in obtaining information about another person)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: For inquiries about yourself: Your residential court (for consumer insolvency proceedings) or Charlottenburg District Court (for standard insolvency proceedings). For inquiries about another individual regarding consumer insolvency: the residential court of that person. For inquiries about standard insolvency proceedings or companies: Charlottenburg District Court (central office for Berlin).

name: Insolvency Proceedings - Standard Insolvency - Business Operations - Execution - Self-Application
description: This service allows a business to apply for opening standard insolvency proceedings when the business is unable to meet its financial obligations.
eligibility: The application to open insolvency proceedings must be filed by at least one member of the management body (e.g., managing director, board, etc.). For a management-less GmbH (i.e., when there is no managing director), the application can also be filed by the shareholders. For a management-less stock corporation (i.e., when there is no board of directors), the application can be filed by members of the supervisory board. If the application is not filed by all members of the management body, all shareholders, or all members of the supervisory board, the grounds for opening insolvency must be credibly demonstrated with directly accessible evidence.
requiredDocuments: Application to open insolvency proceedings - Submit a fully completed application form; the application form offered under 'Forms' contains all required information

Documentation of insolvency grounds (in special cases) - Submit documents or directly accessible evidence that substantiate the grounds for opening; these documents need only be submitted if the application is not filed by all members of the management body, all shareholders, or all members of the supervisory board
fees: Court costs and compensation for the insolvency administrator apply, the amount of which depends on the estate.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court (Amtsgericht) Berlin Charlottenburg is centrally responsible for processing standard insolvency proceedings for the assets of a business operation.

name: Insolvency Proceedings - Standard Insolvency - Natural Person - Administration
description: This service administers standard insolvency proceedings for individuals, including the filing of an insolvency application and the granting of debt relief.
eligibility: You must submit a declaration of assignment for the attachable portion of your income together with your application to open insolvency proceedings. If you use the forms provided here, this declaration is included. You must also submit other necessary declarations. The purpose of these declarations is to verify whether you have already been granted or denied debt relief and in what timeframe this occurred. If you use the forms provided here, this declaration is included.
requiredDocuments: Application to open standard insolvency proceedings and to grant debt relief (all necessary declarations are included if you use the forms provided here)
fees: Court fees and expenses as well as the compensation of the insolvency administrator are determined by the insolvency estate. In case of cost deferment, the state treasury initially covers the costs.

name: Consumer Insolvency Proceedings
description: This service allows you to file for consumer insolvency and debt discharge protection through a court process.
eligibility: Completely filled out application form (available under "Forms"). You must attempt an out-of-court settlement, and you must obtain help from a qualified person (e.g., lawyer) or qualified organization (debt counseling service) for this attempt. The proof of the failed out-of-court settlement must not be older than 6 months at the time of application. You must submit an assignment declaration for the attachable portion of your income together with your application to open insolvency proceedings; this declaration is included in the Federal Ministry of Justice and Consumer Protection's form. You must also submit other necessary declarations confirming whether you have previously been granted or denied debt discharge and within what time period; these declarations are included in the Federal Ministry of Justice and Consumer Protection's form.
requiredDocuments: Application for opening of consumer insolvency proceedings and granting of debt discharge (mandatory form)
Application for approval of cost deferment (if needed)
fees: Court fees and costs as well as the compensation of the insolvency administrator depend on the insolvency assets. In case of cost deferment, the state treasury initially bears the costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent insolvency court is the district court (Amtsgericht) in whose jurisdiction the debtor is resident.

name: Insolvency Proceedings - Procedure Costs - Deferment
description: This service allows individuals to request deferment of insolvency procedure costs if they lack sufficient income or assets to cover them and meet other eligibility criteria.
eligibility: You must be a natural person (not a legal entity such as a GmbH or corporation). You must declare whether you have been convicted of insolvency-related crimes under §§ 283-283c of the German Criminal Code (Strafgesetzbuch) or have been granted or denied debt relief (Restschuldbefreiung) within ten years prior to the insolvency application—if any of these apply, deferment is excluded. You must be seeking debt relief through the insolvency proceedings. You must demonstrate that due to your economic situation, you cannot pay the procedure costs, and that your income and assets are insufficient to cover the costs of the proceedings.
requiredDocuments: Combined application for opening, granting debt relief, and cost deferment (see Forms section) — for standard insolvency proceedings (Regelinsolvenzverfahren)

Application for cost deferment (see Forms section) — for consumer insolvency proceedings (Verbraucherinsolvenzverfahren); note that the deferment application is not part of the opening application and must be submitted separately
Current proof of income, such as wage certificate, Jobcenter decision, basic security decision, pension decision, or other income statements
Evidence of monthly expenses, such as rent, building costs, loan payments, insurance, maintenance payments
processingTime: Depends on the processing time of the insolvency opening application.

bookingInfo.office: District Court (Amtsgericht) Charlottenburg for standard insolvency proceedings (Regelinsolvenzverfahren); District Court at the applicant's place of residence for consumer insolvency proceedings (Verbraucherinsolvenzverfahren).

name: Hunting License - Application for Issuance or Renewal

eligibility: Minimum age of 18 years; Passed hunter or falconer examination or equivalent qualification recognized in Berlin (if residing outside Germany and applying for a daily hunting license or falconry daily hunting license); Reliability and personal suitability; Concluded hunting liability insurance with minimum coverage of 500,000 euros for personal injury and 50,000 euros for property damage; Where applicable, residence in Berlin or address for stay in Berlin for daily hunting licenses and falconry daily hunting licenses; Personal collection (hunting license must generally be collected in person); For online application: consent to electronic payment method (PayPal or SEPA direct debit available).
requiredDocuments: Completed application for hunting license (online or written by post or email)
Proof of concluded hunting liability insurance
Certificate of successfully passed hunter or falconer examination (first application only)
Proof of enrollment in forestry studies (only if applicable)
Employer certification (only if employed in forestry service)
Hunting invitation (only if residing outside Germany and applying for daily hunting or falconry daily hunting license)
Hunting license from competent authority of your main residence abroad (only if residing outside Germany and applying for daily hunting or falconry daily hunting license)
List of all previous addresses in the last 10 years if applicable (outside Berlin)
Proof of participation in practice shooting (required only for renewal applications)
2 passport photos with name and date of birth on reverse (only for first application or renewal with new hunting license booklet; must be submitted by post)
Current hunting license (only for renewal in existing hunting license booklet; must be submitted by post)
Copy or photo of identity card or passport
fees: Annual hunting license: 50.00 euros (1 year), 90.00 euros (2 years), 125.00 euros (3 years); reduced by 50% for forestry students. Falconry hunting license: 15.00 euros (1 year), 25.00 euros (2 years), 35.00 euros (3 years). Daily hunting license or daily falconry hunting license: 15.00 euros. Land entry: 15.00 euros. Renewal fees: 25.50 euros (1 year), 51.00 euros (2 years), 76.50 euros (3 years) for annual license; 17.50 euros (1 year), 35.00 euros (2 years), 52.50 euros (3 years) for falconry license; 5.00 euros for daily license.

name: Request Capital Gains Tax Exemption
description: This service allows eligible individuals to request an exemption from capital gains tax through either a tax exemption order or a non-assessment certificate.
eligibility: You must have a German tax identification number; be a natural person with unlimited income tax liability (resident in Germany); be both the account holder and creditor of the capital gains (exemption orders do not apply to trust accounts); request a tax exemption order only up to €1,000 (or €2,000 for joint assessment); or request a non-assessment certificate only if you are not expected to be assessed for income tax and do not intend to file a voluntary income tax return.
requiredDocuments: Tax exemption order (Freistellungsauftrag) — contact your financial institution to submit this directly

Application for non-assessment certificate (Antrag auf Ausstellung einer Nichtveranlagungs-Bescheinigung) — obtain the form from your tax office or via the Federal Ministry of Finance's form management system (FMS); submit the completed form either in paper form to your tax office or electronically via the ELSTER portal as a PDF attachment

Proof of authorization (Nachweis der Verfügungsberechtigung) — if you are requesting a non-assessment certificate on behalf of a minor child, you must provide proof that the capital is the child's property (for example, proof of the child's account authorization)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Tax exemption orders must be submitted directly to your financial institutions. Your residential tax office (Wohnsitzfinanzamt) is responsible for issuing non-assessment certificates or conducting income tax assessment.

name: Purchase Price Collection - Request Information
description: A service that provides property valuation data from Berlin's purchase price collection to qualified experts, authorities, and certified professionals, or to other parties with legitimate interests on a case-by-case basis.
eligibility: Access to property-specific information is limited to publicly appointed and sworn experts in property valuation, authorized government employees and employees of institutions under state or federal supervision, and certified property valuation and real estate assessment experts accredited under DIN EN ISO/IEC 17024. Other individuals and organizations may request block-level information (without specific property location details) on a case-by-case basis upon written application if they can demonstrate legitimate interest. Data provided must be used appropriately and only for the stated purpose; data may not be shared with third parties.
requiredDocuments: Application for one-time information from the purchase price collection (online or written form via post)
For online submission: all required documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or DOCX format (total file size max 30 MB; individual file max 5 MB)

Evidence of legitimate interest, certificates, certifications (e.g., court order as work assignment, proof of legitimate interest, certification from an authority with extended access rights confirming employee responsibility)
If applicable: proof of fee or cost exemption for fee-free or cost-free proceedings
fees: €39.10 per commenced 30 minutes for written information (experts, companies, organizations, or private individuals); if exceeding €78.20, applicant will be contacted. For turnover analysis and custom evaluations, a cost estimate with cost assumption confirmation will be provided. €122.00 base fee for up to 12 datasets plus €8.50 for each additional dataset. €146.00 base fee for up to 12 datasets plus €10.40 for each additional dataset. €78.20. No fees for fee-exempt or cost-exempt proceedings.
processingTime: Processing typically takes 1-2 weeks. Complex and extensive applications may exceed 2 weeks.

bookingInfo.office: Gutachterausschuss für Grundstückswerte in Berlin (SenStadt Department III)

name: Application for Access to AKS Online Purchase Price Collection — Automated Retrieval Procedure

eligibility: You must already be registered for AKS Online and require repeated information from it. For block-related retrieval: access can be granted to real estate appraisers who repeatedly need information for lawful completion of their valuation tasks and can credibly demonstrate this and their reliability. For property-related retrieval: access is granted to experts in one of the following categories: court-appointed or sworn real estate appraisal expert; employee of a public authority or institution under state or federal supervision assigned to property valuation; certified real estate expert in accordance with DIN EN ISO/IEC 17024 whose accreditation body is accredited. Legitimate interest: this is assumed particularly for authorities or publicly appointed and sworn experts or certified experts engaged in valuation as part of their duties. Data provided must be used appropriately and only for the stated purpose; data may not be shared with third parties.
requiredDocuments: Application for AKS Online access (online or by postal mail)
For online submission: all required documents and evidence in PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or DOCX format (total file size max 30 MB; individual file max 5 MB)
For block-related retrieval: copies of the first pages of three appraisals prepared by you as evidence of repeated activity in property valuation
For property-related retrieval: proof of qualification such as certificate or appointment document (in copy)
processingTime: Within one week

name: Request Childlessness Grant for Assisted Reproduction
description: This service provides financial grants to eligible couples or partnership holders in Berlin who are undergoing assisted reproduction treatment (artificial insemination) and meet specific medical, age, and residency requirements.
eligibility: Applicants must be: (1) married same-sex female couples or opposite-sex couples; registered same-sex female partners under the Partnership Act; or same-sex female or opposite-sex couples in non-marital cohabitation (defined as a long-term partnership between a man and woman or two women with no concurrent partnerships, confirmed by the treating physician; in opposite-sex couples, the man must acknowledge paternity of any child conceived through assisted reproduction); (2) involuntarily childless; (3) have their primary residence in Berlin at the time of application and treatment start; (4) conducting treatment at an approved fertility clinic in Berlin; (5) not yet started treatment (first treatment begins when the first prescription is filled at the pharmacy); (6) bearing part of the treatment costs themselves; (7) have received both medical and psychosocial counseling; (8) both partners at least 25 years old (the woman undergoing treatment must not yet be 40 years old; the man or woman not undergoing treatment must not yet be 50 years old); (9) for same-sex female couples, only eggs from the partner undergoing treatment are used. Payment request deadline: application must be submitted by mail to LAGeSo within 2 months of receiving the final invoice/receipt. If eligible for insurance reimbursement, submit claims there first; the resulting letter serves as the final proof for the 2-month deadline calculation.
requiredDocuments: Application/follow-up application for assisted reproduction grant (completed online, printed, hand-signed by both applicants, mailed to LAGeSo Berlin)
Marriage certificate or registered partnership certificate (for married couples or registered partnerships)
Current residence registration certificates or online register information and copies of ID cards/passports (front and back)

Approved treatment plan from statutory health insurance(s) with insurance letter(s), including cost estimate or separate cost estimate from fertility center if not on treatment plan (for opposite-sex married couples)
Cost estimate from fertility center if not included on treatment plan
Completed medical certificate from fertility clinic (form varies by couple type: married/opposite-sex couples with donor sperm; married/opposite-sex couples; same-sex couples)
Documentation of supplementary services/bonus payments/cost coverage/rejection notices from statutory health insurance, private health insurance, or subsidy office
Proof of cost reimbursement from statutory health insurance, private health insurance, and/or subsidy office(s)
Invoices from fertility center
Pharmacy receipts and prescriptions for acquired medications
Anesthesia invoice
Laboratory invoices for blood tests
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Declare Church Withdrawal
description: A service that allows residents aged 14 and over, or their legal representatives, to formally declare withdrawal from a religious community at the district court.
eligibility: You can declare your withdrawal yourself if you have completed your 14th year of life. For children under 14 years old and for persons lacking legal capacity, parents or legal representatives can declare the withdrawal. From the age of 12 onwards, children must appear in person with you and give their consent to the declaration of withdrawal. The declaration must be made personally before the competent district court (Amtsgericht) in your jurisdiction, either in person or in writing with a notarially certified signature. Representation by an authorized third party is not permitted.
requiredDocuments: Church withdrawal declaration — only possible in person on site or in writing with notarially certified signature; withdrawal cannot be declared online
Valid national ID card (Personalausweis) or passport with registration certificate (Meldebescheinigung)
Birth certificates of your children — required only if you are declaring withdrawal for your children who have not yet reached their 14th year of life

Marriage certificate or civil partnership certificate — required only if you wish to have the withdrawal from the religious community recorded in the marriage or civil partnership register at the registry office (Standesamt)
fees: 30.00 Euro; additional costs may be incurred if the declaration is notarially certified by a notary (Notarin or Notar).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent office is exclusively the district court (Amtsgericht) in whose jurisdiction your place of residence or habitual residence is located. Note: The option to book an appointment for church withdrawal online is currently only available at a few district courts. If your residence is in a district court jurisdiction where online appointment booking is not offered, please arrange an appointment in person (e.g., via contact form).

description: This service allows Berlin residents who are guardians of a child at least 8 weeks old to request or expand a voucher for childcare at a licensed facility or with a childcare provider.
eligibility: You must have your primary residence in Berlin; be legally responsible for the child (usually both parents); obtain consent from all guardians (not required if you are the sole guardian); your child must be at least 8 weeks old; submit your initial application at least 9 months but no later than 2 months before your child is to start at the kita or childcare provider (no deadline for expanding care coverage); have a valid kita voucher if you are requesting an expansion of care hours.
requiredDocuments: Application for Issuance or Expansion of a Kita Voucher (Registration for Promotion of Children) — completed, printed, signed by all guardians, and submitted by post to the responsible Youth Office or delivered in person at your district's Family Service Office

Proof of consent from the other guardian — written authorization from the parent who did not sign the application, or a written declaration of sole guardianship (evidenced by a negative certification or court order)

Residence confirmation (if information blocking is in place)

Proof that you cannot care for the child yourself for expanded care needs or children under one year — examples include: current employer confirmation of employment (or start of employment) with specific or changed working hours (from both parents if applicable), training/course/study confirmation or internship contract, proof of self-employment (e.g., tax office certification, business registration, or artist social security contribution notice)
Childcare facility's written consent to increased care hours (only required if changing care hours in the current month or when requesting expansion)

name: Permit - Request Limited Extension of Car Rental License
description: Request a temporary extension of your car rental license for event-related passenger transport in Berlin.
eligibility: Valid car rental permit; minimum age 18 years; registered business location within Berlin; vehicles must have a second right door (unless the vehicle design has no rear bench seating); vehicles with foreign registrations are not permitted; drivers must hold a valid Berlin passenger transport driver's license (P-Schein) for car rentals; vehicles must have an easily readable odometer and alarm system (exception permits available upon request if these cannot be installed).
requiredDocuments: Application for limited extension of car rental permit (event transport) — submit informally in writing by post or to the mailbox at Friedrichstr. 219, 10969 Berlin
Identity card or passport (and registration confirmation if applicable)
Vehicle registration certificate Part I (Fahrzeugschein)

Insurance confirmation for passenger transport rental vehicles — coverage must be documented with appropriate evidence and must remain valid for commercial passenger transport during the period of use

Consent from vehicle owner for passenger transport, and framework agreement with contractual partner if applicable — vehicle lease agreements must not contain clauses excluding commercial passenger transport
Event documentation — must include the event name, duration with dates, and evidence of public interest; additional documentation may be requested

List of additional vehicles if applicable — additional vehicles (typically rented or sponsored) must be registered as car rental or self-drive vehicles in Part I of the registration certificate, or an exemption permit from the registration authority must be provided; vehicles deployed under such exemption permits must not be older than one year
fees: €50.00 for the first vehicle; €15.00 for each additional vehicle in the same application; €50.00 per application for exemption permits; €50.00 minimum fee for required decisions under § 10 PBefG or preparation of information letters (higher fees possible for high effort cases)
processingTime: Approximately 4 weeks (processing time cannot bridge limited extensions)

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be provided by the State Office for Citizen and Administrative Affairs (Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten).

name: Permit - Request Renewal/Extension of Authorization to Conduct Patient Transport Services
description: This service allows authorized businesses in Berlin to renew or extend their permit to operate patient transport services (Krankentransporte).
eligibility: Business registered in Berlin; valid existing permit (application must be submitted 3 months before expiration); minimum age 18 years; operating location within Berlin; professional competency demonstrated through a written and practical examination before the Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IHK) as required by the Emergency Medical Services Act (§ 13 para. 1 no. 4 RDG) — for corporations (e.g. GmbH) the responsible representative must demonstrate competency, and for civil partnerships all partners must demonstrate competency; personal reliability demonstrated by providing a police clearance certificate (federal criminal record) and a commercial register disclosure; financial capacity demonstrated through a completed asset overview statement — for corporations this must be confirmed by a tax advisor, and cash cannot be used as proof.
requiredDocuments: Application for renewal and/or extension of authorization to conduct patient transport services (see Forms section) — submit by mail or drop in mailbox at Friedrichstr. 219, 10969 Berlin
Asset overview statement (see Forms section) with complete bank statement for the last completed month
Identity card or passport (or registration confirmation if applicable)
