name: Corporate Income Tax - Exemption Certificate (Recognition of Non-Profit Status)
description: This service provides tax-exempt status recognition for organizations that serve the public interest through non-profit, charitable, or religious purposes.
eligibility: Organizations can only be recognized as tax-exempt (non-profit) if they meet the requirements of sections 51 et seq. of the German Tax Code (Abgabenordnung). According to these provisions, an organization qualifies as non-profit only if it pursues public benefit purposes in a self-less, exclusive, and direct manner according to its bylaws and actual business operations. The bylaws must precisely define the organization's purpose and the measures for fulfilling it so that it is unambiguously clear which specific tax-exempt purpose is being pursued and how it will be realized. Multiple exempt purposes may be pursued simultaneously; bylaws must meet requirements equally for each. The Finance Office issues a determination notice confirming compliance with statutory requirements for non-profit status. The exemption certificate confirms that the organization serves non-profit, charitable, or ecclesiastical purposes in the years specified, following review of its actual business operations, typically for the three preceding years. The corporate income tax return must be submitted electronically; paper submissions are treated as not submitted except in cases of particular hardship. Online filing requires registration on the ELSTER portal and either an activated eID function or ELSTER certificate.
requiredDocuments: Profit determination
Activity report
Bylaws
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Generally, the Finance Office for Corporations I is responsible for tax-exempt organizations under section 5(1) no. 9 of the Corporate Income Tax Act and section 3 no. 6 of the Trade Tax Act. If the non-profit organization is affiliated with another enterprise, responsibility may also lie with the Finance Offices for Corporations II, III, or IV. Special jurisdictions may apply according to the Finance Offices Jurisdiction Regulation.

description: This service provides an E-registration plate for electrically operated vehicles from abroad that do not have such designation from their country of origin.
eligibility: Vehicle must not have an E-registration from the country of origin. Vehicle classes: M1, N1, N2 (up to 4,250 kg maximum gross weight), L3e, L4e, L5e, L7e. Vehicle must be one of the following: pure battery electric vehicle, plug-in hybrid electric vehicle, or fuel cell vehicle. For plug-in hybrid vehicles, either CO2 emissions must not exceed 50 grams per kilometer, or electric-only range must be at least 30 km (for first registration until 31 December 2017) or 40 km (for first registration from 1 January 2018 onwards). Vehicle registration document (Zulassungsbescheinigung) Part I

name: Apply for Temporary Vehicle Registration Plate (Kurzzeitkennzeichen)
description: This service allows you to request a temporary registration plate for a vehicle that is known to the registration authorities and meets specific requirements regarding operating permits and inspections.
eligibility: The vehicle must be known to the registration authorities with type or individual approval. If an operating permit cannot be provided, use of the temporary plate is restricted to trips related to obtaining an expert report for operating permit approval (type or individual approval) to a testing facility in the registration district where the vehicle is located or an adjacent registration district and back. A valid main inspection (HU) or safety inspection (SP) must be demonstrated, expiring after the temporary plate expires. If a valid HU/SP cannot be demonstrated, use of the temporary plate is restricted to trips to obtain HU/SP at an inspection facility in the registration district where the vehicle is located or an adjacent district and back.

name: Vehicle Re-Registration (Kraftfahrzeug - Umschreibung)
description: Apply to re-register a vehicle in Berlin under a new owner or with a new registration number, provided you meet residency and vehicle requirements.
eligibility: You must have your residence or registered office in the jurisdiction of the Berlin vehicle registration authority. You must not have any outstanding motor vehicle tax arrears with the main customs office or any fee arrears with the state of Berlin. The vehicle must have a valid main inspection (TÜV). For online applications: the vehicle's main inspection must be retrievable in the central vehicle register. For online applications: the registration certificate part II must have been issued on or after 01.10.2017 and must have a security code. For online applications: the registration certificate part I must have been issued on or after 01.01.2015. For online applications: the vehicle must not have been out of operation for longer than seven years. For online applications: you must have the online identification function via your ID card or residence permit with activated eID and six-digit PIN, plus an external card reader or a modern smartphone with Android or iOS operating system and software such as the AusweisApp. For online applications: you must consent to electronic payment via credit card (Visa, Mastercard) or PayPal.

name: Change Vehicle License Plate on Request
description: This service allows residents of Berlin to request a change to their vehicle's license plate combination according to specific eligibility criteria.
eligibility: Short license plate combinations are assigned on a case-by-case basis by the registration authority only for vehicles that structurally cannot accommodate larger combinations; such requests cannot be processed through online reservation. For seasonal and classic vehicle plates, the character combination may not exceed 5 characters total, and the letter series HJ, KZ, NS, SA, and SS are not available. For motorcycles and mopeds, valid combinations include: 1 letter and 3 digits; 1 letter and 4 digits; 2 letters and 2 digits; 2 letters and 3 digits. For cars and trucks, valid combinations are: 1 letter and 4 digits; 2 letters and 3 digits; 2 letters and 4 digits. For three- and four-wheeled vehicles (vehicle classes L5e and L7e) and registration-exempt vehicles, valid combinations are: 1 letter and 4 digits or 2 letters and 3 digits (each using 280x200 mm plates); 2 letters and 4 digits (using single-row 520x110 mm plates).

Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
Informal power of attorney including identity document of the authorizing person—unless it is a notarially executed power of attorney—and identity document of the authorized person (if applicable)

Business registration (original or certified copy) for businesses
Extract from the association register (original or certified copy) for associations
Written consent and identity cards of both parents/guardians for minor vehicle holders
Vehicle registration document Part I (Fahrzeugschein / Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I)
Vehicle registration document Part II (Fahrzeugbrief / Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil II) or, for registration-exempt vehicles, the operating permit (Betriebserlaubnis)
Previous license plate(s)

Proof of valid main inspection (HU) according to § 29 StVZO; the HU inspection report must only be provided if the due date of the next inspection cannot be determined from the vehicle registration document
Printout of online reservation confirmation (if applicable)

The manufacture of license plates is not a service provided by the Berlin vehicle registration authority, and no information can be given regarding additional costs.

name: Apply for Global Cultural Exchange Scholarship
description: A professional artists and curators in Berlin can apply for a stipend to support cultural exchange projects abroad.
eligibility: Applications accepted from 03.08.2026 to 15.09.2026 at 14:00 (Berlin local time); only one application per person; you must live and work in Berlin; individual artists and artist groups may apply (groups must confirm their association with a joint declaration or existing GbR contract); you must be a professionally working artist or curator; application must be completed and submitted in German (attachments may be in German or English); if you receive another stipend offer, you must report it to verify compatibility with this one (may be combined with other Berlin state stipends up to €24,000 per year); you must not be enrolled at a university (including doctoral studies) or employed as a professor at a university at the time of application.
requiredDocuments: Application for funding through the Global Cultural Exchange Scholarship (online submission only)
Project description (max. 5 pages) describing the planned activities abroad, topics, goals, and type of cooperation
Invitation letter from cooperation partner(s)

CV/Portfolio (max. 10 MB, PDF format, max. 10 pages) showing career, stipends, awards, and selection of important projects from recent years; for group applications, attachments required for all members

Proof of Berlin address and residence permit - German citizens: copy of valid ID card (front and back); EU citizens: copy of valid ID card or passport and registration confirmation; non-EU citizens with residence title card: residence title card counts as ID and registration proof; non-EU citizens without residence title card: copy of valid ID or passport, registration confirmation, and valid residence title or residence right documentation (front and back)
GbR contract or joint artist declaration with signatures from all group members (required for group applications only)

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Cultural Exchange Scholarship in Istanbul, Paris, New York or Tokyo
description: This service allows professional artists and curators living and working in Berlin to apply for a cultural exchange scholarship to conduct work in Istanbul, Paris, New York, or Tokyo.
eligibility: Applications are open from August 3, 2026 to September 15, 2026, with the deadline at 14:00 on September 15, 2026. Online applications must be received by 14:00; after that time, submissions are no longer possible. Only one application per person is permitted. You must live and work in Berlin. Only individual artists can apply. You must be a professionally working artist or curator. The application must be completed and submitted in German; the "Application Form" attachment must be completed in English; other attachments may be in German or English. You may apply for this scholarship even if you have applied for other scholarships, but you must inform the office if you receive approval for another scholarship so compatibility can be checked; this scholarship can be combined with other Berlin state scholarships up to a maximum of €24,000 per year. You must not be enrolled at a university (including for doctoral studies) or employed as a professor at a university at the time of application.
requiredDocuments: Application for funding through the international cultural exchange scholarship in Istanbul, Paris, New York, and Tokyo (online submission only; prepare all required documents and evidence as PDF for upload)

Project description (maximum 5 pages) - substantive description of the proposed project abroad (topics, goals, etc.)
CV/Portfolio (maximum 10 MB, PDF file, maximum 10 pages) - should include career history, scholarships, awards, and selection of important projects from recent years

Identity document, proof of main residence in Berlin, and if applicable, proof of residence permit - requirements vary by citizenship status (German citizens: copy of valid ID card front and back; EU citizens: copy of valid ID card or passport and registration certificate; non-EU citizens with residence title card: the card serves as ID and proof of residence; non-EU citizens without residence title card: copy of valid ID card or passport, registration certificate, and valid residence title or proof of residence rights)
processingTime: 4 to 5 months

name: Store Opening Hours - Report Exception for Special Occasion
description: This service allows retail establishments to report and request permission to open on Sundays and public holidays for special occasions or events.
eligibility: Retail stores may open on Sundays and public holidays under specific circumstances: Tourist-oriented stores selling souvenirs, maps, travel guides, tobacco, photography supplies, and food for immediate consumption may open 1–8 PM on Sundays and public holidays. Stores with specialty assortments (flowers, plants, newspapers, bakery items, dairy products) may open 7 AM–4 PM. Special stores (gas stations, pharmacies, station shops, airports, bus terminals) may open any time on Sundays and public holidays. Art and second-hand markets may open 7 AM–6 PM. The city of Berlin permits up to eight city-wide Sunday/public holiday openings (1–8 PM) annually, announced in the official gazette. Additionally, stores may open on two more Sundays or public holidays per year (1–8 PM) for special events or occasions (such as company anniversaries or street festivals). This opening must be reported to the responsible district office two weeks in advance.
requiredDocuments: Notification of intended Sunday/public holiday opening (online or by mail)
Informal written notification stating the reason/occasion, submitted two weeks in advance
Sample form for notification (available in forms section or online)
processingTime: Approximately 1 week

bookingInfo.office: The notification must be submitted to the district office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for the retail location.

eligibility: No prerequisites required.

Name and address of the applicant (contracting party)

Contact details of the responsible person on-site available at all times during the requested project
Information on the location of the project (address)
Date/timeframe of the project
Designation and brief description of the project
Location description (e.g., distance to nearest residential buildings)
Explanation of the necessity of the project (why it is necessary and should take precedence over standard noise protection, particularly for projects at night or on Sundays and public holidays)

Details on the extent of expected noise disturbance: e.g., number of participants, modalities of required setup and dismantling work, delivery traffic, time, duration and volume of sound checks for outdoor music events, arrangement and performance of loudspeakers, expected impact on nearest residents

List of possible technical noise sources and their arrangement, and information on type, manufacturer, device number and year of manufacture of the respective machines and equipment used

Description of intended noise protection measures, for example use of low-noise generators/equipment/machines, use of headsets/walkie-talkies, enclosure of equipment; if applicable, proof of existing fee exemption
fees: 400.00 to 7,000.00 euros for public large-scale outdoor events; 100.00 to 1,500.00 euros for other public outdoor events; 130.00 to 2,135.00 euros for projects for commercial purposes; 50.00 to 425.00 euros for other projects; 25% of the underlying permit fee, minimum 110 euros for minor modifications; 50% of the underlying permit fee, minimum 110 euros for substantial modifications.
processingTime: Applications must generally be submitted four weeks before the start of the project. For shorter application deadlines, you should contact the responsible authority immediately.

bookingInfo.office: District Environmental and Nature Conservation Office or Senate Administration for Mobility, Transport, Climate Protection and Environment

name: Initial Registration of Civil Partnership Formed Abroad - Without Domestic Residence
description: This service registers a civil partnership that was established abroad by applicants who have never had a residence in Germany, making it valid under German law.
eligibility: The civil partnership was established abroad; applicants have or have never had a residence in Germany; the civil partnership's validity under German law must be established; applicants are the civil partners themselves, or if both are deceased, their parents and children.
requiredDocuments: Civil partnership certificate
Current certified extracts from the birth register with information section for both civil partners (if birth was registered in a German birth register)
Birth certificates of both civil partners (if birth was registered exclusively abroad)
Identity card or passport of the civil partners
Evidence of all previous marriages or civil partnerships (documentation of marriage/civil partnership formation and dissolution)
Foreign-language documents must generally be translated and, if necessary, certified; further documents may be required depending on the individual case and will be requested during processing
Original documents or certified copies must be provided with the application; simple copies or electronically transmitted documents are not sufficient
fees: €80.00 for retroactive registration application (German law only); €125.00 for retroactive registration application (foreign law applicable to one person); €170.00 for retroactive registration application (foreign law applicable to both persons); €12.00 for civil partnership certificate; €6.00 for each additional civil partnership certificate issued simultaneously; €12.00 for certified register extract from civil partnership register; €6.00 for each additional certified register extract issued simultaneously
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Foreign Civil Partnership Registration – Request for Documentation
description: This service allows you to register a civil partnership that was legally established abroad in the German civil registry.
eligibility: The civil partnership was established abroad, and at least one of the partners is a German citizen at the time of application, or at least one is stateless, a homeless foreigner, or a recognized foreign refugee with usual residence in Germany. The applicants are the partners themselves; if both are deceased, their parents or children may apply. At least one partner must have or have had a residence in Germany, or the applicant must have had one; if neither ever had a German residence (even as a child), the civil registry office I in Berlin is responsible instead. All documents must be submitted in original form or as certified copies; simple copies or electronically transmitted documents are insufficient.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration of foreign civil partnership
Civil partnership certificate
Birth certificate or certified extract from the birth register for each partner
Current certified extract from the birth register if born in Germany, or birth certificate if born abroad
Identity cards or passports of both partners
Certified extract from the marriage or civil partnership register of any previous marriage or partnership (if applicable), with dissolution notation from the registering office
Marriage certificate or civil partnership certificate with legally binding divorce or annulment judgment or death certificate (if applicable for previous foreign marriage or partnership)
Naturalization certificate or citizenship document (if applicable as proof of German citizenship)
Certified German translation or further certification (Apostille or legalization) of documents in foreign languages
Any additional documents as determined on a case-by-case basis
fees: €80.00 if only German law applies; €125.00 if foreign law applies to one partner; €170.00 if foreign law applies to both partners; €8.00 to €80.00 for withdrawal or rejection of application
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request a Life Partnership Certificate
description: This service allows you to request an official certificate documenting a registered life partnership that was previously established at a registry office.
eligibility: The life partnership must have already been registered at the registry office in whose district it was established. You are entitled to request the certificate if you are: both life partners; a person in direct lineage with the registered persons (parents, children, grandparents, grandchildren); a person who can demonstrate legal interest; or a person with a power of attorney. You must know the responsible registry office, or you can search for it online at no cost or commission a paid search. For online applications, you must consent to electronic payment by credit card (Visa, Mastercard) or bank transfer.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a life partnership certificate or certified copy from the life partnership register (can be submitted online or in person)
Identity document (Personalausweis or Reisepass) — required for in-person applications
Proof of relationship (if applicable) such as birth certificate or life partnership certificate — required if you are in direct lineage with the registered persons
Proof of legal interest (if applicable) such as inheritance certificate or property register extract — required if you are not related to the registered persons
Power of attorney — required if you are applying on behalf of another person
fees: No fee for life partnership certificate for social insurance purposes; €12.00 for life partnership certificate (German); €12.00 for certified copy from the life partnership register; €6.00 for each additional certificate of the same type issued simultaneously; €20.00 to €80.00 depending on search effort for determination of the responsible registry office in Berlin
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

Recent bank statements for housing costs and any expenses for private or voluntary statutory health insurance

name: Monitor and Report Legionella in Drinking Water
description: Business owners and operators of large drinking water heating systems that supply water for commercial or public use must monitor their installations for legionella bacteria and report findings to the health department.
eligibility: Required for business owners and operators of drinking water installations that: operate a large drinking water heating system; supply drinking water for commercial or public purposes; and maintain showers or similar equipment where water is aerosolized. Large heating systems are defined as those with storage volume exceeding 400 liters and/or 3 liters in piping between the water heater outlet and the point of use (circulation lines excluded). Testing must be conducted by an approved testing laboratory.
fees: The report is submitted free of charge. However, microbiological testing, hazard analysis preparation, and any necessary remediation measures incur costs for the business owner or operator.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Benefits under the Asylum Seeker Benefits Act - Report Changes
description: This service allows eligible foreign nationals to report changes in their circumstances that affect their benefits under the Asylum Seeker Benefits Act.
eligibility: You are a foreign national, actually present in German territory, and meet certain residence requirements. You are eligible if you hold one of the following residence permits: Residence permit under § 23 para. 1 of the Residence Act (admission of groups of persons); Residence permit under § 24 of the Residence Act (temporary protection in case of mass influx under EU Directive 2001/55/EC); Residence permit under § 25 para. 4 sentence 1 of the Residence Act (urgent humanitarian or personal reasons); Residence permit under § 25 para. 5 of the Residence Act provided the suspension has not been in effect for 18 months or more (legal or factual obstacles to departure, whose removal is not foreseeable); Suspension of deportation (toleration) under § 60a para. 1 of the Residence Act (group regulation); Suspension of deportation (toleration) under § 60a para. 2 of the Residence Act (legal or factual obstacles to departure, whose removal is foreseeable, or which you are responsible for); Residence deemed tolerated under § 71a para. 3 in conjunction with § 71 of the Asylum Procedure Act (follow-up asylum application); Residence deemed tolerated under § 71a para. 3 of the Asylum Procedure Act (second asylum application). You must report any changes in your circumstances affecting your benefit entitlement under the Asylum Seeker Benefits Act.
requiredDocuments: Application for social benefits
Attachments to the social benefits application
Personal and residence documents
Registration confirmation
Health insurance card
Proof of income and assets
Proof of other necessary needs as applicable
processingTime: 60 minutes

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

Eligible foreign nationals are those with one of the following residence titles: residence permit under § 23 para. 1 of the Residence Act (admission of specific groups); residence permit under § 24 of the Residence Act (temporary protection in case of mass influx under EU Directive 2001/55/EC); residence permit under § 25 para. 4 sentence 1 of the Residence Act (urgent humanitarian or personal reasons); residence permit under § 25 para. 5 of the Residence Act provided the suspension of deportation has not been suspended for 18 months or more (legal or factual obstacles to departure whose removal is not foreseeable); suspension of deportation (toleration) under § 60a para. 1 of the Residence Act (group regulation); suspension of deportation (toleration) under § 60a para. 2 of the Residence Act (legal or factual obstacles to departure whose removal is foreseeable, or if self-caused); residence is deemed tolerated under § 71a para. 3 in conjunction with § 71 of the Asylum Procedure Act (follow-up asylum application); residence is deemed tolerated under § 71a para. 3 of the Asylum Procedure Act (second asylum application); you have been granted benefits under the Asylum Seeker Benefits Act (AsylbLG).

Registration certificate (Meldebestätigung)
Income and asset documentation (scope depends on individual circumstances)

name: Counseling on Benefits under the Asylum Seeker Benefits Act
description: This service provides consultation and advice for foreign nationals regarding financial and material support benefits available under German asylum law.
eligibility: You are a foreign national, are actually residing in the Federal Republic of Germany, and possess a specified residence permit. Eligible foreign nationals are those who hold one of the following residence permits: Residence permit under § 23 Para. 1 of the Residence Act (admission of groups of persons); Residence permit under § 24 of the Residence Act (temporary protection in case of mass influx under EU Directive 01/55/EG); Residence permit under § 25 Para. 4 Sentence 1 of the Residence Act (compelling humanitarian or personal grounds); Residence permit under § 25 Para. 5 of the Residence Act insofar as the suspension of deportation has not been in effect for 18 months (legal or factual obstacles to departure whose removal is not foreseeable); Suspension of deportation (tolerated status) under § 60a Para. 1 of the Residence Act (group regulation); Suspension of deportation (tolerated status) under § 60a Para. 2 of the Residence Act (legal or factual obstacles to departure whose removal is foreseeable, or if caused by your own actions); Residence deemed tolerated under § 71a Para. 3 in conjunction with § 71 of the Asylum Act (follow-up asylum application); Residence deemed tolerated under § 71a Para. 3 of the Asylum Act (second asylum application).
processingTime: 60 minutes

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

Health insurance card
Proof of income and assets
Proof of any other necessary needs if applicable

name: Apply for Benefits under the Education and Participation Package
description: This service allows eligible children, youth, and young adults to apply for financial support covering education costs, school meals, learning assistance, and participation in cultural, sports, and leisure activities.
eligibility: Eligible are children, youth, and young adults up to age 25. Exception: For benefits to participate in culture, sports, and leisure activities, children and youth are only eligible up to age 18. No age restriction applies if receiving social welfare or asylum seeker benefits. Apprentices receiving training compensation do not receive benefits from the education package. Eligibility also requires receiving one of the following: social welfare, asylum seeker benefits, Bürgergeld (citizen benefit), housing allowance, child allowance supplement, supplementary assistance benefits under SGB XIV in conjunction with SGB XII benefits (formerly: Federal Welfare Act, BVG); or alternatively, BAföG, vocational training allowance (BAB), or apprenticeship allowance; or in some cases, low family income, for example when family income is only slightly above the social welfare rate.

Valid identity document, e.g. ID card, passport, or registration confirmation if applicable
Proof of benefit receipt, e.g. Bürgergeld or social welfare
Certification of daycare attendance or care contract
Child's student ID
School certificate
School admission letter
School authority assignment
Completed supplementary form for additional learning support
Completed and school/daycare-confirmed proof of excursions or school/daycare trips
Membership contract, e.g. with sports club, music association, or fitness studio
Receipts for leisure activities, instruction, courses, and equipment purchases
Travel passes, Berlin-Ticket-S

name: Benefits under the Berlin State Care Allowance Act (LPflGG)
description: This service provides financial care allowance benefits to Berlin residents who are blind, severely visually impaired, or deaf according to the legal definitions.
eligibility: You must have ordinary residence and domicile in Berlin and meet one of the following conditions: Blindness (complete loss of sight, or visual acuity no better than 1/50 on either eye or both eyes tested together, or other sight disorders of equivalent severity); Severe visual impairment (visual acuity no better than 1/20 on either eye or both eyes tested together, or other sight function disorders of equivalent severity, with a disability degree of 100 but not yet classified as blind); or Deafness (congenital or acquired deafness or severe hearing loss equivalent to deafness by age 7, or acquired later if the disability degree due to severe speech disorder exceeds 90).
requiredDocuments: Care allowance application under the Berlin State Care Allowance Act
Valid identity documents (and if applicable, registration confirmation)
Medical documentation regarding visual impairment or deafness
Disability assessment notice under severe disability law
If applicable, decisions on equivalent benefits
Nursing care level assessment notice from the nursing care insurance fund
Note: The scope of required documents depends on the specific circumstances of each case
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Youth Offices (Jugendämter): for children and young people under 18 years of age; Social Affairs Offices (Ämter für Soziales): for adults; State Office for Citizens' and Administrative Affairs (Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten): for recipients of benefits under the PrVG (Nazi Persecution Victims Recognition and Support Act)

name: Property Register - Request Information/Extract
description: This service allows residents to request information or extracts from the property register (Liegenschaftskataster), with varying access depending on whether ownership information is included.
eligibility: Any person may obtain written or oral information and extracts from the property register without ownership information. Oral information about parcel descriptions is possible (maximum three inquiries) as long as official concerns do not prevent it. If you request information or extracts from the property register with ownership information, you must demonstrate a legitimate interest. Personal data are subject to data protection regulations. Ownership information cannot be provided if the data will be used for advertising purposes without the consent of the owners.
requiredDocuments: Application for extract/information from the property register (online or written submission)
Extract from the cadastral map (Flurkarte)
Information/extract from the property register (with or without ownership information)
Proof of legitimate interest (for queries including ownership information, with reference to the information sheet on substantiating legitimate interest)
fees: 16.00 EUR per page; 2.00 EUR (additional) per certification from DIN A3 format onwards; 50% of the base fee for multiple copies requested simultaneously; 32.00 EUR (minimum additional) per half-hour of work required for boundary length entry; 16.00 EUR for extracts up to 5 pages; 1.90 EUR for each additional page.
processingTime: You will normally receive the requested service within two weeks.

bookingInfo.office: The Berlin Surveying Office (Berliner Vermessungsamt) responsible for the area in which the property is located.

name: Property Register - Request Digital Data from the Property Register Information System (ALKIS)
description: This service allows you to request digital data from Berlin's property register (ALKIS) system, with different fees and eligibility requirements depending on whether you're requesting ownership information and your type of applicant.
eligibility: For ownership information, you must demonstrate a legitimate interest. For online application as a private individual requesting owner data: you must authenticate using electronic identification (eID). You will need: your electronic ID card, EU citizen ID card (eID-Karte), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated online authentication function (eID) and your PIN; an external card reader or a modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS operating system; and the "AusweisApp" software.
requiredDocuments: Application for digital data from the Property Register Information System (ALKIS) — please submit the application online
For ownership information queries: proof of legitimate interest (documentation must demonstrate in each case that there is legitimate interest; see information sheet under "Further Information")
For ownership information queries: confirmation that ownership data will not be used for advertising purposes without owner consent

For legal entities: proof of business or public institution existence (e.g., commercial register extract, business license, tax office registration, or chamber registration — proof must not be older than one year)

processingTime: You will generally receive the data within two weeks.

name: Request a Payment Demand and Enforcement Order in German Court Proceedings
description: A service for filing a payment demand petition with the competent court in Germany to obtain a payment demand order and, if necessary, an enforcement order.
eligibility: Procedure initiation: The options for initiating the procedure are found under "Required documents". To participate in the mass procedure EDA ("Electronic Data Exchange"), an approval and registration is necessary. This involves the issuance of a so-called "identification number".
requiredDocuments: Payment demand application (single applications): To initiate payment demand proceedings, you must apply to the Central Payment Demand Court (see "Responsible office") for the issuance of a payment demand order. The application is bound to a specific form and can be transmitted in various ways: Print online payment demand application and send by post (barcode application/print on paper). This transmission method is no longer permitted for lawyers, registered collection service providers, and as of 01.01.2022 also for authorities and legal entities under public law (§ 130 d Civil Procedure Code). Electronically submit online payment demand application (using ID card and activated online identification function (eID), special electronic lawyer mailbox (beA), notary mailbox (beN), authority mailbox (beBPo), electronic citizen and organization mailbox (eBO), or via My Justice Mailbox (MJP)). Paper payment demand application (official forms from stationery shops). This transmission method is no longer permitted for lawyers, registered collection service providers, and as of 01.01.2022 also for authorities and legal entities under public law (§ 130 d Civil Procedure Code). Please do not attach receipts, confirmations, etc.

Follow-up applications (single applications) and objections: All forms still required for the procedure will be sent to you by the payment demand court in the appropriate form, or you can complete them in the "Online Payment Demand Application" portal, print them, or download them electronically and submit them to the payment demand court accordingly. This also applies if you are on the opposing side and wish to file an objection. Please also note the required transmission method for lawyers, authorities, registered collection service providers, and legal entities under public law (see above regarding payment demand application).
Application for reissuance of the payment demand order
Application for issuance of an enforcement order
Application for reissuance of the enforcement order
Objection

Application for admission to "Electronic Data Exchange - EDA": If you are already approved with one payment demand court in Germany, you can use this registration with all other payment demand courts.
fees: The payment demand procedure incurs only half the fee according to the Court Costs Act (GKG), but at least €38.00 (cost schedule 1100 to § 34 GKG). The "Online Payment Demand Application" portal calculates the court fee for the respective payment demand procedure and automatically adds the amount when you fill it out. You can also calculate this yourself using the "Court Costs Calculator" (see under "Further Information / Websites of Payment Demand Courts in Germany"). The fee is due upon receipt of the application—not only when the respective payment demand order is issued. You will receive a cost statement automatically.
processingTime: 2–3 weeks until notification of service of the payment demand order

bookingInfo.office: Responsible for applications from applicants with residence or business address in Berlin or Brandenburg. Responsible for applications from applicants with residence or address abroad. If the opposing party has no residence or business address in Germany, § 703 d ZPO applies. More information can be found in the brochure "Machine Processing of Court Payment Demand Proceedings", starting on page 15 (under "Further Information"). For foreign addresses, please provide the foreign country code ("Table of Foreign Country Codes for Payment Demand Applications with Foreign Connection" under "Further Information"). The competent payment demand court for the application for issuance of a payment demand order depends on the residence of the applicant or, for businesses, their business address. See "Location and Court Register" under "Further Information".

name: Report Vehicle or Trailer Defect Rectification
description: A service to report that defects found on a vehicle or trailer have been repaired and corrected.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
requiredDocuments: Proof of defect rectification (according to requirements in the defect report or written notice from the registration authority); online submission possible
Notification must include your name and address, as well as the vehicle registration plate
Confirmation from the specialist workshop by: Invoice (confirmation of order is not sufficient) or stamp on the defect card or manufacturer's participation certificate for a recall action
HU report if main inspection has expired
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Enforcement Measures for Monetary Claims
description: This service enables creditors to initiate compulsory enforcement proceedings against a debtor to collect a monetary debt through the court bailiff.
eligibility: You must be a creditor with a valid enforcement title (court decision with enforceable content), such as court judgments, enforcement orders from a dunning procedure, cost fixing orders, court settlements, or notarial deeds. The enforcement title must have been served on the debtor. You must also have an enforcement clause (a notation on the enforcement title permitting you to initiate compulsory enforcement against the debtor), unless you have an enforcement order from a German dunning procedure or another exception applies. The enforcement clause must be issued by the authority that created the enforcement title, must bear an official designation, be signed, and be sealed. For certain enforcement titles, enforcement cannot begin until two weeks after service on the debtor, including cost fixing orders not contained in the judgment, orders in simplified proceedings regarding child support, settlements concluded before a lawyer and declared enforceable, and certain notarial or court documents.
requiredDocuments: Enforcement order to the court bailiff (form available under 'Forms') — you can check boxes to specify what the court bailiff should do; you may also submit this via the Electronic Court and Administrative Mailbox (EGVP) under 'Further Information'

Enforcement title (original) — such as judgments, enforcement orders from a dunning procedure, cost fixing orders, court settlements, or notarial deeds; if the enforcement title has not yet been served, check this in the order; you must already have an enforcement title in your possession; if you have an enforcement order from a dunning procedure and wish to enforce no more than €5,000.00, you may request enforcement via secure electronic means and need only submit a scanned copy of the enforcement order
Enforcement clause (original)
Statement of claims — if you have incurred additional costs (such as prior enforcement costs) or made payments, please list these in a statement of claims
Proofs — costs listed in the statement of claims must be supported by attached receipts or documents

Declaration regarding the existence of the claim — if you submit the enforcement order electronically via the court's EGVP, you must declare that you have a copy of the enforcement order together with proof of service and that the claim still exists in the amount requested
fees: €25.00 to €200.00 in fees per order depending on the case; additional costs may apply for service, witnesses, information requests, locksmiths, storage, and similar expenses; you may apply for legal aid or assistance with court costs (see 'Further Information')
processingTime: Processing time is normally 3 months.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court (Amtsgericht) in the district where the debtor resides or where the enforcement measure is to take place; for businesses, the District Court at the place of business of the debtor.

name: Enforcement Measures - Restitution Enforcement
description: This service enables you to enforce a court decision requiring another party to return or vacate property by engaging a court bailiff to carry out the enforcement action.
eligibility: You must have an enforceable court title (a court decision with enforceable content), such as judgments, court orders (for example, a judgment from an auction), court-approved settlements, or notarized documents. The property to be returned must be precisely identified in the court title. You must have an enforcement clause — a notation on the court title that authorizes you to initiate enforcement against the debtor. The enforcement clause typically reads: "This certified copy is issued to the plaintiff for the purpose of enforcement" and must be issued by the originating authority, signed, and sealed. The court title must be served on the other party before or at the same time enforcement begins; service generally occurs by the court ex officio, with proof noted on the title or enforcement clause. If you lack proof of service, you may also instruct the court bailiff to serve it. If you wish to enforce before the judgment becomes final and the decision is only enforceable upon posting security, you must provide proof of the security deposit. Any additional enforcement prerequisites will be explained by the court bailiff after you issue the enforcement order. If your enforcement concerns a residential eviction and the other party was given a notice period in the judgment, the eviction may only proceed after that period expires.
requiredDocuments: Enforcement order to the court bailiff (available under "Formulare") — submit the order in writing and specify what the court bailiff should do
Enforcement title (original) — attach the court order, judgment, or settlement on which your restitution claim is based
Enforcement clause (original) with proof of service
Proof of security deposit (if applicable) — required if you begin enforcement before the court decision is final
fees: €26.00 for engaging the court bailiff to remove movable items; additional costs and time surcharges may apply if the enforcement action exceeds three hours. €100.00 for eviction of real property (apartment, cellar, garden) by the court bailiff without removal of movable items. €150.00 for eviction of real property with a moving company, plus additional costs. Additional costs may include moving company fees, witness fees, locksmith fees, and storage costs for evicted goods; expenses for eviction with a moving company typically total several thousand euros.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court (Amtsgericht) of the location where the property is situated. The District Court forwards the enforcement order to the responsible court bailiff.

name: Measures for Opening Foreign Markets - Apply for Funding for Network Development Projects
description: This service provides grant funding for network development projects by Berlin-based business-related institutions seeking to expand into foreign markets.
eligibility: You must represent a business-related institution (chambers, associations, or sector networks) based in Berlin that wishes to carry out the aforementioned projects. The project duration should be between 1 and 3 years. Funding is not permitted if other public subsidies are claimed for the same purpose. The project must not have begun before the application is submitted. The network project must be in the special economic interest of the Land Berlin. A mandatory consultation meeting with the responsible contact person at the Senate Department for Economics, Energy and Enterprises must take place before application.
requiredDocuments: Application form PfI Network (online submission via IBB or printed form with all attachments sent by post to IBB)
Detailed project description with justification of the application regarding the special economic interest of the Land Berlin
Detailed work plan, timeline, cost plan, and financing plan
Self-presentation of the applicant institution including representation of the company's economic situation and business report if applicable
Current register extract from the commercial, cooperative, foundation, or association register, or copy of register registration in case of business start-up
Signature specimen sheet
Copy of identity card (front and back) or passport with registration certificate (Meldebescheinigung) for all persons listed in the signature specimen sheet
Declaration of Politically Exposed Person (PEP) for all beneficial owners

Declaration according to § 3 paragraph 1 Performance Provision Regulation (LGV) if grant amount is 25,000 euros or more (only the state funding portion is decisive) and for beneficiaries with more than 10 employees
Proof from the tax office if not entitled to input tax deduction
processingTime: 8 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Support for Measures to Access Foreign Markets - Funding for Joint Projects
description: This service provides funding support for joint projects by Berlin-based business institutions aimed at accessing and developing foreign markets.
eligibility: You must be a representative of a business-related institution (chambers, associations, or industry networks) based in Berlin that wishes to carry out the above-mentioned projects. The measure must not have begun before the application is submitted to the Investment Bank Berlin (start is defined as conclusion of a supply and performance contract; however, registration for a trade fair or event, related contract conclusion, and/or related payments before application submission are permitted and generally eligible). Applications for measures listed in the State Trade Fair Plan should be submitted no later than twelve weeks after the announcement of the State Trade Fair Plan. Applications for measures not listed in the State Trade Fair Plan should be submitted no later than six weeks before the start of the measure. Funding is not permitted if other public subsidies are claimed for the same purpose.
requiredDocuments: PfI Community application form (online application via IBB or printed, signed, and submitted by post)
Comprehensive concept for the measure including detailed description of individual measures and their objectives
Justification of the application regarding Berlin's special economic interest (except for measures listed in the State Trade Fair Plan)
Detailed budget, financing, and schedule plan
Self-presentation of the applying institution
Current registry extract from the commercial, cooperative, foundation, or association register, or copy of registration for new businesses
Specimen signature sheet
Copy of identity card (front and back) or passport with registration certificate for all persons listed on the specimen signature sheet
Declaration of politically exposed person (PEP) for all beneficial owners
Declaration pursuant to § 3 para. 1 of the Performance Provision Regulation (LGV), if subsidy amount is 25,000 EUR or more (only state funds counted) and for recipients with more than 10 employees
Proof from tax office if not entitled to input tax deduction
processingTime: 8 weeks

eligibility: There must already be a proceeding pending before a Berlin civil court (District Court, Regional Court, or Court of Appeals). Both parties must consent to mediation.

eligibility: An ongoing court proceeding must already be pending at the Social Court Berlin or Administrative Court Berlin. The parties to the proceedings must consent to mediation.

name: Request a Registration Certificate
description: A service to obtain an official registration certificate (Meldebescheinigung) confirming your residence registration in Berlin.
eligibility: Minimum age 16 years; you are registered in Berlin; for online application: BundID registration/login (register at BundID if you do not have an account); for online application: activated online identification function requiring your electronic ID card, EU citizen ID card (eID-Karte), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated online identification function and six-digit PIN, plus an external card reader or modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS, and the AusweisApp software; a residence certificate (Lebensbescheinigung) can only be requested in person at a Citizens' Office; if applying by proxy: written power of attorney (proxy applications only possible in person at a Citizens' Office); for written applications: advance transfer of the fee.
requiredDocuments: Application form for registration certificate (online, in person at any Citizens' Office with or without appointment, or by post/email)
Payment proof and transfer confirmation for written applications (copy)

Identity document: electronic ID card, EU citizen ID card (eID-Karte), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated online identification function and PIN (for online); original ID card or passport (for in-person); copy of ID card or passport (for written applications)

Written power of attorney with personal details, signature, and representative's information, plus representative's ID card or passport (if applying by proxy); original ID document if German ID card or passport not issued in Berlin or if foreign document
Proof of fee exemption (e.g., social benefits notification) if applicable for recipients of social benefits or pension matters
fees: Free if you submit the application online; free as residence certificate (Lebensbescheinigung) for pension matters, SGB II or XII cases, and other exceptions per legal basis; €10.00 per person for in-person or written applications; €5.00 additional per further family member (for relatives with identical registration periods combined on one certificate) for in-person or written applications
processingTime: Immediately for online or in-person applications; 1–2 weeks for written applications

bookingInfo.office: In-person applications accepted at all Berlin Citizens' Offices (Bürgerämter) of your choice without prior appointment booking (some locations optionally offer appointment scheduling); written applications can be submitted to any Citizens' Office by mail or in person; online applications handled by the State Office for Citizens' and Regulatory Affairs (Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten)

name: Registration Register — Request a Data Disclosure Block (Auskunftssperre)
description: This service allows you to request a data disclosure block on your registration record to prevent your personal information from being released to third parties if you can demonstrate that doing so would pose a danger to your safety or wellbeing.
eligibility: You must have compelling reasons and must credibly demonstrate the danger to the registration authority. You must credibly show that you or another person could face danger to life, health, personal freedom, or similar protected interests through the release of registration information. The authority must verify that the danger you have described is substantiated.
requiredDocuments: Application for data disclosure block — submit a written informal application with detailed justification by mail to the State Office for Citizen and Administrative Affairs (LABO), or alternatively submit and/or file the application at a Citizen Office (Bürgeramt)

Detailed justification — in your application you must present facts and credibly demonstrate why releasing your information would pose a danger to your life, health, personal freedom, or similar protected interests
Objective evidence (copies) — for example witness statements, police confirmations, medical certificates
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: State Office for Citizen and Administrative Affairs (LABO). Submit your written informal application with detailed justification by mail to LABO, or alternatively submit and/or file the application at a Citizen Office (Bürgeramt).

name: Registration Records - Request Correction of Data
description: A service allowing Berlin residents to request corrections to inaccurate or incomplete personal data in the registration records (Melderegister).
eligibility: Your data in the registration records is incorrect or incomplete. You can only request corrections to data that concerns you; you cannot submit an application for other persons. The registration authority must be made aware of or be informed of the correct data.
requiredDocuments: Request for correction of data in the registration records (informal written request, which can be submitted in writing or in person at a Bürgeramt)
Documents proving the correct data (documents that demonstrate that the personal data processed is incorrect or incomplete)
Proof of identity (if required in individual cases: identity card, passport, children's passport for German nationals, or national passport or travel document substitutes for foreign nationals)
processingTime: Processing time may range from a few days to several weeks, depending on the scope of the correction.

bookingInfo.office: This service is available at all citizen service offices (Bürgerämter) in Berlin.

name: Population Register - Data Transmission to Public Authorities (Authority Information Requests)
description: A service that enables public authorities to request and receive data from Berlin's population register through centralized channels.
eligibility: Technical requirements: Inquiries from Berlin's population register must be managed through central offices in the respective federal states; all federal states have the technical infrastructure in place for retrieval through central offices. Written form: Data transmission in written form is provided as an exception under § 34 para. 2 sentence 5 no. 1 BMG only in cases where data transmission via automated procedure or electronic data transmission is not available at the requesting authority. In such cases, data transmissions are subject to an administrative fee under § 34 para. 2 sentence 2 BMG.
fees: Data transmissions from registration authorities to other public authorities within Germany are generally free of charge. This does not apply to special assets and operations of the State of Berlin that prepare business plans, as well as equivalent profit-oriented institutions of legal entities under public law and credit institutions under the Credit Institutions Act (§ 2 para. 2 Administrative Fees Regulations). Data transmissions in written form or by sending data carriers in secured form are only free of charge if the registration authority is responsible for the reasons for non-use of the automated retrieval.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: State Office for Citizens' and Public Order Affairs (LABO) as the central office for the State of Berlin.

name: Registration Register - Simple Registration Register Information Request
description: Request basic information about a person from the Berlin registration register, subject to eligibility requirements and data protection rules.
eligibility: The person you are inquiring about must be clearly identifiable based on information you provide (such as birth date or a previously known address). There must be no information lock (Auskunftssperre) on the registration record. If the data will be used for advertising or address trading purposes, you must have explicit written consent from the person in question. For commercial use, you must specify the purpose, and the data can only be used for that stated purpose. Data obtained for commercial address determination purposes cannot be reused by recipients (data pooling prohibition).
requiredDocuments: Application form for simple registration register information (use online procedure, or complete the sample form and submit by mail to registration office/citizen office, or submit in person at a citizen office)
Payment proof in copy (for written applications only) - specify on the transfer document: Registration register information about [surname, first name of inquired person]
Declaration that the information will not be used for advertising and address trading purposes, or alternatively written consent from the person in question
fees: €5.00 per person for online application; €10.00 per person for written application or in-person application
processingTime: Immediate for online applications; several weeks for written applications depending on inquiry volume at the respective registration office

bookingInfo.office: Written applications can be sent to the State Office for Citizen and Administrative Affairs (LABO) or to a citizen office (Bürgeramt). Alternatively, you can submit the application in person at a citizen office.

name: Register Office - Extended Register Information Request
description: Request an extended report from the Berlin registration office about a specific person's registration data, for legitimate purposes.
eligibility: You must demonstrate a legitimate interest in obtaining the information in writing for each request. The person you are seeking must be clearly identifiable based on the information you provide — you must already have some data about that person, such as their date of birth or a known former address. No information can be provided if there is a blocking notation in the registration office. If you intend to use the data for advertising or address trading purposes, you must have written consent from the affected person; without this consent, the registration office cannot release the data for such purposes. If you use the data for commercial purposes, you must specify those purposes, and the data may only be used for them; misuse can result in a fine. Once your stated purpose is fulfilled, you must delete the data.
requiredDocuments: Application form for extended registration information (filled out and submitted by post or in person at a citizen office or state office)

Proof of legitimate interest, such as: a payment order; an enforcement notice related to a dunning order; or other documentation of legal relationships like contracts, court judgments, or appointment as estate administrator
Proof of payment (copy) — specify on the transfer form: Extended registration information about [surname, first name of requested person]
Declaration that the information will not be used for advertising or address trading purposes, or alternatively consent declaration from the affected person
processingTime: Written applications are processed in the order they are received and payment is confirmed. Processing typically takes several weeks depending on the volume of requests at the respective registration office. Please avoid follow-up inquiries.

bookingInfo.office: Submit written applications to the State Office for Citizen and Regulatory Affairs (LABO) or to a citizen office (Bürgeramt). You may also submit and/or file the application in person at a citizen office.

name: Request for Registration Register Information from the Archives
description: Request historical registration information for a person who was registered in Berlin between 1945 and 1980.
eligibility: The person must have been registered in Berlin from 01.01.1961 to 1980 in the former Western part, or from May 1945 to 1989/1990 in the former Eastern part. You must specify the purpose for which you need the information. Payment must be transferred in advance to the account of the State Office for Citizens' and Regulatory Affairs (LABO), with the reference: Melderegisterauskunft über [name of the person requested].
requiredDocuments: Application for extended registration register information (archive information) submitted in writing by mail
Full name of the person being searched (including maiden name for married women)
First name or common name
Date of birth
Occupation (reference only, not a search criterion)
Documentation of the reason for the request (e.g., appointment letter)
Proof of payment (copy) - please include a copy of the payment receipt if possible
processingTime: 4 to 6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: State Office for Citizens' and Regulatory Affairs (LABO): for archive information for the years 01.01.1961 to 1980 in Berlin (former Western part) and May 1945 to 1989/1990 in Berlin (former Eastern part); State Archives Berlin: for registration documents of persons for years before 1960 (former Western part) and before May 1945 (former Eastern part) who have moved from Berlin or deceased

name: Register Information Request for Property Owners and Landlords (Melderegister)
description: A service that allows property owners and landlords to request information from the resident registration records about tenants in their rental properties, provided they can demonstrate a legal interest.
eligibility: You are the owner or landlord of the rented apartment; you can credibly demonstrate a legal interest.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a resident registration record (Melderegisterauskunft) in special cases as owner or landlord — submit an informal written application by mail, or in urgent cases submit in person at a local Bürgeramt office
Proof that you are the owner or landlord, for example a copy of the land registry extract (Grundbuchauszug)
Justification — a brief written explanation of your legal interest
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You can submit your application by mail to any local Bürgeramt (citizen office) or to the Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten (LABO).

name: Register Transmission Blocks (Melderegister) — Entry or Deletion

eligibility: You must be an adult; your primary residence must be in Berlin; for online applications: registration/login with a BundID account or guest access; for online applications: activated online identification function (eID). For BundID registration using the 'online identification' variant, you will need: your electronic ID card or EU citizen ID card (eID card) with activated online identification function (eID) and your PIN; an external card reader or a modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS operating system; the 'AusweisApp' software.
requiredDocuments: Application for entry of a transmission block in the residence register (use the online procedure; alternatively submit an unsigned application in writing by post to the LABO or apply in person at a citizen service office)
Identity card or passport (required for in-person applications at the office)
processingTime: Immediate (automated) for online applications; a few minutes for in-person applications at the office; approximately 1 week for written applications

eligibility: Commercial rental of your vehicle (self-drive rental vehicle) or repeated provision of your vehicle to third parties for payment (car-sharing). All documents must be submitted in original form.

Notification of termination of use of a vehicle as a self-drive rental vehicle (must be submitted informally and must include the lessor's name/business name and address, as well as the number, type, and official license plates of the vehicles)
Vehicle Registration Document Part I (Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I)
Vehicle Registration Document Part II (Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil II)
Previous license plates (not required if the vehicle has been decommissioned)

Electronic insurance confirmation (eVB) with the notation 'self-drive rental vehicle' for start of use; or eVB without this notation for termination of use
Trade registration certificate showing the requested business activity
Application for registration if applying in conjunction with vehicle registration
SEPA direct debit mandate
Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
Power of attorney if applicable, including identification document of the authorizing person (unless it is a notarized power of attorney) and identification document of the authorized representative

processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.
