requiredDocuments: Identity document (e.g. ID card)
processingTime: Immediate

bookingInfo.office: Available at all citizen offices (Bürgerbüros) in Berlin. No appointment required.

name: Passport - Report Recovery of Lost Passport
description: This service allows Berlin residents to report that they have recovered their previously lost passport, including provisional passports and children's passports.
eligibility: You must have recovered your lost passport (this also applies to provisional passports and children's passports). You must appear in person — the report can only be made on-site and only by you personally. You must reside in Berlin and be registered here; a secondary residence in Berlin is sufficient.
requiredDocuments: Report form for recovery of the passport (to be completed in person at the office)
The recovered passport
processingTime: A few minutes

bookingInfo.office: This service can be accessed at all Citizens' Offices (Bürgterämter) in Berlin.

name: Passport Pickup
description: A service to collect your completed passport from the Berlin citizen office where you applied for it.
eligibility: You must pick up your passport in person at the citizen office (Bürgeramt) where you applied for it. If you cannot pick it up yourself, you may authorize another person in writing to collect it on your behalf. If you are under 18 years old and wish to collect your passport yourself, you will need written authorization from one of your legal guardians (for example, a parent). You can optionally check your application status online by providing your date of birth and the serial number (if you have it). You can register your email address to receive a pickup notification.
requiredDocuments: Your previous passport (if available), even if it has already expired but has not yet been invalidated
Written authorization from your legal representative if someone else is collecting the passport on your behalf
processingTime: Approximately 10 minutes

bookingInfo.office: Pick up your passport at the citizen office (Bürgeramt) where you applied for it. Pickup is available at all Berlin citizen offices without requiring a prior appointment booking. Some locations additionally offer the option to book an appointment. If you are newly naturalized and applied for your passport at Sellerstraße, you can pick up your passport at the "Bürgeramt Klosterstraße - Document Pickup" location.

name: Apply for a Passport
description: This service allows German citizens to apply for a travel passport (Reisepass) in Berlin, with options for standard or expedited processing.
eligibility: You must be a German citizen. Personal attendance at the appointment is required for the applicant (including minors). For minors under 18 years old, the legal guardian(s) must submit the application, and the child must also be present. You must have your place of residence registered in Berlin (exceptions possible); a secondary residence (second home) in Berlin is sufficient if an important reason exists, though this increases costs. If you are not registered in Berlin but are staying there temporarily, are homeless, or are visiting for tourism, you may also apply at the State Office for Citizens' and Public Order Affairs. A provisional passport is only possible if you can demonstrate you urgently need a passport and expedited processing is not possible before your travel date.
requiredDocuments: 1 current digital biometric passport photo (new rules effective 01.05.2025) — biometric photos must be created digitally only at government citizen offices (Bürgerämtern) or certified photo studios and transmitted securely; if you belong to a religious community required to wear head coverings in public, you must provide evidence of this at initial application; for babies and small children under 6 years, advance digital biometric photos can be taken at a certified photo service and retrieved by the citizen office from the cloud
Your old document (if available) — bring it even if expired or invalidated
Your valid document (if available) — for example your ID card or old passport

Birth certificate, marriage certificate, or registered partnership certificate (if applicable) — required if you have never had a document such as an ID card or passport, or if your personal details differ from those stored in the registration office (for example, after marriage or name change)

Written consent and ID document from a non-present legal guardian (if applicable) — required when applying for a passport for a minor; if both parents have custody, are not separated, and one parent is not present, the absent parent must provide written consent and their ID/passport must be brought for signature verification; if parents with joint custody are permanently separated, only the parent with whom the minor is registered as primary residence may apply

Passport or ID card of the former nationality, or identification certificate from the State Office for Immigration (LEA), plus naturalization certificate (if applicable) — required if you were naturalized and are applying for German documents for the first time
fees: €37.50 for applicants under 24 years old; €70.00 for applicants 24 years or older (fee doubles if Berlin is not your main residence); €32.00 additional for expedited passport; €22.00 additional for 48-page passport; €6.00 additional for photo taken on-site; €15.00 additional for direct mail delivery
processingTime: Up to 8 weeks (ask when you submit your application); or at most 4 working days if you submit the application before 11:00 am at the citizen office

bookingInfo.office: This service is available at all citizen offices (Bürgerämter) in Berlin, regardless of your place of residence.

name: Passport for persons not registered in Berlin, tourists, and Germans residing abroad
description: This service issues German passports to individuals not registered in Berlin, tourists, and German citizens with residence outside Germany.
eligibility: You must possess German citizenship. Personal appearance is required in all cases. For minors, the child must be present at the time of application and the application must be submitted by the legal representative (typically both parents).
requiredDocuments: One current digital biometric passport photo (new regulation as of 01.05.2025) - Biometric passport photos for travel and identity documents may only be created digitally directly at the authority (LABO) or in certified photo studios and transmitted via secure electronic means. If you belong to a religious community that requires members not to appear in public without head covering, you must provide evidence of this at initial application.
Existing passport, or otherwise identity card (valid or expired)
For those with residence abroad: proof of foreign residence (requirements vary by country; consult German embassy or consulate websites to avoid delays) and information sheet for Germans abroad
Civil registry document (birth certificate or marriage certificate) - only required if there are discrepancies from previous entries, such as name changes due to marriage
fees: €37.50 for under 24 (regular passport); €70.00 for 24 and over (regular passport); €26.00 provisional passport; €75.00 for under 24 if applicant is not responsible office jurisdiction (€37.50 passport + €37.50 jurisdiction surcharge); €140.00 for 24 and over if not responsible office jurisdiction (€70.00 passport + €70.00 jurisdiction surcharge); €52.00 provisional passport if not responsible office jurisdiction (€26.00 passport + €26.00 jurisdiction surcharge); €22.00 surcharge for 48-page passport; €32.00 surcharge for express application
processingTime: Passports are ready for collection in eight weeks.

bookingInfo.office: Passports for persons not registered in Berlin (tourists) can be applied for exclusively at the State Office for Citizenship and Regulatory Affairs (Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten).

name: Request Preliminary Passport
description: This service allows German citizens to apply for a temporary travel document when an immediate passport is urgently needed and express processing cannot be completed before departure.
eligibility: You must be a German citizen with residence in Berlin (exceptions possible for those without permanent housing, temporarily in Berlin, or tourists). Personal appearance is mandatory for the applicant and any minors. For minors under 18, a legal guardian must apply and the child must be present. The preliminary passport is only issued if you can demonstrate urgent need and express passport production is not possible before travel.
requiredDocuments: 1 current digital biometric passport photo (as per regulations from 01.05.2025)
Your old document if available (even if expired or invalidated)
Valid ID document if available (e.g., national ID card or old passport)
Civil status certificate if needed (birth certificate, marriage certificate, or registered partnership certificate)
Written consent and ID document of absent legal guardian if applying for a minor (if applicable)
Previous country's passport or ID card, or identity certificate from the State Office for Immigration (LEA), if you were naturalized and are applying for German documents for the first time
fees: 26.00 euros for the preliminary passport; if Berlin is not your primary residence, this fee doubles and additional expenses may be charged; 6.00 euros additional for passport photo taken on-site
processingTime: Immediately

bookingInfo.office: This service can be obtained at all citizen offices (Bürgerämter) in Berlin (except for tourists, who must apply at the State Office for Citizen and Regulatory Affairs)

name: Compensation Request for Honorary Judges in Specialized Courts
description: Request reimbursement for compensation and expenses incurred while serving as an honorary judge in a specialized court.
eligibility: You must have been summoned to serve as an honorary judge in a specialized court and appeared at that hearing; application must be submitted within 3 months of the court date.
requiredDocuments: Completed compensation request form (obtained with summons, at hearing, or from the court office)
Attendance certificate and payment authorization signed by the presiding judge
Earnings loss certificate from employer (if applicable)
Evidence of self-employment status, such as business license, average monthly gross income, and regular working hours (if self-employed)
Documentation of freelance activity, average monthly income, and regular working hours (if freelancer)
Receipts or proof of travel and other expenses incurred, such as original tickets, booking confirmations, flight invoices, or accommodation costs
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application in person at the court office, by mail, by fax, or via electronic means to the address on your summons; or submit in person at the Compensation and Reimbursement Office (Ground Floor, Room 0204) or Administrative Department (1st Floor, Room 1508).

name: Rundfunkbeitrag - Request Exemption or Reduction
description: This service allows residents to request an exemption from or reduction of the broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag) if they receive certain state social benefits, have disabilities, or face financial hardship.
eligibility: You may apply for an exemption if you receive state social benefits including Bürgergeld, assistance for living expenses under SGB XII, basic security for seniors and those with reduced work capacity, BAföG, vocational training assistance, benefits under the Asylum Seeker Benefits Act, blind assistance, care allowance/participation allowance, care assistance under SGB XII, or care supplements under the Equalization of Burdens Act; or if you are deafblind or receive blind assistance. You may apply for a reduction if you have a disability, are blind or hearing-impaired, and have been granted the RF identification mark on your severely disabled person's identification card. You may request an exemption as a special hardship case if you do not receive social benefits because your income exceeds the applicable threshold by less than EUR 18.36.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from broadcasting fee obligation or reduction of broadcasting fee, to be sent by post to the Beitragsservice of ARD, ZDF and Deutschlandradio
Severely disabled person's identification card with RF mark (certified copy); certification of the original will be provided free of charge at the citizen office if you present in person

Documentation of receipt of social benefits (in copy form), for example a copy of your BAföG decision; if you receive social benefits, a visit to the citizen office is not necessary — send your completed application and certificate directly to the Beitragsservice
For hardship cases: rejection decision from the social benefits provider
Rejection decision from the social benefits provider for minor income threshold exceedance to be submitted as a special hardship case
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: 20 cents per call from all German networks

name: Request Compensation for Expert Witnesses in Criminal and Administrative Offense Proceedings
description: A service that allows expert witnesses commissioned by courts or investigating authorities to request compensation for their work in criminal and administrative offense proceedings.
eligibility: You must have been commissioned by a court or investigating authority to prepare an expert report and must have performed work within the scope of that commission. Additionally, you must submit your compensation claim within three months of: (1) receipt of your written report by the commissioning authority, or (2) the end of the hearing at trial, or (3) if multiple hearings occurred, the end of the last hearing. If the commission ends early, the three-month period begins when you are notified of the early termination.
requiredDocuments: Application for Expert Witness Compensation (available under 'Forms')
Payment authorization form original and one copy (Form HKR 174, provided after your release from the hearing, documenting your attendance)
Invoice for written expert report (submit in duplicate with your written report, referenced by case number)
Documentation of travel costs or other expenses incurred (original receipts/documentation)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: If you worked for the Court of Appeals (Kammergericht), you will receive compensation from that court; in all other cases, compensation is handled by the District Court Tiergarten (Amtsgericht Tiergarten).

name: Request Compensation for Expert Witnesses in Civil Court Proceedings
description: This service allows court-appointed expert witnesses to request payment for their work on expert reports and testimony in civil legal cases.
eligibility: You must have been commissioned by the court to prepare an expert report and must have performed work within the scope of that commission. Your compensation claim must be submitted to the court that commissioned you within three months. The deadline begins: for written reports, when your report is received by the court; for testimony at a hearing, when the hearing ends. If you are called multiple times (e.g., at continuation hearings), the deadline begins after the final hearing ends. If your commission or engagement ends early, the deadline begins once you receive notice of the early termination.
requiredDocuments: Invoice for the written expert report (submit in duplicate with your written report using the case reference number)
Receipts for travel expenses or other costs incurred (original documents)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The court for which you provided expert services is responsible for handling your request.

name: Request Compensation and Reimbursement for Expert Witnesses in Specialized Courts
description: This service allows expert witnesses commissioned by courts to request payment and reimbursement for their work, including compensation for expert reports, translations, interpretations, travel costs, and other expenses incurred during court proceedings.
eligibility: You must have been commissioned by the court to prepare an expert report or findings report, provide translation or interpretation services at a hearing, or assist as an expert witness in another capacity, and must have performed work within the scope of your commission. Additionally, you must submit your compensation claim within 3 months of the relevant deadline (from receipt of your written report, end of hearing, or notification of early termination by court order).
requiredDocuments: Compensation and reimbursement application form (completed in full and submitted by post, fax, or in person)
Payment authorization and attendance certificate (signed by the court or presiding judge)
Invoice for written expert report or commission (submitted twice with the case reference number)
Original receipts and documentation of travel costs or other expenses incurred
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your completed written application in person at the office, in the mailbox of the Social Court Berlin, or by post, fax, or electronic means to the court that issued the summons. For specialized processing, you may submit your application in person at the Compensation and Reimbursement Office, Ground Floor, Room 0408, or at the Administration Department, 1st Floor, Room 1508.

name: Expert Witness Public Appointment and Oath - Crafts Chamber
description: This service allows qualified craftspeople to apply for public appointment as an expert witness authorized to provide professional assessments in their field of expertise.
eligibility: Applicants must meet four requirements: (1) Public need — the Crafts Chamber Berlin must determine that a public need exists for expert witnesses in the relevant field; (2) Special expertise — applicants must demonstrate above-average knowledge, skills, and practical experience in their field; (3) Personal suitability — applicants must be able to conduct expert assessments objectively and impartially, both in fact and in appearance; (4) Lawful practice of a craft in Berlin — applicants must be lawfully registered in the Berlin Crafts Register (Handwerksrolle), the register of trades not requiring licensing, or the register of craft-like trades, either as owner, personally liable partner, manager/director of a legal entity, registered business manager, or as an employee with written release from their employer during working hours if combining this role with employment.
requiredDocuments: Application for public appointment as expert witness (HWK)
Tabular curriculum vitae
Training and qualification documentation including above-average specialized knowledge and expertise certificates (e.g., master craftsperson certificate, training and continuing education records)
Commercial register extract (Gewerbezentralregisterauszug) for presentation to an authority (document type 9) — not older than three months
Certificate of good conduct (Führungszeugnis) for presentation to an authority (document type O) — not older than three months
Registration in the Berlin Crafts Register or proof of business manager function in an HWK-registered business — registration must have existed for at least 5 years
Attendance certificate for appropriate expert witness seminars covering fundamentals of expert witness practice (e.g., conducting site inspections, writing expert reports, billing procedures)
Tax clearance certificate (Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung) from the responsible local tax office
Health insurance clearance certificate (Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung) from the responsible health insurance company confirming proper payment of employee contributions
Work samples — at least 3 expert reports (Gutachten) related to your field of expertise
processingTime: Depends on the field of expertise; if all documents are complete, up to 18 months.

bookingInfo.office: The Berlin Crafts Chamber (Handwerkskammer Berlin). Applicants must be registered in the Crafts Register for the specific crafts or trades in which they wish to provide expert assessments. The business location as an expert witness must be in the Berlin Chamber district, or if no such location exists, the primary residence must be in the Berlin Chamber district.

name: Request Public Appointment and Oath for IHK Expert Witnesses
description: Apply to become a publicly appointed and sworn expert witness in your field of expertise through the Berlin Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IHK).
eligibility: Public need: There must be public demand for publicly appointed expert witnesses in the relevant field of commerce. The Berlin IHK will verify this public need. Special expertise: The applicant must demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Berlin IHK during the appointment procedure that they possess special expertise in the relevant field. According to consistent case law, above-average knowledge, skills, and practical experience in the relevant field are required. Personal suitability: The applicant must be personally suitable. This requires that the applicant not only provides assurance through personal qualities to perform expert activities objectively and impartially, but can also meet this requirement from the perspective of the public, considering their entire personal and professional environment.
requiredDocuments: Application for a consultation meeting for public appointment of expert witnesses (IHK)
Tabular curriculum vitae and photograph with detailed description of professional activities and previous expert witness experience
List of all expert reports from the past three years (work samples)
Reference list with at least five persons who can provide information on personal suitability and special expertise
Certified copies or photocopies of all relevant certificates, diplomas, or other documents (e.g., professional designations), employment records, etc.
Certificate of conduct (Führungszeugnis) for submission to an authority, not older than three months
Certificates of participation in continuing education events from the past three years in the requested field of expertise
Documentation of attendance at at least three seminars on necessary knowledge for preparing expert reports, court behavior, dealing with private clients, and liability and insurance matters
Tax clearance certificate (Steuerliche Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung) from the competent tax office

Certificates from the insolvency register: For natural persons resident in Berlin, two certificates are required—one from your local district court for consumer insolvency proceedings and one from the Amtsgericht Charlottenburg for regular insolvency proceedings (Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin). For legal entities and partnerships with business location in Berlin, apply to Amtsgericht Charlottenburg. Applicants with residence/business location outside Berlin should check the competent insolvency courts via the central local and court directory.
Employer release declaration (Freistellungserklärung) for expert witnesses in employment, service, or civil service relationships
fees: €1,000.00 to €3,000.00; plus approximately €2,500.00 for verification by a specialist committee
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: A consultation meeting for public appointment of expert witnesses can be requested online through the Berlin Unified Contact Point (Einheitlicher Ansprechpartner Berlin) portal or directly at the Berlin Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IHK zu Berlin). The IHK is responsible if the expert's business location or expert witness activity is within the Berlin chamber district. After successful public appointment and oath, you will be registered in the federal directory of expert witnesses.

name: Satellite Positioning Service (SAPOS) - Request Usage in Berlin
description: This service allows residents with GNSS equipment to apply for access to Berlin's satellite positioning service.
eligibility: GNSS equipment must be available.
requiredDocuments: Application for SAPOS usage in Berlin (can be submitted online or by post using the official form)
processingTime: 2 business days

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Report Damage Following an Accident Involving a Berlin State Vehicle
description: Report vehicle damage that occurred in a traffic accident involving a vehicle owned by the State of Berlin, such as fire trucks or police cars.
eligibility: Vehicle damage must have resulted from a traffic accident involving a motor vehicle owned by the State of Berlin (e.g., fire department or police vehicles). Standard statutory deadlines and limitation periods apply.
requiredDocuments: Damage report (submitted online or by post; online submissions must not exceed 30 MB total file size, with individual files limited to 20 MB)
Authorization form for confidentiality waiver for the purpose of examining damage compensation or pain and suffering claims
Personal data: Contact information (name, address) and bank account details for the claimant
Vehicle information: Make and model, Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) and owner details, Official registration number and current mileage, Year of first registration
Details of damage: Estimated damage amount, description of what was damaged
Incident details: Date and location of damage, information about who caused the damage and any witnesses, detailed description of the incident

Evidence: Photos of damage, accident report, invoices, cost estimates, expert assessments if applicable, release certificates if applicable, and other documents supporting the claim amount (please do not include sensitive data such as medical reports)
processingTime: Case-by-case basis

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Claim Damages - General Damage Case
description: This service allows residents to file a damages claim against Berlin state authorities for harm caused by government employees or facilities, including incidents involving police or fire departments.
eligibility: General damage case involving harm caused by employees or facilities of state administrations, particularly from official liability and incidents involving police and fire departments. Damage claim must exceed 200.00 euros. Standard statutory limitation periods and prescription periods apply.
requiredDocuments: Personal information for whom the damage claim is being filed
Contact details (name, address)
Bank account details
Damage amount (estimated or actual)
Identity of the party that caused the damage
Date when the damage occurred
Location where the damage occurred
Detailed description of the damage
Photos of the damage, expert assessments, invoices, cost estimates, and other damage-relevant documents
File size limit: total upload maximum 30 MB per submission, individual file maximum 20 MB (for online submission)
processingTime: Depends on individual case

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Report Pest Infestation
description: A service for reporting pest infestations to the appropriate health authority in Berlin.
eligibility: No requirements.
fees: The report is free of charge. The responsible party under the Pest Control Ordinance (Schädlingsverordnung) must bear the costs of pest control.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Health Department (Gesundheitsamt) responsible for the district where the pest infestation occurred is in charge.

name: Exhibition of Persons - Apply for Permission
description: A permission service for individuals or entities who wish to legally conduct exhibitions or public displays of persons, subject to reliability checks and suitable venue requirements.
eligibility: Personal reliability: Reliability is verified through various documents. The applicant must provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (Führungszeugnis) from the Federal Central Register and information from the Trade Register. Suitability of premises and location: The spaces used for the event must be suitable for the type and scope of intended use.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission to exhibit persons
Identity document (passport, national ID card, or other official identification document with photograph; residence permit if the applicant is not a citizen of an EU country)
Certificate of Good Conduct from the Federal Central Register for submission to a government authority (document type O) — no older than three months
Trade Register extract for submission to a government authority (document type 9) — no older than three months
Floor plans of all event spaces including operational areas (preferably at scale 1:100)
Building permit for the operational spaces authorizing use as an event venue
Current extract from the Commercial Register (for registered businesses); or Articles of Association/Charter (for companies in formation such as GmbH or AG)
fees: 100.00 to 1,500.00 euros, depending on effort required
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The permission must be requested from the district office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for the event venue location.

name: Exhibition of Persons — Extend Permission
description: This service allows you to renew your existing limited-term permission to exhibit persons in Berlin.
eligibility: You must already hold a valid limited-term personal permission to exhibit persons for the venue. You must demonstrate personal reliability, which is verified through official records including a certificate of conduct from the federal criminal register and a commercial register extract. The rooms and location must be suitable for the type and scope of the intended use.
requiredDocuments: Application for extension of permission to exhibit persons — submitted informally in writing or electronically (for example, by email), and must include information about the applicant and the event venue
Identity document — a national identity card or other official photo identification document; residence permit if the applicant is not a citizen of an EU country
Limited-term personal permission to exhibit persons — the original permit must be provided, clearly showing the expiration date and the reason for the time limit
Certificate of conduct for submission to an authority (Federal Criminal Register extract, form O) — no older than three months
Commercial register extract for submission to an authority (form 9) — no older than three months
Current extract from the commercial register — required if the applicant is a registered business; articles of association or statutes for companies under formation (GmbH, AG)
Floor plans — floor plans of all event rooms including operational areas, preferably at a scale of 1:100, if applicable
Building permit for the operational rooms authorizing use as an event venue, if applicable
fees: 50.00 to 500.00 euros, depending on administrative effort required
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit the application to the responsible district office (Ordnungsamt) for the event venue, which is also the original licensing authority.

name: File for Divorce
description: This service allows you to file for divorce through a lawyer at a Berlin family court, provided the marriage has failed and legal representation requirements are met.
eligibility: Legal representation is mandatory — you must be represented by a lawyer who will file your divorce petition with the court. You may consent to your spouse's petition without hiring your own lawyer. The marriage must have irretrievably broken down, which is presumed if you have been separated for one year and both spouses agree to the divorce, or if you have been separated for at least three years. If separated for less than three years and your spouse does not consent, you must prove the marriage has failed. The court may also grant a divorce regardless of separation duration if continuing the marriage would cause unreasonable hardship due to circumstances involving your spouse.
requiredDocuments: Divorce petition (to be filed by your lawyer with the court)
Photo identification
Marriage certificate in original or certified copy
Birth certificates of minor children in original or certified copy
fees: €3,000.00 minimum amount for the dispute value
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The divorce proceedings are conducted at one of four Berlin family courts. Your lawyer will inform you of the specific details and which court handles your divorce petition.

name: Schengen Visa Extension
description: This service allows eligible foreign residents to extend their Schengen visa under specific circumstances such as force majeure, humanitarian reasons, or serious personal grounds.
eligibility: Extension is available only in cases of force majeure, humanitarian reasons, or serious personal grounds. Force majeure includes situations such as no flight traffic due to weather or strikes. Humanitarian reasons include urgent medical treatment, travel inability, sudden illness, or serious events affecting close family members. Serious personal grounds include urgent business or professional matters that could not be foreseen before entry. Extension is also possible if a visa was not fully utilized due to delayed entry into Germany or another Schengen state. Applicants must demonstrate secured means of subsistence for the duration of the visa extension. Appointments are required and must be scheduled via contact form.
requiredDocuments: Passport with valid visa
Power of attorney with passport or ID card (if personal attendance is not possible)
Completed application form for extension of a Schengen visa

Proof of secured means of subsistence: declaration of support and proof of sufficient financial means of the inviting person (bank statement / three most recent salary statements / for self-employed, income certificate from tax advisor), or proof of own sufficient means, or if applicable, reference letter from the responsible embassy covering living expenses
Travel health insurance for the duration of the extended stay, or reference letter from the responsible embassy covering travel health insurance
Additional documentation for business or professional visas demonstrating public interest in the extension
fees: Free of charge if the Schengen visa is extended due to force majeure or humanitarian grounds; €30.00 if extended due to serious personal grounds or delayed entry; €60.00 for adults, €30.00 for minors
processingTime: Generally upon personal appearance; not stated on the page for processing duration

bookingInfo.office: The service can only be obtained at the Immigration Office (Landesamt für Einwanderung - LEA) at the Keplerstr. location in Berlin.

name: Compensation Request for Lay Judges (Schöffen)
description: Request reimbursement for expenses and lost income incurred while serving as a lay judge in court proceedings.
eligibility: The judge must certify your lay judge service after the hearing and authorize the compensation payment. You must submit your application no later than three months after the end of your current term of service.
requiredDocuments: Compensation request form for lay judges (available under 'Formulare') — included with your annual summons and again with the hearing reminder
Payment authorization from the hearing (HKR 177) signed by the judge — submit both original and copy, received at the end of the hearing
Certificate of lost earnings from your employer (if applicable) — form included with annual summons and hearing reminder
Proof of self-employment (e.g., business registration certificate) if self-employed, including average monthly gross income and regular working hours
Documentation of freelance activity if applicable, including average monthly income and regular working hours
Receipts and documentation for travel costs and other expenses (e.g., original tickets, booking confirmations, flight invoices, accommodation costs)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit to the Calculation Office (Berechnungsstelle) of the District Court (Amtsgericht) Tiergarten (also responsible for the Berlin Regional Court) by mail, deposit in the office mailbox (Old Building Room A 236), or hand over to the courtroom clerk after the hearing. Alternatively, submit to or file on record with the office or department where you served as a lay judge.

name: Illegal Scrap Disposal
description: A service for reporting and arranging the removal of illegally dumped waste materials.
eligibility: Report the illegal waste by telephone, in writing, or electronically.
requiredDocuments: Complaint form containing the following information: location and time, volume, responsible party (if known), personal details of the reporter
fees: Free of charge (potentially chargeable to the responsible party if identified).
processingTime: Up to 7 days for public roadways.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Debtor and Insolvency Counseling
description: This service provides counseling and assistance for individuals who are overindebted or unable to pay their living expenses and financial obligations.
eligibility: You are eligible if you are overindebted or facing insolvency, meaning you are no longer able to cover your living expenses, due installments, and invoices with your income and existing assets.
requiredDocuments: All documents proving overdebtedness
Documentation of income and expenses
Documentation of use of government assistance programs
Notices and wage tax certificates
Reminders and current statements of claims
Garnishment orders
Housing termination notices or eviction orders
Disconnection of energy and heating supply
Application for rent debt assumption under § 22 Abs. 8 SGB II
Application for account garnishment protection
Documentation of pending criminal proceedings
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The service can be accessed at a recognized debtor and insolvency counseling office in your residential district.

name: Debtor Registry - Information Request
description: A service that allows authorized persons to access information from the debtor registry online for specified legal purposes.
eligibility: You may access the debtor registry online only for the following reasons: for enforcement proceedings; to fulfill statutory obligations to verify economic reliability; to check conditions for granting public benefits; to prevent economic harm resulting from persons failing to meet their payment obligations; to the extent necessary for criminal prosecution and sentence enforcement; to obtain information about entries concerning yourself. Information obtained may only be used for the purpose for which it was obtained, and sharing with third parties is not permitted. Information must be deleted after the purpose is achieved. The online system logs and stores your query, including personal data, for 6 months.
requiredDocuments: Registration with ID card with eID function
Registration without ID card with eID function
Activation number (PIN) received by mail for first access to the debtor registry
Login credentials for subsequent access
fees: €4.50 per data record transmitted; €4.50 also applies for the response 'No data available'. Self-disclosure is free of charge.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Courts do not provide information themselves. Persons without internet access can register and, after receiving the PIN by mail, access the registry in person at any district court (Amtsgericht) as the enforcement court.

name: Debtor Registry - Information on Persons Who Have Accessed Your Entry
description: This service allows you to request information about who has accessed your entry in the debtor registry (Schuldnerverzeichnis).
eligibility: You must be registered in the debtor registry (Schuldnerverzeichnis).
requiredDocuments: Informal written request (can be submitted in writing or using the provided form; a separate request must be submitted for each entry)
Photocopy of your ID card (Personalausweis)
Current and complete address with proof of previous addresses from the registration office (Melderegister)
File reference number of the underlying entry (e.g., DR II file reference number of the bailiff/enforcement officer)
Name or designation of the ordering authority (e.g., name and first name of the bailiff/enforcement officer)
Case number from the central enforcement court (Verfahrensnummer des zentralen Vollstreckungsgerichts) — Berlin case numbers begin with F1112R
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court (Amtsgericht) Mitte is the responsible central enforcement court (zentrales Vollstreckungsgericht) for decisions on your request. Your application can be submitted at any district court.

name: Debtor Registry - Self-Disclosure
description: A service that allows individuals to view their own entries in the central debtor registry after registration and activation.
eligibility: Registration is required. You may register using a personal ID card with eID function by selecting 'Register with new personal ID card' and following the instructions in the ID app that opens in a separate window. Alternatively, without an eID-enabled ID card, select 'Registration Information', complete the required fields, and confirm by clicking 'Save'. You will receive a confirmation email with further instructions. After successful registration, you will receive an activation number (PIN) by mail, which you must use to access the debtor registry for the first time. For all subsequent access after initial viewing, select 'Login Public' and then 'Login'.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Users can register for the Central Debtor Registry (online) and, after receiving the PIN by mail, also view their entries in person at any district court (Amtsgericht) serving as an enforcement court.

name: Debtor Register - Request Early Deletion
description: A service to request early removal of an entry from Berlin's debtor register if the debt has been paid, the grounds for registration no longer exist, or a court has ordered suspension or removal.
eligibility: You must demonstrate full satisfaction of the creditor's claim; OR demonstrate that the grounds for registration are absent or have ceased to apply; OR submit an enforceable court decision ordering the removal or temporary suspension of the registration order.
requiredDocuments: Application for early deletion from the debtor register (available under "Forms") — may be submitted informally in writing or using the official form

Proof of full satisfaction of the creditor — a written declaration from the creditor or their representative confirming that the claim underlying the registration has been fully satisfied (instalment agreements or mere consent for early deletion are not sufficient)

Proof that grounds for registration are absent or have ceased to apply — for example, a copy of a court decision that rescinded the enforcement title underlying the registration or declared enforcement from that title to be impermissible
Enforceable copy of a court decision showing the removal or temporary suspension of the registration order
Statement of the case number from the central enforcement court (Berlin case numbers begin with F1112R....)
Court summons from the bailiff (Gerichtsvollzieher) for statement of assets
Registration order from the bailiff (Gerichtsvollzieher)
fees: None; possible service delivery costs may apply
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The application may be submitted to any district court (Amtsgericht). The District Court Mitte serves as the responsible central enforcement court for decisions on early deletion.

name: Debtor Registry Objection to Registration Order
description: This service allows you to file a written objection against a court bailiff's order to register you in the debtor registry within two weeks of receiving the order if you believe the registration is unjustified.
eligibility: You have received a registration order from the court bailiff; less than 2 weeks have passed since the order was served to you; you believe the registration order is unjustified. You can successfully object if there is no valid registration reason or if a registration obstacle exists, such as: a payment plan agreement has been concluded with the court bailiff; the creditor's claim has been paid in full; or the information in the registration entry is incorrect (e.g., your name, date of birth, or similar details are stated incorrectly).
requiredDocuments: Written objection against the registration order from the court bailiff (can also be submitted in person at the legal application office of the competent enforcement court, in which case you must bring your ID card or passport with registration certificate)
Documents related to the enforcement measure: a copy of the registration order from the court bailiff, together with proof of when the order was served to you

Evidence supporting the objection: written payment plan agreement with the court bailiff, receipt confirming payment of the creditor's claim, or the invalidated enforcement title issued by the creditor
fees: No fees are charged for this procedure. However, costs may apply for serving the decision to the parties at 3.50 euros per service according to item 9002 of the Court Costs Act cost schedule (KV GKG).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent enforcement court (Vollstreckungsgericht) is the one in the district where the court bailiff who served you the registration order operates.

name: School - Request Supplementary Care and Support (Ergänzende Förderung und Betreuung)
description: A service for Berlin residents to request supplementary educational support and childcare for school-age children.
eligibility: You must have registered residence in Berlin with all custodial parents and the child registered in Berlin. You must be the legal guardian of the child (typically both parents are guardians). All custodians must consent to the application; if you are the sole custodian, no consent from another party is needed. For children in grades 1-3, no needs assessment is required for care from 7:30 to 16:00. Extended care hours for grades 1-3 and grades 4-6 must be requested separately. The needs assessment is typically issued by the end of the third school year. Starting in grade 4, a new application must be submitted three months before the fourth grade begins.
requiredDocuments: Application form for supplementary care and support (Antrag auf ergänzende Förderung und Betreuung) — completed and signed by all custodians, normally submitted at school enrollment or later at the child's school. Forms vary by school type: open all-day school, full-time all-day school, or school with special education focus

Proof of consent from the other custodian — written authorization from the other custodial parent or written declaration of sole custody, which can be evidenced by a negative certificate or court order
Copy of foster care agreement, if the child is in foster care
Registration certificate (Meldebescheinigung) if there is a registration restriction

For children in upper or final stage at schools with special education focus on intellectual development or in grades 7-10 at contract schools with autism focus: Evidence of needs assessment including current employer confirmation of work hours and duration of employment, and confirmation of parental leave use (not older than 12 weeks); vocational training, course, or study certificate; evidence of self-employment (such as business registration or artist social insurance contribution notice)
For grade 4 and above: Declaration for determining cost participation in day care (income statement) for 01.01 to 31.12 of the last calendar year (in copy)

Income tax assessment of the last calendar year, or if not yet available, provisional income statements for the last calendar year (self-assessment of gross income is possible), or electronic wage tax certificate or December salary statement with annual sum

For parents without employment: Benefit notice from Jobcenter or Employment Agency, maternity and parental benefit notice, study or BAföG documentation, or for pensions the most recent and first pension notice and any supplementary pension notices
For parents paying child support for children not living in the household: maintenance order and proof of payment for the last three months
processingTime: Needs assessment approval is typically issued to parents within 6 to 8 weeks.

bookingInfo.office: Youth Welfare Office (Jugendamt) of the residential district

name: School - Request Approval for Private Schools
description: This service allows individuals and organizations to apply for official authorization to establish and operate a private school in Berlin.
eligibility: If you wish to establish a private school, please seek consultation with the Senate administration responsible for education. Approval requires a full-day school concept and compliance with Berlin School Law § 98.
requiredDocuments: Application for approval as a private school under § 98 Berlin School Law (non-formal written application)
Written statement of personal data of the school operator
Written statement of personal data of authorized representatives

Written documentation demonstrating the suitability of the operator and authorized representatives to responsibly lead a school (e.g., experience in establishing childcare facilities, pedagogical, school law, organizational knowledge, commercial/accounting knowledge)
Proof of professional qualification (curriculum vitae)
Extended police clearance certificate under § 30 para. 5 Bundesregistergesetz (evidence of reliability)
Extract from the association register or commercial register
Articles of association or bylaws of the association or limited company
Proof of non-profit status (tax exemption certificate from the financial authority)

Pedagogical concept - explicit presentation of the learning work standard, including mandatory subject areas, central topics, and expected subject-specific and cross-curricular competencies, with reference to the extent that regulations applicable to the corresponding public school will be applied and where deviations are planned
Presentation of supervision form in the concept
Presentation of special pedagogical priorities (curriculum or teaching plan)
Information on hourly schedule and hour distribution / weekly timetable
Information on framework curricula, learning documentation, and performance assessment
Information on teaching organization
Information on holiday regulations
Information on teaching and learning materials
Information on the planned structure of the school, including the number and types of grade levels to start with and an overview of the planned number of students
Notice of whether full-day operation is planned, and if so, in what form (open or bound full-day school)
References to deviations from official or submitted documents (e.g., curriculum)
Samples of planned certificate forms
For primary schools: demonstration of special pedagogical interest and that a public school of this type does not exist within reasonable distance
Demonstration of denominational or worldview school (if applicable)
For vocational schools: confirmation that the training and examination regulations for the respective public educational program (e.g., APO-BFS) form the basis of the requested program
If organizational or content deviations are planned, submit detailed concept explaining the deviations
Specification of the number of classes and frequencies of all educational programs
Specification of general entry requirements for the educational program
Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IHK) approvals (3-year OBF and OB)
Information on quality seals / audits / certificates
Information on support measures and supplementary offerings
List of internship companies and internship concept for the examined educational program
Demonstration that the school can equip students with the required competencies for final qualifications at the end of each educational program
List of participants with proof of meeting admission requirements
For vocational programs: listing of institutions offering internship places
For dual system educational programs (vocational school): proof that students are in a training relationship under the German Vocational Training Act (BbiG)
Teacher list with assignment to subjects of the hourly schedule
Organizational chart / list of other staff (e.g., administrative management)
Proof that school leadership, teachers, and supervision meet legal requirements both qualitatively and in number for students
Concept for substitute regulations
Salary structure or presentation of teacher compensation
Copy of model employment contract and salary table with written confirmation from the operator that employment contracts will be concluded accordingly
For marginal employment: model honorarium contract

Designation of school principal and corresponding proof of suitability (current curriculum vitae, extended police clearance certificate, copies of diplomas/master certificates/appointment documents or other certificates with corresponding examination certificates and/or further qualification evidence, employment references)
Application for teaching authorization for each teacher
Current curriculum vitae for each teacher (without time gaps)

Proof of academic training and examination or proof of comparable independent qualifications (copies of diplomas/master certificates/appointment documents or other certificates with corresponding examination certificates and/or further qualification evidence, employment references)

For teachers of non-German origin or without German as native language teaching German: proof of German language skills at least at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference (e.g., Goethe-Institut certificate)

Copy of extended police clearance certificate or written confirmation from the operator that the extended police clearance certificate (from date) has no entries; for new appointments not older than six months
Copy of employment contract and salary table with written confirmation from the operator that employment contracts will be concluded accordingly
For marginal employment: honorarium contract in copy
School location (address)
Lease agreement / proof of ownership
Site plan / floor plan of school building and outdoor areas (number of classrooms and recreational rooms, cafeteria, social spaces, media offerings / technical equipment, etc.)
Clearance certificate from the responsible district building office (building and fire safety)
Clearance certificate from the responsible district health office (hygiene)
Statement on use of sports facilities (e.g., gymnasium or corresponding contracts)
School and/or house rules
Information on school financing during the development phase
Presentation of students' and parents' participation rights (school constitution, §§ 67-93 SchulG)
Sample of planned school / training contract
School fee regulations (proof of compliance with non-segregation requirements)
List of registered students / class list (origin, age, entry requirements)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: School - Request School Psychological Counseling (SIBUZ)
description: This service provides psychological counseling and support for school-related issues through the school psychological services office (SIBUZ) in your school district.
eligibility: No prerequisites required.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: If you need support, please contact the SIBUZ in your school district.

name: School - Request State Recognition for Supplementary Schools
description: Apply for state recognition of a supplementary school that offers vocational training comparable to state-approved educational standards.
eligibility: You must operate a vocational training program that has been reported to the school supervisory authority for at least two years under § 102 of the School Act. Recognition can be granted if there is public interest in the vocational training offered, instruction follows a curriculum approved by the school supervisory authority in consultation with relevant Senate members, and final examinations follow an approved examination regulation. Recognition is only granted if the training is comparable in scope and requirements to state-approved vocational education, the examination meets requirements for orderly examination procedures, and the school supervisory authority can attend the examination. A decision on recognition cannot be made until at least two years after the supplementary school was opened.
requiredDocuments: Application from the school operator for recognition as a supplementary school (informal written application)
Evidence of public interest in the vocational training offered
Submission of a curriculum for approval
Submission of an examination regulation for approval
Proof that the training program has been operating for at least two years in this form
fees: 500.00 to 1,500.00 Euro depending on administrative effort
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request State Recognition for a Private School (Ersatzschule)
description: A service for private school operators to apply for official state recognition of their private school after meeting specific operational requirements.
eligibility: The private school must have been operating for at least two years; the first cohort of students must have completed the final grade level at the school; consultation with the State Department for Education (Senatsverwaltung für Bildung) is required.
requiredDocuments: Application from the school operator (Schulträger) for recognition as a state-recognized private school (formloses schriftlicher Antrag)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Protection Against Violence
description: This service provides legal protection for victims of violence, including assault, bodily harm, or psychological abuse such as stalking, through court-issued orders.
eligibility: You are a victim of violence, for example assault, bodily harm, or psychological violence such as stalking.
requiredDocuments: Application for protection against violence (submitted orally at the court's legal application office or in writing to the court; if you wish your address to be kept confidential, you must state this when applying)

Detailed written statement of facts describing the current incidents with specific dates; description of any past violent acts; each incident must be described as precisely as possible and clearly for the court to understand
Deliverable address of the perpetrator (usually the registered address, or the actual current address if police have already evicted them from your home)
Personal ID or passport (required for oral application at the court's legal application office)
Police case numbers and all documents provided by police (if available, should be submitted with or attached to the application)
Medical certificates or treatment records (if you received medical care after the violent incidents, these should be submitted with or attached to the application)
Photographs documenting your injuries (if available, should be submitted with or attached to the application)
fees: Court fees apply based on the procedural value. Additional costs may include court expenses for expert opinions and interpreter fees. Attorney fees may also apply. You can apply for legal aid (Verfahrenskostenhilfe) if you cannot afford the procedural costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The family court (Familiengericht) in the district where the act was committed; or the family court in the district where the shared residence of the parties is located; or the family court in the district where the perpetrator has their habitual residence.

name: Pregnancy Conflict Counseling
description: This service provides counseling to pregnant individuals facing a difficult decision about whether to continue their pregnancy.
eligibility: A minimum of three days must pass between receiving pregnancy conflict counseling and any potential abortion procedure. Abortion is only permitted up to the 12th week of pregnancy.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service is available at all locations of the Center for Family Planning.

name: Supplementary Pass (Beiblatt) for Severe Disability Certificate with or without Value Stamp
description: Request a supplementary pass to accompany your severe disability certificate (Schwerbehindertenausweis), optionally including a value stamp (Wertmarke) for public transport.
eligibility: You must have a valid two-color severe disability certificate (Schwerbehindertenausweis) with designation markers. Money must have been received by the Versorgungsamt (Social Welfare Office) for processing. The value stamp is free if you receive unemployment benefits (Bürgergeld), basic security assistance (Sozialhilfe), or equivalent social benefits. Otherwise, fees apply depending on the duration and your certificate's markers.
requiredDocuments: Application for value stamp with markers 'H', 'Bl', or 'Tbl' (can be submitted online or in writing)
Application for value stamp with markers 'G', 'Gl', or 'aG' (must be submitted in writing only)

Confirmation of receipt of ongoing social benefits (if applicable) — must be certified by the responsible authority with official seal or stamp (e.g., JobCenter, Social and Basic Security Office, Chief Welfare Office) and received by the Versorgungsamt before the supplementary pass is issued
fees: Free if you receive benefits for securing livelihood; Free if your severe disability certificate contains markers 'H', 'Bl', or 'Tbl'; €104.00 (instead of €91.00) for 12 months with markers 'G', 'Gl', or 'aG'; €53.00 (instead of €46.00) for 6 months with markers 'G', 'Gl', or 'aG'
processingTime: The value stamp is sent by the Versorgungsamt 2–3 days after payment is received.

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the Landesamt für Gesundheit und Soziales (State Office for Health and Social Affairs).

name: Replacement Issuance of Disability Certificate Supplement After Loss
description: This service allows holders of a valid disability certificate to request a replacement supplement after loss.
eligibility: Valid two-color disability certificate (Schwerbehindertenausweis)
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of the supplement with or without value stamp after loss (can be submitted online or by mail)
Written notification of loss (loss declaration) to request replacement issuance of the supplement with or without value stamp
processingTime: 2-3 business days

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the Berlin Social Welfare Office (Versorgungsamt Berlin)

name: Replacement Severe Disability Certificate - Request After Loss
description: This service allows Berlin residents who have lost their severe disability certificate to request a replacement copy.
eligibility: You have lost your severe disability certificate; you reside in Berlin
requiredDocuments: Application for replacement of the severe disability certificate after loss (can be submitted online, by email, by post, or in person)

Current photograph (from age 10 onwards) - must be submitted as a new photo if you did not consent to photo storage at a previous issuance; can be uploaded online, sent by email in JPG, PNG, or BMP format, mailed to the Versorgungsamt with name and reference number, or submitted in person
processingTime: Up to 10 working days after the photograph is received; immediate issuance is possible at the customer service center where the certificate can be handed out on the spot

bookingInfo.office: Versorgungsamt (Provision Office)

name: Apply for Severely Disabled Person ID Card
description: This service allows you to apply for, renew, or replace a Severely Disabled Person ID card (Schwerbehindertenausweis) if you have been certified with a disability degree (GdB) of 50 or higher.
eligibility: You must have been awarded a disability degree (GdB) of 50 or higher in a formal assessment procedure. You are applying for your first Severely Disabled Person ID card, or your existing card is damaged, expired, expiring soon, or there has been a change (name, disability degree, or special markers). You must be registered as resident in Berlin. If you have moved to Berlin from another federal state, your file must be transferred to the Berlin Versorgungsamt (provision office).
requiredDocuments: Current photograph (from age 10 onwards) — must be submitted online (JPG format), by email, by post, or in person; biometric photo not required; free photography available on-site upon request
Valid residence permit in Germany (copy) — required for non-EU citizens; EU citizens may submit a copy of their ID document instead
Power of attorney (written) — required if another person is receiving the card on your behalf
fees: No fees; free photography available on-site upon request
processingTime: Immediate issuance at the customer service center in-person, or 4-6 weeks by post after the photograph is received

bookingInfo.office: Versorgungsamt (Provision Office) Berlin only

name: Reporting Changes for Severe Disability Status
description: A service for notifying the Berlin office of changes to your severe disability determination status, such as address changes, name changes, or death.
eligibility: Severe disability determination procedure under the Severe Disability Rights Act (Schwerbehindertenrecht)
requiredDocuments: Change notification form for severe disability determination procedure (see 'Forms')
Proof of address or name change if applicable: ID card, passport, or other civil status documents such as name change certificate or marriage certificate
Death certificate if applicable
processingTime: Immediate

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the Berlin Versorgungsamt (Social Welfare Office)

name: Apply for Temporary Participation in Special Transport Service (Severe Disability)
description: This service allows severely disabled individuals who use wheelchairs or rollators to apply for temporary participation in a special transport service.
eligibility: You have submitted an application under severe disability law and have marked the letter "T" (Participation in Special Transport Service) on page 8, section IV of the form. You must be a wheelchair user or dependent on a rollator.
requiredDocuments: Application for temporary participation in special transport service (submitted in writing)
Proof of cost coverage for wheelchair or rollator from a health insurance company or other service provider
processingTime: 10 days after receipt of the cost coverage confirmation from the health insurance company or other service provider by the office.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Disability Support at Work — Request Accompanying Assistance for Employers
description: This service allows employers to request accompanying assistance (Begleitende Hilfe) for employees with severe disabilities in the workplace.
eligibility: The employee must be recognized as a severely disabled person with a degree of disability of at least 50 as determined by the Regional Insurance Office (Versorgungsamt), OR have a degree of disability of 30 or 40 with official equality status (Gleichstellung) granted by the Employment Agency (Agentur für Arbeit).
requiredDocuments: Application for Accompanying Assistance at Work (Antrag auf Begleitende Hilfe im Arbeitsleben) for employers — must include a statement of need
Recognition decision from the Regional Insurance Office (Anerkennungsbescheid) showing the severe disability determination — held by the employee
Equality status decision from the Employment Agency (Gleichstellungsbescheid) — held by the employee
Severely Disabled Person ID Card (Schwerbehindertenausweis) — held by the employee
Employment contract (Arbeitsvertrag) — held by the employer
Job description (Tätigkeitsbeschreibung) — to be prepared by the employer
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Supportive Assistance in Employment for Severely Disabled Employees
description: This service allows employees recognized as severely disabled to request supportive assistance in the workplace.
eligibility: Recognition as a severely disabled person: The employment authority (Versorgungsamt) must have awarded a disability degree of at least 50. Equivalence: For a disability degree of 30 or 40, equivalence with a severely disabled person must have been granted by the employment agency (Agentur für Arbeit).
requiredDocuments: Application for Supportive Assistance in Employment for Employees (available under "Forms") with justification of need required
Recognition decision from the employment authority (Versorgungsamt) — must be in possession of the employee
Equivalence decision from the employment agency (Agentur für Arbeit) — must be in possession of the employee
Severely disabled ID card (Schwerbehindertenausweis) — must be in possession of the employee
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Severe Disability - Pay Co-payment for Special Transport Service
description: Service for paying the required co-payment amount for the Berlin Special Transport Service (Sonderfahrdienst) if you have a disability eligibility number.
eligibility: You have an eligibility number for the Berlin Special Transport Service. With the eligibility number, you register with the transport service WirMobil. The co-payment is billed via the eligibility number. The transport service reports completed trips to LAGeSo for co-payment billing. You receive benefits from your social welfare provider: ongoing social assistance (SGB XII), ongoing basic security (SGB XII), ongoing benefits under SGB II (Bürgergeld), or cash allowance (pocket money) for residents in care facilities.
requiredDocuments: Benefit decisions from social welfare providers for reduced co-payment (ongoing social assistance under SGB XII, ongoing basic security under SGB XII, ongoing benefits under SGB II/Bürgergeld)
Documentation of cash allowance (pocket money) from social welfare provider for care facility residents, if applicable
fees: €2.05 per trip (up to 8th trip); €5.00 per trip (from 9th trip); €10.00 per trip (from 17th trip); €1.53 per trip (up to 8th trip); €3.50 per trip (from 9th trip); €7.00 per trip (from 17th trip); €2.00 per person per trip for more than one companion per eligible person; €2.05 cancellation fee for trips cancelled on the day of transport; €3.00 per person for transport up to 5 km beyond the state border
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be obtained from the Public Health Office (Versorgungsamt).

name: Disability Determination - Application for Recognition of Severe Disability
description: This service allows you to apply for official recognition of a disability if your health condition has impaired your ability to participate in society for more than 6 months.
eligibility: You must have a health condition lasting longer than 6 months that significantly impairs or prevents your participation in social life. Your health impairments must be documented with medical records. You are required to cooperate with the office by providing all relevant information and submitting required documents as copies. You must observe deadlines and request written extensions if needed to avoid rejection.
requiredDocuments: Application for Disability Determination (submit in writing by post using the provided form)
Missing documents and records in PDF format can be submitted later via the online service
Identity verification: Copy of front and back of identity card (Personalausweis)
Non-EU citizens: Official certification of residence status, which may be a color copy of passport or residence permit
Border workers maintaining residence abroad: Employment certificate from current employer
If representing another person: Power of attorney or guardian certificate
For applicants under 18 years old (from age 15): Proof of custody
Tax identification number (Steuer-ID)
Medical records in your possession (if available): Submit only the findings, not X-ray images or ultrasound/CT files
Medical expert opinions from Jobcenter, Federal Employment Agency, Medical Service (care assessment), pension insurance providers, or other administrative decisions

Decisions from other administrative authorities (e.g., under social compensation law), occupational associations, or court determinations of health conditions, loss of earning capacity (MdE), or degree of disability (GdS)
Additional documents such as blood sugar diary, wheelchair or rollator prescription
processingTime: 5-6 months

bookingInfo.office: This service is only available through the State Office for Health and Social Affairs - Versorgungsamt Berlin (Social Security Office Berlin)

name: Severe Disability - Submit Taxi Receipts for Special Transport Service
description: This service allows eligible severely disabled individuals to submit taxi receipts for reimbursement if they are authorized to use Berlin's special transport service.
eligibility: You must have a valid authorization number to participate in the Berlin Special Transport Service (Sonderfahrdienst) and possess the notation 'T' (participation in special transport service) in your severe disability pass. The 'T' notation is granted to persons with an exceptional walking disability (notation 'aG' in the severe disability pass). You must obtain a receipt for the paid transport costs.
requiredDocuments: Written application for reimbursement of taxi receipts

Original taxi receipts (with no corrections, alterations, or marks from different pens; must contain: company name and address with authorization number (stamp), route details (start and destination), fare/tax rate, date of journey, and driver signature)
fees: A flat deduction of €40.00 is applied for full co-payment; a flat deduction of €20.00 is applied for reduced co-payment.
processingTime: 15 business days

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Schwerbehindertenschutz - Zustimmung zur Kündigung beantragen
description: This service allows severely disabled employees or those with equivalent status to request approval from the Inclusion Office before their employer can terminate their employment.
eligibility: Recognition as a severely disabled person: The employment office must have determined a degree of disability of at least 50. Alternatively, for a degree of disability of 30 or 40, you must have been granted equivalent status with a severely disabled person by the employment agency.
requiredDocuments: Application for consent to termination (available under 'Formulare') — can also be submitted informally and by the employer
Detailed statement of reasons for the intended termination — must be submitted by the employer with the application
Job description of the employee — must be submitted by the employer with the application
Recognition decision from the employment office — to be requested by the employee
Equivalent status decision from the employment agency — to be requested by the employee
Severely disabled person ID card — to be requested by the employee
processingTime: For ordinary termination: Decision by the Inclusion Office within one month, provided all necessary information is available. Average processing time nationwide is 7 weeks. For extraordinary (immediate) termination: Decision by the Inclusion Office within two weeks of application receipt. If no decision is made within this period, consent is deemed granted.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Swimming Pools - Hygiene Supervision
description: A hygiene inspection and supervision service for swimming pools located in Berlin.
eligibility: The swimming pool is located in Berlin.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the health department (Gesundheitsamt) of the district in which the swimming pool is located.

name: Sex Education: Group Services on Sexual Health and Family Planning
description: This service provides group-based educational offerings on sexual health and family planning with no prerequisites required.
