name: Solar Obligation Exemption Request
description: Request an exemption or partial exemption from Berlin's solar installation mandate for buildings constructed after December 31, 2022, if installation poses financial hardship, technical impossibility, or other qualifying difficulties.
eligibility: Building construction began after December 31, 2022; non-public building with usable floor area exceeding 50 square meters. You are the owner of a non-public building. For buildings with 50 square meters of usable floor area or less, the solar obligation does not apply and no application is necessary. The building type must be subject to the solar obligation. You do not need to apply if your building falls into one of the following exempt categories: underground structures, greenhouses or cultivation facilities for growing, propagating, and selling plants, pneumatic structures or temporary buildings, garages or ancillary structures on a property where another building fulfills the solar obligation. An exemption or partial exemption may be granted for reasons including: extraordinary financial burden, insufficient financing and inability to obtain bank credit, unreasonably high costs for roof modifications, extreme disproportion between solar installation costs and essential roof renovation costs, or insufficient roof area due to mandatory installations, significant shading, or other obstacles to installing a photovoltaic system according to solar law requirements.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from solar obligation (available online or by mail)
Supporting documents and evidence proving exemption eligibility (such as roof surveys, cost estimates, bank loan rejections)
Photographs and building plans
processingTime: 1 to 3 months

name: Apply for Sector-Open Funding for One- or Two-Year Festivals and Series from the Independent Arts Scene
description: This service provides grant funding for festivals, series, and special program focuses developed and presented in Berlin with majority participation of Berlin-based artists.
eligibility: Applications are accepted from 03.06.2026 to 14.07.2026, with the deadline at 14:00 on 14.07.2026. Projects must be developed and presented in Berlin and involve a majority of Berlin-based artists. Eligible formats include series (sequences of at least three different events), festivals, and special program focuses (e.g. anniversaries). Applicants must be individuals or organizations with primary residence/headquarters in Berlin and work professionally as artists or curators. The majority of project participants must live and work in Berlin. Minimum honorarium thresholds must be included in the budget. Funded projects must be created and visible in Berlin during the funding years. Each applicant may submit only one application. Applicants must not be enrolled as students or employed as professors at a university during the funding period; violations may result in funding withdrawal.

Detailed project description (max. 5 MB, PDF file, max. 5 DIN A4 pages including cover sheets and photos; use the provided template; filename: PB_Name Applicant)

Sample budget plan (max. 5 MB, XLSX file; filename: FP_Name Applicant; ensure appropriate ratio between overhead costs and artist honoraria; include costs for barrier removal if applicable; budget must be balanced with equal income and expenses; annual sums are binding and unused funds cannot be carried over; for 2028, applications exceeding 100,000 Euro are not permitted; for 2027, applications exceeding 100,000 Euro are permitted)

Confirmation from at least one venue (max. 2 MB, DOCX or PDF file; filename: SB_Name Applicant; use mandatory template; must include concrete dates with years; project must take place in the specified funding year)
CV of artistic director and participating artists (max. 2 MB, DOCX or PDF file; filename: CV_KL Participants_Name Applicant; must include artists' residence and work locations)

name: Open-Source Funding for One- and/or Two-Year Projects by (Structurally Funded) Cultural Institutions
description: A funding program for Berlin-based cultural institutions to support one- or two-year artistic projects with public presentation in Berlin.
eligibility: Applications open from 03.06.2026 to 14.07.2026, with deadline at 14:00 on 14.07.2026. Eligible applicants include all subordinate institutions, non-juridical institutions, and public law foundations in Berlin's cultural sector, district cultural work facilities, and privately organized cultural institutions receiving institutional funding from federal, state, district, or DKLB sources. Privately organized cultural institutions receiving project-based funding may only apply if they are structurally funded (operational financing), possess their own production and event venue, and maintain a curated program. Applicant organization must be based in Berlin. Majority of project participants must live (primary residence) and work in Berlin. Project must not have started yet. Exhibition fees and honorar floors must be included in the budget plan. Funded projects must be developed during the funding years in Berlin and be visible exclusively in Berlin through public events. Pure film festivals and film series are excluded. Application volume limits: projects requesting more than €100,000 for 2028 are not permitted; up to €100,000 for 2028 is allowed; for 2027, applications exceeding €100,000 remain permissible. Funding primarily covers artistic (co-)production costs; non-structurally funded applicants may claim rental and other ongoing personnel and material costs on a project basis. Funding covers only expenses directly related to the project in Berlin. Projects may be funded for one year (2027 or 2028) or two years (2027 and 2028). Applicants should plan accessible offerings for people with disabilities.
requiredDocuments: Project funding application (submit online with all attachments)
Detailed project description (max. 5 MB, PDF file, max. 5 DIN A4 pages including cover sheets and photos; filename: PB_Name Applicant; use provided sample template)

Budget plan (max. 5 MB, XLSX file; filename: FP_Name Applicant; use provided sample budget plan; ensure appropriate ratio between overhead costs and artist fees; include costs for barrier removal if applicable; budget must be balanced with equal income and expenses; annual sums are binding and unused funds cannot be carried forward)

name: Permission for Games with Prize Opportunities
description: This service allows you to apply for permission to operate games with monetary or merchandise prizes at specified venues in Berlin.
eligibility: For games with monetary prizes: the game may only be held in a gaming hall or similar establishment, with a maximum of one such game per operator. For games with merchandise prizes: the game may only be held at folk festivals, shooting competitions or similar events, fairs or specialty markets, or in restaurants or accommodation businesses (excluding those primarily visited by children and youth, as well as excluding taverns, ice cream parlors, milk bars, and establishments where food or beverage service plays only a minor role). Personal reliability will be verified through a certificate of good conduct (Führungszeugnis) and a commercial register certificate (Gewerbezentralregisterauszug). A certificate of no objection from the Federal Criminal Police Office (Bundeskriminalamt) is required. Game rules and prize schedule must be visibly posted at the venue.

Valid photo identification (personal identity card or other official photo ID document)

Documentation of the game venue including exact location details (e.g., gaming hall, restaurant, folk festival) and event duration
Certificate of no objection from the Federal Criminal Police Office (Bundeskriminalamt) — valid certificate or a copy thereof for the specific game
Current commercial register extract for registered businesses, or articles of association/bylaws for companies in formation (GmbH, AG)

processingTime: Approximately 1-2 weeks

If the game equipment is to be produced in series, it must be ensured that reproductions match the sample tested by the responsible authority.

Game rules
If required by the nature of the game: calculation of payout and hit expectations
Any further evidence as needed

name: Commercial Explosives Handling Certificate (Sprengstoff-Befähigungsschein) - Application
description: Application for a commercial certificate authorizing the handling of explosives, requiring proof of expertise, reliability, personal fitness, minimum age of 21, and German or EU citizenship.
eligibility: Applicant must be at least 21 years old and be a German citizen (as defined in Article 116 of the Basic Law) or an EU citizen. Applicant must demonstrate professional expertise through successful completion of a state-recognized course in accordance with explosives regulations. Applicant must possess the required reliability, meaning no conviction for felony or intentional criminal offense resulting in prison sentence of at least 1 year within the last 10 years. Applicant must be personally suitable, including physical fitness to handle explosives, and must not be legally incompetent, alcohol-dependent, drug-dependent, mentally ill, or mentally disabled. Applicant will be invited for a personal interview with the authority.

Certificates from completed training courses or evidence of professional experience with explosives

name: Commercial Explosives License (Sprengstoff) Application
description: This service allows qualified applicants to obtain a commercial license for handling explosives under German explosives law.
eligibility: You must be at least 21 years old and meet four requirements: (1) Expertise — demonstrated by successful completion of a state or state-recognized training course; (2) Reliability — normally given if you have behaved lawfully and have no criminal convictions; (3) Personal suitability — you must have no restrictions on mental or physical health and no substance or alcohol dependency; (4) Liability insurance covering the minimum amounts specified in section 10.7 of the Explosives Administration Regulation (SprengVwV).
requiredDocuments: Application for commercial explosives license under § 7 of the Explosives Act (SprengG) — submit in writing by post, fax, or email to sprengstoff@lagetsi.berlin.de
Valid identity card (Personalausweis) or passport
Proof of expertise (course certificates) in original or certified copy, or evidence of a qualified person holding a competency certificate (Befähigungsscheininhaber)
Liability insurance documentation
Description of intended storage (e.g., technical documentation, photographs, storage plan)
Business registration (Gewerbeanmeldung) if applicable — not required if no profit is generated; must be provided no later than notification of business commencement under § 14 SprengG
Copy of explosives competency certification under § 20 SprengG (if available)
Copy of explosives license under § 27 SprengG (if available)
For persons residing abroad or of non-German nationality: Criminal record extract in certified translation from competent authority of home or origin country, if relevant to assessing reliability
For persons from non-EU countries: Certificate of good standing in certified translation from competent authority of home or origin country confirming facts relevant to assessing reliability
processingTime: 6 to 8 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Explosives - Storage Authorization for Explosive Substances
description: This service authorizes the commercial or non-commercial storage of explosive substances and pyrotechnic items subject to regulatory approval.
eligibility: For commercial handling: Authorization under § 7 of the Explosives Act (SprengG); For non-commercial handling: Authorization under § 27 of the Explosives Act; For storage of pyrotechnic items presenting very low or low risk: No authorization for acquisition and handling under the Explosives Act is required. Which pyrotechnic items fall into this category is listed in § 4 section 1 of the First Explosives Ordinance in connection with § 3a of the Explosives Act.
requiredDocuments: Application for authorization or modification of a storage facility for explosive substances according to § 17 SprengG (submit in writing by mail in duplicate, fax, or email to sprengstoff@lagetsi.berlin.de)
Valid authorization (authorization under § 7 SprengG or § 27 SprengG, or no authorization required for unrestricted handling)
Land register map (Flurkarte) with marked storage location
Building documentation (construction description, building method, or similar)
Fire safety concept according to Industrial Building Directive with floor plan and location of safety equipment
Building type approval (if using components or systems such as cabinet storage specifically approved for storage of explosive substances)
For modifications to existing authorized storage: storage authorization with detailed description of intended changes, facility address, and contact person
fees: €200.00 to €970.00 (depending on storage quantity); up to €2,500.00 for significant effort in commercial operations; up to €1,250.00 for significant effort in non-commercial operations
processingTime: 4 to 8 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Report Explosives - Blasting
description: This service allows permit holders to notify the responsible authority of planned blasting operations and provide required technical documentation for approval.
eligibility: You must hold a permit under § 7 or § 27 of the Explosives Act (SprengG) and a competency certificate under § 20 of the Explosives Act. Notification must be submitted in a timely manner: for multiple identical blasting operations within a facility or project, at least 4 weeks before blasting begins; for any other blasting, at least 1 week before blasting begins; for any changes to an already-reported blasting, without delay.
requiredDocuments: Blasting notification form according to § 1 or § 2 of the 3rd Explosives Ordinance (3. SprengV), submitted in writing by post (in duplicate), fax, or email to sprengstoff@lagetsi.berlin.de

Calculation and planning documents including: type, method, and scope of blasting operations; type and maximum quantity of explosives and detonators to be used per blasting; distances of blasting sites from sensitive buildings and facilities (hospitals, schools, nursing homes, childcare facilities, sports facilities, playgrounds) within at least 1,000 meters radius; security measures including shelter areas for employees, barriers on traffic routes, and protective measures against stone ejection, vibration, blast fumes, and noise
Expert assessment report (if required by the authority in individual cases when doubts exist about the documentation and planned construction project)

Site plan (to scale) with indication of blasting sites including expected location changes and distances from traffic routes, residential and work areas, and public utility facilities within at least 300 meters radius (if distance information is not provided in the notification)
processingTime: 6 to 8 weeks

name: Urban Planner Registration — Request Entry
description: This service allows qualified urban planners to register on the Berlin urban planner list (Stadtplanerliste) if they meet professional, educational, and personal suitability requirements.
eligibility: You must have your place of residence or business establishment in Berlin, or your primary place of employment must be in Berlin. You must intend to work as an urban planner. You must have successfully completed at least four years of standard study duration in the relevant field at a German university or university of applied sciences. You must have at least two years of practical work experience in the essential professional tasks of urban planning, or alternatively possess qualifications for higher-level building or horticultural technical administrative service. You must be personally suitable (no professional-related criminal convictions or other disqualifying grounds). If registering with the "independent/freelance" designation, you must provide proof of professional liability insurance. For online application, you must register with the Berlin Chamber of Architects portal.
requiredDocuments: Application for entry in the urban planning field (online or written via post)
Birth certificate (copy)
Proof of eligibility for Berlin (registration certificate for residence, rental agreement for business establishment, or employer confirmation of workplace location in Berlin)
Proof of professional qualifications (certificates, professional credentials)
Documentation of education content and duration (Diploma Supplement, Transcript of Records, further education certificates, or proof of professional practice)

Proof of at least two years of practical work experience in essential urban planning tasks, or alternatively proof of qualifications for higher-level building or horticultural technical administrative service
Certificate of good conduct (Führungszeugnis) for official submission — current federal register extract (Belegart O), not older than 3 months
Proof of professional liability insurance (if registering with "independent/freelance" designation)

name: Report a Death
description: This service allows you to officially report the death of a person to the appropriate local registry office within the required timeframe.
eligibility: The death must be reported to the competent registry office within 3 business days. The report can be filed by hospitals, care facilities, senior homes, funeral homes, relatives or witnesses present at the time of death, or police (in cases of uncertain or unnatural cause of death). All required documents must be submitted in their original form and in German language; documents in other languages require certified translation by a sworn translator in Germany. For some countries, documents also require official certification (Apostille or Legalisation). For documents originally in Arabic, Greek, Hebrew, or Cyrillic script, personal names must be transliterated according to ISO standards (ISO 9-1995, ISO 843, DIN 31634, ELOT 734, etc.). Documents must not be altered, perforated, or laminated.
requiredDocuments: Death report form (completed and signed) — submitted either by the institution/authority (e.g., hospital, funeral home) or by relatives
Medical examiner's report (Leichenschauschein)
Birth certificate of the deceased person
Marriage/registered partnership certificate or certified extract from the register (if the deceased was married or in a registered partnership)
Proof of dissolution of marriage/partnership (if the deceased was divorced or widowed) — including a note on the certificate or a final divorce judgment/dissolution order or death certificate
Birth certificates of children (if the deceased left minor children)
Additional documents may be required depending on individual circumstances
fees: Free: Report of death. 12.00 euros: Issuance of death certificate. 12.00 euros: Certified extract from the death register. 12.00 euros: Issuance of an international death certificate. 6.00 euros: Each additional certificate of the same kind issued at the same time.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The death must be reported to the registry office (Standesamt) of the district where the death occurred. The last place of residence of the deceased is not the determining factor.

name: Request a Death Certificate
description: Request an official death certificate or certified extract from the death register for a deceased person whose death was registered with the appropriate registry office.
eligibility: The death must have already been registered with the registry office in the district where the person died. You are authorized to request the certificate if you are: a person in direct line of relationship with the deceased (parents, children, grandparents, grandchildren); the spouse or registered life partner; siblings, if you can credibly demonstrate legitimate interest in the issuance of the certificate; persons who can credibly demonstrate legal interest; or persons with a power of attorney. You must know the responsible registry office, or you may search for it online at no cost, or request a paid search.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a death certificate or certified extract from the death register (can be submitted online or in person)
Identity document (Personalausweis or passport) — required for in-person application
Proof of relationship (if applicable) — required for in-person application if you are related in a direct line (e.g., birth certificate, marriage certificate, or registered partnership certificate)
Proof of legal interest (if applicable) — required for in-person application if you are not related (e.g., inheritance certificate or land register extract)
Power of attorney (if applicable) — required if requesting the certificate on behalf of another person
fees: Free: Death certificate for social security purposes; €12.00: German death certificate; €12.00: Multilingual/international death certificate; €12.00: Certified extract from the death register; €6.00: Each additional certificate of the same type issued simultaneously; €20.00–€80.00: Determination of the responsible registry office in Berlin (depending on search effort)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Registry Office (Standesamt): Responsible is the registry office in the district where the person actually died (regardless of residence). If only the death location 'Berlin' is known, you may request a paid search for the responsible registry office. State Archive (Landesarchiv): If the death occurred more than 30 years ago, contact the Landesarchiv Berlin.

name: Tax Claims Relief (Erlass)
description: A service allowing taxpayers to request relief or cancellation of tax claims in cases of substantial hardship.
eligibility: Relief requires substantial hardship, which can be based on objective or personal grounds. For objective grounds, a legal tax claim must exist but circumstances must contradict the law's purpose and values. For personal grounds, tax collection must threaten the taxpayer's economic or personal existence, meaning they cannot afford basic living expenses without relief measures. The taxpayer must also be deemed worthy of relief—meaning they did not create their inability to pay themselves and have not violated tax obligations or acted against public tax interests.
requiredDocuments: Written relief application submitted to the competent tax office (preferably via the Elster Portal)
Supporting documents for the stated grounds for relief (such as information about current economic circumstances—specific requirements determined by the tax office on a case-by-case basis)
fees: No fees for application submission or the relief decision
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent local tax authority responsible for processing the relief application is typically the tax office (Finanzamt) that originally issued the tax assessment being requested for relief.

Notification to tax office via: completed tax declaration form, unsigned written notice sent by mail, scanned email attachment, or electronically authenticated via ELSTER using the 'Change of Bank Account' form

name: Tax Claims Deferral
description: A service that allows taxpayers to defer payment of tax claims if they face significant hardship, either through offsetting against future refunds or due to financial difficulties.
eligibility: Significant hardship must be demonstrated, either on objective grounds (when the tax authority will likely refund amounts soon or can apply future refunds to current tax debt) or on personal grounds (due to adverse economic circumstances). For personal hardship, the taxpayer must demonstrate both need for deferral and worthiness of deferral: deferral need exists if payment would cause serious payment difficulties or threaten existence, requiring temporary lack of funds and inability to obtain them reasonably; deferral worthiness exists only if the taxpayer did not cause their lack of ability to pay and has not violated tax obligations or acted against public tax interests. The applicant must provide clear evidence of the grounds and amounts claimed.
requiredDocuments: Written deferral application (submit to your competent tax office, usually the one that issued the assessment notice; use the Elster portal if possible)
Documentation of claimed deferral grounds (as specified by the tax office on a case-by-case basis; typically evidence of current economic circumstances)
fees: No fee for application submission and deferral decision. Deferral interest accrues at 0.5 percent on the deferred amount for each full month, either assessed when deferral is granted or at a later time, and is due with the final payment installment. In exceptional cases, deferral may be granted interest-free at the discretion of the responsible tax authority.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent local tax authority (typically the tax office that established the tax claim being deferred) is responsible for processing deferral applications under German tax code sections 17 et seq.

name: Tax Advisor (Steuerberater/in) — Request Exemption from the Tax Advisor Examination
description: This service allows qualified professionals with specialized expertise in tax law to request exemption from the tax advisor examination based on their professional experience and qualifications.
eligibility: You must have special professional qualifications in the field of tax law. The following persons may be exempted from the examination: professors who have taught for at least ten years at a German university in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities; former finance judges who have been active for at least ten years in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities; former senior civil service officials and comparable employees of the finance administration who have been active for at least 10 years in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities as section heads or in at least equivalent positions; former mid-level civil service officials and comparable employees of the finance administration who have been active for at least 15 years in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities as case officers or in at least equivalent positions. For online application: registration/login via BundID using either an ELSTER certificate or online identification (eID). For online application: consent to electronic payment (credit card, giropay, direct debit, or bank transfer accepted). All certificates, documents and attestations must be presented in notarized or officially certified form (if necessary, sent by post to the responsible tax advisor chamber/examination office). Documents must be submitted in German language (if necessary, with a certified translation).
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from the tax advisor examination (submit online; in individual cases, request a paper form from the StBK)
Curriculum vitae with detailed information about the person and professional background
Passport photograph not older than one year
Documents regarding discharge from civil service; transfer to retirement; appointment as professor; or conferral of academic degrees (if applicable)

Evidence of practical activities in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities (employer certificate): a certificate from a German university, the last employer or party leadership stating the type and duration of activity (or teaching activity as professor) in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities. The certificate must contain information on: employment period (start and end date of activity); type of employment relationship (e.g., civil servant or employee); working hours (number of hours per week); type and scope of activity in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities (number of hours per week); all periods of professional interruption of non-temporary duration (e.g., extended leave, overtime compensation, parental leave, maternity protection, periods of illness, etc.)
Evidence of military/civilian service time, statutory maternity protection time (if applicable)
fees: Approximately €200.00. For the exact amount of fees, please consult the current fee schedule of the Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Tax Advisor (Steuerberater/in) - Application for Appointment
description: Application to be appointed as a licensed tax advisor in Berlin, subject to passing the tax advisor examination and meeting professional and personal requirements.
eligibility: You must have passed the tax advisor examination (Steuerberaterprüfung) or be exempted from it; live in orderly financial circumstances; not have lost the ability to hold public office due to criminal conviction; not engage in activities incompatible with the profession (such as employment in another profession or self-employment in other fields); have a professional liability insurance coverage confirmation from an insurer (or for employees, proof of inclusion in the employer's liability insurance); be registered/logged in via BundID for online application; have activated online ID function (eID) on your electronic ID card, EU citizen card, or electronic residence permit with your PIN, an external card reader or modern NFC-enabled smartphone with Android or iOS, and the AusweisApp software; and consent to electronic payment methods (credit card, Giropay, direct debit, or bank transfer available).
requiredDocuments: Application for appointment as tax advisor (submit online; request application form from StBK if needed)
Certified copy of tax advisor examination certificate or exemption certificate
Current passport-style photograph (not older than 1 year)
Certificate of Good Conduct (Führungszeugnis) for presentation to authorities (type O, not older than 6 months)
Proof of professional liability insurance or proof of co-insurance with employer
Academic degrees or state-conferred qualifications (only if included in examination certificate or separately documented)
For employees (syndikus tax advisor): employer certification naming specific reserved tasks, job description, and employment contract copy
For former finance officials: discharge certificate or proof of separation from tax administration

For lawyers, foreign EU lawyers, auditors, or certified accountants: certification from competent professional body that no grounds exist for withdrawal or revocation of license or disciplinary proceedings
fees: Approximately €200.00 (exact amount per current fee schedule of Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin); members must also pay chamber dues set by chamber assembly — contact Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin for details.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin) — you can be appointed if your intended professional business location is within the Berlin chamber district.

name: Tax Advisor - Request Binding Information on Admission or Exemption from Tax Advisor Examination
description: Request legally binding information from the Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors regarding eligibility for admission to the tax advisor examination or exemption from the examination.
eligibility: You want to obtain legally binding information about the requirements for admission to the examination or exemption from the examination at the Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin). For online application: Registration/login via BundID. For registration/login, choose the option 'ELSTER certificate', 'Online ID (eID)', or 'Username/password'. For online application: Consent to electronic payment. Payment options include credit card, Giropay, direct debit, and bank transfer.
requiredDocuments: Application for binding information - submit the application online; in individual cases, you can request an application form from the Chamber of Tax Advisors (StBK)
Curriculum vitae with detailed information about the person and professional history

Certificates/documents/evidence of completion of a business or legal university degree, or a university degree with business focus and the standard study duration, or completion of vocational training with business focus begun in the former East Germany before January 1, 1991, or successful completion of an apprenticeship examination in a commercial profession or equivalent qualification, or successful examination as a certified accounting technician (geprüfter Bilanzbuchhalter/in) or tax specialist (Steuerfachwirt/in)

For binding information on admission to examination: Documentation of practical experience - certificates regarding the type and duration of your work in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities, including: employment period (start and end date if applicable), type of employment relationship (e.g., employee, freelancer, civil servant), working hours (number of hours per week), information on the type and scope of activity in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities (number of hours per week), all periods of professional interruption of more than temporary duration (e.g., extended leave, compensatory time off, parental leave, sick leave, etc.)

For binding information on exemption from examination: Certification from a German university or the last government agency or party leadership regarding the type and duration of your activity (or your teaching activity as a professor) in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities, including: employment period (start and end date if applicable), type of employment relationship (e.g., employee, freelancer, civil servant), working hours (number of hours per week), information on the type and scope of activity in the field of taxes administered by federal or state finance authorities (number of hours per week), all periods of professional interruption of more than temporary duration (e.g., extended leave, compensatory time off, parental leave, sick leave, etc.)
Evidence of military service/civilian service, statutory maternity protection period if you claim these in the application
fees: Approximately 200.00 euros. A processing fee is charged depending on the effort required. The Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors can provide information about the amount of this fee.
processingTime: Approximately 1 to 2 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Contact the Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin) if you work as your main occupation or have your (primary) residence in their district. If this location is abroad, the Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors is responsible if your intended place of professional practice is located in their district. If your intended place of professional practice is abroad, the Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors is responsible if you applied for admission to the examination with them.

name: Tax Advisor (Steuerberater/in) - Request for Re-registration
description: A service for applying to be re-registered as a tax advisor in Berlin after having previously held the qualification.
eligibility: You must have passed the tax advisor examination (Steuerberaterprüfung) or been exempted from it. You must live in orderly financial circumstances. You must not have lost the capacity to hold public office due to criminal conviction. You must not engage in any activity incompatible with the profession (such as being an employee in another profession or being self-employed in another trade). You must have a letter of coverage from a professional liability insurer (or for employees, proof of inclusion in the employer's liability insurance). For online application: you must be registered with BundID. For online application: you must have activated the online ID function (eID) — this requires your electronic passport, EU citizen card (eID card), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated eID function and your PIN, an external card reader or a modern NFC-enabled smartphone with Android or iOS, and the AusweisApp software. For online application: you must consent to electronic payment (credit card, Giropay, direct debit, and bank transfer are available).
requiredDocuments: Application for re-registration as tax advisor (submit online; contact the StBK for a paper form if needed)
Certified copy of the certificate showing successful completion of the tax advisor examination or exemption from the examination
Current passport-style photograph not older than 1 year
Certificate of good conduct for submission to authorities (per § 30 Abs. 5 BZRG — document type 'O'), not older than 6 months
Proof of professional liability insurance or proof of coverage under an employer's insurance

Evidence of academic degrees or state-conferred qualifications (only included in the appointment certificate if already in the examination or exemption certificate or separately documented during the appointment process)

For intended employment as an employed tax advisor (Syndikus-Steuerberater): employer certificate naming the reserved tasks undertaken at the non-tax profession employer, job description (brief written outline in bullet points is sufficient), and copy of employment contract
For re-registration following revocation: evidence that the reasons for revocation no longer exist
For former tax authority officials only: discharge certificate or corresponding proof of departure from the tax authority

For lawyers, registered European lawyers, auditors, or sworn auditors only: certificate from the competent professional organization or responsible body confirming no facts are known that would justify withdrawal or revocation of registration or initiation of professional or disciplinary proceedings
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You can be re-registered by the Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin) if your intended professional practice location is within the Chamber's jurisdiction in Berlin.

name: Tax Advisor (Steuerberater) - Application for Admission to Qualification Examination for Recognition of Foreign Professional Qualification
description: This service allows EU/EWR/Swiss nationals with foreign tax advisory qualifications to apply for admission to a qualification examination to gain recognition as a tax advisor in Berlin.
eligibility: Citizenship of an EU member state, EWR contracting state, or Switzerland; Authorization to provide tax assistance in your home country; BundID registration using ELSTER certificate, online ID (eID), or username/password for online application; Consent to electronic payment methods (credit card, Giropay, direct debit, or bank transfer); All certificates, documents and credentials must be presented in notarized or officially certified form (may be sent by post to the responsible Tax Advisor Chamber); All documents must be submitted in German language or with certified German translation.
requiredDocuments: Application for admission to qualification examination (submit online or request paper form from the Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin)
Current CV, passport photo, and current employer certificate (for resubmissions)
Current CV
Current passport photo (not older than one year)
Current employer certificate

Proof of citizenship of an EU member state, EWR state, or Switzerland (e.g., passport, European ID card, or convention passport); if not in German, include certified German translation with name, first name, place of birth, and date of birth in Latin characters; document should include photo and signature
CV with detailed personal information and professional history

Proof of qualification/training from another EU/EWR member state or Switzerland (certificates of successful completion of full-time or part-time formal or informal training programs, recognized as equivalent by the issuing state, conferring the same rights as tax advisor qualifications or preparing for tax advisor practice)
Certificates of professional qualifications that may not meet legal requirements of the home state but grant rights under home state law
Certificates of academic degrees if applicable

Proof of knowledge in examination subjects that may be waived under § 37a paragraph 4 of the Tax Advisor Act (diplomas or equivalent examination certificates from state or state-recognized universities/colleges, case lists showing file reference, subject matter, time period, type and scope of activity, status, and anonymized work samples if requested)
Proof of knowledge from previous training (diplomas or equivalent examination certificates from state or state-recognized universities/colleges)
Case lists with file reference, subject matter, time period, type and scope of activity, and current status (to demonstrate knowledge from professional experience)
Anonymized work samples if requested by the examination authority

Professional practice certificate or professional preparation certificate if the profession is not regulated in your home country (showing at least one year of professional practice in the previous ten years at 16+ hours per week in an EU/EWR member state or Switzerland, or certification that you were prepared for the profession)

Certificate of at least three years of professional practice (if your diploma, examination certificate, or qualification from a third country was recognized in an EU/EWR member state or Switzerland; must show 16+ hours per week)
Current official medical certificate (at your own expense) if you have a physical disability, stating what measures can compensate for it in terms of time and technical aspects
fees: Approximately 200.00 EUR for admission to the qualification examination; additional fees may apply for conducting the examination. See the current fee schedule of the Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin for exact amounts.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin). You can apply if you work primarily in Berlin, or if not employed, reside in Berlin, or can credibly demonstrate intent to permanently settle in Berlin.

name: Tax Advisor (Steuerberater) – Application for Admission to Tax Advisor Examination
description: This service allows individuals to apply for admission to the tax advisor (Steuerberater) examination in Berlin, provided they meet specific educational and professional experience requirements.
eligibility: You must meet one of the following paths: (1) Hold a completed university degree in economics, law, or economics-related field with at least 2 years (if degree ≥8 semesters) or 3 years (if degree <8 semesters) of practical professional experience in tax matters; (2) Hold a commercial training certificate in tax law with 8 years of practical experience, or 6 years if you have passed the examination as certified accounting technician (Bilanzbuchhalter) or tax specialist (Steuerfachwirt); (3) Be a civil servant in the senior service or comparable employee of the financial administration with at least 6 years of practical work experience as case officer or equivalent position. You must be primarily employed in Berlin or, if not employed, reside in Berlin.
requiredDocuments: Application for admission to tax advisor examination (submit online)
Curriculum vitae with detailed personal and professional information
Passport photograph not older than one year

Certificates/diplomas/documentation of completion of university degree in economics, law, or economics-related field with standard study duration, or vocational training completed before 1 January 1991 in the former GDR with economics focus, or successful completion of commercial apprenticeship or equivalent qualification, or successful examination as certified accounting technician (Bilanzbuchhalter) or tax specialist (Steuerfachwirt)
Certificates documenting academic degrees (if applicable)

Evidence of practical work in federal or state tax administration (employer certificate) including employment period (start and end dates), type of employment (e.g., employee, freelancer, civil servant), weekly working hours, description of tax work duties with weekly hours, and periods of professional interruption lasting more than temporarily (e.g., extended leave, overtime compensation, parental leave, sick leave)
Evidence of military/civil service time and statutory maternity protection time (if applicable)

Certificate from Chamber of Auditors (Wirtschaftsprüferkammer) or other competent authority confirming appointment or examination success as auditor (Wirtschaftsprüfer) or sworn auditor (vereidigter Buchprüfer) (if applicable)
Medical certificate from government physician (if applicable for disability-related examination accommodations; must be obtained at your own expense)
All certificates, documents, and certifications must be presented in officially certified or notarially certified form; documents must be in German language with certified translation if necessary
fees: Approximately €40.00–€100.00 for admission to the examination; approximately €280.00 for examination administration per candidate
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Steuerberaterkammer Berlin (Chamber of Tax Advisors Berlin) — you are eligible if you are primarily employed in Berlin or, if not employed, reside in Berlin

name: Apply for Representation or Permission to Continue Professional Practice as a Tax Consultant in Public Service
description: This service allows tax consultants or tax agents who have entered into public service employment to request either a designated representative or permission to continue practicing their profession alongside their official duties.
eligibility: You are a tax consultant or tax agent who has entered into a public-law employment relationship as an elected civil servant with fixed term or a public-law official relationship. You wish to either continue your activity as a tax consultant or tax agent yourself (in addition to your public-law employment or official relationship) or appoint a representative for its continuation. For online application: Registration/login via BundID — choose the variant 'ELSTER certificate', 'Online ID (eID)', or 'username/password'. For online application: Consent to electronic payment method — credit card, Giropay, direct debit, and bank transfer payment options are available.
requiredDocuments: Application for appointment of representation or permission to continue professional practice (submit online or in writing by post; for written submission, you may make an informal statement to the tax consultant chamber)

Evidence of the public-law employment relationship or official relationship (copy of the appointment certificate showing the type of public-law employment or official relationship (honorary or with compensation) and its time scope)
Any further evidence for the representation to be appointed, if applicable
fees: Approximately 200.00 euros. The exact amount of fees can be found in the current fee schedule of the Steuerberaterkammer Berlin (Tax Consultant Chamber Berlin).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Steuerberaterkammer Berlin (Tax Consultant Chamber Berlin) is responsible for your application if you are already registered there as a tax consultant or tax agent.

name: Tax Advisor Professional Register - Registration as Tax Advisor
description: This service allows tax advisors and tax representatives to register in the professional register, or to register additional advisory offices or professional practice entities in Berlin.
eligibility: You are a tax advisor and tax representative being newly appointed or relocating your professional office to Berlin; You are a newly recognized professional practice entity or relocating your headquarters to Berlin; You are establishing additional advisory offices of tax advisors and tax representatives in Berlin; You are establishing additional advisory offices of recognized professional practice entities in Berlin; For online application: registration/login via BundID or a verified tax advisor identity on the tax advisor platform. For registration/login, select the "ELSTER certificate" or "Online ID (eID)" option. You can only be registered by the Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors if your intended future professional office is located within the Berlin chamber district.
requiredDocuments: Registration form for the professional register (application may be submitted online or in writing by post; for written application, use the official form from the tax advisor chamber)
Proof of professional liability insurance
Academic degree certificates (if applicable)
Proof of professional title, specialist advisor designation, or professional title supplement (if applicable)
Recognition certificate (required only for audit firms, accounting firms, or professional practice entities under BRAO)
Separate statement on branch offices, stakeholders, election resolutions (if applicable)
processingTime: Approximately 1 week

bookingInfo.office: Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin)

name: Tax Advisor Professional Register - Registration of Persons Established Abroad with Authority to Provide Tax Services
description: This service allows tax advisors professionally established in Finland to register temporarily and occasionally provide tax services in Germany under German tax advisory law.
eligibility: You are professionally established as a tax advisor in the EU member state Finland and wish to provide temporary and occasional professional assistance in tax matters within the scope of German tax advisory law in Germany. For online application: registration/login via BundID. For online application: activated online identification function (eID) — you will need your electronic ID card, EU citizen card (eID card), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated eID function and your PIN; an external card reader or a modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS operating system; the software 'AusweisApp'.
requiredDocuments: Notification for temporary and occasional professional assistance in tax matters — submit the application online; request an application form from the StBK if needed in individual cases

Certification from the Finnish tax advisor supervisory authority confirming that the person is lawfully established to provide professional tax services in the EU member state Finland and that the exercise of this activity is not prohibited at the time of submission of the certificate, not even temporarily
Proof of professional qualifications

Proof of relevant professional experience — evidence that the person has practiced the profession in one or more member states, treaty states, or Switzerland for at least one year during the preceding ten years, if neither the profession nor the training for this profession is regulated in the state of establishment
Proof of professional liability insurance — information about the details of professional liability insurance or other individual or collective protection regarding professional liability
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details

bookingInfo.office: The Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin is only responsible for processing your notification if you are permanently professionally established in the EU member state Finland.

name: Tax Advisor Professional Register - Registration of Tax Advisory Companies

eligibility: You operate a tax advisory company with an office in Berlin and want to register in the professional register for tax advisors. For registration/login, select the "ELSTER certificate" or "Online ID (eID)" option.
requiredDocuments: Recording form for the professional register (official form from the Tax Advisor Chamber)
Professional liability insurance - preliminary coverage confirmation or proof of concluded professional liability insurance
If applicable: proof of authorization to use the designation "Agricultural Bookkeeping Office" for the legal representative

name: Tax Advisor Professional Register - Request Deletion from Professional Register
description: A service for registered tax advisors, tax representatives, or members of tax advisory firms who are no longer active to request deletion from the professional register.
eligibility: You are registered as a tax advisor, tax representative, or member of a tax advisory firm in the professional register but are no longer actively practicing. For online application: registration/login via BundID or verified tax advisor identity on the tax advisor platform. For online application: activated online identification function, which requires your electronic ID card, EU citizen card (eID card), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated online identification function (eID) and your PIN; an external card reader or modern NFC-capable smartphone with Android or iOS operating system; and the AusweisApp software.
requiredDocuments: Declaration of intention to withdraw from the professional register (possible online or in writing by post; for written application, you may submit your declaration informally to the tax advisor chamber)
Death certificate (if applicable, required only if the registered person is deceased)
processingTime: Approximately 1 month

bookingInfo.office: You can request deletion from the Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin if you are registered there in the professional register.

name: Tax Advisory – Applying for Recognition as a Tax Advisory Firm
description: This service allows you to apply for official recognition as a tax advisory firm (Steuerberatungsgesellschaft) in Berlin.
eligibility: The firm must be managed by licensed tax advisors (Steuerberater). At least one member of the board, managing director, or personally liable partner must be a licensed tax advisor. At least one such advisor must have their professional office at or near the firm's registered address. You must provide professional liability insurance coverage confirmation. For online applications, you need to register via BundID or verified tax advisor identity on the tax advisor platform (using ELSTER certificate, online ID/eID, or username/password), and must consent to electronic payment methods (credit card, Giropay, direct debit, or bank transfer). The firm must be registered in the Commercial Register or Partnership Register and must intend to establish its office in the Berlin Chamber of Tax Advisors' jurisdiction.
requiredDocuments: Application for recognition as a tax advisory firm (submit online; contact StBK for a paper form if needed)
Personal identification document (passport or other official photo ID)
Articles of association or bylaws (certified copy or officially certified extract)
Professional liability insurance – preliminary coverage confirmation for the requested insurance policy
Registration in the Commercial Register or Partnership Register (certified copy or official printout)
Extract from the professional register (if applicable)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Steuerberaterkammer Berlin (Tax Advisors Chamber Berlin) – applies if your intended professional office will be located in the Berlin Chamber's jurisdiction.

name: Tax Advisory - Request Exception Permit for Operating an Additional Consulting Office
description: This service allows established tax advisors and tax representatives to request an exception permit to maintain an additional consulting office or branch in Berlin without requiring another tax advisor or representative on-site as management.
eligibility: For tax advisors and tax representatives: You are an established tax advisor or tax representative and want to maintain an additional professional consulting office or branch in Berlin without appointing another tax advisor or tax representative on-site as management. For professional practice companies: You are a newly recognized and established professional practice company and want to maintain an additional professional consulting office or branch in Berlin without appointing another tax advisor or tax representative on-site as management. For online application: Registration/login via BundID or a verified tax advisor identity on the tax advisor platform. Select "ELSTER Certificate" or "Online ID (eID)" for registration/login. For online application: Consent to electronic payment. Payment options include credit card, Giropay, direct debit, and bank transfer.
requiredDocuments: Application for exception permit to operate additional consulting offices (submit online or by mail)
For written application: informal application to the Tax Advisor Chamber is sufficient
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You can obtain an exception permit from the Berlin Tax Advisor Chamber if your additional consulting office or branch is located within the Berlin Chamber's jurisdiction.

name: Tax Advice - Application for Professional Designation Addition "Agricultural Bookkeeping Office"
description: A service for tax advisors, tax representatives, and lawyers to apply for authorization to use the additional professional title "Agricultural Bookkeeping Office" (Landwirtschaftliche Buchstelle) in Berlin.
eligibility: You must be a tax advisor (Steuerberater), tax representative (Steuerbevollmächtigter), lawyer, or registered European lawyer; you must demonstrate special expertise in tax assistance for agricultural and forestry businesses as defined by the Valuation Act (Bewertungsgesetz); for online applications, you must be registered or logged in via BundID or verified tax advisor identity on the tax advisor platform using either "ELSTER certificate", "online ID (eID)", or "username/password"; for online applications, you must consent to electronic payment methods, which include credit card, Giropay, direct debit, and bank transfer.
requiredDocuments: Application for the addition "Agricultural Bookkeeping Office" to professional designation (submit online or by mail; a brief written application to the Tax Advisor Chamber is sufficient for postal submission)
Curriculum vitae with detailed personal information and professional background

Proof of expertise (only required if requesting exemption from oral examination): suitable evidence such as certificates, diplomas, or credentials for relevant training in tax law and at least three years of tax advisory experience in an accounting agricultural or forestry business

Employer confirmation (only required if requesting exemption from oral examination): proof of practical activity under § 44 paragraph 2 sentence 2 StBerG (German Tax Advisor Act) provided by your respective employer confirming your practical work
fees: Approximately 150.00 euros. See the current fee schedule of the Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin) for the exact amount.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Tax Advisor Chamber Berlin (Steuerberaterkammer Berlin) — available if your professional residence is located within the chamber's jurisdiction (Kammerbezirk Berlin).

Transfer is not possible for periods in which maintenance payments are made under the Maintenance Advance Act.

Contracts and resolutions related to the deregistration or transfer

name: Apply for Translator Scholarship in Literature
description: A scholarship program in Berlin for professional literary translators to support the translation of published works into German.
eligibility: Applicants must reside and work in Berlin; be a professional literary translator with at least two published literary translations (not self-published); be applying as an individual (not a group); not be enrolled at a university (including doctoral studies) or employed as a professor at a higher education institution at the time of application. The work to be translated must be published, with copyright and usage rights clarified in advance. Applicants whose studies ended recently must provide proof of completion. The application period runs from 09.12.2025 to 03.03.2026, with a deadline of 03.03.2026 at 11:00 AM. Only one application per person is permitted. Applications in German language are required. The scholarship cannot be combined with a federal translation scholarship from the Deutscher Übersetzerfonds with the same funding period, but may be combined with other German state scholarships up to 24,000 euros per year and with other named or unnamed domestic and foreign funding (applicants must verify compatibility). Combinations with project funding are permitted.
requiredDocuments: Application for funding through the translator scholarship (online only, all required documents and evidence in PDF format)
Curriculum vitae/CV (max. 2 MB, PDF file) including list of recent translations with title, place of publication, and medium
Translation sample (max. 5 MB, PDF file, max. 5 DIN A4 pages)
Copy of the translated passage (max. 5 MB, PDF file)

Project exposé (max. 2 MB, PDF file, max. 2 DIN A4 pages in German or English) describing the original work and author, justification for the translation, challenges in translation, scope of original and translation work, current status of translation work, planned publication date, and source and target languages

Documentation of copyright clearance/usage permission for the original work (max. 2 MB, PDF file) - either a contract with the rights holder or publisher, or completed rights clearance form, or public domain confirmation form

Proof of Berlin address and residence permit - German citizens: copy of valid ID card (front and back); EU citizens: copy of valid ID card or passport plus registration certificate from local registration office; non-EU citizens with residence permit card: the permit card itself (page showing Berlin address); non-EU citizens without permit card: copy of valid ID card or passport, registration certificate, and valid residence title or residence right certificate (front and back)
processingTime: 4-5 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Dance Practice Scholarship
description: This service allows professional contemporary dancers and choreographers in Berlin to apply for a financial scholarship to support their artistic practice.
eligibility: Applications are open from March 3, 2026 to April 14, 2026, with the deadline at 14:00 hours (CET). You must be a professional artist with completed artistic training and/or multiple years of professional artistic work in dance. Selection criteria include quality of artistic practice, continuity and public visibility of previous artistic work in Berlin, and prospective development in contemporary dance. Only individual applicants are eligible; group applications are not permitted. You must be at a specific career stage: Emerging artists (3-5 years of professional practice), Mid-career artists (6-10 years), or Senior artists (11+ years). Only one application per person is allowed. You must live and work in Berlin and maintain your primary residence there throughout the application and scholarship period. Non-EU citizens can only apply if their passport/ID has no special note from the immigration authority prohibiting independent activity. You cannot be enrolled at a university (including for doctoral studies) or employed as a professor at a university at the time of application. Applications must be submitted in German (portfolio and CV may be in English). Multiple scholarships are possible if combined funding does not exceed €24,000 per year from Berlin state sources.
requiredDocuments: Application for Dance Practice Scholarship (PDF format, all documents must be submitted online as PDFs)
Exposé / Detailed description of artistic practice (PDF file, maximum 2 DIN A4 pages, maximum 5 MB)
Artistic CV (PDF file, maximum 2 DIN A4 pages, maximum 1 MB)
Portfolio or documentation/information material about previous artistic work (PDF file, maximum 5 DIN A4 pages, maximum 7 MB)

Identity document and proof of Berlin address / residence permit if applicable (copy of valid ID card front and back for German citizens; copy of valid ID or passport and registration confirmation from residence office for EU citizens; residence permit card or documents as specified for non-EU citizens)
processingTime: 3-4 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Radiation Protection - Notify Operation or Significant Change of Technical X-Ray Equipment
description: This service allows you to notify the responsible authority about operating a technical X-ray facility or making a significant change to an existing facility's operation.
eligibility: Notification must be submitted at least four weeks before operation begins and there must be no grounds for refusal. Only every other light mast should be used to give all election advertisers a fair opportunity. Other contractually approved advertising on light masts must not be impaired. The applicant must comply with the regulations for posting election advertising on public lighting masts. The earliest posting period begins 7 weeks before the election and ends no later than 1 week after election day. The election advertiser bears all costs for production, installation, and removal of posters.
requiredDocuments: Application for street special use permit for posting election campaign posters (DIN A 0) - may be submitted online or in writing by mail

name: Request for Street Special Use Permit - Advertising on Light Posts
description: A service for businesses and organizations to request permission to display advertising on public light posts in Berlin, subject to content and location restrictions.
eligibility: Advertising is only permitted for business operations and other facilities, or informational signs about cultural, sports, and other events in Berlin's interest. Sexist, discriminatory, war-glorifying, or violence-promoting content is prohibited. Advertising is not permitted on light posts with traffic signs or traffic equipment, in UNESCO World Heritage core areas, monument zones, near monuments, in areas with preservation ordinances, on Kurfürstendamm, Unter den Linden, Forum Fridericianum, Humboldtforum, artistically significant light posts (e.g., Friedrichstadtleuchte, Alexanderplatz lights), reconstructed historic light posts (e.g., Paulickleuchte), preserved original lights (e.g., Speerleuchte), candelabras, bundle pier masts, gas posts, wooden posts, or concrete posts. Advertising signs on the same street side may only be placed on every other light post. Unlit and backlit signs must follow specific format requirements: backlit signs are approved with external dimensions of 70 cm x 100 cm and visible advertising area of 56 cm x 83 cm.
requiredDocuments: Two copies of an informal application with information about the size of the advertising installation and photos of the location
fees: Special use fees apply for Berlin state locations. Additional costs may apply if you place advertising on light posts yourself. Billing is handled directly with mediateam Stadtservice GmbH using a simplified procedure.
processingTime: Approximately 14 days for application review under simplified procedure, including issuance of special use permit with conditions and requirements to mediateam Stadtservice GmbH.

name: Sales Tax - Small Business Operator (Kleinunternehmer)
description: A sales tax regulation for small business operators whose annual revenue does not exceed specified thresholds.
eligibility: You are a small business operator. A small business operator is an entrepreneur whose total revenue in the previous calendar year did not exceed 25,000 euros and does not exceed 100,000 euros in the current calendar year. The small business operator regulation ends immediately when revenue exceeds the 100,000 euro threshold for the current calendar year. In the year of business establishment, only the total revenue must not exceed 25,000 euros. For detailed regulations, please contact the tax office responsible for you. Note: For years through 2024, the requirement for the small business operator regulation was that total revenue in the previous calendar year did not exceed 22,000 euros (up to 2019: 17,500 euros) and was not expected to exceed 50,000 euros in the current calendar year. The projected revenue for the current year was based on the expected revenue development anticipated at the beginning of the year.
requiredDocuments: No separate application required — the small business operator regulation applies by law
For business establishment: information about the expected revenue amounts must be provided in the questionnaire for tax registration
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

eligibility: Entrepreneurs with residence, seat, or business management outside the European Union. The Berlin International Tax Office is primarily responsible for entrepreneurs based in China, India, Japan, Australia, and South Korea. However, the Berlin International Tax Office is not responsible for entrepreneurs based in Liechtenstein, Macedonia, Norway, Russia, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine, United States of America, and Belarus — for these countries, other tax offices listed in the UStZuStV are responsible. Registration is required if you generate sales subject to German sales tax, including: sale of goods from a warehouse in Germany to a buyer in Germany; sale of goods from a warehouse in another EU member state to a buyer in Germany (observing the sales threshold per § 3c UStG); sale of goods from a third country to a buyer in Germany, if the seller or their agent handles customs clearance and taxation.

fees: No costs are charged for the activities of the administrative authorities. The costs of accommodation in a facility and the costs for required examinations and treatments are borne by the admitted person, unless a social insurance provider or other third party is obligated to cover the costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Maintenance Advance Payment (Unterhaltsvorschuss)
description: Financial support for single parents whose children do not receive adequate child support from the other parent.
eligibility: Child under 18 years old living with you in Berlin; you are registered as residing in Berlin; you are raising the child alone (single, divorced, widowed, or permanently separated from your spouse or partner); the other parent provides no child support, only partial support, or only irregular support; for children over 12 years old, additional income requirements apply (no Bürgergeld/SGB II, or income of at least €600 gross monthly with supplementary Bürgergeld, or Bürgergeld can be avoided through maintenance advance). Special rules apply if you receive Bürgergeld (SGB II) — see the information sheet for details.
requiredDocuments: Application form for maintenance advance (online or paper via post)
Identification document (e.g., passport or ID card)
Proof of residence (ID card or registration certificate)
Proof of residence right if foreign (residence permit or EU ID)
Child's birth certificate
School certificate for children aged 15 and over
Income statement for children aged 15 and over if schooling has ended
Maintenance agreement or court order (all written agreements, notarised documents, court rulings)
Proof of maintenance payments or orphan benefits (bank statements, receipts, pension notices)
Proof of paternity for children born outside marriage
Proof of permanent separation (if still married or in civil partnership — e.g., lawyer letter or tax office confirmation)
Proof of divorce or dissolution of civil partnership (divorce decree or notice)
Supplementary information form for children aged 12 and over
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Accommodation - Issuance of an Assignment for Asylum Seekers/Foreign Nationals Threatened with Homelessness
description: This service assigns emergency accommodation to foreign nationals and asylum seekers who are threatened with or facing homelessness and cannot secure suitable housing through their own means.
eligibility: Threatened or actual homelessness; inability to secure adequate accommodation through your own resources (self-help requirement takes priority); foreign nationals with specific residence permits under §§22-24 of the Residence Act (AufenthG) or other persons for whom the State Office for Immigration (LAF) has a legal obligation to provide accommodation. You must hold one of the following: residence permit under §22 AufenthG, residence permit under §23(1) AufenthG (admission of specific groups), residence permit under §24 AufenthG (temporary protection for mass influx under EU Directive 2001/55/EC), or be a person under §15a AufenthG assigned to standard accommodation.

Valid residence permit with supplementary sheet or a toleration notice (Duldung)
Certificate of application from the State Office for Immigration (LEA) if applicable

Residence permit under §24 Residence Act (often issued in A4 format and valid with national travel passport) or corresponding fictitious certificate (for Ukrainians and third-country nationals previously residing in Ukraine)
German travel document for foreigners - blue or grey if applicable

As a status-changed person, you must have received a notice from the competent benefit authority (Jobcenter or district office) denying you subsistence benefits due to income. eligibility: Only for companies in the legal form of a stock corporation (AG), limited liability company (GmbH), limited partnership (KG), or limited partnership on shares (KGaA). Documents regarding the appointment of the board, management, or general partners

Articles of association or partnership agreement (in original or as officially certified copies)
Articles of association or partnership agreement in the most recent version

name: Youth Work Protection Act Medical Examination
description: A medical examination required for young people aged 15-17 to comply with youth work protection regulations in Germany.
eligibility: Age between 15 and 17 years old. Medical examination authorization certificate required only if you wish to use free choice of doctor. You can obtain the authorization certificate from the Child and Youth Health Service in the district where the young person last attended a general education school. You must present your ID card or passport for this.
requiredDocuments: Completed survey form for parents/guardians (see 'Forms' section) — please fill out carefully and sign
ID card or passport

name: Certificate of Marriage (Eheurkunde) for Marriage Contracted Abroad or in Former German Territories
description: Request an official marriage certificate when your marriage was registered abroad or in former German territories that are now administered by the Berlin Registry Office.
eligibility: Marriage must have been registered with the Berlin Registry Office (Standesamt I Berlin) or one of its administered offices in former German territories. You may request the certificate if you are one of the spouses, an ancestor or descendant of the spouses, or any person who can credibly demonstrate a legal or legitimate interest in obtaining the certificate. For online applications: you must consent to electronic payment methods (credit card: Visa or Mastercard; PayPal) or arrange a bank transfer. If fees apply, you will receive a payment request via email.
requiredDocuments: Application for marriage certificate (Antrag auf Ausstellung einer Eheurkunde bei Eheschließung im Ausland) — preferably submitted online; in-person applications require a prior appointment
Proof of relationship or other evidence of legal or legitimate interest
Passport or national ID card (required only for in-person applications)
fees: Marriage certificate (Eheurkunde): €12.00; each additional certificate issued simultaneously: €6.00; international marriage certificate (internationale Eheurkunde): €12.00; each additional certified register extract issued simultaneously: €6.00; certified extract from marriage register (Beglaubigter Registerausdruck Eheregister): €12.00; each additional certified extract issued simultaneously: €6.00
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

eligibility: Registration must have been completed with Berlin's Registry Office I (Standesamt I) or a registry office administered by it in former German territories. Eligible applicants include the person themselves, parents, grandparents, children, siblings, spouses, or registered life partners, as well as any person who can demonstrate a legal or legitimate interest in obtaining the certificate. For online applications: consent to electronic payment methods (credit card via Visa or Mastercard, or PayPal) or alternatively payment by bank transfer; fees will be requested by email if applicable.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a birth certificate for a birth abroad (preferably submitted online; in-person applications require prior appointment)
Proof of relationship or other evidence of legal or legitimate interest
Passport or ID card (for in-person submission)
fees: 12.00 EUR for a birth certificate; 6.00 EUR for each additional certificate issued simultaneously; 12.00 EUR for an international birth certificate; 6.00 EUR for each additional international certificate issued simultaneously; 12.00 EUR for a certified extract from the birth register; 6.00 EUR for each additional certified extract issued simultaneously

Proof of family relationship or other evidence of legal or legitimate interest
Valid identity document (passport or ID card) for in-person submissions

eligibility: Registration must have been completed at Registry Office I (Standesamt I) in Berlin. If fees apply, you will receive a payment request by email at a later time.

Proof of kinship or other evidence of legal or legitimate interest

processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.
