name: Paternity Recognition Declaration
description: A service that allows unmarried fathers to legally declare paternity of a child by making a personal declaration before an authorized official.
eligibility: The paternity recognition can only be declared personally before an authorized official. Competent authorities are the registry office (Standesamt), the youth welfare office (Jugendamt) of the child's residence, and notaries. You and the child's mother must not be married to each other. If the parents are not sufficiently proficient in German, a sworn interpreter must be involved at the parents' request. The child's mother must personally consent to the paternity recognition before the authorized official. Minor mothers and fathers must bring a person with parental authority to the appointment. All required documents must generally be submitted in original form to the competent registry office. If required documents or certificates are not in German, they must be translated by a court-certified translator in Germany. For some countries, a certificate of authenticity (apostille or legalization) issued by the competent authority in the home country or by the German embassy is additionally required and must be attached to or connected with the original. For documents originally issued in Arabic, Greek, Hebrew, or Cyrillic script, the translation of personal names must be done according to transliteration standards (ISO 9-1995 / ISO 843 / DIN 31634 / ELOT 734, etc.). Documents must not be altered, perforated, or laminated.
requiredDocuments: Valid and signed identity card or passport of both parents (original)
Birth certificates of both parents; if your name differs from that on your birth certificate, you must provide evidence of the change (e.g., name change certificate, marriage certificate)
Mother's maternity record (Mutterpass) — required only if paternity recognition occurs before the child's birth

Child's birth certificate — required if paternity recognition occurs after birth; required for recognition at the youth welfare office or with a notary; at the registry office, only required if the birth was registered at a different registry office
fees: €40.00 for paternity recognition or consent declaration at the registry office (Standesamt); no fee at the youth welfare office (Jugendamt); paternity recognition with a notary is free of charge, but fees apply if combined with a custody declaration (Sorgeerklärung)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Registry office (Standesamt) — paternity recognition can generally be recorded at any registry office; appointments may be required as not all registry offices offer open office hours. Youth welfare office (Jugendamt) of the child's or mother's residence — appointments may be required as not all youth welfare offices offer open office hours. Notaries

name: Event Permit Application
description: Apply for permission to hold a public event in Berlin, which requires liability insurance and advance notification to local authorities.
eligibility: Liability insurance is required (at minimum a general liability insurance policy; depending on the type of event, additional accident insurance may be necessary). The application must be submitted up to 9 weeks before the event.
requiredDocuments: Event permit application form (available from the responsible district office)
Site plan: sketch of the event location showing all structures to be erected (stands, tables, benches, tents, stage, etc.)
Traffic sign plan (5 copies) if traffic routing will be changed, showing the surrounding area with all traffic signs, traffic lights, and other traffic facilities required for the event
Event organizer declaration regarding special use under § 8 FStrG, liability exclusion for breach of traffic safety obligations, and declaration under § 29 para. 2 StVO (liability insurance)
Proof of insurance coverage (e.g., confirmation from insurance company or copy of insurance contract)
Estimated attendance: expected number of participants, spectators, and other visitors (informal estimate on DIN-A4 paper)
Consent from affected parties as needed (e.g., consent from neighbors, BVG if public transport is affected, fire department if campfire or fireworks planned)
Approval for outdoor public events (noise protection) if disturbing noise is expected for third parties under § 7 Berlin State Immission Control Act
GEMA membership confirmation if music will be played or performed
Additional documents as required on a case-by-case basis (check with the responsible district office)
fees: Varies depending on the scope of the event; non-profit organizers may be exempted from part of the fees.
processingTime: 4-9 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Apply at the district office (Bezirksamt) in the district where the event will take place.

name: Request Civil Service Status for Teachers
description: This service allows employed teachers in Berlin to apply for conversion to civil service (permanent public employee) status, subject to meeting specific eligibility criteria including age, health, and citizenship requirements.
eligibility: You must be an employed teacher in Berlin. Specific eligibility includes: employed teachers, employed seminar leaders, and employed assistant seminar leaders; continuous, non-terminated employment or leave of absence in Berlin's public school service during school year 2022/2023, or release under legal provisions such as parental leave law; qualification in the Education career path; not have exceeded age 52; citizenship of an EU member state or Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, or Switzerland; and a positive health prognosis from a medical examination (not older than six months at time of appointment).
requiredDocuments: Application for admission to civil service status (Antrag auf Übernahme in das Beamtenverhältnis)
Medical examination report (if requested)
Additional documents as requested by personnel office
processingTime: No average processing time can be specified, as the number of applicants is not known.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Register Association Bylaws - Recording Bylaw Changes
description: This service records changes to an association's bylaws that have been decided by the membership assembly or other governing body in the association register.
eligibility: The association's bylaws have been changed, for example by resolution of the members' assembly.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration of bylaw change (notification) - must be submitted by the board of directors in authorized numbers, with signatures publicly notarized
Specification of which governing body (typically the members' assembly) changed which paragraphs or whether the bylaws were entirely redrawn

Protocol of the members' assembly (if bylaw changes were decided) - must include: association name, date of assembly, specification of paragraphs and wording of changes, voting results (number of yes and no votes), confirmation that the assembly was quorum-capable if required by bylaws, and confirmation that the changes were announced in the invitation notice

Protocol of the members' assembly (if bylaws were completely redrawn) - must include: association name, date of assembly, resolution on the redraft with voting results (number of yes and no votes), confirmation that the assembly was quorum-capable if required by bylaws, and confirmation that the redraft was announced in the invitation notice
Complete copy of the bylaws (for bylaw changes): must include all decided changes and must match the non-amended provisions of the bylaws last registered in the association register
Complete copy of the bylaws (for complete redraft): must be labeled as attachment to the members' assembly protocol, dated, and signed by the same persons who signed the protocol
processingTime: Average 2–4 weeks if the submitted documents require no objections from the court.

bookingInfo.office: The association register is located in the courthouse of the Charlottenburg District Court (Amtsgericht Charlottenburg).

name: Association Registry - Registration of an Association
description: This service allows members to register a newly formed association in the Berlin association registry, provided they meet the minimum membership and governance requirements.
eligibility: To register an association, at least 7 founding members must unite. The association must have a clear name that does not mislead and is distinct from other associations in the Berlin registry. The association must have a registered seat (location). The association's purpose and activities must be of an idealistic nature only — the association may not pursue commercial goals or offer paid services. A founding assembly must be held where members elect a board of directors. The founding members must adopt bylaws that clearly specify membership requirements, entry and exit rules, board composition, membership dues obligations, meeting procedures, and other governance details. The bylaws must be signed by at least seven members and dated with the founding date.
requiredDocuments: Application for association registration (notification) with publicly certified signatures of the authorized board members, including birth dates, residential addresses of all authorized board representatives, and the association's mailing address
Bylaws signed by 7 association members, dated with the founding date (copy acceptable)
Board election protocol (founding protocol) containing the required content regarding board member election and acceptance of office (copy acceptable)
fees: €100.00 court filing fee; notary certification fees can be obtained from the notary.
processingTime: Approximately 2-4 weeks, provided the submitted documents do not require objections from the registry court.

bookingInfo.office: The decision on whether to recognize an association as nonprofit is made exclusively by the Finance Office for Corporations. Nonprofit status is neither a reason nor a prerequisite for registration in the association registry.

name: Association Register - Register Board of Directors Changes
description: This service allows associations to register changes in their board of directors composition, such as those resulting from elections or resignations.
eligibility: Changes have occurred in the composition of your association's board of directors, for example through elections or resignations.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration of board of directors change (notification), which must be submitted by the board in the required representative number per § 26 BGB, with signatures publicly certified by a notary; must specify which board members have left and which new members have joined, including any changes in board member positions, and must provide birth dates and residential addresses of new board members

Meeting minutes (if change is based on election): must include association name, meeting date, full names of candidates, clear voting results (number of yes and no votes), and declaration of elected members accepting the election; note that with more than 2 candidates, results must be determined in multiple successive ballots, and runoff or block voting only permitted if association bylaws provide for this; elections must be announced in the meeting invitation

Appointment letter (if change is based on third-party appointment): letter from the authorized person or institution per bylaws, plus declaration from appointed persons accepting the position (copy sufficient)
Resignation declaration (if change is based on resignation): resignation letter from the board member (copy sufficient)
processingTime: Average 2-4 weeks if submitted documents do not require objection by the court registrar.

bookingInfo.office: The Association Register is located in the courthouse of the Charlottenburg District Court (Amtsgericht Charlottenburg).

name: Request Review of an EU-wide Public Procurement Procedure
description: This service allows eligible parties to request a review before the procurement appeals chamber if they believe an EU-threshold public procurement procedure conducted by a Berlin-based public body violated procurement law.
eligibility: The service is available if: (1) the contract is a public procurement contract or concession involving goods, works, or services between a public contracting authority and a business; (2) the contract value meets or exceeds EU thresholds; (3) the contracting authority's procurement office is based in Berlin; (4) you have previously filed a formal protest (Rüge) with the contracting authority and it was rejected, with the review request filed within 15 calendar days of receiving the rejection; and (5) the contract award has not yet been granted.
requiredDocuments: Formal request for review (Antrag auf Nachprüfungsverfahren) containing a specific request and prompt justification
Identification of the defendant (contracting authority) with complete address and fax number where available
Identification of the applicant and any other involved businesses, particularly the intended award recipient (if known)
Description of which procurement law violations are alleged against the contracting authority
Explanation of how the procurement violations could negatively affect you
Copies of procurement documents proving the conditions above were met
Copy of your formal protest letter and the contracting authority's response
Copy of the contracting authority's prior information notice under § 134 GWB
fees: A preliminary fee deposit of the minimum fee of €2,500 is generally not required, except typically when the applicant is based outside Germany. The unsuccessful party must bear the proceedings costs and the expenses of the opposing party.
processingTime: The procurement appeals chamber will issue and justify its decision within five weeks after receipt of the review request following an oral hearing. The chamber may extend this period in cases of special difficulty. No legal remedy may be filed against a time extension.

bookingInfo.office: Vergabekammer Berlin (Berlin Procurement Appeals Chamber) — has jurisdiction only for review procedures where the public contracting authority's procurement office is based in the state of Berlin.

name: Entertainment Tax (Vergnügungsteuer)

Notification of initial installation or final removal must be made within one week. Registration for entertainment tax must be submitted by the 10th day after the end of each calendar month for each calendar month. For online application, registration/login with the "Elster" portal is required.

Entertainment tax registration (online or by post)

name: Submit Declaration of Commitment (Verpflichtungserklärung)
description: A service to submit a legally binding declaration of commitment confirming that you can financially support a foreign visitor applying for a German visa.
eligibility: You must have a visa application pending or planned at a German embassy or consulate; you must have your primary residence in Berlin; a declaration of commitment has been requested by the German embassy/consulate or the visitor lacks sufficient funds for travel and living costs in Germany; you must be financially capable of covering living expenses with minimum monthly net income or savings depending on family status and visa type (you can verify this in the free Quick-Check tool); if you are not an EU/EEA citizen (German, other EU state, Iceland, Liechtenstein, or Norway), you must possess a valid residence permit (residence or settlement permit); you must provide a current email address; you must have read the forms "Additional Declaration for Declaration of Commitment" and "Information on Storage and Use of Application Data in VIS" (for Schengen visas only); you must submit the online application for submitting a declaration of commitment and pay the fee before submission using credit card or PayPal.
requiredDocuments: PDF confirmation document from the online application (save and print if possible)
Last three net income statements (if employed; if employer does not issue them monthly, last statement plus bank statements showing last 3 salary deposits)
Employment contract (for long-term stays/national visas only, if employed)

Last tax assessment (for self-employed/freelancers; dated according to application submission date) or certification of approximate current net income for last three months from tax advisor, tax auditor, or lawyer with relevant tax law experience (not older than 14 days)
Pension notification (if receiving pension)
Unemployment benefit I decision (if receiving unemployment benefit I)
Bank statements showing savings (if no regular income; only savings/fixed-term accounts at German financial institutions qualify, not stocks, funds, securities, or speculative investments)
Health insurance documentation: proof of contribution amount for voluntary statutory health insurance membership or existing private health insurance
Your identity card or passport
Copy of passport of the person applying for the visa
Proof of your online application for submitting a declaration of commitment (PDF document shown during application submission)
Appointment confirmation email received after submitting your online application
fees: €29.00 for submitting a declaration of commitment for one adult person or a married couple (with or without children); €14.50 if the declaration of commitment is submitted only for one or more minor persons
processingTime: After review of your complete digital application, you will be notified of an appointment, which can take between three to six weeks. The declaration of commitment will be issued at your appointment. Please refrain from making inquiries about the status.

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be obtained at the State Office for Immigration (LEA) at the Keplerstraße location.

name: Sign Declaration of Commitment
description: This service allows you to sign a declaration of commitment (Verpflichtungserklärung) at the State Office for Immigration after submitting your online application and receiving an appointment.
eligibility: You must have submitted the declaration of commitment online and received a scheduled appointment from the State Office for Immigration (Landesamt für Einwanderung) after they have reviewed your online submitted documents. If you cannot attend your appointment, you must cancel it in the ServicePortal. To request a new appointment, contact the responsible department B 5 via the contact form on the State Office for Immigration website, providing your transaction number from your online application PDF. You may authorize a third party to sign the declaration on your behalf. Personal appearance is required for the signing.
requiredDocuments: Your passport or national ID card (a copy is acceptable if signing is done by an authorized representative)

If you do not hold German, another EU state, Icelandic, Liechtenstein, or Norwegian citizenship: valid residence permit (a residence permission, suspension of deportation notice, or fictitious certificate is not sufficient)
If signing is done by an authorized representative: identification document of the authorized representative
If signing is done by an authorized representative: written power of attorney for signing the declaration of commitment
fees: None (the fee was already paid with the online application)
processingTime: Approximately 10 minutes; waiting times may occur in individual cases

bookingInfo.office: This service can only be accessed at the State Office for Immigration (LEA) at the Keplerstraße location

name: Insurance Consultant - Request Permission
description: This service allows individuals to apply for official permission to work as an insurance consultant in Berlin, subject to demonstrating personal reliability, financial stability, professional competence, and adequate liability insurance.
eligibility: You must demonstrate personal reliability (no convictions in the last 5 years for crimes including theft, embezzlement, extortion, fraud, disloyalty, money laundering, forgery, receiving stolen goods, usury, or insolvency offences); orderly financial circumstances (no open insolvency proceedings or listing in the debtor registry); required professional competence (proven through IHK professional examination or equivalent recognized professional qualifications and relevant work experience); and adequate liability insurance with the legally required minimum coverage amounts for insurance consultant activities. For online applications, you must have a BundID account.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission as an insurance consultant (can be submitted online or in writing by post)
Personal identification document — passport or other official photo ID (not required for electronically submitted applications)
Certificate of conduct from the Federal Central Criminal Register (Führungszeugnis) for submission to authorities — not older than three months
Commercial register extract from the Commercial Central Register for submission to authorities — not older than three months

Proof of no insolvency proceedings — two certificates required for natural persons resident in Berlin (one from your local court for consumer insolvency proceedings and one from the Berlin Regional Court Charlottenburg for regular insolvency proceedings); for legal entities and partnerships based in Berlin, contact the Berlin Regional Court Charlottenburg; applicants with residence/business location outside Berlin should check the central locality and court directory
Proof of no debtor registry entry — obtain online from the Central Enforcement Portal of the Länder
Tax clearance certificate — from your local competent tax office
Professional competence proof — IHK certificate demonstrating knowledge of insurance industry regulations and legal requirements, or comparable recognized professional qualification

Professional liability insurance confirmation — from an insurance company confirming the existence of professional liability insurance for insurance consultant activities with coverage amounts meeting statutory minimum requirements
Current commercial register extract (only required if registered in the commercial register) — or for legal entities in formation, the articles of association or bylaws
fees: 600.00 Euro for permission procedure for insurance intermediaries and consultants
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IHK) responsible for your principal business location. If this is not yet known, you may apply to the IHK responsible for your place of residence.

name: Insurance Advisor or Insurance Broker — Registration for Professional Competence Examination
description: Registration service for the professional competence examination required for insurance advisors and insurance brokers in Berlin.
eligibility: Personal appearance: You must appear in person for the examinations. Attention to registration deadline: The examination is offered on a maximum of eight uniform federal dates. The registration deadline is set by the respective Chamber of Commerce and Industry. Possible exemption from practical examination: Either you have a permit as a financial investment intermediary, fee-based financial investment advisor, or real estate loan intermediary, or you have obtained a corresponding professional competence certificate.
requiredDocuments: Online registration for professional competence examination — you must register on the IHK Berlin registration portal
Photo identification for identification during the examination
Possible evidence of exemption from practical examination — see the registration form for required documents
Possible evidence of passing the written examination section — only necessary when retaking only the practical examination section
fees: €200.00 for written examination section; €150.00 for practical examination section; €330.00 for written and practical examination sections
processingTime: You will receive the certificate within 1-2 weeks after the examination.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Insurance Agent — Request Permission
description: This service allows you to apply for official permission to work as an insurance broker in Berlin, subject to passing background checks, financial stability verification, and professional qualification requirements.
eligibility: You must demonstrate: (1) Personal reliability — you have not been convicted of serious crimes (including fraud, embezzlement, money laundering, forgery) in the past 5 years; (2) Ordered financial circumstances — no open insolvency proceedings, dismissal for lack of assets, or entry in the debtor registry; (3) Professional competence — passed Chamber of Commerce (IHK) examination or equivalent recognized vocational qualification with relevant work experience; (4) Adequate insurance coverage — proof of professional liability insurance with legally required minimum coverage limits; (5) For online applications: registration with a BundID account.
requiredDocuments: Application for Insurance Agent Permission (submitted online or via postal form)
ID document (passport or official photo ID; not required for electronically submitted applications)
Certificate of Conduct from Federal Central Register (Führungszeugnis) for presentation to authority (form type O), not older than three months
Extract from Commercial Registry (Gewerbezentralregister) for presentation to authority (form type 9), not older than three months

Certificates from Insolvency Register: for natural persons resident in Berlin, two certificates are required — one from your local court for consumer insolvency proceedings and one from Charlottenburg District Court for regular insolvency proceedings; for legal entities and partnerships based in Berlin, apply to Charlottenburg District Court (Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin); applicants with residence/business location outside Berlin should check the central court registry
Information from Debtor Registry (Zentrales Vollstreckungsportal), available online
Tax clearance certificate (Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung) from your local tax office
Professional competence certificate from IHK demonstrating required knowledge and legal regulations of the insurance industry, or equivalent recognized professional qualification
Confirmation from an insurance company of professional liability insurance (Berufshaftpflichtversicherung) for the insurance industry with coverage matching statutory minimum amounts
Current extract from Commercial Register (Handelsregister) if registered; or for entities under formation, the articles of association or bylaws
fees: €600.00 for insurance broker and consultant permission procedure
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IHK) responsible for your principal business location. If not yet known, you may apply to the IHK responsible for your place of residence.

name: Request Exemption from Licensing Requirement for Product-Accessory Insurance Brokers
description: This service allows you to request an exemption from the insurance broker licensing requirement if you mediate supplementary insurance products as an accessory to your main business activities.
eligibility: You must mediate insurance products only as a supplement to other products or services (accessory to your main business); work directly on behalf of one or more licensed insurance brokers (master brokers) and/or one or more insurance companies; maintain adequate professional liability insurance with the required minimum coverage limits; and provide a declaration from your client(s) confirming your reliability, qualifications, and sound financial situation. For online applications, you must register/log in with a BundID account.
requiredDocuments: Application for licensing exemption for product-accessory insurance brokers (submit preferably online or in writing by post using the form)
Personal identification document (passport or other official photo ID; not required for electronically submitted applications)

Declaration from your client(s) confirming reliability and qualifications (page 4 of the application form; must be completed separately for each insurance company or master broker you intend to work for)

Professional liability insurance confirmation from an insurance company confirming the existence of professional liability insurance for the insurance business with coverage amounts meeting statutory minimum requirements
Current commercial register extract (only required if your business is registered in the commercial register; newly established legal entities should submit articles of association or bylaws)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Submit your application to the Chamber of Industry and Commerce responsible for your business location. If your business location is not yet known, you may submit the application to the Chamber of Industry and Commerce responsible for your residential address.

name: Equalization of Pension Benefits (Versorgungsausgleich)
description: This service handles the division and adjustment of pension rights and benefits between former spouses following a divorce, particularly for divorces finalized abroad.
eligibility: You or your former spouse must have acquired German pension rights. Eligible pension rights include those from statutory pension insurance, civil service pensions, public-sector supplementary pensions, and occupational or private retirement provisions within Germany and abroad. For divorces finalized abroad, you must submit an application to the competent family court for the equalization process to be conducted in Germany.
requiredDocuments: Written application for equalization of pension benefits after foreign divorce (may be submitted in free form or using the official form)
Your name and your former spouse's name with current addresses
Your personal signature on the application (unless represented by a lawyer; legal representation is not required)
Identity document proving your nationality (certified copy of your passport; for marriages dissolved before September 1, 1986, the husband's nationality at the time of divorce may be relevant)
Marriage certificate (original or officially certified copy)
Divorce decree or divorce judgment (original or officially certified copy)
Proof of legal force: the divorce decree or judgment must bear a certification of legal finality (Rechtskraftvermerk)
Translations: foreign-language documents must be accompanied by a certified German translation

Proof of service: court certificate or receipt confirmation showing when your divorce application was served to the other party, or if you jointly initiated the proceedings, proof of when your joint application was filed with the court

Declaration of service authority: if your permanent residence is outside Germany, you should designate in writing a person in Germany authorized to receive service of documents (this saves time and costs by avoiding international service procedures)

Additional documents as circumstances require: (a) If your former spouse is deceased: their death certificate and names/addresses of survivors and heirs; (b) If you have private agreements or court rulings regarding equalization of pension benefits or pension credits: documentation of these; (c) If applicable, proof of recognition of the foreign divorce (not required if divorced after March 1, 2001 in an EU Member State other than Denmark, or through a joint home court abroad)
processingTime: The processing time depends primarily on the number of pension rights to be reviewed and on your cooperation and participation. If assessment of foreign pension rights is required, expert actuarial assessments may be necessary, which could result in additional costs.

bookingInfo.office: District Court (Family Court) Schöneberg: has territorial and international jurisdiction if both former spouses reside outside Germany at the time the equalization proceeding is initiated. District Court (Family Court) of the residence location: if one former spouse resides in Germany, the application must be filed with the family court competent for that spouse's residence.

name: Auctioneer License - Apply for Permission
description: This service allows individuals and businesses to apply for permission to operate as an auctioneer (Versteigerer) in Berlin, subject to verification of personal reliability and financial stability.
eligibility: Personal reliability: Verified through various documents including a certificate from the Federal Central Register (Führungszeugnis) and a report from the Commercial Register. Sound financial situation: The applicant must not have debts (private or public) or any known insolvency proceedings. For online application: Registration/login via BundID is required.
requiredDocuments: Application for auctioneer permission (online or paper form)
Identity document: Passport or other official identity document with photograph (not required for electronic submission); residence permit if applicant is not a citizen of an EU country

Certificate from the Federal Central Register (Führungszeugnis) for verification of personal reliability, issued for presentation to a government authority (certificate type O); must not be older than three months

Commercial Register extract for individuals: Report from the Commercial Register for natural persons for presentation to a government authority (certificate type 9); must not be older than three months

Commercial Register extract for legal entities: Report from the Commercial Register for legal entities for presentation to a government authority (certificate type 9); must not be older than three months
Information from the Debtor Register (Central Enforcement Portal): Reports of entries must be requested online at the Central Enforcement Portal of the states

Insolvency Register information: For natural persons resident in Berlin, two certificates are required — one from the competent residential court for consumer insolvency proceedings and one from the District Court Charlottenburg (Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin) for standard insolvency proceedings. For legal entities and partnerships with registered office in Berlin, contact the District Court Charlottenburg (Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin). Applicants with residence/registered office outside Berlin should check the relevant insolvency court jurisdictions via the central directory of courts

Current extract from the Commercial Register (Handelsregister): Registered companies must provide a current extract at time of application. Legal entities in formation (GmbH, AG) should submit the articles of association or bylaws
fees: €100.00 to €1,200.00, depending on administrative effort required
processingTime: Approximately 1 month

bookingInfo.office: The application must be submitted to the regulatory office (Ordnungsamt) responsible for the intended business location. If a business location is not yet known, the application can be submitted to the regulatory office responsible for the applicant's residential address.

name: Auctioneer - Public Appointment and Oath Application
description: This service allows eligible individuals to apply for public appointment and oath as an auctioneer in Berlin, subject to demonstrating professional expertise, business integrity, and compliance with relevant regulations.
eligibility: Applicants must be natural persons (not legal entities). You must hold a license for the auctioneer profession and work either self-employed or as an employee of an auctioneer with independent authority to assess and evaluate auction items. You must demonstrate exceptional expert knowledge and experience in valuing movable household goods typical of pawn shop transactions (carpets, furs, jewelry, furniture, art, household items) for general appointments, or specialized expertise in specific auction categories (antiques, artworks, etc.). You must have comprehensive knowledge of all relevant regulations including the Trade Regulation Code, Auctioneer Regulation, Commercial Code, and Civil Code. You must provide evidence of multiple years of professional experience as an auctioneer, conducting several auctions annually. You must demonstrate orderly financial circumstances and personal reliability, including trustworthiness necessary for handling forced sales and pawn transactions that protect economically vulnerable populations from exploitation.
requiredDocuments: Application submitted in text form by post or electronically
Copy of identity card (Personalausweis) or passport, and residence permit if applicant is not an EU citizen
Tabular curriculum vitae detailing professional background, relevant qualifications, and continuing education or training measures
Copies of relevant exam certificates or attendance confirmations for professional development and training measures
Evidence of professional experience: minimum five years as auctioneer with several auctions annually, including documentation of completed work such as appraisals or auction lists
Proof of expertise: may be required to pass an examination before a neutral expert panel (e.g., Chamber of Commerce)
Copy of auctioneer license
Certificate of conduct from the Federal Central Register (criminal background check) for presentation to authorities (form O), not older than three months
Extract from the Commercial Register for presentation to authorities, not older than three months, stating purpose as 'Public appointment as auctioneer according to § 34b para. 5 GewO'

Certification from the Insolvency Register: for persons resident in Berlin, two certificates are required—one from your residential court for consumer insolvency proceedings and one from Berlin District Court Charlottenburg (Amtsgerichtsplatz 1, 14057 Berlin) for standard insolvency proceedings, not older than three months
Self-disclosure from the debtor register, not older than three months
Tax certification from your business tax office (if already operating a business) or residential tax office (if not yet operating a business), not older than three months
Copy of business registration (Gewerbeanmeldung) if already operating as an auctioneer
Release certificate from employer (if employed as auctioneer's employee) confirming independent fulfillment of duties without employer direction
Insurance company confirmation of professional liability insurance (Berufshaftpflichtversicherung) for the auctioneer profession
processingTime: 1 to 3 months, depending on completeness of submitted documents, receipt of criminal background certificate, and any required examinations before a neutral expert panel

bookingInfo.office: Submit applications without paper clips. For applicants with residence or business location outside Berlin, consult the central location and court directory regarding competent insolvency courts.

name: Auctioneer Trade - Notification of Auction Event
description: This service allows registered auctioneers to notify the competent authority of an upcoming auction event.
eligibility: Valid license to conduct the auctioneer trade; for online application submission: registration/login via BundID
requiredDocuments: Notification of auction event — submit online or use the template form in writing or electronically, specifying location, time, and goods to be auctioned (use the template form available under 'Formulare')
Auctioneer license — proof by presenting the license document or a copy
fees: No fee for standard auction notifications; 14.32 EUR for expedited auctions with shortened two-week advance notification period
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The notification must be submitted to the local authority (Ordnungsamt) responsible for the auction location.

name: Enforcement Protection Request, Special Case: Eviction Protection Request
description: A request to halt or suspend enforcement action or eviction proceedings when the action would create exceptional hardship for the debtor.
eligibility: Three conditions must be met: (1) The enforcement action or eviction constitutes unreasonable hardship — extraordinarily exceptional circumstances where forced enforcement would violate basic principles of decency, particularly if your life, health, or the life of a close family member is seriously threatened and cannot be addressed by any other means than suspending the eviction proceedings; (2) Your interests as debtor outweigh the creditor's interests — the creditor's protection need must be weighed against yours, and you can only receive enforcement protection if the creditor's interests are in gross disproportion to yours; (3) You have received an eviction notice from the court bailiff — you must present the eviction notice from the court bailiff to contest the eviction. Additionally, you must submit the request at least 2 weeks before the eviction date set by the court bailiff, unless the hardship circumstances arose after that deadline or you were prevented from timely filing without your fault (which you must document).
requiredDocuments: Written request from the debtor with detailed explanation of the unreasonable hardship (can be submitted during office hours at the court's legal application office)
Identity card or passport with registration certificate
Eviction notice from the court bailiff (a copy is sufficient)

Supporting documents proving unreasonable hardship, such as a new rental contract or medical certification from a specialist showing that the enforcement action poses significant health risk to you or a close family member
fees: €20.00 for the enforcement protection request, plus €3.50 for each service of notice.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The District Court (Amtsgericht) that serves as the enforcement court in the jurisdiction where the enforcement action takes place.

name: Vehicle Inspection
description: A service for presenting vehicles to the vehicle registration authority for inspection, with no specific eligibility requirements.
eligibility: No specific eligibility requirements.
requiredDocuments: Available vehicle registration documents
Proof of acquisition if applicable
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service is available exclusively at the vehicle registration authority (Kfz-Zulassungsbehörde) Berlin-Lichtenberg. Appointments are required; please submit appointment requests to post.kfz-zulassung@labo.berlin.de. For appointments to inspect electric mopeds (Elektro-Kleinkrafträder), submit requests via the contact form to the Berlin vehicle registration authority, selecting "Vorführen eines Elektro-Kleinkraftrades" in the subject line.

name: Municipal Right of First Refusal - Request Negative Certificate
description: A service that allows you to request a certificate confirming that the municipality does not exercise its right of first refusal on a property purchase within the municipality.
eligibility: Purchase contract for a property within the municipal area; the content of the purchase contract must be communicated to the municipality by one of the contracting parties (seller or buyer).
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of a negative certificate (can be submitted informally with information from the purchase contract or using the completed form sheet)
Information from the purchase contract: fact of purchase, date of purchase, exact designation of the property (street, house number, section, lot number, size, land register page number)
Names and complete addresses of the purchase contract parties and identification of the party liable for fees
Public deed register
processingTime: Approximately 3 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The service can be accessed at the competent local Building Planning Department (Fachbereich Stadtplanung) of the Urban Development Office (Stadtentwicklungsamt).

name: Guardianship (Vormundschaft)
description: A service for appointing a suitable person, authority, or organization as legal guardian for a minor child.
eligibility: A suitable person (such as a family member or professional guardian), a public authority (for example, the youth office), or a charitable organization may serve as guardian. Parents may name a guardian for their children in their will, but the final selection is made by the family court. With rare exceptions, guardians perform their duties without compensation. There is particular need for volunteer guardians for unaccompanied minor refugees who have entered Germany without their parents.
requiredDocuments: Name, date of birth, and place of residence of the child for whom you wish to become guardian
Name, date of birth, place of birth, and place of residence of the person who wishes to assume guardianship
Explanation of why you wish to assume guardianship for the child
fees: Costs for the guardianship proceedings at the family court are borne by the child. Fees are only charged if the ward's assets, after deduction of liabilities, exceed €25,000.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Substantively responsible for the appointment, support, and supervision of the guardian is the District Court (Family Court). Geographically responsible is the court in whose district the child has his or her habitual residence, or in whose district the need for care becomes known; or during pending divorce proceedings, the court with which the divorce was filed in the first instance, provided it concerns common children of the spouses.

name: Certify Power of Attorney and Care Directives
description: This service certifies your power of attorney or care directive documents to make them legally valid.
eligibility: Personal presence of the person granting the power of attorney is required.
requiredDocuments: Power of attorney or care directive in original form
Valid personal identification documents
fees: 10.00 Euro for certification of the power of attorney or care directive
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: This service can be obtained at the Social Services Office (Amt für Soziales) in your residential district.

name: Registration for Expert Examination for Commercial Weapons Trading
description: This service allows you to register for the expert examination required to obtain a license for commercial weapons trading.
eligibility: You must be registered or pre-registered for the examination by the authority responsible for issuing commercial weapons trading licenses. In most cases, the authority that processed your application for the weapons trading license will handle your registration.
requiredDocuments: Notification from the weapons trading license authority that the examination should take place
Valid personal identification document (passport or national ID card with photo)
Residence permit if the applicant is not a citizen of an EU country
processingTime: Expert examinations take place irregularly, so the duration between notification by the authority and the examination date may vary. The certificate is normally available immediately or a few days after passing the oral examination component.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Weapon Possession Card (Yellow) for Sport Shooters
description: A permit card for licensed sport shooters in Berlin to legally possess and acquire firearms for competitive shooting purposes.
eligibility: You must be a sport shooter (Sportschützin/Sportschütze). Minimum age is typically 25 years, with exceptions: minimum age 18 for acquisition and possession of firearms up to 5.6 mm caliber (.22 l.r.) with rim fire ammunition (muzzle energy max 200 joules) and single-loader long rifles with smooth barrels caliber 12 or smaller approved by a shooting sports federation; minimum age 21 if a personal suitability assessment is available and you plan to acquire other weapon types. You must also meet requirements for reliability, personal suitability, pass a firearms knowledge test (Sachkundeprüfung), and demonstrate a legitimate sporting need (Waffengesetz §§ 8, 14). Within six months, no more than two firearms may typically be acquired (acquisition restriction regulation).
requiredDocuments: Application form for Weapon Possession Card (Yellow) — available online or submit by post/email with signature
Identity card (Personalausweis) or passport — copy or photo
Sporting need certification (Bedürfnisbescheinigung für Sportschützen) — must be issued by a recognized association or sub-association
Firearms knowledge certificate (Sachkundenachweis) — examination certificate from a shooters' association or officially licensed commercial firearms knowledge course provider
Personal suitability assessment (Nachweis der persönlichen Eignung) — required if under 25 years old; may be requested later during processing

Proof of secure storage — purchase receipt and photo of weapon safe showing legible type plate with serial number; details requested immediately for online applications or at a later date for postal applications
Previous residential addresses for the past 10 years — if you have lived outside Berlin in the last 10 years, provide all addresses for the application
fees: €107.00 for Weapon Possession Card (Yellow); €61.00 every three years for regular reliability review; €45.00 every five years for sporting need review; €30.00 every ten years thereafter for sport shooters for sporting need review; €103.00 for weapon storage inspection; €51.00 for weapon storage inspection if repeated within less than three years
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Weapons Possession Card (Green)
description: A green weapons possession card permits individuals who meet eligibility criteria to acquire and possess firearms for purposes such as sport shooting, hunting, or personal protection.
eligibility: Minimum age generally 25 years, with exceptions: sport shooters aged 21+ with psychological aptitude certificate; sport shooters aged 18+ for small-caliber rifles and shotguns without aptitude assessment; hunters and heirs aged 18+ without aptitude assessment. Requirements include reliability, personal suitability, and proof of competency (except for heirs). A legitimate need for the weapon is required (except for heirs). One-month deadline applies for inheritance cases. For online applications: consent to electronic payment (PayPal or SEPA direct debit).
requiredDocuments: Application form for weapons possession card (green)
Identity card or passport (copy or photo)
Proof of competency from shooting sports association or certified commercial training provider (for sport shooters)
Certificate from recognized shooting sports association documenting need and minimum 12 months of shooting sports activity (for sport shooters)
Valid hunting license (for hunters)
Proof of competency and demonstration of endangerment (for endangered persons)
Weapons possession card of the deceased (for heirs)
Death certificate, testament, or certificate of inheritance if applicable (for heirs)
Previous residential addresses if lived outside Berlin in last 10 years
fees: Fees range from €5.00 to €205.00 depending on card type and purpose, including sport shooters (€87.00–€112.00), hunters (€31.00), endangered persons (€205.00), security companies (€95.00–€205.00), and various additional fees for ammunition permits, weapon registration, and periodic compliance reviews.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Red Weapons Possession Card (Rot) for Collectors and Experts
description: This service allows weapons collectors and expert appraisers to apply for a red weapons possession card, subject to eligibility requirements including minimum age, reliability, personal suitability, and expert knowledge certification.
eligibility: You must be a weapons collector or expert appraiser; Minimum age: typically 25 years; from age 18 only with an expert assessment of personal suitability; Reliability required; Personal suitability required; Expert knowledge examination required; Legitimate need under the Weapons Act (WaffG) §§ 8, 17, 18; For online applications: consent to electronic payment methods (PayPal or SEPA direct debit).
requiredDocuments: Application for a red weapons possession card (online or written via post/email)
Identity card or passport (copy or photo)

Proof of legitimate need for weapons (collectors must demonstrate scientific or technical activity as a collector, or acquisition of a culturally-historically significant collection; experts must demonstrate need for scientific, technical purposes, testing, appraisal, examination, or similar purposes)
Expert knowledge certificate/examination test (from an officially-approved training provider)
Proof of personal suitability (if under 25 years old) — to be submitted at a later point during processing
Proof of secure storage (purchase receipt and photo of weapons safe with clearly visible type plate and serial number) — to be submitted at a later point during processing
Previous residential addresses from the last 10 years (if you lived outside Berlin)
fees: €387.00 for issuance of weapons possession card for collectors or experts; €61.00 every three years for regular reliability verification; €45.00 every five years for verification of continuing legitimate need; €103.00 for weapons storage inspection; €51.00 for weapons storage inspection if repeated within less than three years
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Weapons Law - Request Exception Permit to Carry Weapons at Public Events
description: An exception permit allowing individuals who meet specific eligibility criteria to carry weapons at public events in Berlin.
eligibility: You must already possess a weapons license or equivalent permit if you wish to carry a firearm; if you wish to carry other weapons, you must be generally permitted to acquire and possess such items; you must be reliable and personally suitable; you must demonstrate that you cannot forgo weapons at the public event; and there must be no danger to public safety or order.
requiredDocuments: Application for an exception permit to carry weapons at public events (to be submitted in writing by post, fax, or email; no form required)
Family name, given names, date and place of birth, and address; company name and address if applicable for security companies
Copy or photo of identity card or passport
For regulated firearms: copies of weapons possession card and weapons license
For other weapons: details about the type of weapons
Justification that weapons cannot be foregone at the public event
For security companies: contract for provision of security services at the event
fees: 167.00 Euro — a fee notice will be issued and further processing will occur after payment is received.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Firearms Law — Apply for/Modify Permission to Operate a Fixed Shooting Range
