name: Report Water Supply System or Non-Potable Water System
description: A service for operators of water supply systems or non-potable water systems in Berlin to register the installation, operation, modification, ownership transfer, or decommissioning of their systems.
eligibility: You are the operator of a water supply system or non-potable water system in Berlin. This includes central water supply systems, decentralized water supply systems, self-supply water systems, mobile water supply systems, building water supply systems, and temporary water supply systems. You must report the following within the specified timeframes: installation of a water supply system providing drinking water, installation of a non-potable water system, initial or resumed operation of a water supply system, structural or operational modifications to drinking water components of a water supply system that may significantly affect drinking water quality, or transfer of ownership or usage rights — all must be reported at least 4 weeks in advance. For decommissioning of a water supply system, parts of a system, or a non-potable water system, report within 3 days. For temporary water supply systems, report immediately upon becoming aware of the need.
requiredDocuments: Notification of installation, operation, decommissioning, or ownership transfer of a water supply system or non-potable water system (may be submitted online or by mail using the official form)
Documentation of the water supply system as required by the Health Authority upon request
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Exchangeable License Plates
description: This service allows vehicle owners to obtain exchangeable license plates that can be shared between two registered vehicles of the same class and specifications.
eligibility: Exchangeable license plates can be assigned when two vehicles are registered a) to the same owner, b) in the same vehicle classes (see Registration Certificate Part I, Field J): M1 (passenger vehicles with up to 8 seats), L or O1, and c) with the same number and dimensions of license plates. Exchangeable license plates cannot be assigned for seasonal plates, red plates, short-term plates, authority plates, or export plates.
requiredDocuments: Application for Registration (Antrag Zulassung)
Vehicle Registration Certificate Part II (Fahrzeugbrief)
Vehicle Registration Certificate Part I (Fahrzeugschein)
Current license plate(s)
Electronic Insurance Confirmation (eVB) - must be declared by the insurance company as valid for exchangeable plates; one eVB required for each vehicle with exchangeable plates (two per pair)
Proof of valid main inspection according to § 29 StVZO
Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
Power of attorney if applicable (informal or notarized), including ID documents of both grantor and representative
Commercial Register extract and business registration in original or certified copy (for businesses)
Association Register extract in original or certified copy (for associations)
SEPA direct debit mandate
fees: €6.00 plus all additional applicable registration fees. The manufacture of license plates is not a service of the Berlin Motor Vehicle Registration Authority. No information can be provided regarding separately incurred costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Wine Production - Issue Accompanying Documents for Wine Transports
description: This service issues accompanying documents required for transporting wine products in quantities exceeding specified thresholds or distances within Berlin.
eligibility: You transport unpackaged wine products exceeding 60 liters; you transport wine products in labeled containers exceeding 10 liters with non-reusable closures; the transport route for wine products exceeds 70 kilometers from vineyard to winemaking facility, between two facilities of the same company, or between facilities of a producer organization. Certain special cases are exempt from requiring accompanying documents under EU Regulation 2018/273 Article 9.
requiredDocuments: Form 'Begleitdokumente für die Beförderung von Weinbauerzeugnissen' (Accompanying Documents for Transport of Wine Products) — available from Formular-Verlag PURSCHKE+HENSEL GmbH, Thiemannstraße 1, 12059 Berlin, Order No. 3465
processingTime: 0-5 days; processing times may vary in individual cases

bookingInfo.office: The Ordnungsamt Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf is responsible for all of Berlin

name: Advertising Materials - Request Permission to Distribute
description: This service allows you to request permission from the Berlin government to distribute advertising materials (flyers, brochures) in public spaces.
eligibility: You must designate a responsible person; specify the location and timeframe of the planned distribution; submit your request in writing at least 14 days before the planned distribution date; commit to immediately removing or having removed any expected dirt or litter from public roads.
requiredDocuments: Application for permission to distribute advertising materials (formal application; informal applications permitted in exceptional cases)
Business registration and, if applicable, extract from the commercial register (copy)
Advertising material/flyer (copy)
fees: Base fee: 34.00 Euro; Additional 3.00 Euro per street or district per day; or additional 5.00 Euro for the entire city area per day; 10.00 Euro for each additional copy of the permit
processingTime: 14 days

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Workshop Card (Werkstattkarte)
description: This service allows qualified workshop operators and technicians to apply for an official workshop card required for authorized vehicle repair and inspection facilities.
eligibility: Personal attendance is required. The application must be submitted in person, or by an authorized representative if applicable.
requiredDocuments: Completed application form for the workshop card (must be presented in person; applications by mail cannot be processed)
Copy of the applicant's or authorized representative's ID card or passport
Power of attorney for representation (if applicable)
Copy of business registration certificate (Gewerbeanmeldung) or commercial register extract (Handelsregisterauszug)
Current official recognition or authorization under § 57b StVZO (for workshops)
Copy of the technician's ID card or passport

Training certificate for the technician in accordance with the "Directive for conducting training of responsible specialist staff performing tachograph and control device inspections under § 57b paragraph 3 StVZO" (not older than 3 years)
Written statement on the employment relationship of the technician (handwritten confirmation or copy of employment contract)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The issuing office for control device cards (memory cards for digital tachographs) in Berlin is the State Office for Citizens' and Administrative Affairs (Landesamt für Bürger- und Ordnungsangelegenheiten, LABO). Applications can only be submitted at the office building at Puttkamerstraße.

name: Apply for Resumption Funding from the Capital Culture Fund
description: This service allows applicants to request additional funding to resume and present a cultural project that was previously supported by the Capital Culture Fund.
eligibility: Your original Capital Culture Fund-supported project must be completed. At least four performances or events must be planned in Berlin; projects must be developed and presented in Berlin, with the number of performances guaranteed by the venue in writing (this requirement does not apply to exhibitions, festivals, or similar formats). You must have submitted the final accounting report for the original funded project. You must ensure accessible offerings for people with disabilities, and should indicate in the application form whether and for which groups you are planning accessible services and how these are reflected in the budget; consultation is available from the Berlin Diversity Development Office (DAC).
requiredDocuments: Application for Resumption Funding from the Capital Culture Fund (must be submitted online only)
Detailed financing plan
Confirmation of presentation venue and accessibility of the venue
processingTime: 3-6 months

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Illegal Waste Disposal (Wild Dumping) - Removal
description: A service for reporting and removing illegally dumped waste in Berlin.
eligibility: Report the illegal waste by telephone, in writing, or electronically.
requiredDocuments: Complaint containing the following information: location and time of dumping; volume of waste; person responsible (if known); personal data of the person reporting
fees: Free of charge (may be charged to the person responsible for the dumping).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Winter Service on Sidewalks - Information on Clearing and Spreading Obligations
description: This service provides information to property owners about their legal obligations to clear snow and spread de-icing materials on sidewalks during winter.
eligibility: You are a property owner, usufruct holder, or holder of a land registry-registered right of use (Anlieger under the Street Cleaning Act). Sidewalks must exist in front of your property. Winter service must be performed on the nearest sidewalks running in the same or similar direction in front of your property, including sidewalk sections branching off to the property or in corner cut-off areas; on streets without sidewalks on the preferred pedestrian surface; and on insufficiently developed Category C streets with extended clearing obligations including sidewalk continuation in intersection areas. You must maintain the required clearing width: a width appropriate to pedestrian traffic, minimum 1 meter; 1.5 meters on sidewalks of major traffic streets and business streets (Category A1/2); 3 meters in special cases. You must perform winter service immediately after snow or snow and ice slickness develops: snow must be cleared immediately after snowfall ends, or several times at appropriate intervals if snowfall continues; snow and ice slickness must be addressed immediately upon formation; if snowfall continues past 8:00 PM or snow/ice forms after that time, winter service must be completed by 7:00 AM, or 9:00 AM on Sundays and public holidays. You must perform full winter service including: snow clearing, spreading de-icing materials, and removal of ice formations that cannot be addressed by spreading. You must not use prohibited de-icing agents—any de-icing agents including salts are prohibited. If delegating winter service to others, you remain responsible for monitoring proper execution. Exemptions may apply for physical or economic inability or undue hardship based on danger avoidance.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Winter Street Cleaning Service – Request Exemption for Inability to Perform
description: A service allowing property owners to request exemption from winter sidewalk maintenance obligations if they are unable to do so due to physical and economic reasons.
eligibility: Property owners must demonstrate both physical and economic inability to perform winter street cleaning services. Both conditions must be present simultaneously.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from winter service due to inability to perform (informal written application, can be submitted by email, must be resubmitted annually)
Evidence of physical inability to perform (copy): Copy of disability certificate (e.g. aG, H, Bl) and/or medical certification

Evidence of economic inability to perform (copy): Income documentation such as copies of recent pension statements, basic security payments, or tax assessments, other income and earnings, information about assets, and copies of annual invoices for costs of energy, electricity, gas, coal, water, chimney sweep, street cleaning, waste disposal, property tax, and building insurance
processingTime: 2–3 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The Bezirksamt Lichtenberg (District Office Lichtenberg), Office for Regionalized Administrative Tasks, is responsible for processing all exemption requests for all Berlin districts.

name: Winter Service Exemption for Sidewalks - Request Exemption Due to Undue Hardship
description: This service allows property owners to request an exemption from winter snow and ice removal obligations on sidewalks if the exemption is necessary to avoid undue hardship and pedestrian safety is not compromised.
eligibility: An exemption can only be granted if it is necessary to prevent undue hardship and simultaneously ensures that pedestrian traffic is not endangered. No winter service will be performed — not even as a substitute by third parties.
requiredDocuments: Application for exemption from winter service due to undue hardship
Informal written application (can also be submitted by email using signature procedures)
processingTime: 4-6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: The authority responsible for granting the exemption is centralized throughout Berlin and is handled exclusively by the Lichtenberg District Office (Bezirksamt Lichtenberg), Department for Regionalized Regulatory Tasks (Amt für Regionalisierte Ordnungsaufgaben), for all Berlin districts.

name: Housing Entitlement Certificate (WBS) Application
description: A housing entitlement certificate (WBS) is a document that qualifies low-income residents to rent subsidized social housing in Berlin, based on income limits and housing needs.
eligibility: You must meet income limits based on household size. Housing size is determined by one room per person, with exceptions for single persons (up to 50 sqm in 1.5 or 2-room apartments) and special needs. You must be at least 18 years old, have German citizenship, EU citizenship, or a valid residence permit lasting at least 1 year. You must reside in Berlin for at least 11 months with intent to establish permanent residence. Special housing needs may be recognized for families with inadequate housing, people with severe disabilities (50% or more), those in emergency shelters, persons over 65 downsizing, those with involuntary housing loss, and recipients of basic social security benefits (SGB II/XII) with relocation notices.
requiredDocuments: Application form for Housing Entitlement Certificate (WBS) - completed and signed by all adults, submitted online (PDF/JPG format, max 30 MB total, max 5 MB per file) or by post to your district Citizens' or Housing Office
Income declaration - completed and signed by all adults
Income certificate - completed and signed by employer
Copy of identity documents for all persons named in the application (e.g., passport or foreign travel passport with residence permit)
Partnership declaration - if applicable for unmarried or unrelated persons
Copy of proof of other marital status if not single (e.g., divorce decree or death certificate)
Copy of birth certificates of your children if named in the application
Declaration regarding joint custody
Copy of paternity recognition if applicable (e.g., for unmarried couples with shared children and custody order)
Copy of maternity pass showing 14th week of pregnancy if pregnant
Copy of both sides of severe disability certificate if severely disabled
Copy of semester certificate if a student (with additional proof of study duration for foreign students)
Copy of proof of residence right if foreign national (EU citizens typically need only passport copy; non-EU citizens need residence permit documentation)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Housing Office of the district where you reside. If you do not live in Berlin, you may select a Housing Office.

name: Housing Allowance - Request for Burden Subsidy (Lastenzuschuss)
description: A financial subsidy for homeowners or condominium owners in Berlin who bear the costs of capital service and property management for their own residence.
eligibility: You must have your primary residence in Berlin. You must be the owner of a single-family home or condominium that you occupy yourself and bear the costs for capital service and property management (burden). You cannot receive transfer benefits where housing costs are considered, such as Bürgergeld/Arbeitslosengeld II/Sozialgeld, basic security in old age and disability, help for subsistence, or child and youth welfare. You cannot receive BAföG, vocational training allowance (BAB), or benefits from the MobiPro-EU program. You can use the housing allowance calculator before applying to check your eligibility without obligation.
requiredDocuments: Application form for housing allowance as burden subsidy (online or paper form)
Identification documents (copies) from all persons living in your household
Proof of residence rights (copies) — EU citizens usually need only a copy of their ID document; non-EU citizens need proof of residence permit or similar authorization
Proof of ownership (copies), for example purchase contract or land registry excerpt
Current operating cost statement (if available, in copy)
Proof of your housing allowance payments for the last three months (copies), for example receipts or bank statements
Proof of your burden payments (copies), for example loan contracts, third-party funding certificates, or property tax notice

Proof of transfer benefits from all household members (copies), for example: unemployment benefit or Bürgergeld/Arbeitslosengeld II notice; basic security notice with welfare calculation form; youth office advance maintenance payments notice
Income statements for all household members (copies), for example salary statements, earnings statements, or pension notices
Proof of advertising expenses, severe disability status, care level, basic pension periods (copies)
For renewal application: application form with necessary attachments, income/earnings statement, notification of changes to capital service or management costs
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: For paper applications: send the completed and signed application and all documents (in copies) by mail to your district housing office or citizen office, or submit the application in person.

name: Housing Allowance - Rental Subsidy Application
description: A financial assistance program for Berlin residents who pay rent and meet income and eligibility requirements.
eligibility: You must have your primary residence in Berlin; be a main tenant or subtenant of residential space or live in a similar rental arrangement (such as a cooperative apartment or residential facility), use the space yourself, and pay rent for it; not receive transfer benefits that cover housing costs (such as Citizens' Allowance/Unemployment Benefit II/Social Allowance, basic security in old age and in case of inability to work, assistance for living expenses, or child and youth welfare); and not be eligible for BAföG, vocational training allowance, or benefits under the MobiPro-EU program. You can use the Housing Allowance Calculator to check your eligibility before applying.
requiredDocuments: Application form for Housing Allowance as Rental Subsidy (can be submitted online or by mail)
Copies of identification documents from all persons living in your apartment

Proof of residence rights (in copy); if you are an EU citizen, a copy of your ID document usually suffices; if you are from a non-EU country, you need proof of your residence permit or residence approval
Copy of your rental contract and any supplementary agreements or landlord's change notices
Proof of your rent payments for the last three months (in copy), for example receipts or bank statements

Copies of transfer benefit notices from all persons living in your apartment, such as unemployment benefit notices, Citizens' Allowance/Unemployment Benefit II notices, basic security notices with social welfare calculation sheets, or child maintenance advance payment notices from the Youth Office
Income statements for all household members (in copy), such as salary certificates, earnings statements, or pension notices
Proof of income-related expenses, severe disability status, care level, and basic pension entitlement periods (in copy)

For continuation applications: application form with applicable attachments, income statements and/or earnings certificates, rent payment proof, and if your rent has changed, the most recent rent change notice
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: For written applications: send your completed and signed application and all supporting documents (in copy) by mail to your district Housing Office or Citizen's Office, or submit the application in person.

name: Housing Development Grant - Income Certificate Application (IBB)
description: This service allows you to request an income certificate from the IBB housing development program when required by your landlord.
eligibility: You have been asked by your landlord to submit an income certificate.
requiredDocuments: Application for issuance of an income certificate according to § 9 paragraph 2 of the Housing Development Act (Wohnraumförderungsgesetz)
Declaration regarding personal circumstances and current housing conditions
Income declaration (must be completed for each person and signed by all adults)
Income certificate (to be completed and signed by your employer)
Copy of identification documents from all persons named in the application, such as passports or foreign travel passports with residence permit
Copy of registration certificates (Meldenachweise) from all persons named in the application
Copy of marriage certificate or civil partnership certificate
Copy of partnership declaration (may be necessary for unmarried or unrelated persons)
Copy of proof of other marital status, such as divorce decree or death certificate if applicable
Copy of birth certificates of your children (if included in the application)
Copy of declaration regarding joint custody (if applicable)
Copy of maternity record with documented 14th week of pregnancy, if applicable
Copy of paternity recognition, such as in a domestic partnership with joint child custody order
Copy of front and back of severely disabled person pass (Schwerbehindertenausweis) if applicable
Copy of semester certificate if currently studying, plus proof of duration of studies for foreign students
Copy of proof of residence right if a foreigner, such as residence permit or (for EU citizens) copy of identification document
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Housing office (Wohnungsamt) of the district in which you live. If you do not live in Berlin, you may select a housing office. Applications are normally submitted in writing. No appointment is necessary.

name: Register Primary Residence or Sole Residence
description: Register your new primary residence or sole residence in Berlin with the local registration office within 14 days of moving.
eligibility: You have moved to a new primary residence or sole residence in Berlin. Registration must be completed within 14 days of moving. Exceptions: If you are already registered in Germany and staying in Berlin for a maximum of six months, registration is not required. If you live abroad and are staying in Berlin for a maximum of three months, registration is not required. Military service members, federal volunteers, civil service members, police officers, Bundeswehr soldiers (up to 12 months only), or other public service employees (for training and continuing education purposes only) in communal accommodations or other service-provided housing do not need to register. For minors: consent declaration from guardians is required. For online registration: minimum age 18 years, German citizenship or EU citizenship, registration via BundID, activated online identification function (eID). For in-person registration: minimum age 16 years (if under 16, a legal guardian must register); appointment required; written power of attorney required if represented.
requiredDocuments: Completed registration form (submit online or in person at the citizen office)

Valid identity document (for online registration: valid ID card or EU citizen card with activated eID function and PIN; for in-person registration: valid ID card, passport, children's passport for German citizens, national passport, passport replacement documents, or travel document with electronic residence permit for foreign nationals)

Landlord confirmation of move-in (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung) signed by the landlord within two weeks of move-in, containing: landlord's name and address, owner's name (if different), move-in date, apartment address, and names of persons registering
Accommodation confirmation for Ukrainian refugees (equivalent to landlord confirmation, in-person registration only)

Consent declaration from absent custodian (for cohabiting parents with joint custody; for online family registration: click 'confirmation of authorization' in online service; for in-person registration: informal written consent from absent parent required)
Form 'Consent Declaration of Custodians' and identity document of other custodian (for separated parents with joint custody, in-person registration only)
Supplementary form to registration/primary residence declaration (for multiple residences, in-person registration only)
Vital records documents for first Berlin registration (marriage certificate, birth certificate, etc., to be brought if available)

Written power of attorney or consent declaration for representation (for online family registration: click 'confirmation of authorization' in online service; family members only can represent in online service; for in-person registration: signed power of attorney and completed form required)
processingTime: Immediate

bookingInfo.office: Available at all Berlin citizen offices (Bürgerämter). Special responsibility for Ukrainian refugees, asylum applicants, and persons with toleration or border crossing certificates covering all of Berlin. Handles group registrations and deregistrations for accommodation facilities in Berlin.

name: Register Secondary Residence or Additional Residence in Berlin
description: This service allows you to register a secondary residence or additional residence in Berlin while maintaining another residence elsewhere in Germany.
eligibility: You have obtained a further residence or main residence in Berlin and are retaining your previous residence in Germany. Registration must be completed within 14 days of moving in. Minimum age 16 years — if you are under 16, the person of legal age in whose apartment you are moving must register your new main residence. An appointment must be arranged. If someone is representing you, they must have written power of attorney.
requiredDocuments: Completed registration form (to be submitted in person at the Citizen's Office)

Valid identity document: German ID card, passport, children's passport for German nationals, or national passport, passport replacement documents, or eAT for foreign nationals (please bring all available documents for all persons moving in)

Landlord's confirmation of move-in (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung) — landlords are required to confirm in writing with signature within two weeks of move-in; confirmation must contain: name and address of landlord and, if not owner, the owner's name, move-in date, apartment address, and names of persons required to register; a lease agreement does not replace this confirmation
For Ukrainian refugees: confirmation of permanent provision of accommodation for Ukrainian refugees for submission to LEA or LAF (equivalent to landlord's confirmation)
Written power of attorney if someone is representing you (must be signed by you personally along with the completed registration form)
processingTime: Immediate

bookingInfo.office: This service is available at all Citizen's Offices (Bürgerämter) in Berlin. The office is responsible for refugees from Ukraine, asylum seekers, persons with toleration status or border crossing certificates from all of Berlin. The office is responsible for batch registrations and deregistrations for accommodation facilities in Berlin.

name: Apply for Housing Construction Savings Subsidy (Wohnungsbauprämie)
description: A government subsidy program for eligible savers who set aside funds for residential construction or purchase through a building savings account.
eligibility: You must be at least 16 years old. Your taxable income (after tax allowances for children in the savings year) must not exceed 35,000 euros if single, or 70,000 euros if married or in a registered civil partnership (if jointly assessed). The funds saved must not represent assets eligible for employee savings allowance. The subsidy must be claimed from the building savings company within two years and will be credited to your savings account (for example, by December 31, 2025 for the 2023 savings year).
requiredDocuments: Application for Housing Construction Savings Subsidy (Antrag auf Wohnungsbauprämie) — available only from the building savings company, typically sent with the annual account statement
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Applications are received by the building savings company (Bausparkasse). Information is provided by the tax office of your place of residence (Wohnsitzfinanzamt).

name: Condominium Association Matters (WEG Cases)
description: A court service for filing lawsuits related to condominium association (WEG) disputes, subject to special procedural requirements including proper identification of parties, the property address, and adherence to specific deadlines.
eligibility: Filing a lawsuit: General formal requirements of the German Code of Civil Procedure (ZPO) apply. For WEG cases, the following special conditions must be met: (1) Designation of claimant and defendant – in the claim, the WEG may initially be identified by the address of the shared property; however, a list of owners with names and addresses of other property owners must be submitted by the end of the oral hearing; (2) Designation of the property manager – if the manager of the WEG is a party, representative, or authorized agent for service, this must be stated; (3) Deadlines – for a challenge to a resolution (Beschlussanfechtungsklage), a one-month deadline applies from the date of the resolution, and a two-month deadline applies for substantiating the claim from the date of the resolution.
requiredDocuments: Claim (Klageschrift)
fees: Processing the claim depends on payment of a court cost advance. As the claimant, you will receive a payment request from the court after filing the claim. The court will only serve the claim after the court cost advance has been paid.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent court is the local court (Amtsgericht) in the district where the property (for example, an apartment or commercial unit) is located.

name: Request Compensation for Witness Testimony in Specialized Courts
description: This service allows witnesses who appeared at court hearings to request compensation for their time and expenses.
eligibility: You were summoned as a witness to a court date and appeared at that date; You did not waive witness compensation; Application must be submitted within 3 months
requiredDocuments: Completed compensation application form for witnesses in specialized courts (obtained with summons or at the court date)
Payment authorization and attendance certificate signed by the court or presiding judge
Earnings loss certificate from employer (if applicable and only if you experienced lost wages)
Proof of self-employment such as business registration certificate, average monthly gross income from self-employment, and regular working hours (if self-employed)
Supporting documentation for freelance activities such as suitable evidence of freelance work, average monthly income from freelance activities, and regular working hours (if freelancing)
Receipts and documentation for travel costs or other expenses incurred to attend the hearing, such as original tickets, booking confirmations, flight invoices, or accommodation costs
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You may submit your completed written application in person at the office, place it in the mailbox of the Social Court Berlin, or send it by post, fax, or electronic legal communication to the sender of the summons. Alternatively, submit your application in person at the Compensation and Reimbursement Office on the ground floor, Room 0408, or at the Administration on the 1st floor, Room 1508.

name: Compensation for Witnesses in Criminal and Traffic Violation Proceedings
description: This service allows witnesses who appeared at a court hearing in criminal or traffic violation proceedings to apply for compensation for their expenses and lost earnings.
eligibility: You were summoned as a witness to a hearing and attended the hearing; application must be made within 3 months
requiredDocuments: Application for Compensation of Witnesses in Criminal and Traffic Violation Proceedings (available under 'Forms') — submit in writing by mail or in person at the court; you also received this form with your hearing summons

Payment Order (Form HKR 172) — signed by the court or by the public prosecutor's office, certifying your attendance; you receive the original and copy after your witness testimony or release from the hearing

Documentation of travel costs or other expenses incurred — provide receipts for travel expenses to and from the hearing (e.g., original tickets, booking confirmations, flight invoices, accommodation costs)
Certificate of Lost Earnings — if you lost income, have your employer complete the lost earnings certificate form that was included with your summons
Documentation of Self-Employment Status — if self-employed, provide proof of self-employment (e.g., business registration) and state your average monthly gross income and regular working hours

Documentation of Freelance Activities — if self-employed as a freelancer, provide supporting documents demonstrating your freelance work, along with your average monthly income and regular working hours
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: District Court Tiergarten (Amtsgericht Tiergarten) - Calculation Office (Berechnungsstelle); submit your written application by: handing it to the courtroom attendant, depositing it in the mailbox of the Calculation Office in front of Room A 236, or sending it by mail to the Amtsgericht Tiergarten - Berechnungsstelle; you may also request to apply verbally at your hearing or send your application by mail to the sender of your summons

name: Witness Compensation in Civil Court Proceedings
description: Request compensation for serving as a witness in a civil court case if you appeared when summoned and did not waive your right to compensation.
eligibility: You were summoned as a witness to a court date and appeared in person; You did not waive your right to witness compensation; Application must be submitted within 3 months
requiredDocuments: Application for witness compensation in civil court proceedings (form available under "Formulare") — you received a copy with your court summons

Payment authorization form (official form: HKR 172) certifying your attendance — you receive the original and copy after your testimony or dismissal from the hearing, and it must be signed by the court
Evidence of travel costs or other expenses — provide receipts for travel to and from the court (e.g., original tickets, booking confirmations, flight invoices, accommodation costs)
Certificate of lost earnings — if you lost income, request a certificate from your employer; the form was provided with your summons
Proof of self-employment — if self-employed, provide documentation (e.g., business registration) and state your average monthly gross income and regular working hours
Documentation of freelance activity — if freelance, provide suitable documentation of your freelance work, and state your average monthly income and regular working hours
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Request Access Authorization for Airport Security Areas (Airport ID)
description: This service allows eligible individuals from specified personnel categories to obtain an airport access pass (Flughafenausweis) for non-occasional access to airport security areas.
eligibility: You belong to one of the personnel groups named in § 7 Section 1 of the German Aviation Security Act (Luftsicherheitsgesetz) and require access to an airport's security area not merely occasionally for your work. For online application (optional), you must have an activated online identification function (eID) and either an electronic national ID card (Personalausweis), EU citizen ID card (eID-Karte), or electronic residence permit (eAT) with activated eID function and your PIN; an external card reader or a modern NFC-enabled smartphone with Android or iOS operating system; and the software 'AusweisApp'.
requiredDocuments: Application for airport access authorization (Flughafenausweis) — may be submitted online or by post
Identity verification — two-sided copy of national ID card or two-sided copy of passport
Employment history for the past 5 years (day-exact)
Residential addresses for the past 10 years
Registration certificate if applicable (not older than 4 weeks)
Certificate of good conduct or European criminal record certificate if residence abroad exceeded 6 months in the past 5 years
Residence permit including supplementary sheet if applicable
fees: 56.00 to 110.00 euros depending on processing effort
processingTime: 1-6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Registration of a used vehicle imported from EU/EEA countries
description: This service handles the registration of used vehicles that were previously registered in EU or EEA countries and are now being imported to Berlin.
eligibility: The vehicle was already registered in the EU or EEA. All documents must be provided in original form.
requiredDocuments: Application for vehicle registration (completed) (under "Forms")
SEPA direct debit mandate (under "Forms")
Purchase contract or invoice
Electronic insurance confirmation (eVB)
Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
Foreign registration certificate(s)
Presentation of foreign license plate(s) for registered vehicles (if available)
COC document (EC Certificate of Conformity) or manufacturer's data confirmation
Proof of valid main inspection according to § 29 StVZO
Expert assessment according to § 21 StVZO for vehicles without type approval (not older than 18 months)
Exception permit if deviations were found in the expert assessment according to § 21 StVZO
Trade registration/extract from commercial register in original (or certified copy) and personal documents of authorized representative (for businesses)
Extract from association register in original (or certified copy) and personal documents of authorized representative (for associations)
Informal power of attorney if applicable, including identity documents of grantor and proxy (unless notarially executed)
fees: Base fee starts at €34.70 according to the current traffic regulation fee schedule, but may be higher depending on individual case circumstances. Additional fees apply if an exception permit is required. License plate production fees are not included and cannot be quoted by the registration authority.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Appointments with the Vehicle Registration Authority Berlin can be arranged via the contact form.

name: Registration of a factory-new vehicle imported from the EU with registration certificate part II
description: This service registers a brand-new vehicle imported from the EU that has never been registered before, provided you possess all required documentation.
eligibility: The vehicle has never been registered (neither domestically nor abroad); you are in possession of all required documents.
requiredDocuments: Completed registration application form
SEPA direct debit mandate
ID card or passport with residence certificate (or officially certified copy)
Power of attorney if applicable, including ID document of the authorizer — unless it is a notarially executed power of attorney — and ID document of the authorized representative
Commercial register extract and business registration in original or certified copy, plus ID documents of the authorized representative (for businesses)
Association register extract in original or certified copy, plus ID documents of the authorized representative (for associations)

Registration certificate part II in conjunction with COC documents / data confirmation / expert report according to §13 EG-FGV for cars, trucks, trailers or expert report according to §21 StVZO (not older than 18 months) for motorcycles and special vehicles; entry for Germany is required in section 47 of the COC certificate (emissions class / emissions key)
Exemption permit if applicable, if deviations are found in the expert report according to §21 StVZO or §13 EG-FGV — in this case an application for an exemption permit must be submitted
Electronic insurance confirmation (eVB)
fees: The fee is determined according to the current fee schedule for road traffic measures and is at minimum 34.70 euros. Please note that this fee may be higher depending on the individual case and application specifics. If an exemption permit is required, separate fees apply. The manufacture of license plates is not a service of the Berlin vehicle registration authority; information about additional costs cannot be provided.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Registration of a factory-new vehicle imported from the EU without registration certificate part II
description: This service registers a brand-new vehicle imported from another EU country that has never been registered anywhere and for which you do not have registration certificate part II.
keywords: new car registration without part II
eligibility: The vehicle has never been registered (neither domestically nor abroad); you are in possession of all required documents.
requiredDocuments: Completed registration application form
VAT notification form for intra-community acquisition of a new motor vehicle (form available from the registration authority)
Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
If applicable: informal power of attorney including personal document of the grantor (unless notarially executed) and personal document of the authorized representative
Trade register extract and business registration in original or certified copy, plus personal documents of the authorized representative (for companies)
Association register extract in original or certified copy, plus personal documents of the authorized representative (for associations)

CoC papers or inspection report per §13 EG-FGV for cars, trucks, trailers, or inspection report per §21 StVZO (not older than 18 months) for motorcycles and special vehicles; entry for Germany required in section 47 of CoC certificate (emission class/emission key)
If applicable: exemption permit if deviations were found in the inspection report per §21 StVZO or §13 EG-FGV (exemption permit application must be submitted in this case)
Purchase contract or import certificate
SEPA direct debit mandate
Electronic insurance confirmation (eVB)
fees: Fees are determined according to the current road traffic fee schedule and amount to a minimum of €34.70. Please note that this fee may be higher depending on individual circumstances and the specific application. If an exemption permit is required, additional fees apply. License plate manufacturing is not a service of the Berlin vehicle registration authority; no information can be provided regarding additional costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Registration of a Used Vehicle Imported from a Non-EU Country
description: This service registers a used vehicle that was previously registered in a third country and is being imported to Berlin.
eligibility: The vehicle was already registered in a third country and you are in possession of all required documents. Please bring all documents in original form.
requiredDocuments: Application for vehicle registration (completed) (available under 'Formulare')
SEPA direct debit mandate (available under 'Formulare')
Identity card or passport with proof of registration (or officially certified copy)
Power of attorney if applicable, including personal documents of the person granting and receiving the power (unless it is a notarized power of attorney)
Extract from the commercial register and business registration in original or certified copy, plus personal documents of the authorized representative (for businesses)
Extract from the association register in original or certified copy, plus personal documents of the authorized representative (for associations)
Electronic insurance confirmation (eVB)
Customs clearance certificate (if not provided, the customs office will be notified of the vehicle import by the vehicle registration authority)

Full technical inspection report with technical data sheet according to § 21 StVZO (not older than 18 months) or COC documents or manufacturer data confirmation (COC or manufacturer confirmation is only sufficient if the third country vehicle documents show that the EC type approval number was recognized for registration there)
Exemption permit if applicable, when deviations in the inspection report according to § 21 StVZO are found (in this case, an application for an exemption permit must be submitted)
Foreign vehicle registration documents
Proof of authorization to dispose of the vehicle, e.g., purchase contract
Proof of valid main inspection according to § 29 StVZO
Foreign license plates if the vehicle is currently registered (if available)
fees: The fee is determined by the current fee regulation for road traffic measures and starts at 34.70 euros in the best case. Please note that this fee may be higher depending on the individual case — this depends on the specific application. If an exemption permit is required, separate fees apply. The production of license plates is not a service of the Berlin vehicle registration authority. No information can be provided about additional costs that may apply.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: You can schedule an appointment with the vehicle registration authority (Kfz-Zulassungsbehörde) through the contact form.

name: Registration of a New Vehicle Imported from a Non-EU Member State
description: This service allows you to register a new vehicle that has been imported from outside the EU and has never been registered anywhere before.
eligibility: The vehicle has never been registered before (neither domestically nor abroad); you possess all required documents.
requiredDocuments: Completed registration application form
ID card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
If applicable, informal power of attorney including identification document of the grantor—unless it is a notarized power of attorney—and identification document of the authorized representative
Extract from Commercial Register and business registration in original or certified copy (for businesses)
Extract from Association Register in original or certified copy (for associations)
SEPA direct debit mandate

CoC papers or expert report according to §13 EG-FGV for cars, trucks, trailers, or expert report according to §21 StVZO (not older than 18 months) for motorcycles and special vehicles. Entry for Germany must be present in item 47 of the CoC certificate (emission class/emission code).
If applicable, exemption permit if deviations were found in the expert report according to §21 StVZO or §13 EG-FGV. In this case, an application for an exemption permit must be submitted.

Electronic insurance confirmation (eVB)

processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Registration of a De-registered Vehicle with Berlin License Plate under a New Owner
description: This service allows the transfer of ownership of a previously de-registered vehicle with a Berlin license plate to another registered owner.
eligibility: For online processing, please refer to the 'Umschreibung' (Vehicle Transfer) service.
requiredDocuments: Application form
SEPA direct debit mandate
Proof of valid motor vehicle liability insurance via the eVB procedure with receipt of a seven-digit electronic insurance confirmation number (eVB)
ID card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)

Informal power of attorney if applicable, including ID document of the authorizing person unless it is a notarized power of attorney, and ID document of the authorized representative (also applies to businesses and associations if representation rights do not result from business registration or a register extract)

If the vehicle is to be registered to a business or association with headquarters or branch in Berlin: certified copies of management ID(s), business registration, extract from the commercial register (for a GmbH & Co. KG, the commercial register of the GmbH is also required), and extract from the association register
Vehicle registration certificate Part II / Vehicle title / Operating permit (for vehicles exempt from registration)
Vehicle registration certificate Part I / Vehicle registration document

Proof of valid main inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) according to § 29 StVZO; inspection report is only required if the due date for the next inspection cannot be determined from the vehicle registration document/ZBI
fees: €19.60 base fee plus additional fees for registration procedures such as technical modifications, particulate matter badge, personalized license plate, etc.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Additional appointments are released daily as capacity permits. Regular checking of the appointment platform is recommended.

name: Registration of a Vehicle with Foreign License Plate and Change of Owner
description: This service registers a vehicle that currently has a foreign license plate with a change of owner in Berlin.
eligibility: For online processing, please refer to the service 'Umschreibung' (Re-registration).
requiredDocuments: Application for vehicle registration (completed)
SEPA direct debit mandate
Proof of valid motor vehicle liability insurance via the eVB procedure with receipt of a seven-digit electronic insurance confirmation number (eVB)
Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)

Registration certificate Part II / Vehicle registration document / Operating permit (for vehicles not requiring registration)
Registration certificate Part I / Vehicle registration document
Previous license plate(s) — not required if the previous license plate(s) are retained

KG, the Commercial Register of the GmbH is also required); Extract from the Association Register
fees: €29.90 base fee plus additional fees for registration services such as technical modifications, fine dust sticker, personalized license plate, etc.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Within available capacity, additional appointments are released daily. Regular checking of the appointment platform is therefore recommended.

name: Registration of Vehicles for Passenger Transport (Taxis, Car Rentals, Medical Transport)
description: This service registers vehicles for use as taxis, rental cars, or medical transport vehicles, requiring prior authorization from the relevant government authority.
eligibility: You must have obtained a taxi concession, car rental concession, or authorization for medical transport operations (medical transport concession) from the State Office for Citizen and Regulatory Affairs — Department IV — Driver Licenses, Passenger and Freight Transport.
requiredDocuments: Application for registration (available under 'Forms')
Vehicle registration certificate part I (Fahrzeugschein)
Vehicle registration certificate part II (Fahrzeugbrief)
Authorization decision or authorization deed and business registration (Gewerbeanmeldung)
Electronic insurance confirmation (eVB) issued by the insurance company for use as taxi, rental car, or medical transport vehicle
Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
Valid main inspection (HU) report according to § 29 StVZO — the inspection report is only required if the next HU due date cannot be determined from the vehicle registration certificate
Power of attorney if applicable, including ID documents of the principal and authorized representative
Business register extract and business registration in original or certified copy (for companies)
Previous license plate(s)
SEPA direct debit mandate for vehicle tax collection (available under 'Forms')
fees: Fees are calculated according to the current Road Traffic Fees Regulation and vary by registration type. For changing a vehicle's use category after initial registration, the fee is €12.60. The manufacture of license plates is not a service provided by the Berlin Vehicle Registration Authority, and no information can be provided on additional costs.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Application for Admission to Retake the Second Legal State Examination for Grade Improvement
description: This service allows applicants who passed the Second Legal State Examination on their first attempt to apply for permission to retake it to improve their grade.
eligibility: You must have passed the Second Legal State Examination on your first attempt; You must submit your application for admission within two months after taking the oral examination (exclusion deadline).
requiredDocuments: Application for admission to retake the Second Legal State Examination for grade improvement (can be submitted in writing or electronically)
processingTime: Approximately 2 months

bookingInfo.office: Joint Legal Examination Office of the States of Berlin and Brandenburg at the Senate Department of Justice

name: Replace Vehicle Registration Certificate Part I (Vehicle Logbook) Due to Loss or Theft
description: This service allows you to obtain a replacement vehicle registration certificate (Part I / vehicle logbook) if your original document has been lost or stolen.
eligibility: The vehicle document has been lost or stolen. If stolen, a police report is required. For old vehicle documents (before 10/2005), only the vehicle registration authority can issue replacements. For online application: the vehicle must not be deregistered, must be registered in Berlin, and must have received registration papers from 01.10.2005 onwards. For online application with eID: you need an electronic ID card, EU citizen ID card, or electronic residence permit with activated eID function and PIN, an external card reader or modern NFC-capable smartphone (Android/iOS), and the AusweisApp software. For online payment: you must consent to electronic payment methods including credit card (Visa, Mastercard) or PayPal.
requiredDocuments: Application for replacement issuance of registration certificate Part I (can be submitted online, in person at citizen office without form, or at vehicle registration authority with completed form)
Identity document: passport or ID card and registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
Statutory declaration (Eidesstattliche Versicherung) if the original certificate was lost
Police theft report if the original certificate was stolen
Vehicle registration certificate Part II (Fahrzeugbrief) if none has been issued yet
Proof of valid inspection (HU certificate according to § 29 StVZO)
Registration certificate Part II or written consent from the bank holding it (required only when applying in person at citizen office)
Power of attorney and ID documents of both the authorizing person and authorized representative if applying by proxy (unless notarized power of attorney)
processingTime: Same day at vehicle registration authority; minimum 7 days if applying at citizen office; next business day for online applications

bookingInfo.office: All citizen offices (Bürgерamt) in Berlin regardless of residential location, or the vehicle registration authority (Kfz-Zulassungsbehörde). For old vehicle documents (before 10/2005), application must be made exclusively at the vehicle registration authority.

name: Request Registration Certificate Part II - Leasing Letter Information
description: This service allows you to request your vehicle's Registration Certificate Part II (Fahrzeugbrief) from your credit or leasing company and check its status with the registration authority.
eligibility: You must have previously commissioned your credit or leasing provider to transmit the Registration Certificate Part II to the registration authority.
requiredDocuments: Status inquiry for receipt of Registration Certificate Part II at the registration authority (online only)
Vehicle Identification Number (FIN)
or number of Registration Certificate Part II (Fahrzeugbrief)
fees: No fee for the status inquiry; 15.30 euros additionally for transmission and storage of the Registration Certificate Part II; 5.10 euros additionally if the Registration Certificate Part II should not be returned to the sender
processingTime: Immediate

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Replace Vehicle Registration Certificate Part II Due to Loss or Theft
description: This service replaces a lost or stolen vehicle registration certificate (Part II) for motor vehicles after completion of a publication procedure.
eligibility: Issuance of a registration certificate Part II is only possible after completion of the publication procedure. You must present the vehicle registration document (Part I). An affidavit (Versicherung an Eides Statt) by the last holder is required in case of loss. In case of theft, a police report (Diebstahlsanzeige) must be submitted.
requiredDocuments: Identity card or passport with registration certificate (or officially certified copy)
Power of attorney if applicable, including identification document of the principal (unless it is a notarized power of attorney) and identification document of the authorized representative
Commercial register extract and trade registration in original or certified copy (for businesses)
Proof of valid main inspection (HU report) if the date of the next main inspection does not appear in the submitted documents
Register of associations extract in original or certified copy (for associations)
Vehicle registration certificate Part I
Police report of theft or affidavit (Versicherung an Eides Statt) regarding the loss
fees: €13.80 for publication of the previous registration certificate Part II in the traffic gazette; €16.50 for issuance of new documents after successful publication.
processingTime: Approximately 3 weeks

bookingInfo.office: This service can be obtained at the vehicle registration office (Zulassungsbehörde) at the locations Berlin-Lichtenberg and Berlin Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg.

name: Consolidation of Multiple Incomes of the Debtor
description: A court service that consolidates multiple incomes of a debtor when several income sources are subject to or intended to be subject to garnishment.
eligibility: Multiple incomes of the debtor are garnished or are to be garnished. The debtor receives multiple incomes and these have been garnished by you or are to be (simultaneously) garnished. The type of income is irrelevant. It is possible to consolidate multiple work incomes, as well as work income and social benefits, and work income and benefits in kind.
requiredDocuments: Written application for consolidation of the debtor's incomes (can also be submitted in person at the legal application office of the court during office hours)
Evidence that the debtor's income has been garnished (if income garnishment has already occurred, the corresponding garnishment and payment orders must be presented)
Identity card or passport with registration certificate

Documentation of the requirements for consolidation of incomes (evidence of the existence of multiple incomes, if applicable confirmation of an already-executed garnishment of one of the incomes, the amount of the incomes, and their stability)
fees: The application is free of charge. Costs may be incurred for service of documents and copies.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: Competent is the enforcement court at the residence of the debtor or the enforcement court that issued the garnishment and payment order.

name: Request Reliability Check for Aviation
description: A security clearance process for aviation industry workers and pilots whose activities directly affect air traffic safety.
eligibility: You must be one of the following: personnel of airport and aviation companies, air traffic control organizations, aircraft repair facilities and maintenance businesses, cargo, mail or cleaning companies, or goods suppliers and comparable supply companies involved in secure supply chains whose work directly affects aviation safety; private pilots; or flight school students. For online application, you need an activated electronic ID function (eID).
requiredDocuments: Application for Reliability Check (can be submitted online or by mail)
Identity verification: two-sided copy of ID card or two-sided copy of passport
Employment history for the past 5 years (exact dates)
Residential addresses for the past 10 years
Certificate of registration if needed (not older than 4 weeks)
Certificate of good conduct or European Criminal Record Certificate if residing abroad for more than 6 months in the past 5 years
For pilots and flight school students: confirmation from flight school; pilot license for repeat checks
For self-employed: business registration certificate
For renewals: decision notice from previous reliability check
Residence permit including additional pages if applicable
fees: €5.00 to €150.00. Prepayment is only required for applicants with residence or regular stay abroad and employers in insolvency. Standard practice is bank transfer of fees after the decision is sent to the applicant (for flight students and private pilots) or notification to the employer (for all other applicants).
processingTime: 1-6 weeks

bookingInfo.office: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

name: Apply for Grants (FAZIT)
description: This service allows organizations to apply for grants through the FAZIT online system, request fund disbursements, and submit proof of use after project completion.
eligibility: You must have received a business reference number and been instructed by the authority to submit the online grant application; your organization must be registered in the Berlin State Transparency Database; for initial applications: the project has not yet started; for fund requests: the grant has been approved and the project has begun; for proof of use: the project is completed.
requiredDocuments: FAZIT grant application submitted online, then printed, manually signed, and mailed to the responsible office
All required documents and evidence ready for upload in PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, DOCX, or XLSX format (maximum total file size 45 MB, individual file maximum 15 MB)
Attachment to FAZIT grant application - Financing plan (online submission only, no postal mailing required)
Attachment to FAZIT grant application - Fee schedule, if applicable (online submission only, no postal mailing required)
Attachment to FAZIT grant application - Personnel plan, if applicable (online submission only, no postal mailing required)

Attachment to FAZIT grant application - Attachment to the Performance Provision Regulation (LGV), required for grants of €25,000 or more with more than 10 employees (submitted online, then printed, signed, and mailed)
FAZIT fund request submitted online, then printed, signed, and mailed to the responsible office

FAZIT proof of use attachments submitted online; numerical evidence/receipt list, inventory list, fee schedule for proof of use, and subject report submitted digitally only (no print or postal mailing); LGV attachment for proof of use printed, legally signed, and mailed; summary proof of use printed and signed, then mailed to the responsible office
Online subject reports describing the use of the grant and results achieved, submitted digitally only (no print or legal signature required)
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The responsible office is the grant approval authority for your project.

name: Foreclosure Auction - Bidding
description: This service allows residents to participate in foreclosure auctions of real estate properties by submitting bids and providing the required security deposit.
eligibility: You must be prepared to provide a security deposit immediately after submitting your bid if requested by parties involved in the proceedings (e.g., creditors or debtors). The security deposit amounts to 10% of the property's market value. Acceptable forms of security deposit: bank transfer to the account of the Judicial Cost Collection Office (KEJ), Bundesbank checks or clearing checks (must be issued by a domestic bank and dated no more than three business days before the auction date), or bank guarantees. Cash, savings books, securities, written bank confirmations of account balances, and private checks are not accepted as security deposits. The security deposit must be transferred approximately one week before the auction date. If the funds are not needed as a security deposit, the court will arrange for a refund immediately after the auction.
requiredDocuments: Valid personal identification card or passport (a driver's license is not sufficient)
Notarial proxy for bidding (if bidding for another person not present at the auction, including bidding for a spouse)

Certified commercial register extract (if bidding for a company such as a GmbH, to prove authorization to represent the company; should not be older than 15 days, though courts handle currency requirements differently)
Family court authorization (in individual cases, such as bidding for minor children, must be obtained in advance from the competent family court)
fees: No fees are charged for bidding. If you receive the highest bid and purchase the property, the foreclosure court will charge court fees according to the Court Costs Act (GKG), calculated based on the sum of the cash bid and the value of any assumed encumbrances (e.g., mortgages).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent foreclosure court is the district court (Amtsgericht) in whose jurisdiction the property is located.

name: Enforcement - Amendment of Exempt Income Amount
description: This service allows you to request an increase to the amount of your income that is exempt from garnishment if you have higher living expenses than the standard legal exemption.
eligibility: Your income is garnished through a garnishment and transfer order by your creditor; garnishable amounts are being paid to your creditor because your income exceeds your entitled basic exemption, meaning you cannot fully dispose of your income; you have higher necessary expenses than the monthly exemption amount under § 850c ZPO and can prove this, such as due to support obligations or documented illness with higher living costs.
requiredDocuments: Written application for amendment of the exempt income amount (can also be submitted orally at the court's legal services office)
Proof that your income has been garnished (copy of the garnishment and transfer order or the order opening insolvency proceedings over your assets)
Identity card or passport with registration certificate
Salary statements from the last 3 months and/or notices regarding any social benefits you receive

Proof of your higher necessary expenses or those of persons you are obligated to support (marriage or birth certificates if supporting multiple people; account statements from the last 3 months if dependents do not live in your household; cost evidence, medical certificates, or account statements for higher expenses due to personal or professional reasons; proof of the time period for which you require higher living expenses)
fees: The procedure incurs no court fees. Costs for serving the decision to all parties may apply at €3.50 per service in accordance with item 9002 of the Court Costs Regulation (KV GKG).
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The enforcement court or insolvency court at your place of residence, or the enforcement court that issued the garnishment and transfer order, or the insolvency court that opened insolvency proceedings over your assets.

name: Enforcement Objection — Objection to the Manner of Enforcement
description: A service that allows residents to file an objection against the manner in which a court enforcement officer or enforcement court conducts debt collection measures.
eligibility: You must have been affected by an enforcement measure (such as a garnishment and transfer order or a summons for asset disclosure) from a court enforcement officer or enforcement court, and the measure has not yet been completed. You may file an objection if you believe that: the court enforcement officer is refusing to carry out a creditor's order or is garnishing an item that you believe is non-garnishable; or the enforcement court failed to observe statutory requirements when issuing the garnishment and transfer order (for example, lack of territorial jurisdiction).
requiredDocuments: Written objection statement (Rechtsbehelf in Schriftform) — you must submit and substantiate your enforcement objection in writing
Letter/summons/protocol from the court enforcement officer (Schreiben/Ladung/Protokoll der Gerichtsvollzieherin oder des Gerichtsvollziehers)
Certified copy or copy of the challenged enforcement court measure (Ausfertigung/Kopie der angegriffenen Maßnahme des Vollstreckungsgerichts)
fees: The procedure is free. Costs may arise for service of documents and copies.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The enforcement court (Vollstreckungsgericht) responsible is the one in whose district the enforcement measure was carried out.

name: Enforcement - Garnishment Protection Account (P-Konto) - Request to Expand Garnishment Protection
description: A service to convert a standard checking account into a garnishment protection account (P-Konto) and request expansion of garnishment protection in Berlin.
eligibility: To obtain garnishment protection, you must convert your checking account into a garnishment protection account (P-Konto). Termination of your checking account is not required. You must notify your bank in writing with your IBAN that you wish to convert to a P-Konto. Protection applies retroactively to the first of the month if you initiate the conversion within 4 weeks of the garnishment order being received by the bank. You may also request the conversion as a precaution even without an existing garnishment. You may only maintain one checking account as a P-Konto. The P-Konto will be reported to SCHUFA. You must declare in your conversion letter that you do not operate another P-Konto. For an increased garnishment exemption: circumstances justifying the increase must be documented.
requiredDocuments: Application for garnishment protection/expansion of garnishment protection (submitted in writing by post, with written justification and IBAN of the account converted to P-Konto)
P-Konto certificate
Salary or wage statements from the last three months
Complete bank statements from the last three months up to the day of application
Garnishment and transfer orders (or specification of case reference and court issuing the order)
Marriage certificate (only if support obligations exist, e.g., to children or spouse)
Birth certificate or registration certificate for children living in your household (only if support obligations exist)
Birth certificate or paternity recognition document for children not living in your household (only if support obligations exist)
Bank statements from the last three months showing regular support payments for children, or other corresponding documents such as receipts from the child's mother (only if support obligations exist)
Employer certification that garnishment is already occurring (only if wage garnishment is already in place)
Amount of remaining balance to be garnished (only if wage garnishment is already in place)
Garnishment and transfer orders for wage garnishment or case reference and court details (only if wage garnishment is already in place)
Identity card or passport with registration certificate (only if submitting through the legal aid office of the competent enforcement court)

Certificate for submission to bank (from employer, family allowance office, social benefits provider, or debt and insolvency counseling service, to verify additional dependents, child allowance, or care allowance)
fees: No fees for the procedure; possible costs of up to 3.50 euros per service of orders to parties; possible costs of 0.50 euros per copy for the first 50 pages and 0.15 euros per page thereafter.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The competent enforcement court is the court that issued the garnishment and transfer order under which your account was garnished.

name: Misuse of Residential Space - Reporting and Approval
description: A service to obtain permission or report the non-residential use of apartment space in Berlin when public or private interests outweigh the interest in preserving the space for residential purposes.
eligibility: Permission may be granted on request if overriding public interests or protected private interests outweigh the public interest in preserving the residential space for permanent residential purposes. In exceptional cases, permission may be granted if the loss of residential space due to misuse is offset by the creation of adequate replacement housing. Replacement housing must be available to the housing market at reasonable conditions during the tight housing market situation and should be created in spatial proximity to or in the same district as the misused space. Alternatively, exemption from permission requirements is available for non-residential use of a maximum of 49% of living space in a Berlin primary residence if reported in advance to the district office.
requiredDocuments: Application form: Application for Permission for Non-Residential Use (including structural modifications) of Residential Space (available under 'Forms') — must include precise information about the affected residential unit and be submitted in writing to the competent district office (online submission not possible)
Detailed application justification with supporting documentation
Proof of ownership: current land register extract (if applicant is the authorized owner)
Power of attorney for representation (if application is not submitted by the owner, such as by property management companies)

Valid rental or sub-rental agreement and registration certificate plus landlord's written consent (if applicant is the tenant); or proof that the apartment is legally and factually vacant (if not rented)
Proof of Berlin primary residence (if applicable)

Residential floor area calculation in accordance with § 42 of the Second Calculation Ordinance (II. BV) in conjunction with the Residential Area Ordinance (WoFlV) and § 2 paragraph 1 of the Misuse Prevention Ordinance (ZwVbVO)

Notification of permission-free non-residential use of up to 49% of residential space of Berlin primary residence (available under 'Forms') — must be submitted in writing to the competent district office (online submission not possible); a confirmation of receipt with registration number will be issued by mail and must be publicly displayed when offering or advertising the space for non-residential purposes
fees: €77.00–€693.00 per application for vacancy approval; €225.00 per residential unit for misuse permission; €205.00 for demolition approval up to two residential units; €307.00 for demolition approval of more than two units; €225.00 per unit for permission to make structural changes rendering a unit unsuitable for residential use; €77.00–€231.00 for negative certificates without profit calculation; €231.00–€693.00 for negative certificates with profit calculation required; one-tenth to five-tenths of the full fee if application is withdrawn after processing begins or rejected; half the fee for modification requests to established permits; additional costs for expert assessments or appraisals as separate expenses; no separate fee for registration number assignment.
processingTime: Case- and application-dependent.

name: Second Home Tax Payment
description: A service for paying the annual second home tax (Zweitwohnungsteuer) on a residential property in Berlin where your primary residence is not located.
eligibility: You have a residential property in Berlin that you use or have available to you, but your primary residence is not in this property. It does not matter whether you own the property, rent it, or use it rent-free. However, if you do not use the property yourself but instead rent it to someone else, you do not have to pay second home tax on it.
requiredDocuments: Second home tax declaration (Zweitwohnungsteuererklärung) — must be submitted in writing by post
Lease agreement (copy) if available
Notices of rent changes (copy) if available
fees: The tax rate is 15 percent of the net cold rent (base rent excluding operating and heating costs) until December 31, 2024, and 20 percent from January 1, 2025 onward.
processingTime: Not stated on the page — check the official page for details.

bookingInfo.office: The Tax Office Mitte/Tiergarten (Finanzamt Mitte/Tiergarten) is responsible for the entire Berlin area.
